text.title: 把宝宝放进摇篮！
text.objectives: 与奥丹姆神殿的哈里森·琼斯交谈。
text.description: 哟！$b$b你跟琼斯一路晃悠到这里来啦？！$b$b$g喝着小酒:手拉着手;，闲庭信步，肯定错不了。$b$b先别闲得发慌了，真正的苦差事才刚开始！$b$b这件古代神器所隐藏的秘密比你们预想中的更多，但是要揭开这些秘密，我们就得把它送到远古的摇篮去！$b$b你觉得我们该怎么办呢？$b$b也许琼斯会想出些好点子来？
text.completion: Of course I have a plan for moving the coffer. Someday, maybe the old coot will learn to trust me.

english.title: Put That Baby in the Cradle!
english.objectives: Speak to Harrison Jones at the Temple of Uldum.
english.description: Och!$b$bYou an' junior took yer sweet time gettin'  'ere, din't ya!?$b$b$gDrinkin' ale:Holdin' hands;, takin' in the sights, I'll wager.$b$bDon't go breakin' yer arm pattin' yerself on the back now, the real work's just beginnin'!$b$bThere be more ta this ancient artifact than ye know, but in order ta reveal its secrets, we need ta get it to the Cradle of the Ancients!$b$bNow howdya spose we do that?$b$bMaybe junior over there has some bright ideas, eh?
english.completion: Of course I have a plan for moving the coffer. Someday, maybe the old coot will learn to trust me.

text.title: 三人飞行
text.objectives: 在奥丹姆神殿中使用信号弹。
text.description: 我原本打算把箱子带回我的实验室进行研究，不过看样子布莱恩有别的想法。$b$b他认为自己有办法阻止死亡之翼在奥丹姆的行动。$b$b我的老伙计约克已经把运输工具准备好了，就等我们的信号。$b$b拿着这些信号弹，把它们放置在周围，让他知道我们已经准备好了。
text.completion: Nice work, lad. Looks as tho everything made the trip in one piece. I'm beginnin' ta see why junior keeps ye around.
text.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard at the Cradle of the Ancients.

english.title: Three if by Air
english.objectives: Use the Signal Flares at the Temple of Uldum.
english.description: I had planned on bringing the coffer back to my lab for study, but it seems Brann here has different ideas.$b$bHe thinks he knows how to put a stop to Deathwing's plans here in Uldum.$b$bMy buddy, Jock, is standing by with the transport, just waiting for our signal.$b$bTake these flares and plant them around the perimeter to let him know that we're ready.
english.completion: Nice work, lad. Looks as tho everything made the trip in one piece. I'm beginnin' ta see why junior keeps ye around.
english.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard at the Cradle of the Ancients.

text.title: 朝西方挺进
text.objectives: 去找奥丹姆尼斐塞特城郊的法奥瑞斯国王。
text.description: 我们在这里的工作完成了，$n。我们克服万难，阻止了尼斐塞特人进入纳奥姆。$B$B让我们和大部队一起朝西推进，别让他们把功劳都独吞了。$B$B他们现在应该抵达尼斐塞特城郊了。
text.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.

english.title: The Push Westward
english.objectives: Report to King Phaoris at the Neferset City Outskirts in Uldum.
english.description: Our work is done here, $n.  Against all odds, we stopped the Neferset advance on Nahom.$B$BLet us join the forces pushing west, lest they take all the glory for themselves.$B$BThey must've reached the outskirts of Neferset City by now.
english.completion: You've arrived just in time, $n.

text.title: 爱吹嘘的基尔拉姆
text.objectives: 跟迪兹·石爆谈一谈。
text.description: 呸！粗糙又笨拙的锤子！$B$B你需要的不仅仅是力量。我的斧头和莉莉丝的锤子一样坚固，但是它更为锋利，可以直接劈开大树！$B$B没错，一斧头就能劈开！我要在大家面前证明这一点。去问问迪兹，看他能不能搞来一棵树！
text.completion: They want a tree now? Let's see what I got.

english.title: Kilram's Boast
english.objectives: Speak with Deez Rocksnitch.
english.description: Pah! Crude and clumsy is all I see!$B$BYou need more than just strength. My axes are just as strong as Lilith's maces, but so sharp, I can cut through a tree in one chop!$B$BYou heard me, one chop! I'll prove it, too, here in front of everyone. Go ask Deez if he can get a tree in here!
english.completion: They want a tree now? Let's see what I got.

text.title: 砍啊砍
text.objectives: 从霜叶树人身上收集10片刚切下的冻心木料。
text.description: 我是做细木工料生意的，但是你一次要一整棵树？这对我来说还是有点新鲜，跟砾石生意一样奇怪。$B$B你可以再帮我一个忙吗？镇子以西的凯斯利尔湖旁有一片树林。不知道是幽灵还是精灵的魔法作用，最近树人和鞭笞者在那里频繁出没。$B$B他们的出现令伐木作业难以继续，不然你去消灭一些好吗？从树人身上收集木材，然后带回来给我。
text.progress: Show me the lumber.
text.completion: Not a bad haul. Maybe we should look into growin' those treants instead...
text.completed: Return to Deez Rocksnitch at Everlook in Winterspring.

english.title: Chop Chop
english.objectives: Collect 10 pieces of Fresh-Cut Frostwood from Frostleaf Treants.
english.description: I deal in small timber plenty, but full trees? That's a novelty item. Kinda like those boulders.$B$BMaybe you can do me another favor. Just west of town there's a grove of trees overlooking Lake Kel'theril. I don't know if it's the spooks there, or all that elf magic junk strewn around the place, but we've been getting treants and lashers wandering around there recently.$B$BThey're making it a real pain to chop wood over there, so why don't you chop some of them? Bring the wood from the treants back here.
english.progress: Show me the lumber.
english.completion: Not a bad haul. Maybe we should look into growin' those treants instead...
english.completed: Return to Deez Rocksnitch at Everlook in Winterspring.

text.title: 大树到货
text.objectives: 将超易用速植树交给永望镇的基尔拉姆。
text.description: 给，一个速成的超易用速植树，由80%的天然材料制造而成！$B$B不含树根，简单方便。把它交给基尔拉姆，告诉他，使用时要退后。
text.progress: Chop chop!
text.completion: Alright! Stand back now and watch what a true quality weapon can do!
text.completed: Report to Kilram at Everlook in Winterspring.

english.title: Tree Delivery
english.objectives: Deliver the Super-Gro Insta-Tree to Kilram at the inn in Everlook.
english.description: Here you go, one instant Super-Gro Insta-Tree made with 80% natural ingredients!$B$BNo roots, no muss, no fuss. Just give it to Kilram and make sure he stands the heck back when he uses it.
english.progress: Chop chop!
english.completion: Alright! Stand back now and watch what a true quality weapon can do!
english.completed: Report to Kilram at Everlook in Winterspring.

text.title: 爱吹嘘的瑟里尔
text.objectives: 跟迪兹·石爆谈一谈。
text.description: 粗制滥造，业余。$B$B如果你只需要像食人魔那样抓着武器乱劈一通，那它是否锋利是否耐用根本就不重要。我可以滔滔不绝地讲述技巧、速度、平衡、控制等等要素……但是要证明我的武器更胜一筹也很容易。$B$B告诉迪兹，我要订货。我需要一块冰。
text.completion: Oh, it's you again! I'm so surprised!

english.title: Seril's Boast
english.objectives: Speak with Deez Rocksnitch.
english.description: Brutes and amateurs.$B$BIt doesn't matter how sharp or heavy your weapon is if all it's good for is hacking like an ogre. I could go on and on about finesse and speed and balance and control... but it's easier to one-up these fools.$B$BTell Deez we've got one more order for him. I need a block of ice.
english.completion: Oh, it's you again! I'm so surprised!

text.title: 冰块到货
text.objectives: 将速效寒冰屏障交给永望镇的瑟里尔。
text.description: 好啦，高品质高纯度的速效寒冰屏障！$B$B我原本已经厌倦了出售这些保护用品。就像法师施放的那个法术，你知道吧？我始终没想通他们在寒冰屏障下是如何“呼吸”的。
text.progress: Ah, you're back!
text.completion: Perfect. Now you'll see what really matters in a weapon... finesse.

english.title: Ice Delivery
english.objectives: Deliver the Instant Ice Block to Seril Scourgebane in Everlook.
english.description: Alright, one high-quality, pure grade Instant Ice Block!$B$BI tried selling these to people for protection for a while. Y'know, like that trick you see mages pull? Couldn't figure out the whole "breathing" thing, though.
english.progress: Ah, you're back!
english.completion: Perfect. Now you'll see what really matters in a weapon... finesse.

text.title: 雪怪计划！
text.objectives: 从冰蓟雪人身上收集10张厚雪人毛皮。
text.description: 我的朋友们总有着各种好主意，我一直觉得自己比不上他们……直到今天！我刚刚想出了一个很好的计划！如果你保证不告诉其他人，我就告诉你这个秘密……$B$B我要做一个机械雪人！我的朋友们肯定会被它吓一跳，并为之惊叹的！$B$B我需要一些冰蓟雪人身上的厚雪人毛皮。东南面的冰蓟岭有很多冰蓟雪人。
text.progress: 我有很多准备工作要做，请你尽快把毛皮交给我!
text.completion: 这些皮毛非常完美，$N。好的开始是成功的一半!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Umi Rumplesnicker at Everlook in Winterspring.

english.title: Are We There, Yeti?
english.objectives: Collect 10 Thick Yeti Furs from Ice Thistle Yeti.
english.description: My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! I just drew up the plans for something great! If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret... $B$BI'm going to make a mechanical yeti! Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed!$B$BI need thick yeti fur from the ice thistle yeti. There's plenty of them in the Ice Thistle Hills to the southeast.
english.progress: I've got lots to get started on here. Please get me those furs as soon as you can!
english.completion: These furs are perfect, $n. We're off to a great start here!
english.completed: Return to Umi Rumplesnicker at Everlook in Winterspring.

text.title: 回音3号
text.objectives: 找到回音3号。
text.description: 有许多地精在冰蓟岭一带失踪了。我几乎也是其中之一！$B$B我曾经想了个点子，安装了一台感应器，可以在雪人靠近永望镇的时候发出警报。当然了，它根本没正常运作过。漫山遍野都是雪人，它从来都没有响过哪怕一声。$B$B你能去帮我检查一下吗？也许它还可以修好呢。回音3号就在冰蓟岭的东南边缘。至于回音1号和回音2号出了什么事，就别问了。
text.completion: Part of this machine is still moving, but on closer inspection it's been severely manhandled. The metal is dented and cracked, and there's huge footprints in the snow all around it.$B$BIn fact, it sounds like something's approaching right now...

english.title: Echo Three
english.objectives: Find Echo Three.
english.description: A lot of goblins have been going missing out there in Ice Thistle Hills. I was almost one of them!$B$BI had the idea to set up a sensor to tell us when the yeti were getting close to Everlook. Of course, it's not working either. There's yeti all over the hills and I haven't heard a peep from it.$B$BWould you mind checking on it for me? It might still be fixable. Echo Three's set up to the southeast on the edge of Ice Thistle Hills. Don't ask what happened to Echo One and Two.
english.completion: Part of this machine is still moving, but on closer inspection it's been severely manhandled. The metal is dented and cracked, and there's huge footprints in the snow all around it.$B$BIn fact, it sounds like something's approaching right now...

text.title: 完美的角
text.objectives: 获得冰隆隆的原始之角。
text.description: 没有角，还怎么制造雪人啊！$B$B我寻觅完美的雪人角已经有好些日子了……但是从来没有找到过靠谱的！不过前几天我看到了冬泉谷里面最大个的雪人。$B$B我管他叫冰隆隆。他的角正是我要找的东西！他就藏在冰蓟岭东部山脊深处的洞穴里。$B$B把他的角给我带来……路上别忘了看看回音3号！
text.progress: Are they perfect? They better be perfect!
text.completion: 我等不及要给我的朋友展示这个机械雪人了!现在，稍等片刻，我这就把它们安上去……$B$B太完美了!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Umi Rumplesnicker at Everlook in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 看看那双漂亮的角！

english.title: The Perfect Horns
english.objectives: Obtain Icewhomp's Pristine Horns.
english.description: I can't make a yeti without horns!$B$BI've been looking for what seems like forever for the perfect set of horns... and no horn I find is good enough! But just the other day I saw the biggest yeti in Winterspring.$B$BI named him Icewhomp. His horns are the ones I've been looking for! He lurks all the way in the back of the cave along the eastern ridge of Ice Thistle Hills.$B$BBring me his horns... but be sure to check on Echo Three along the way!
english.progress: Are they perfect? They better be perfect!
english.completion: I can't wait to show my friends! Now, just wait a moment while I attach these...$B$BPerfect!
english.completed: Return to Umi Rumplesnicker at Everlook in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: Just look at those beautiful horns!

text.title: 新鲜的冰块
text.objectives: 在冰蓟岭的洞穴中收集7块纯净的冰川寒冰。
text.description: 这次是冰块？好吧。我有一个好消息和一个坏消息。$B$B好消息是永望镇以东，冰蓟岭的洞穴里就有纯净的冰块。坏消息是一群邪恶的雪人居住在那里。$B$B只要解决掉那些雪人就行。嗨，这对你来说是小菜一碟吧！挑选体积较大的冰块，用你的武器打破它们。把冰块带回来给我，剩下的事我来办。
text.progress: Oh, you're back! How were the yetis?
text.completion: Not bad! Let's hope they don't ask for lava or something next, right?
text.completed: Return to Deez Rocksnitch at Everlook in Winterspring.

english.title: Fresh From The Hills
english.objectives: Collect 7 Pieces of Pure Glacier Ice from the cavern in Icethistle Hills.
english.description: Ice this time? Hoo boy, sure. I've got good news and bad news for you.$B$BThe good news is there's a bunch of pure solid ice over in the Ice Thistle Hills cavern, straight east from Everlook. The bad news is there's also a bunch of vicious yetis in there.$B$BBut if you can handle the yeti, hey, piece of cake! Just walk right up to the bigger chunks and crack 'em open with your weapon. Bring it all back to me and I'll do my thing.
english.progress: Oh, you're back! How were the yetis?
english.completion: Not bad! Let's hope they don't ask for lava or something next, right?
english.completed: Return to Deez Rocksnitch at Everlook in Winterspring.

text.title: 应许约柜
text.objectives: 把应许约柜中的东西交给布莱恩·铜须。
text.description: 我不知道会有什么东西冒出来，所以你要提高警惕，好吗？$b$b这些密码应该可以揭示应许约柜的真正用途，并使我们有机会在奥丹姆击败死亡之翼！$b$b后退！
text.progress: Well, now.$b$bWould ya look at that!?
text.completion: Of course! I had a hunch this is what we'd find. Had no idea about the organic transformations, though, I must admit. There's more to this old relic than I'd dared to hope.
text.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard in the Cradle of the Ancients.

english.title: The Coffer of Promise
english.objectives: Give Brann Bronzebeard the contents of the Coffer of Promise.
english.description: I'm not quite certain what ta expect 'ere, so stay on yer toes, eh?$b$bThese codes should reveal the coffer's true purpose, and present us with the tools to thwart Deathwing's efforts in Uldum fer good!$b$bStand back!
english.progress: Well, now.$b$bWould ya look at that!?
english.completion: Of course! I had a hunch this is what we'd find. Had no idea about the organic transformations, though, I must admit. There's more to this old relic than I'd dared to hope.
english.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard in the Cradle of the Ancients.

text.title: 大灭绝
text.objectives: 杀死12只暴怒的枭兽。
text.description: 枭兽……这些来自扭曲虚空最黑暗的深渊的羽兽，肆意袭击弱小的生灵。$B$B<尼尔斯指着环绕东点哨塔的丛林。>$B$B这里四面八方都能找到它们的踪影，我知道，它们随时准备发起进攻。你必须先发制人。$B$B我要你进入丛林，杀死你撞见的所有枭兽。杀光它们！
text.completion: The itching has stopped - for now - but they will return.$B$BOh yes, they will return...
text.completed: Return to Nils Beerot at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Extinction
english.objectives: Kill 12 Rampaging Owlbeasts.
english.description: Owlbeasts... Soulless, feathered monstrosities sent from the darkest depths of the Twisting Nether to prey upon the weak.$B$B<Nils points to the woods surrounding Eastpoint Tower.>$B$BThey surround us on all sides and they are planning an attack - I can sense it. You must stop them before they can organize.$B$BI want you to head into the forest and kill every owlbeast that you see. NONE SHOULD SURVIVE!
english.completion: The itching has stopped - for now - but they will return.$B$BOh yes, they will return...
english.completed: Return to Nils Beerot at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 闹鬼事件
text.objectives: 调查丹加洛克是否有闹鬼的现象。
text.description: 丹加洛克爆发了希尔斯布莱德丘陵区域最为血腥的战役。矮人们以一挡十，苦苦支撑直到咽下最后一口气。他们在那场保卫战中全部牺牲。$B$B从那之后，我就听说丹加洛克闹鬼了。没有人敢靠近那里！但是上头命令我清理废墟，准备驻军。$B$B你能帮我个忙，去丹加洛克查探闹鬼事件吗？就在遥远的东南方。
text.completion: Haunted? Ye could say that!
text.end: 调查丹加洛克的闹鬼事件。
text.completed: Speak to Captain Ironhill's Ghost at Dun Garok in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: A Haunting in Hillsbrad
english.objectives: Search Dun Garok for evidence of a haunting.
english.description: The battle over Dun Garok was the bloodiest of all the Hillsbrad battles. The dwarves, outnumbered ten-to-one, fought until the bitter end. Every last one of 'em died in defense of that piece of land.$B$BNow I hear claims that the place is haunted. Nobody wants to go near it! Unfortunately I have orders to prepare Dun Garok for habitation.$B$BCould you do me a favor and go to Dun Garok and search for evidence of a haunting? It's far to the southeast.
english.completion: Haunted? Ye could say that!
english.end: Search Dun Garok for Evidence of a Haunting.
english.completed: Speak to Captain Ironhill's Ghost at Dun Garok in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 沉默的矮人
text.objectives: 杀死10个丹加洛克鬼魂。
text.description: 士兵的灵魂仍在这座堡垒徘徊，$g小伙子:姑娘;。他们被禁锢在这里。即便在死后，他们也要为保卫此地而战。这真令人感伤。$B$B结束他们的痛苦吧，说不定你还能顺手收获一些战利品。
text.completion: They fight for their land even after death - much like the Forsaken. I will report back to high command that Dun Garok is uninhabitable. Let them keep what they hold so dear.
text.completed: Return to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Silence of the Dwarves
english.objectives: Kill 10 Dun Garok Spirits.
english.description: The spirits of my soldiers haunt this fort now, $g lad:lass;. Their souls are now bound to this place. Even in death they continue to fight for it. 'Tis sad.$B$BPut 'em out o' their misery and perhaps ye shall have the spoils of yer people's victory.
english.completion: They fight for their land even after death - much like the Forsaken. I will report back to high command that Dun Garok is uninhabitable. Let them keep what they hold so dear.
english.completed: Return to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 美味的熊肉
text.objectives: 杀死15头碎齿熊。
text.description: 你曾经有没有奢侈过一把尝尝熊肉？我以前在吉尔尼斯的时候，可从来没有这种机会，但是这里的熊实在是美妙啊。$B$B南边的碎齿熊生有厚厚的皮脂，以此抵御这里的严酷寒流。我一直享受着猎熊的乐趣，不过我更喜欢吃它们的肉！$B$B我建议你也去试试。挑那些白色毛皮的碎齿熊下手，队长会将你杀掉的猎物统统带回来的。
text.completion: Simply splendid! I've been watching the Captain bring bear after bear back to camp and I can't wait to see them thrown on the smoker.$B$BPerhaps I'll have a taste of them raw...
text.completed: Return to Francis Morcott at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
text.turninWindow: 嗯……熊肉……

english.title: A Taste for Bear
english.objectives: Kill 15 Shardtooth bears.
english.description: Have you ever had the luxury of trying bear meat? I never had the chance to try it in Gilneas, but the bears here are simply exquisite.$B$BThe shardtooth bears that roam just to the south are well-marbled with fat from the cold here. I've been hunting them myself, and it's quite a lark, but I much prefer eating them!$B$BI recommend you try your hand at the hunt. Stick to the white-pelted Shardtooth bears, and the Captain will go to field to bring back any you kill.
english.completion: Simply splendid! I've been watching the Captain bring bear after bear back to camp and I can't wait to see them thrown on the smoker.$B$BPerhaps I'll have a taste of them raw...
english.completed: Return to Francis Morcott at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
english.turninWindow: Mmm... bear...

text.title: 美味的枭肉
text.objectives: 杀死15只冬泉巨枭。
text.description: 我这辈子都一直在吃枭肉。枭肉很好吃，我的朋友杰兹也这么说。我是第一个建议他售卖枭的人！$B$B那位娘里娘气的狼人觉得熊肉更好吃，别信他的鬼话。你应该去狩猎枭。它们就栖息在南面。你的目标是那些灰色的巨枭，狩猎成功的话，就按下杰兹给你那个小玩意儿通知我。
text.completion: The Captain's been bringin' back bags full of owl, and I can't wait to try it! Maybe Mr. Fancypants Francis here will even try some.
text.turninWindow: 这个喋喋不休的家伙令我很困惑。

english.title: The Owls Have It
english.objectives: Slay 15 Winterspring Owls.
english.description: I've been eatin' owls my whole life. Owls is good eatin', and my friend Jez agrees. I was the first one that told him to sell owl!$B$BMister fancy-pants worgen here says bears taste better, but don't pay him no mind. You should go hunt yourself some owl. There's plenty of 'em wandering just south of here. Stick to the gray ones for now, an' buzz me on the little talky-thing Jez gave you when you've racked up a few.
english.completion: The Captain's been bringin' back bags full of owl, and I can't wait to try it! Maybe Mr. Fancypants Francis here will even try some.
english.turninWindow: This here fancy talky thing just confuses me.

text.title: 尤西乌斯
text.objectives: 杀死尤西乌斯。
text.description: 我听过一个说法，吃什么补什么。我不知道这个说法可不可信，但是如果是真的……我就该吃掉最强壮的动物。$b$b尤西乌斯是冬泉谷最大的熊。每当碎齿熊集体捕获奇美拉或是枭熊时，尤西乌斯有权优先享受猎物。它占据着碎齿熊领地内最舒适的洞穴。而且……它总能得到母熊的青睐。$b$b我也担当着领头熊的职责。$b$b我要吃掉它。$b$b它的洞穴就在碎齿暴熊的领地附近。去吧，祝你好运！
text.completion: Ursius is... not delicious.  He tastes like a combination of pinecones and curdled milk, only... oilier.$b$bAre you sure this is Ursius?  The big bear?  In the cave?$b$bThis is horrible.  It honestly tastes like his meat has been steeped in urine.$b$bI don't feel like I'm getting any stronger.$b$bUgh.  It's really bad.  Do you want to try some?
text.completed: Return to Francis Morcott at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 尤西乌斯是我的。

english.title: Ursius
english.objectives: Kill Ursius.
english.description: I've heard it said that you are what you eat. I don't know if I believe that, but if it's true... I'd prefer to eat the strongest creature that I can find.$b$bUrsius is the largest bear in Winterspring. He eats first when his pack of shardtooth brings down a chimaera or an owlbear. He claims the most comfortable cave in the shardtooth-held lands. And he has... considerable influence with the shardtooth females.$b$bHe is my kind of bear.$b$bI want to eat him.$b$bHis cave is near the maulers. Good luck!
english.completion: Ursius is... not delicious.  He tastes like a combination of pinecones and curdled milk, only... oilier.$b$bAre you sure this is Ursius?  The big bear?  In the cave?$b$bThis is horrible.  It honestly tastes like his meat has been steeped in urine.$b$bI don't feel like I'm getting any stronger.$b$bUgh.  It's really bad.  Do you want to try some?
english.completed: Return to Francis Morcott at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: Ursius must be mine.

text.title: 新鲜的豹肉
text.objectives: 杀死15只霜刃豹或是霜刃捕食者。
text.description: 闻起来很棒吧？我的熏肉售价昂贵，但是冬泉谷供应这样的珍馐仅此一家。并且很高效；我给你一点钱，你帮我狩猎，我的其他好朋友则将猎物拖回这里进行剥皮和熏烤！$B$B眼下，霜刃豹肉很受欢迎。豹肉非常鲜美，适合灌制香肠。去西边猎杀这种猫科动物吧，我们的合作就此开始！
text.completion: Alright! Don't stop now, we're after the big ones next!
text.turninWindow: 你继续狩猎，我继续烹饪！

english.title: Fresh Frostsabers
english.objectives: Slay 15 Frostsabers or Frostsaber Stalkers.
english.description: Doesn't that smell great? My smoked meats get top dollar, and nobody else provides the exotic flavors I've got out here in the hills. And it's efficient; you just do the hunting for a small fee, and my other fine friends drag the beasts back here for skinnin' and smokin'!$B$BI've got the market cornered on Frostsaber meat right now. Absolutely delicious stuff, makes great sausages. Head out and hunt those cats just west of here, and we'll call that a start!
english.completion: Alright! Don't stop now, we're after the big ones next!
english.turninWindow: You keep huntin' and I'll keep smokin'!

text.title: 餐桌上的珍馐
text.objectives: 杀死15只霜刃雌豹或是霜刃守卫者。
text.description: 好啦孩子，是时候继续深入野外了！$B$B霜刃豹的狩猎很成功，但是再往西走，你就会发现体型更大的猫科动物。霜刃雌豹和霜刃守卫者的肉质非常紧密，是制作汉堡包的上等食材。非常好卖！$B$B当你猎杀到足够数量的大猫时，就告诉我一声。接下来我会让你准备主菜的。
text.completion: Beautiful! I'm watching the Captain drag this all back right now and it's a gorgeous sight.$B$BAnd the next course...
text.giverWindow: 狩猎很有趣！
text.turninWindow: 还有一只！

english.title: Pride of the Dinner Table
english.objectives: Slay 15 Frostsaber Huntresses or Frostsaber Pride Watchers.
english.description: Alright kid, time to head out further into the field!$B$BThis haul's nice and good, but further to the west you'll find much bigger kitties. The pride watchers and huntresses have a lot more muscle on them, and it makes AMAZING burger patties. They sell like crazy!$B$BGimme a ping when you've cleared house and we'll see about you going after the main course.
english.completion: Beautiful! I'm watching the Captain drag this all back right now and it's a gorgeous sight.$B$BAnd the next course...
english.giverWindow: Huntin's good clean fun!
english.turninWindow: We got one more left!

text.title: Shy-Rotam
text.objectives: 永望镇的斯托姆·影蹄想要你去杀死希洛塔姆。
text.description: 在冬泉谷的北方，有一大群凶猛的雪豹聚集在一处被称作霜刀石的地方。这些豹子的首领是希洛塔姆。打败她，你的同伴就会对你充满敬意。$B$B再去一次冬泉谷，一到那里就开始从霜刃豹身上搜集它们的肉。找到希洛塔姆之石，把肉放在那里，这样就可以召来愤怒的希洛塔姆。$B$B迎战狂怒的霜刃豹首领，并打败她。
text.completed: Return to Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring.

english.title: Shy-Rotam
english.objectives: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.
english.description: In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow $r.$B$BGo again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger.$B$BBe ready for her fury, and defeat her.
english.completed: Return to Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring.

text.title: 敦霍尔德挑战赛：泽菲鲁斯
text.objectives: 杀死泽菲鲁斯。
text.description: 敦霍尔德城堡历来是刀兵之地。人类曾经以这里作为关押兽人的收容所许多年。后来，辛迪加占领了这座城堡。现在？黑暗女王捕捉了一些强大的元素生物，把它们关在城堡中。她任命我来负责“敦霍尔德挑战赛”。任何能够击败所有元素生物的人都可以获得丰厚的奖励！拿着这份指南，去迎接你的第一个挑战：泽菲鲁斯！$B$B敦霍尔德就在我们的东北边。
text.completion: Zephyrus was a mighty adversary. Surely the remaining elementals will challenge you further!$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
text.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 奥拉基尔的爪牙

english.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Zephyrus
english.objectives: Kill Zephyrus.
english.description: Durnholde Keep has always been a place of strife. For years the humans used it as an internment camp and prison for the orcs. After that it was taken over by the Syndicate. Now? The Dark Lady captured and placed powerful elementals within its walls. She charged me with administering "The Durnholde Challenge." Any that can defeat all of the elementals will earn a grand prize! Take this guide and face your first challenge: Zephyrus!$B$BDurnholde is located just northeast of us.
english.completion: Zephyrus was a mighty adversary. Surely the remaining elementals will challenge you further!$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
english.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Minion of Al'Akir

text.title: 敦霍尔德挑战赛：特拉库纳
text.objectives: 杀死特拉库纳。
text.description: 根据指南所述，你的下一个敌人是特拉库纳。它就在泽菲鲁斯的巢穴外游荡。
text.completion: Teracula was an even mightier adversary than Zephyrus.$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
text.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 塞拉赞恩的爪牙

english.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Teracula
english.objectives: Kill Teracula.
english.description: According to the guide, Teracula is your next challenge. It roams the path just outside of Zephyrus' lair.
english.completion: Teracula was an even mightier adversary than Zephyrus.$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
english.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Minion of Therazane

text.title: 敦霍尔德挑战赛：布纳维隆
text.objectives: 杀死布纳维隆。
text.description: 根据指南所述，你的下一个敌人是布纳维隆。这个可怕的元素生物就在敦霍尔德城堡下层，西部监狱的附近。
text.completion: Now you know why the monster was called Bloodvenom. What challenges remain?$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
text.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 耐普图隆的爪牙

english.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Bloodvenom
english.objectives: Kill Bloodvenom.
english.description: According to the guide, Bloodvenom is your next challenge. The fearsome elemental can be found on the lower level of Durnholde Keep, near the western prisons.
english.completion: Now you know why the monster was called Bloodvenom. What challenges remain?$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
english.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Minion of Neptulon

text.title: 敦霍尔德挑战赛：因弗努斯
text.objectives: 杀死因弗努斯。
text.description: 根据指南所述，你的下一个敌人是因弗努斯。这个生物是由熔岩和怒火组成，它就在敦霍尔德城堡下层，东部监狱的附近。
text.completion: Though you have defeated the four elements, one final challenge awaits. What could it be?$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
text.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 拉格纳罗斯的爪牙

english.title: The Durnholde Challenge: Infernus
english.objectives: Kill Infernus.
english.description: According to the guide, Infernus is your next challenge. This being, made of molten lava and raging fire, can be found on the lower level of Durnholde Keep, near the eastern prisons.
english.completion: Though you have defeated the four elements, one final challenge awaits. What could it be?$B$B<You open the guide that Jekyll gave to you.>
english.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Minion of Ragnaros

text.title: 敦霍尔德挑战赛：D-1000
text.description: 被囚禁在古老的敦霍尔德城堡竞技场中的，是由纯水银构成的元素生物。被遗忘者将其称为D-1000。杀死D-1000，赢得你的奖赏！
text.completion: This is the first time anyone has actually completed the challenge. You truly are a powerful $c, $n. As promised, choose your reward.
text.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
text.giverWindow: 布鲁的爪牙

english.title: The Durnholde Challenge: D-1000
english.objectives: Kill the D-1000.
english.description: Imprisoned in the old Durnholde Keep arena is a being comprised of pure mercury. The Forsaken have dubbed it the D-1000. Kill the D-1000 and claim your prize!
english.completion: This is the first time anyone has actually completed the challenge. You truly are a powerful $c, $n. As promised, choose your reward.
english.completed: Report to Captain Jekyll at Eastpoint Tower in Hillsbrad Foothills.
english.giverWindow: Minion of Blue

text.title: 一份特殊的惊喜
text.objectives: 赤色烈焰礼拜堂的骑士团指挥官普雷菲斯特希望你去处决牢房里的银色黎明俘虏，哈尔福特勋爵。
text.description: 我们来这儿之后，把这个地方夷为了平地，然后我们又向牢房进发。在那里看到的一切完全出乎我们的意料，$n。看来血色十字军真的很忙。那里塞满了银色黎明的俘虏，我们到那儿的时候，大部分俘虏都已经死了，只剩少数几个奄奄一息。$B$B我本来准备去那儿解决剩下的那几个的，但是我想这份荣耀应该让给你。尤其是，里面有一个感染了瘟疫的狼人，我想你一定会在处决中寻找到的极大的快感的。
text.completion: Felt good, didn't it? You're not one of them anymore, $n. You're Scourge. You're one of us. Forever...
text.completed: Return to Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

english.title: A Special Surprise
english.objectives: Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Lord Harford, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.
english.description: We got here, tore the place apart, and headed toward the prison house. We weren't expecting what we found in there, $n. Seems the Crusade's been real busy. That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$B$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty worgen in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.
english.completion: Felt good, didn't it? You're not one of them anymore, $n. You're Scourge. You're one of us. Forever...
english.completed: Return to Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

starters.name: 骑士团指挥官普雷菲斯特

enders.name: 骑士团指挥官普雷菲斯特

text.description: 我们来这儿之后，把这个地方夷为了平地，然后我们又向牢房进发。在那里看到的一切完全出乎我们的意料，$n。看来血色十字军真的很忙。那里塞满了银色黎明的俘虏，我们到那儿的时候，大部分俘虏都已经死了，只剩少数几个奄奄一息。$B$B我本来准备去那儿解决剩下的那几个的，但是我想这份荣耀应该让给你。尤其是，里面有一个感染了瘟疫的地精，我想你一定会在处决中寻找到的极大的快感的。

english.objectives: Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame has ordered you to execute Gally Lumpstain, an Argent Dawn prisoner inside the nearby prison house.

That whole thing is full of Argent Dawn prisoners. Most of them were already dead by the time we arrived, but a few were still breathing.$B$BI was about to go in there and execute the rest of them, but I think you should have the honors. In particular, there's a real feisty goblin in there that I think you'll take great pleasure in executing.

english.completed: Return to Knight Commander Plaguefist at the Chapel of the Crimson Flame in Plaguelands: The Scarlet Enclave.

starters.name: 骑士团指挥官普雷菲斯特

enders.name: 骑士团指挥官普雷菲斯特

text.title: 新兵艾尔雷斯
text.objectives: 与提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的新兵艾尔雷斯交谈。
text.description: 不如去跟我的学徒艾尔雷斯谈谈吧？她为我效力，应该可以为你安排一些事情，让你练习一下你的新技能。
text.completion: May the Dark Lady watch over you, $n.
text.completed: 与提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的新兵艾尔雷斯交谈。

english.title: Novice Elreth
english.objectives: Speak to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: Now that the training's done and out of the way, why don't you go speak with Elreth?  She serves Shadow Priest Sarvis, and will probably have some tasks to which you can apply your new abilities.
english.completion: May the Dark Lady watch over you, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Novice Elreth at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 扫墓人凯斯
text.objectives: 与提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇墓地的管理员凯斯交谈。
text.description: 我这边没什么事要你做了。不过，你还可以去帮其他人。$b$b站在我背后的树桩上的管理员凯斯也许有任务可以派给你。你不如去找他谈谈。
text.completion: Yes?  And who might you be?

english.title: Caretaker Caice
english.objectives: Speak with Caretaker Caice at the Deathknell Graves in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: I am done with you.  There are, however, others who can use your aid.$b$bCaretaker Caice, standing on that stump behind me, can probably give you another assignment.  You should speak with him now.
english.completion: Yes?  And who might you be?

text.title: 暗影牧师萨维斯
text.objectives: 与提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的暗影牧师萨维斯交谈。
text.description: 你还在这里啊，$n？你知道的，我只不过是个亡灵卫兵。我并没有很多事情可以交付给你这样的路人去做。$b$b我建议你去跟暗影牧师萨维斯谈谈。我还记得，当我刚从坟墓里爬出来的时候，是他帮我恢复的。我相信他也同样会帮你。$b$b你可以在镇子西侧的礼拜堂里找到他。
text.completion: Greetings, $n. I see you wield a weapon.  Can you fight?

english.title: Shadow Priest Sarvis
english.objectives: Speak with Shadow Priest Sarvis at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
english.description: Are you still here, $n?  You know, I'm only a deathguard.  I don't have many tasks I can hand out to passers-by like you.$b$bI'd recommend that you talk to Shadow Priest Sarvis.  I remember, he helped me get on my feet after I was plucked out of that tomb.  I'm sure he'll do the same for you.$b$bYou'll find him just inside the chapel, here on the west side of town.
english.completion: Greetings, $n. I see you wield a weapon.  Can you fight?

text.title: 问题的核心
text.objectives: 去找起源大厅的布莱恩·铜须。
text.description: 好吧，$g小伙子:小姑娘;，其实我是真的想留下来和你一起欣赏这奇观。$b$b我一辈子见过不少奇闻异事，可同这里的一切相比简直不算什么。$b$b只可惜，我还要对这些圆盘进行研究，才能前往起源大厅。$b$b你看起来挺能干的，或许你愿意一块来看看真正的考古学家是怎么工作的？
text.completion: Bout time ye showed up, $glad:lass;.$b$bNow let's get goin'! There be work ta do!

english.title: The Heart of the Matter
english.objectives: Brann Bronzebeard wants you to meet him in the Halls of Origination.
english.description: Well, $gladdie:little lady;, half of me wishes I could stick around a while and take in the sights with ye.$b$bI've seen some mighty amazin' things in my day, but this here takes the cake.$b$bSadly, I have a fair bit o' research ta do on these discs before I make my way into the Halls of Origination.$b$bYou seem ta be worth your salt, perhaps ye'd like ta tag along and see how a REAL archaeologist works, eh?
english.completion: Bout time ye showed up, $glad:lass;.$b$bNow let's get goin'! There be work ta do!

text.title: 狂野的蛮锤婚礼
text.objectives: 跟格朗迪·迈格拉夫交谈，开始婚礼。把来捣乱的暮光之锤统统杀掉！
text.description: 我们准备就绪，可以开始了，$n！$B$B但我有可靠消息，暮光之锤打算阻扰仪式，借此打击他们的士气并摧毁蛮锤部族。事情还可能会更糟！$B$B为此，我打算亲自举行仪式，这样我就可以看着新娘新郎。听起来能行吗？好的！$B$B既然女方的父亲已经过世，他的哥哥又是伴郎，范妮要你陪她走上圣坛。多大的荣幸啊！你准备好了就告诉我。
text.completion: We did it, $n! Fighting that ... thing side-by-side really brought all the Wildhammers together. The heads of the families are more united than I've ever seen them. Drink up, $n, and celebrate!! Of course, our work is only beginning. I'll rally our new Wildhammer reinforcements with the rest of the Alliance and prepare to storm the Twilight Bastion. I'm sure we'll meet again soon.
text.completed: Talk to Kurdran Wildhammer at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Wild, Wild, Wildhammer Wedding
english.objectives: Talk to Grundy MacGraff to begin the wedding ceremony. Kill any Twilight's Hammer that try to stop it!
english.description: We are ready to begin, $n!$B$BBut I have it on good authority that the Twilight's Hammer may try to disrupt the ceremony, so as to demoralize and destroy the Wildhammer. Things could get dangerous!$B$BFor this reason, I will be performing the ceremony myself, so that I can keep the bride and groom close to me. Sound like a plan? Good!$B$BSince her father is dead and her brother the best man, Fanny has asked that you walk her down the aisle. What an honor! Talk to me when you're ready to begin.
english.completion: We did it, $n! Fighting that ... thing side-by-side really brought all the Wildhammers together. The heads of the families are more united than I've ever seen them. Drink up, $n, and celebrate!! Of course, our work is only beginning. I'll rally our new Wildhammer reinforcements with the rest of the Alliance and prepare to storm the Twilight Bastion. I'm sure we'll meet again soon.
english.completed: Talk to Kurdran Wildhammer at Kirthaven in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 怪异的生命之力
text.objectives: 与冬泉谷雪山小屋的巫医玛艾里交谈。
text.description: 这个生物死去时，某种能量被释放了出来，并转移到了你的体内。现在你感觉到自己变强了。$b$b根据冬泉谷当地居民的说法，雪山小屋的巫医玛艾里对这一带的野外非常熟悉。她也许对这股神秘的能量有所了解。
text.completion: What's dis? You got de smell of de E'ko on ya! Let Mau'ari tell ya a little bit about de E'ko and what it do.$b$bYou're lucky, $r. De E'ko searched you out. A troll like me's gotta go find de E'ko herself.$b$bAll de creatures of Winterspring have E'ko. De furbolg, de chillwind, de shardtooth... even de Ice Thistle yeti! You kill dese creatures, and sometimes, a bit of E'ko comes out. Different creatures... different E'ko.$b$bGo on now. Go find de other E'ko!

english.title: Strange Life Forces
english.objectives: Speak with Witch Doctor Mau'ari at the Snowden Chalet in Winterspring.
english.description: When this creature died, some sort of energy was released from its body. The energy was passed on to you, and now you feel somewhat stronger.$b$bAccording to Winterspring locals, Witch Doctor Mau'ari at the Snowden Chalet is an expert in the wildlife of the area. She might know something about this mysterious energy.
english.completion: What's dis? You got de smell of de E'ko on ya! Let Mau'ari tell ya a little bit about de E'ko and what it do.$b$bYou're lucky, $r. De E'ko searched you out. A troll like me's gotta go find de E'ko herself.$b$bAll de creatures of Winterspring have E'ko. De furbolg, de chillwind, de shardtooth... even de Ice Thistle yeti! You kill dese creatures, and sometimes, a bit of E'ko comes out. Different creatures... different E'ko.$b$bGo on now. Go find de other E'ko!

text.title: 巨大的问题
text.objectives: 你的任务是杀死普罗布里姆，一只在托尔巴拉德的路上游荡的巨型双头魔。
text.description: 我们终于占领了这块天杀的乱石堆，随即发现有一只巨大的双头魔在到处游荡，杀死我们的巡逻兵！$B$B$n，我要你带几个人去干掉那只双头魔。绝不能让那样的怪物随便乱跑，制造灾难。$B$B要提高警惕，前线报告称，他拿着一棵大树当武器，而且他真的会拿这玩意来砸你。
text.completion: You actually killed him?!  I can't believe it!
text.completed: Report back to Commander Zanoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 祝你好运。

english.title: A Huge Problem
english.objectives: You have been asked to kill Problim, a giant ettin that roams the paths of Tol Barad.
english.description: We finally capture this godforsaken rock and then we find out that there is a huge ettin roaming around, taking out our sentry patrols!$B$B$n, I need you to round up a few friends and take that ettin down.  We can't have a beast like that roaming around, wreaking havoc.$B$BStay alert, reports from the front say that he is carrying a huge tree as a weapon, and he is not afraid to use it.
english.completion: You actually killed him?!  I can't believe it!
english.completed: Report back to Commander Zanoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Good luck on this one.

text.title: 沼泽之饵
text.objectives: 你的任务是从托尔巴拉德的巴拉丁鳄鱼身上收集8张鳄鱼皮。你可以在巴拉丁监狱西边的沼泽中找到鳄鱼。
text.description: 在这样的地方，补给是很不容易找到的，$c。自从占领了这座岛，我们就开始了侦察，但前景不太妙。$B$B幸运的是，我们刚刚收到了一份侦察报告，说是在这座基地西边有一处沼泽，里面有许多鳄鱼。那些鳄鱼的皮对我们的制皮匠来说是很有用的材料。去给我尽量弄一些回来。
text.progress: You cleared out that swamp yet?
text.completion: Looks like you were able to get the croc hides that we needed.  Thanks $n, your contributions will not go unnoticed.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Zanoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Swamp Bait
english.objectives: You have been tasked with collecting 8 Crocolisk Hides from the Baradin Crocolisks on Tol Barad.  The crocolisks can be found in the swamp, just west of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Supplies are never easy to find in a place like this, $c.  We have been scouting since we captured the island but things are not looking good.$B$BFortunately, we just  received a scouting report that a swamp full of crocs is just west of our base camp here.  The hides off those crocs will come in handy for our leatherworkers.  Bring back as many as you can.
english.progress: You cleared out that swamp yet?
english.completion: Looks like you were able to get the croc hides that we needed.  Thanks $n, your contributions will not go unnoticed.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Zanoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 负隅顽抗
text.objectives: 你的任务是在托尔巴拉德杀死12名联盟步兵。你可以在托尔巴拉德的熔渣车间、典狱官岗哨和铁甲兵营找到他们。
text.description: 我们费了好大力气才占领了这座岛，$r。我们解决了大部分联盟渣滓，但我还是能闻到他们的恶臭。$b$b我要去你去调查一下熔渣车间、典狱官岗哨和铁甲兵营。见到联盟就格杀勿论。$B$B你知道俗话是怎么说的，好的联盟就是死了的联盟！
text.completion: Those filthy alliance never stood a chance.  Nice work, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Zanoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: The Leftovers
english.objectives: You have been instructed to kill 12 Alliance Infantry on Tol Barad.  You can find the holdouts in The Slagworks, Warden's Vigil and the Ironclad Garrison, here on Tol Barad.
english.description: We fought hard to capture this island, $r.  We cleared out most of the Alliance filth but I can still smell their foul stench in the air.$b$bI need you to investigate the slagworks, warden's vigil and the ironclad garrison.  Kill any Alliance that you find.$B$BYou know what they say, the only good Alliance is a dead Alliance!
english.completion: Those filthy alliance never stood a chance.  Nice work, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Zanoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 清理地牢
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱东边的咒怨地牢中杀死任意9个幽灵。
text.description: 你来得可真是时候啊，$n。我们已经占领了托尔巴拉德，但战斗才刚刚开始。$B$B我们在这里的东边发现了一座监狱，得靠你去清理一下。那地方塞满了不知被关押了多久的幽灵。$b$b尽可能多地清理那里的幽灵，然后回来向我报告。
text.completion: You made it back out alive?  You are a stronger man than I, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Private Garnoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Clearing the Depths
english.objectives: You have been asked to kill 9 ghosts of any type in the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
english.description: You are a sight for sore eyes, $n.  Now that we have claimed tol barad, the battle has just begun.$B$BWe discovered a cell block just east of here that we need you to clear out.  Turns out that its chock full of ghosts that have been locked up down there for who knows how long.$b$bClear out as much as you can and report back to me when you are done.
english.completion: You made it back out alive?  You are a stronger man than I, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Private Garnoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 被囚禁的大法师
text.objectives: 你必须杀死巴拉丁监狱东边的咒怨地牢中的大法师加鲁斯，然后取回他的法杖。
text.description: 自从我们踏上托尔巴拉德的土地，就一直在努力清理咒怨地牢的牢房。似乎每次我们即将大功告成时，那个大法师就会冒出来，把我们打回去。$B$B现在既然我们已经占领岛屿了，就该再试一次。你去跑一趟，把他的法杖给我带回来，作为你完成任务的证据。
text.progress: Have you been able to take out the Archmage?
text.completion: Galus is dead?  Fantastic work $n, now we can send down the cleanup crew and get that cellblock ready for new prisoners.
text.completed: Report back to Private Garnoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 他拿着那把法杖的日子不会太长了。

english.title: The Imprisoned Archmage
english.objectives: You must kill Archmage Galus and return with his Staff from the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
english.description: We have been trying to clear out the Cursed Depths cellblock since we landed on Tol Barad.  It seems that everytime we get close, that archmage shows up and pushes us back.$B$BNow that we have claimed the island, it's time we take another shot.  Head down there and bring me back his staff as proof that you have finished the job.
english.progress: Have you been able to take out the Archmage?
english.completion: Galus is dead?  Fantastic work $n, now we can send down the cleanup crew and get that cellblock ready for new prisoners.
english.completed: Report back to Private Garnoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: He won't have that staff for long.

text.title: 以史为鉴
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱东边的咒怨地牢中收集4本满是灰尘的狱中日记。
text.description: 现在我们终于在这座该死的岛上有了立足之地，可以开始调查它是如何变成现在这番模样的了。我们的士兵在东边的咒怨地牢入口一带发现了一些日记。$B$B基地里的那些老学究对这些日记颇感兴趣。我要你去尽快给我找四本日记回来。$B$B$n，多加小心，那地方到处都是亡灵。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the journals?  Reports mentioned that they were sighted both in and out of the cells down there.
text.completion: These journals are in excellent condition $n.  We will begin deciphering them immediately.  Only time will tell what secrets they hold.
text.completed: Report back to Private Garnoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Learning From The Past
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover four Dusty Prison Journals from the Cursed Depths, just east of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Now that we finally have a hold on this wretched island, we can start to investigate how it got in this condition.  Some of our troops have discovered journals around the entrance to Cursed Depths cellblock just east of here.$B$BThese journals are of particular interest to our elder scribes back at base camp.  I need you to recover four of them and bring them back to me as fast as you can.$B$B$n, be careful down there, that place is crawling with undead.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the journals?  Reports mentioned that they were sighted both in and out of the cells down there.
english.completion: These journals are in excellent condition $n.  We will begin deciphering them immediately.  Only time will tell what secrets they hold.
english.completed: Report back to Private Garnoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 恶魔监狱
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱西北边的恶魔监狱中杀死任意10个恶魔。
text.description: 你听说过恶魔监狱吗，$n？这是岛上的一座旧牢房。问题是，那里到处都是恶魔。我们打算用它来关押岛上的联盟残党，但是以目前的情况来看，这个计划没法实施。$B$B我要你去干掉那些恶魔。搞定之后回来向我报告。
text.completion: D-Block is all clear?  Good work, $n.  We will send down a crew to start cleaning up right away.
text.completed: Report back to Drillmaster Razgoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: D-Block
english.objectives: You have been instructed to kill 10 demons of any type in the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Have you heard of the D-Block yet $n?  It's one of the old cellblocks here on the island.  Problem is, it's infested with demons.  We planned on using it to lock up the leftover Alliance we found on the island, but that is not going to happen in its current state.$B$BI need you to head down there and clear those demons out.  Report back to me when you are done.
english.completion: D-Block is all clear?  Good work, $n.  We will send down a crew to start cleaning up right away.
english.completed: Report back to Drillmaster Razgoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 斯瓦诺斯
text.objectives: 你必须杀死恶魔监狱中的斯瓦诺斯，并带回它的诅咒颈环。斯瓦诺斯就在巴拉丁监狱西北边的恶魔监狱中。
text.description: 你在占领这座岛的过程中表现得很出色，$c。现在，我们既然已经占领了岛屿，就要用这些牢房关押囚犯。恶魔监狱是个特别难以清理的地方，不幸的是，这里到处都是形形色色的恶魔。$B$B我们成功地削减了恶魔的数量，但是有一只巨大的熔火犬冲出了牢笼，正在那里大肆破坏。我要你去干掉它，把它的颈环拿回来。
text.progress: Is the core hound dead?
text.completion: Svarnos is finally dead?  Looks like we can finally get to work setting up that cellblock then.  Thank you $n.
text.completed: Report back to Drillmaster Razgoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 我从来都不喜欢绿色。

english.title: Svarnos
english.objectives: You must kill Svarnos in the D-Block and return with his Cursed Collar.  Svarnos can be found in the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Excellent work on the island capture, $c.  Now that we have claimed the island, we need to make these cellblocks useable for prisoners.  D-Block has been especially hard to clear out.  Unfortunately it has become overrun with demons of all sorts.$B$BWe have been able to thin out the demons but a large core hound has broken its way out of its cell and is wreaking havoc down there.  I need you to kill him and bring back his collar.
english.progress: Is the core hound dead?
english.completion: Svarnos is finally dead?  Looks like we can finally get to work setting up that cellblock then.  Thank you $n.
english.completed: Report back to Drillmaster Razgoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Green never was my favorite color.

text.title: 被诅咒的镣铐
text.objectives: 你的任务是从巴拉丁监狱西北边的恶魔监狱取回8条被诅咒的镣铐。
text.description: 你去过恶魔监狱了吗，$n？每次我们差不多把那些牢房里的恶魔清理干净的时候，他们都会很快卷土重来。我们发现他们是从散布在该地区的被诅咒的镣铐中钻出来的。这就是我要交给你的任务了，$n。$B$B我要你去尽可能收集那些镣铐，把它们带回来交给我。我们会立即摧毁这些东西。
text.progress: Did you find many shackles?  Reports mentioned that they were all over the place down there.
text.completion: The shackles!  We will begin the process of destroying these shackles immediately $n.  Thank you for your help.
text.completed: Report back to Drillmaster Razgoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Cursed Shackles
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover 8 Cursed Shackles from the D-Block, just northwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Have you been down in the D-Block yet, $n?  Every time we clear that infested cellblock out, the demons seem to return rather quickly.  We learned that they regenerate from the cursed shackles scattered around the area.  That's where you come in to the picture $n.$B$BI need you to retrieve as many of those shackles as you can and bring them back to me.  We will destroy them immediately.
english.progress: Did you find many shackles?  Reports mentioned that they were all over the place down there.
english.completion: The shackles!  We will begin the process of destroying these shackles immediately $n.  Thank you for your help.
english.completed: Report back to Drillmaster Razgoth at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：燃烧平原！
text.objectives: 去找燃烧平原焰星哨站的约翰·J·基沙恩。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向焰星哨站的约翰·J·基沙恩报到。$B$B为了终结黑石兽人的威胁，你们的帮助是不可或缺的！$B$B从灼热峡谷向南，穿越黑石山脉，即可抵达燃烧平原。在山脉的另一边寻找焰星哨站。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: It's time for the Blackrock orcs to feel the full wrath of the Alliance. They will pay for what they've done.

english.title: Hero's Call: Burning Steppes!
english.objectives: Report to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post in the Burning Steppes.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to John J. Keeshan at Flamestar Post.$B$BYour aid is urgently needed to put an end to the Blackrock orc menance!$B$BYou can reach the Burning Steppes by traveling south from the Searing Gorge through Blackrock Mountain. Look for Flamestar Post on the far side of the mountain.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: It's time for the Blackrock orcs to feel the full wrath of the Alliance. They will pay for what they've done.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：燃烧平原！
text.objectives: 去找燃烧平原焰星哨站的阿里乌克。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向焰星哨站的阿里乌克报到。$B$B备受景仰的伊崔格的儿子，阿里乌克，需要你们协助阻挡黑石兽人的盲目攻势，避免他们波及邻近的地区。$B$B从灼热峡谷南面穿过黑石山脉，即可抵达燃烧平原。焰星哨站就在山脉的南部。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: We must stop the Blackrock orcs before they can expand their influence.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Burning Steppes!
english.objectives: Report to Ariok at Flamestar Post in the Burning Steppes.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Ariok at Flamestar Post.$B$BHonored Eitrigg's son, Ariok, needs your assistance to halt the blind aggression of the Blackrock orcs before they invade the neighboring lands.$B$BYou can reach the Burning Steppes by traveling south from the Searing Gorge through Blackrock Mountain. Flamestar Post will be south of the mountain.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: We must stop the Blackrock orcs before they can expand their influence.

text.title: 监狱暴动
text.objectives: 你的任务是去巴拉丁监狱西南边的矿渣洞杀死任意10名囚犯。
text.description: 我们已经占领了岛屿，就该让这里的资源发挥作用了。我们在西南边找到了一座废弃的监狱，需要派你去侦察一下，$n。$B$B报告称，那里有许多被关押了多年的囚犯。尽你所能清理该地，解决之后回来向我报告。
text.completion: You cleared that area out?  Looks like you might be more useful to us that we thought, $r.
text.completed: Report back to Staff Sergeant Lazgar at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Prison Revolt
english.objectives: You have been instructed to kill 10 prisoners of any type in The Hole, just southwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: We have the island, now we need to put the resources here to work.  We found an abandoned cellblock just southwest of here and we need you to go check it out $n.$B$BReports have come back that it is overrun with prisoners that have been stuck down there for years.  Do whatever you need to do to clear that place out.  Report back to me when you are done.
english.completion: You cleared that area out?  Looks like you might be more useful to us that we thought, $r.
english.completed: Report back to Staff Sergeant Lazgar at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 典狱官
text.objectives: 你必须杀死矿渣洞的典狱官席尔瓦，并拿到他的钥匙。矿渣洞就在巴拉丁监狱的西南边。
text.description: 我们差不多已经清理了矿渣洞中的暴动囚犯，不过还有一个问题没有解决。典狱官。$b$b典狱官席尔瓦是他们的主人，那些囚犯唯他马首是瞻。如果我们除掉他，就可以把他们全都端掉。去把他解决了，然后把他的钥匙给我带回来。我们可以用那些钥匙进入牢房深处，没准还能找到岛上的水源。
text.progress: Is the warden dead yet?
text.completion: Ahh, the wardens key's.  Another job well done, $n.  These will come in very handy.
text.completed: Report back to Staff Sergeant Lazgar at Baradin Hold when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 是时候让典狱官提前释放了。

english.title: The Warden
english.objectives: You must kill Warden Silva in The Hole and return with his keys.  The Hole is just southwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: We have almost finished clearing out the revolting prisoners in the hole, but one last problem remains.  The warden.$b$bWarden Silva is their master and they will do anything for him.  If we take him out, we take them all out.  Finish him off and bring me back his keys.  We can use those keys to explore deeper into the cellblock and possibly gain access to the water supply here on the island.
english.progress: Is the warden dead yet?
english.completion: Ahh, the wardens key's.  Another job well done, $n.  These will come in very handy.
english.completed: Report back to Staff Sergeant Lazgar at Baradin Hold when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Time to give the warden an early parole.

text.title: 下面的食物
text.objectives: 你的任务是在巴拉丁监狱西南边的矿渣洞中收集12份囚犯的口粮。
text.description: 营地里的物资储备越来越少了，$n。我们最近发现西南边的监狱中储备着多年来没有用掉的干粮。我们要派你去尽可能收集那些干粮，把它们带回营地来。$B$B还有一件事，那座监狱里到处都是逃脱的囚犯，所以你要多加小心。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the rations?  Reports mentioned that they could be found all over the place down there.
text.completion: These rations will really help the troops out $n.  Thank you for your help.
text.completed: Report back to Staff Sergeant Lazgar at Baradin Hold when you are done.

english.title: Food From Below
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover 12 Cellblock Rations from The Hole, just southwest of Baradin Hold.
english.description: Supplies are running low here in camp, $n.  We have recently learned that the cellblock just southwest of here has a number of rations remaining from years of use.  We need you to gather as many of those as you can and bring them back to camp.$B$BOne more thing, the entire cellblock is overrun with prisoners so be careful.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the rations?  Reports mentioned that they could be found all over the place down there.
english.completion: These rations will really help the troops out $n.  Thank you for your help.
english.completed: Report back to Staff Sergeant Lazgar at Baradin Hold when you are done.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：诅咒之地！
text.objectives: 去找诅咒之地巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉报到。$B$B奥克莉拉是部落在巨槌要塞的指挥官，她要求你们协助保卫该处前哨站，抵御暴动的食人魔和联盟部队。$B$B沿着悲伤沼泽南边的路即可抵达巨槌要塞。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Our enemies are numerous, $c. It will take skill and bravery to overcome them all.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Blasted Lands!
english.objectives: Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold.$B$BOkrilla, commander of the Horde forces at Dreadmaul Hold, requires your help to secure the outpost against rebellious ogres and the forces of the Alliance.$B$BTravel to Dreadmaul Hold by taking the road south from the Swamp of Sorrows.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Our enemies are numerous, $c. It will take skill and bravery to overcome them all.

text.title: 战场上的执行官
text.objectives: 去找执行官阿伦。
text.description: 我可以让你在镇子里忙上一个星期……但你看样子更适合战斗。$b$b<艾尔雷斯仔细打量了你一番，然后点了点头。>$b$b没错，你很适合。我想让你去跟执行官阿伦谈谈。沿着北边的路走出丧钟镇。越过街垒之后很快就可以看到他了。
text.completion: What do we have here?  A new $c, ready for battle, eh?
text.completed: 去找提瑞斯法林地丧钟镇的执行官阿伦。

english.title: The Executor In the Field
english.objectives: Report to Executor Arren.
english.description: I can keep you busy here in town all week... but you seem to be more the fighting type.$b$b<Elreth looks you over and nods.>$b$bYes, you'll do just fine.  I'd like you to go talk to Executor Arren.  Follow the path north, out of Deathknell.  You'll find him not far past the barricades.
english.completion: What do we have here?  A new $c, ready for battle, eh?
english.completed: Report to Executor Arren at Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：诅咒之地！
text.objectives: 去找守望堡的军需官朗格尔斯。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向守望堡的军需官朗格尔斯报到。$B$B守望堡的卫戍部队急切需要你们的帮助，阻止部落进军诅咒之地！从悲伤沼泽向南进发，沿路向东就是守望堡。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: For decades has the garrison at Nethergarde held firm against the threat of the Horde and we do not intend to surrender now.

english.title: Hero's Call: Blasted Lands!
english.objectives: Report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.$B$BNethergarde's garrison urgently needs your help to stem the Horde advance into the Blasted Lands! Travel south from the Swamp of Sorrows and follow the road east to reach Nethergarde Keep.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: For decades has the garrison at Nethergarde held firm against the threat of the Horde and we do not intend to surrender now.

text.title: 坠星村
text.objectives: 与坠星村的维恩德·夜风交谈。
text.description: 你在这里还挺忙的。如果你还想做点好事，或者只是想赚点钱，我也许有一些你感兴趣的情报。$B$B坠星村就在永望镇的西北边。那里的暗夜精灵最近深受虫害侵扰，他们正在寻找一切可能的帮助。$B$B这里已经有一些地精过去灭虫了，不过我相信帮忙的总是不嫌多。去跟维恩德·夜风谈谈，他会给你找事做的。
text.completion: Welcome to Starfall, $c. We have opened our doors to all travelers in our time of need.

english.title: Starfall Village
english.objectives: Speak with Wynd Nightchaser at Starfall Village.
english.description: You've been pretty busy around here. If you're still eager to do good deeds, or just get paid, I've got something you might be interested in.$B$BStarfall Village is just northwest of Everlook. The night elves there recently suffered a pretty nasty bug infestation, and they're asking for any help they can get.$B$BA few goblins from here already went there to start exterminating, but I'm sure there's room for more. Talk to Wynd Nightchaser, he'll fill you in.
english.completion: Welcome to Starfall, $c. We have opened our doors to all travelers in our time of need.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：悲伤沼泽！
text.objectives: 去找悲伤沼泽沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐报到。$B$B联盟部队急需贸易巨头提供的补给品！你们必须尽可能地说服贸易巨头，持续地以合理价格向我方出售补给品。$B$B要前往沼泽，就沿着燃烧平原东南方的路，穿过赤脊山地区。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: Welcome to Bogpaddle, $c. I fully expect you will enjoy all our facility has to offer.

english.title: Hero's Call: Swamp of Sorrows!
english.objectives: Report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in the Swamp of Sorrows.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle.$B$BThe Alliance forces urgently needs the munitions provided by the baron! You must do whatever is necessary to convince the baron to keep selling our forces supplies at reasonable prices.$B$BTo get to the swamp, follow the road from the southeastern Burning Steppes through the Redridge Mountains.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Welcome to Bogpaddle, $c. I fully expect you will enjoy all our facility has to offer.

text.title: 灭虫行动
text.objectives: 与班萨罗兽穴里面的瑞诺·弹幕交谈。
text.description: 我们的兽穴受到侵袭是在午夜。这片土地上从未出现过的邪恶生物占满了隧道，从不知藏在何处的卵中持续孵化出来。$B$B我们这里人手吃紧，最多只能阻止它们跑出兽穴而已。我们不得不从永望镇雇佣了一些号称是灭虫专家的地精，不过他们目前还毫无进展。$B$B如果你愿意帮助他们的话，就到这座小屋西边的兽穴里面去，跟瑞诺·弹幕谈谈。
text.completion: Oh good, another warm body!$B$BI hope that elf up there didn't bore you to death. We've got a lot of bugs to kill here.

english.title: Exterminators at Work
english.objectives: Speak with Rinno Curtainfire inside the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den.
english.description: The infestation of our barrow den occured nearly overnight. Vicious creatures never before seen in these lands swarmed the tunnels, hatching from unseen eggs.$B$BWith the few of us here, it was all we could do to keep them from spreading outside the den. We were forced to hire goblins from Everlook that claimed expertise in extermination, but they have not yet been successful.$B$BIf you wish to assist them, enter the barrow den to the west of this lodge and speak with Rinno Curtainfire.
english.completion: Oh good, another warm body!$B$BI hope that elf up there didn't bore you to death. We've got a lot of bugs to kill here.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：悲伤沼泽！
text.objectives: 去找悲伤沼泽沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向沼桨镇的贸易巨头银罐报到。$B$B说服贸易巨头，持续地以合理价格向我方的战士出售武器和补给品，不惜一切代价！$B$B要前往悲伤沼泽，就沿着燃烧平原东南方的路，穿过赤脊山地区。到贸易巨头的海边度假胜地去找他。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Welcome to beautiful Bogpaddle!

english.title: Warchief's Command: Swamp of Sorrows!
english.objectives: Report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle in Swamp of Sorrows.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Trade Baron Silversnap at Bogpaddle.$B$BPersuade the trade baron to continue supplying our warriors with the weapons and munitions they require, no matter what it takes!$B$BTravel to the Swamp of Sorrows by following the road from the southeastern Burning Steppes through the Redridge Mountains and meet the trade baron at his seaside resort.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Welcome to beautiful Bogpaddle!

text.title: P·哈里斯船长
text.objectives: 你的任务是在失落希望海角杀死P·哈里斯船长。失落希望海角就在这里的西北边，海岸附近。找到船骸就对了。
text.description: 这几周来，失落希望海角一直是我们在托尔巴拉德的伤心之地。我们有一半补给船在那边被礁石撞沉了。$b$b更糟糕的是，一群亡灵水手控制了海角。我们曾经试图削减他们的数量，但他们好像总是能恢复元气。我们的最后一个解决办法就是干掉他们的船长。你应该可以在海岸线附近的某艘船上找到他。$b$b哦，对了，希望你不是很怕鲨鱼。
text.completion: You did it!  Maybe we can finally get some ships into port now.  Thank you $n.
text.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 杀死船长，他的爪牙们就会一哄而散了。

english.title: Captain P. Harris
english.objectives: You have been tasked with killing Captain P. Harris at the Cape of Lost Hope.  The Cape of Lost Hope can be found northwest of here, along the coast.  Just look for the shipwrecks.
english.description: The Cape of Lost Hope has been a sore in our side for weeks here on Tol Barad.  Half of our supply ships end up on the rocks down there.$b$bTo make matters worse, it's been overrun by a gang of undead sailors.  We have tried thinning the ranks, but they just seem to keep coming back.  Our last resort is to try and take out the captain that they report to.  You should be able to find him on a ship, just off the shoreline.$b$bOh, and I hope you are not too scared of sharks.
english.completion: You did it!  Maybe we can finally get some ships into port now.  Thank you $n.
english.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Take out the captain, and his minions will fall.

text.title: 激怒敌人
text.objectives: 三副克隆卡尔要你在失落希望海角杀死8名海难水手。失落希望海角位于此地西北方的海边。
text.description: 我们跟失落希望海角的亡灵斗了好长一段时间了。每次有船沉没，就有更多亡灵加入他们的行列。$b$b你能帮我们一个忙，削减一下他们的数量吗？我知道你没可能把他们全都干掉，不过做点什么总是好的。$b$b要留神联盟，我们最近经常收到报告说他们在袭击海滩。
text.completion: Nice work on the undead up there $n.  We really appreciate the help.
text.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Rattling Their Cages
english.objectives: 3rd Officer Kronkar has asked you to kill 8 Shipwrecked Sailors at the Cape of Lost Hope.  The cape is located due northwest of here, on the beach.
english.description: We have been having issues with the undead down at the Cape of Lost Hope for a while now.  Every time a new ship wrecks, they end up getting more undead to join their ranks.$b$bCan you do us a favor and thin out the ranks up there?  I know you won't be able to kill them all, but anything you can do will help at this point.$b$bKeep an eye out for alliance, we have been getting reports of them ambushing the beach lately.
english.completion: Nice work on the undead up there $n.  We really appreciate the help.
english.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 鼓舞士气
text.objectives: 从失落希望海角的船只残骸中取回6桶南海朗姆酒。失落希望海角位于此地以北的海边。
text.description: 最近我方的士气十分低迷，$n。我们想尽了办法来振奋大家的精神，但是鼓舞士气的重要供给……朗姆酒就快喝光了。$b$b我接到了来自前线的步兵的报告，据说失落希望海角的船只残骸中储有大量的南海朗姆酒。你能去那里调查一下吗？$b$b如果找到朗姆酒，就带回来吧。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the rum?  I would try but I am deathly afraid of the water.  Not to mention that crazy shark.
text.completion: This rum will really help us out, $n.  They might not feel great in the morning but at least they will go to sleep happy.
text.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Boosting Morale
english.objectives: You have been asked to recover 6 Barrels of Southsea Rum from the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope.  The cape can be found north of here, along the coast.
english.description: Morale is low these days, $n.  We make every effort we can to keep the troops in high spirits but we are running low on our main supply of morale booster... rum.$b$bI have been getting reports from our infantry to the south that the shipwrecks on the Cape of Lost Hope still have a good supply of southsea rum in their wrecked hulls.  Can you head up there and investigate?$b$bBring back any rum you can find.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the rum?  I would try but I am deathly afraid of the water.  Not to mention that crazy shark.
english.completion: This rum will really help us out, $n.  They might not feel great in the morning but at least they will go to sleep happy.
english.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 巨鲨“坦克”
text.objectives: 你的任务是杀死坦克，一条在失落希望海角的水域中巡游的大鲨鱼。海角就在这里北方的海岸线附近。
text.description: 我恨鲨鱼。我的人都恨鲨鱼。这就是我们要你做的事情，$n。$b$b我要你去失落希望海角，干掉一条名叫坦克的鲨鱼。坦克可不是好惹的，所以如果我是你的话，我会多带几个朋友一起去。
text.completion: No way, you actually killed him?  We are having shark tacos tonight for sure!
text.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 这家伙咬人一点也不痛。

english.title: Shark Tank
english.objectives: You have been tasked to kill Tank, a large shark cruising the waters of the Cape of Lost Hope.  The cape can be found north of here, along the northern coastline.
english.description: I hate sharks.  All of my troops hate sharks too.  This is where you come in, $n.$b$bI need you to head up to the Cape of Lost Hope and take out a huge shark named Tank.  Tank is not to be trifled with so I would bring a few friends if I were you.
english.completion: No way, you actually killed him?  We are having shark tacos tonight for sure!
english.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Jaws has nothing on this guy.

text.title: 占领要塞
text.objectives: 杀死法尔森要塞的要塞领主法尔森。法尔森要塞位于岛屿南端。
text.description: 你看见岛屿北端的要塞了吗，$n？那里是要塞领主法尔森的老巢。$b$b法尔森有一帮忠心耿耿的追随者，自从我们来到这里，他们就一直找我们的麻烦。我们曾经派出侦察小队潜入要塞，探明了法尔森的具体位置。$b$b你能帮我们除掉他吗？
text.completion: You killed him?  We have been trying to take that guy out for weeks!  We thank you, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 他的追随者非常忠心。别低估他们。

english.title: Claiming The Keep
english.objectives: You have been asked to kill Keep Lord Farson at the Farson Hold.  Farson Hold can be found on the north side of the island.
english.description: Have you seen the keep on the north side of the island, $n?  That is where Keep Lord Farson runs his operation from.$b$bFarson has a small group of dedicated followers and they have been giving us trouble since we got here.  We sent a small group to investigate and they reported back on his exact position within the keep.$b$bCan you finish him off for us?
english.completion: You killed him?  We have been trying to take that guy out for weeks!  We thank you, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: His followers are very loyal.  Do not underestimate them.

text.title: 削减蜘蛛的数量
text.objectives: 在黑暗森林杀死12个黑暗森林潜伏者。黑暗森林位于此地以北，穿过岛屿中心的桥梁就到。
text.description: 数周来，我们努力想在黑暗森林取得立足之地，但是这片森林里到处都是蜘蛛。帮我个忙吧，如果你能适当削减它们的数量，我们就有机会组织攻击行动了。$b$b当心，有报告称先前有联盟军队抵达了此地。
text.completion: Nice work on those spiders $n.  At this rate, we will be taking that forest in no time.
text.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Thinning the Brood
english.objectives: Kill 12 Darkwood Lurkers in The Darkwood.  The Darkwood forest is just north of here, across the bridge on the central island.
english.description: We have been trying to get a foothold in The Darkwood for weeks now but that forest is infested with spiders.  Do me a favor and see if you can thin them out enough for us to set up an attack.$b$bCareful out there, I have heard reports of Alliance troops nearby earlier in the week.
english.completion: Nice work on those spiders $n.  At this rate, we will be taking that forest in no time.
english.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 棘手的任务
text.objectives: 从黑暗森林的黑暗森林蛛母身上收集4个粘性丝囊。黑暗森林位于此地以西，穿过岛屿中心的桥梁就到。
text.description: 简而言之，这座岛上很难找到足够的供给。$b$b幸运的是，我们发现此地以北的黑暗森林盛产蛛丝。不过呢，只有蛛母的丝囊才能抽出好丝来。我要你收集4个丝囊。$b$b那样应该够我完成最后这批衬衣了吧。
text.progress: Were you able to gather the sticky silk glands?
text.completion: These glands will do nicely.  We are grateful for your help, $n.
text.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: A Sticky Task
english.objectives: Collect 4 Sticky Silk Glands from Darkwood Broodmother spiders in The Darkwood.  The Darkwood forest is just west of here, across the bridge on the central island.
english.description: Finding supplies on the island has been difficult, to say the least.$b$bFortunately, we have found a good supply of silk in The Darkwood, just north of here.  The bad part of this story is that the silk comes from the glands on Broodmother spiders.  I need you to gather 4 of these for me.$b$bThat should be just enough to finish up this last set of shirts.
english.progress: Were you able to gather the sticky silk glands?
english.completion: These glands will do nicely.  We are grateful for your help, $n.
english.completed: Report back to 3rd Officer Kronkar at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 绝不浪费武器
text.objectives: 从托尔巴拉德半岛北端的法尔森要塞取回12支生锈的步枪。
text.description: 这个鸟不拉屎的破地方很难搞到军备。我们艰难地击退了联盟的每一次进攻，但可能下一次战斗，我们就只能使用棍棒和石头了。$B$B有报告称，岛屿北端的要塞领主法尔森拥有大量的步枪储备。你能去那里调查一下吗？$B$B千万小心，$n。法尔森的追随者会不惜一切代价保护他们的主子的。
text.progress: Any luck with those rifles?
text.completion: Thanks for rounding these up for us, $n.  Kind of hard to fight a battle without any guns.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Leave No Weapon Behind
english.objectives: Retrieve 12 Rusty Rifles from Farson Hold on the north side of Tol Barad Peninsula.
english.description: Battle supplies are hard to come by on this rock.  Every time we hold off another Alliance attack, it feels like we are fighting with sticks and stones.$B$BReports have come in that Keep Lord Farson on the north side of the island has a large stockpile of rifles that we could use.  Can you head down there and check it out?$b$bBe careful $n, Farson's followers will do anything to protect him.
english.progress: Any luck with those rifles?
english.completion: Thanks for rounding these up for us, $n.  Kind of hard to fight a battle without any guns.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 不友善的村落
text.objectives: 指挥官拉尔玛什要你前往洛斯贝格村杀死14名村民。洛斯贝格村位于营地以北，就在右边。
text.description: 你去过洛斯贝格村吗，$n？如果你正要往那里走，我建议你带上一把利刃。$b$b村子里的居民看起来挺正常的，却在背地里做坏事。有报告称村民们会趁士兵形单影只时杀死他们。我们简直受够啦，我要你去那里清理一下门户。$b$b尽可能地除掉那些村民，然后回来向我复命。
text.completion: Told you that village was full of wackos.  Nice job clearing it out $n.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Not The Friendliest Town
english.objectives: Commander Larmash has asked you to kill 14 villagers in Rustberg Village.  Rustberg Village is just north of base camp, on the right side.
english.description: Have you been up to Rustberg Village yet $n?  I would suggest you bring a sharpened blade if you are heading that direction.$b$bThe folks in that town look alright but something suspicious is going on in there.  Reports have been coming in that they are picking off our soldiers left and right.  We have had just about enough of that, so I need you to head down there and do a little cleaning house for us.$B$BTake down as many as you can and report back when you are done.
english.completion: Told you that village was full of wackos.  Nice job clearing it out $n.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 弄点黑鲈鱼来
text.objectives: 从洛斯贝格村取回22条洛斯贝格黑鲈鱼。你可以在村后礁石群的鱼线上找到这种鱼。洛斯贝格村位于营地正北方，就在右边。
text.description: 洛斯贝格村。那座村落被诅咒了，这对我们来说也算是件好事，$n。我都不知道这帮强盗是如何学会钓鱼的，不过我也没时间刨根问底了。$B$B我要你去那里弄点鱼来，能弄多少是多少啦。自从我们夺回岛屿后，吃得简直跟狗屎一样，这次行动简直是储备军粮的绝佳机会。$B$B当心潜伏者，据说村落中到处都是他们的身影。
text.progress: Were you able to pull off the heist and get us some fish?
text.completion: These fish will do nicely, $n.  Keeping the troops fed and in good condition is our number one priority and you really came through for us here.
text.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Teach A Man To Fish.... Or Steal
english.objectives: You must steal 22 Rustberg Seabass from Rustberg Village.  The fish can be found on string stands at the docks, round back of the village.  Rustberg Village is due north of base camp, on the right side.
english.description: Rustberg Village.  That place is a curse and a blessing for us, $n.  I have no clue where bandits learned to fish as well as they do but I have no time to worry about that now.$B$BI need you to head down there and steal as many of their fish reserves as possible.  We have been living off scraps since we retook the island and this is our best chance at some solid food reserves.$B$BKeep an eye out for stealthers up there, reports have told us they are prevalent inside the village walls.
english.progress: Were you able to pull off the heist and get us some fish?
english.completion: These fish will do nicely, $n.  Keeping the troops fed and in good condition is our number one priority and you really came through for us here.
english.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：北荆棘谷！
text.objectives: 前往北荆棘谷，向格罗姆高营地的指挥官阿格罗戈什报到。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向格罗姆高营地的指挥官阿格罗戈什报到。指挥官需要你们的帮助，以确保补给线畅通无阻，免受当地居民和联盟的困扰。$B$B要前往格罗姆高，可以在奥格瑞玛的东部飞艇塔或幽暗城附近的飞艇塔上搭乘飞艇。$B$B使命在召唤你们！
text.completion: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Northern Stranglethorn Vale!
english.objectives: Report to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in the Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp. The commander requires your aid to keep the supply routes open and free of interference from the local inhabitants and the troublesome Alliance.$B$BTo reach Grom'gol, you can take the zeppelin Orgrimmar's eastern zeppelin tower or the one near Undercity.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: At last, the Warchief's reinforcements have arrived.

text.title: 被遗忘的灵魂
text.objectives: 在遗忘山丘释放6名被折磨的灵魂。用手直接触摸墓碑，即可引导灵魂。遗忘山丘位于正西方，穿过不眠前线就是了。
text.description: 许多士兵在这座岛上不幸丧命，$n。我们必须尽可能地对亡者表达敬意，才不枉他们的牺牲。$b$b我要你前往正西方的遗忘山丘，令兄弟们被折磨的灵魂得以解脱。要当心，据说那片区域有亡灵出没。
text.completion: May their souls rest in peace.
text.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: The Forgotten
english.objectives: Release the spirits of 6 tortured souls at Forgotten Hill.  Souls can be channeled by touching your hands directly to the gravestones.  Forgotten Hill is due west of here, past The Restless Front.
english.description: Many soldiers died on this island $n.  It is only fair that we pay our respects to them in any way that we can.$b$bI need you to travel to Forgotten Hill, due west of here and release our brothers in arms' tortured souls away from this place.  Do be careful over there, reports of undead have been ongoing in the area.
english.completion: May their souls rest in peace.
english.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 回收残骸
text.objectives: 你必须从居住在遗忘山丘的食尸鬼那里取回9根腿骨。遗忘山丘位于岛屿西侧，穿过遗忘前线就是了。
text.description: 自从我们夺回这座凄凉的岛屿后，僵尸和食尸鬼就一直在遗忘山丘肆虐。好几次我们都想彻底清理这些家伙，但他们还是三番五次地卷土重来。$b$b有一位中尉指出，杀死食尸鬼后应该取走大腿骨，这样他们就不能在夜里复生了。你能帮我们处理一下这件事吗？
text.progress: Were you able to recover the femur bones?  Better for you to try than me.
text.completion: I didn't think you would be able to do it, $n.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?
text.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Salvaging the Remains
english.objectives: You need to recover 9 Cursed Femur bones from the ghouls that inhabit Forgotten Hill.  Forgotten Hill is on the west side of the island, just past The Forgotten Front.
english.description: Forgotten Hill has been overrun with zombies and ghouls ever since we reclaimed this wretched isle.  We have tried to clear them out many times but they always seem to come back.$b$bOne of our lieutenants recommended taking the ghouls' bones when we kill them in hopes that they can't reincarnate overnight.  Think you can help us out with this one?
english.progress: Were you able to recover the femur bones?  Better for you to try than me.
english.completion: I didn't think you would be able to do it, $n.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?
english.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 康纳中尉
text.objectives: 在遗忘山丘找到并杀死康纳中尉。遗忘山丘位于岛屿的极西侧。
text.description: 第一次听说康纳中尉时，我还是个怒焰裂谷的年轻新兵。我们都不曾料到他会死在托尔巴拉德。不幸的是，他的灵魂依然在这座凄凉的岛上游荡并制造混乱，扰乱我军的士气。$b$b我要你结束他的……以及我们的痛苦。
text.completion: Hey, you made it back alive!  Can't say you were the first one to try this task, but you are definitely the first one to make it back alive.
text.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 没人想死在这里，但是天不遂人愿啊。

english.title: First Lieutenant Connor
english.objectives: Find and kill First Lieutenant Connor at Forgotten Hill.  You will find Forgotten Hill on the far west side of the island.
english.description: The first time I heard about Lt. Connor, I was just a young recruit in Ragefire Chasm.  None of us could believe he ended up here on Tol Barad.
