Sadly, he still roams these wretched islands, wreaking havoc on our troops morale.$b$bI need you to put an end to his misery... and ours.
english.completion: Hey, you made it back alive!  Can't say you were the first one to try this task, but you are definitely the first one to make it back alive.
english.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: No one wanted to end up here, but we don't always get what we want.

text.title: 磁铁的原理是什么呢？
text.objectives: 取回7块攻城坦克废料。在不眠前线使用磁性废料收集器寻找废料。不眠前线位于此地正西方，穿过第二座桥梁就到。
text.description: 我们很难在这座岛上找到有用的机械配件，$n。瞧，有一大堆攻城坦克等着修理，我们却没有可用的零件。$b$b第二军团来报，西边的战场上有废弃的攻城坦克配件。或许可以去那里碰碰运气？$B$b要在旧时的战场上寻找小件的东西可不容易，带上磁性废料收集器吧，你会用得着的。
text.progress: Did that magnet contraptaion actually work?
text.completion: These parts will really help us out, $n!  Who would have thought you can find stuff this useful in all that old junk?
text.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Magnets, How Do They Work?
english.objectives: You have been tasked with recovering 7 pieces of Siege Engine Scrap.  Use the Magnetized Scrap Collector in The Restless Front to find the scraps.  The Restless Front is due west, just past the second bridge.
english.description: Getting useful machine parts out here on the island has been difficult, $n.  We have been trying to repair the broken siege engines here in camp but we keep running out of useful parts.$b$bOur second regiment reported some wrecked out siege engines in a old battlefield to the west.  Maybe we could find some parts over there?$B$bYou are going to have trouble finding anything in that old battlefield so take this magnetized scrap collector and put it to some good use.
english.progress: Did that magnet contraptaion actually work?
english.completion: These parts will really help us out, $n!  Who would have thought you can find stuff this useful in all that old junk?
english.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 收尾工作
text.objectives: 在不眠前线杀死5名不眠的士兵。不眠前线位于岛屿西侧，就在遗忘山丘前。
text.description: 本周我们一直在不眠前线收集有用的废料。每当我们有所收获准备折返营地时，就会遭到不眠的士兵的攻击。你能跑一趟，去那里清剿他们吗？
text.completion: It's about time someone took those guys out.
text.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Finish The Job
english.objectives: Kill 5 Restless Soldiers at the Restless Front.  You can find the front on the west side of the island, just before Forgotten Hill.
english.description: We have been trying to collect useful scraps from the front all week.  Every time we gather a batch to bring back to camp, we get assaulted by the restless soldiers in the area.  Can you head over there and clear them out?
english.completion: It's about time someone took those guys out.
english.completed: Report back to Captain Prug at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 当心鬼魂！
text.objectives: 列兵萨罗斯克要你从维尔松船坞取回15片船坞木料。维尔松船坞位于此地西北方的海岸上，你可以从那里的鬼魂身上找到木料。
text.description: 你去过维尔松船坞吗，$n？除非你有充分的理由，否则别轻易涉足。不幸的是，我正需要你去那里跑一趟。$b$b自从我们夺回岛屿以来，供给就一直处于短缺状态。那座满是鬼魂的船坞储有很多木料，我们曾经派了好些人去收集木料，但是他们都没能回来。$b$b你能帮帮我们吗？
text.progress: Did the ghosts scare you off?
text.completion: I didn't think you would be able to do it, $n.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?
text.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Watch Out For Splinters!
english.objectives: Private Sarlosk has asked you to recover 15 pieces of Shipyard Lumber from the Wellson Shipyard.  The lumber can be recovered from the ghosts in the shipyard or found lying around the premises.  The shipyard can be found northwest of here, on the coast.
english.description: Have you been over to the Wellson Shipyard yet, $n?  Best to stay away from there unless you have a good reason to venture in.  Unfortunately, that is exactly what I need you to do.$b$bYou see, we have been short on supplies ever since we recaptured the island.  That ghost ridden shipyard is overflowing with lumber but every time we send an escort to recover the lumber, they never make it back.$b$bCan you help us out?
english.progress: Did the ghosts scare you off?
english.completion: I didn't think you would be able to do it, $n.  You are just full of surprises aren't you?
english.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 通缉令：工头维尔松
text.objectives: 杀死维尔松船坞的工头维尔松。维尔松船坞位于此地北方，就在西部的海岸上。
text.description: 工头维尔松一直是我们的心头大患。他的船坞拥有大量物资储备，如果我们有办法拿到的话……那些东西都可以派上大用场。$B$B他手下的爪牙防范严密，我们很难在船坞取得落脚点。我要你这次彻底除掉维尔松。当心，$n，有报告称可恶的联盟在这片区域活动。
text.completion: Great work $n.  I will report your efforts to our highest in command immediately.
text.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 曾经不可一世的工头维尔松，已然失宠。

english.title: WANTED: Foreman Wellson
english.objectives: Kill Foreman Wellson at the Wellson Shipyard.  The shipyard can be found north of here, on the western coast.
english.description: Foreman Wellson has been a pain in our side since we got here.  His shipyard holds a large amount of supplies that would be extremely useful to us... if we could get to them.$b$bHe keeps a close watch over his minions and makes it very difficult for us to get a foothold on the shipyard.  I need you to take out Wellson for good this time.  Be careful $n, we have been receiving reports of dirty Alliance all around the area.
english.completion: Great work $n.  I will report your efforts to our highest in command immediately.
english.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Once a great man, Foreman Wellson has fallen from grace.

text.title: 炮弹发射！
text.objectives: 摧毁10艘维尔松补给船。
text.description: 维尔松船坞正源源不断地从海上获得补给品，我们必须阻止他们。他们在码头一带部署了防御火炮，不过如果你能控制火炮的话，我们就可以用炮弹摧毁他们的补给船。$B$B到那边去看看你能做些什么吧。记得向我汇报你的进展。
text.progress: Did you take out the boats?
text.completion: Great work on those supply ships, $n!  We knew you would be good for somethin' around here.
text.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Bombs Away!
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Ghastly Supply Boats.
english.description: The wellson shipyard is constantly receiving supplies from offshore and we need to put a stop to it.  They have setup cannons along the docks for defense but if you can make it to them, we can use them to destroy their supply ships.$B$BHead down there and see what you can do.  Report back to me on your progress.
english.progress: Did you take out the boats?
english.completion: Great work on those supply ships, $n!  We knew you would be good for somethin' around here.
english.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 鬼魂毁灭者
text.objectives: 前往营地东北方的拉尔戈的瞭望台消灭任意14只鬼魂。
text.description: 看见东北边那座高塔林立的山丘了吗？那是拉尔戈的瞭望台，紧挨着它扎营真不是什么好事。自从我们搭建营地以来，鬼魂生物就一直来滋事。$b$b你能去那里教训一下它们吗？要让它们知道，我们可不打算撤离。多干掉几个鬼魂，它们就会规矩一点了。$b$b先谢谢你的帮助啊，$n。
text.completion: Great work, $n!  We should not hear from the ghosts again anytime soon.
text.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Ghostbuster
english.objectives: Kill 14 ghosts of any type at Largo's Overlook, northeast of the Horde camp.
english.description: See that hill with the towers to the northeast?  That's Largo's Overlook and it's not a fun place to setup camp next to.  We have been dealing with those spirits and spectres ever since we setup camp.$b$bCan you head up there and let them know we don't plan on leaving anytime soon?  A few good kills on their ranks should put them in line.$b$bThanks for your help on this, $n.
english.completion: Great work, $n!  We should not hear from the ghosts again anytime soon.
english.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死拉尔戈的瞭望台的幽灵

text.title: 炮弹！
text.objectives: 前往拉尔戈的瞭望台，为列兵萨罗斯克收集4堆炮弹。拉尔戈的瞭望台位于营地东北方。
text.description: 自从我们在这里扎营以来，拉尔戈和他的爪牙们就一直在窃取我们的军备。这件事令我感到非常挫折。$B$B有报告称拉尔戈将偷来的炮弹堆放在可以鸟瞰水面的塔楼中。你能去那里取回一些炮弹吗？$B$B$n，要当心联盟哦。
text.progress: Did you find the cannonballs?
text.completion: Good job on the recovery effort $n. These cannonballs should last us a while.
text.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

english.title: Cannonball!
english.objectives: You need to recover 4 Stacks of Cannonballs from Largo's Overlook for Private Sarlosk.  You can find Largo's Overlook just northeast of the base camp.
english.description: Largo and his minions have been stealing our supplies ever since we setup camp here.  It's frustrating to say the least.$b$bWe have heard reports that he is stockpiling cannonballs in the towers overlooking the water up on his overlook.  Can you head up there and try to recover some of them for us?$b$b$n, don't forget to keep a watch out for Alliance too.
english.progress: Did you find the cannonballs?
english.completion: Good job on the recovery effort $n. These cannonballs should last us a while.
english.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：北荆棘谷！
text.objectives: 去找北荆棘谷反抗军营地的多伦上尉。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向反抗军营地的多伦上尉报到。$B$B在库尔森上校背叛暴风城许多年之后，事情的真相仍然被掩盖在迷雾中。帮助那些幸存者找出库尔森上校最终的下落。从暮色森林向南进发，穿过桥进入丛林之后，沿着路向西走即可抵达反抗军营地。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: Welcome to our camp, $c, such as it is.

english.title: Hero's Call: Northern Stranglethorn Vale!
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp in the Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.$B$BYears after Colonel Kurzen's treachery against Stormwind, the truth of what happened remains a mystery. Aid the survivors in learning what became of the colonel. Travel south from Duskwood and follow the road west after crossing into the jungle to reach the Rebel Camp.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: Welcome to our camp, $c, such as it is.

text.title: 夺回拉尔戈的瞭望台
text.objectives: 列兵萨罗斯克要你前往拉尔戈的瞭望台杀死指挥官拉尔戈。拉尔戈的瞭望台位于营地的东北方。
text.description: 要夺回拉尔戈的瞭望台，只有一个办法。$b$b你应该知道怎么做吧，$n。这些日子拉尔戈的妄想症挺严重的，他多半待在塔楼上指望着假想中的海军尽早登陆呢，所以去楼顶找他准没错。
text.completion: Ha, we finally got Largo!  Nice one, $n.
text.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
text.giverWindow: 祝你好运。

english.title: Taking the Overlook Back
english.objectives: Private Sarlosk has asked you to kill Commander Largo at Largo's Overlook.  The overlook is just northeast of the base camp.
english.description: There is only one way for us to take Largo's Overlook back.$b$bI think you know what we need to do $n.  Largo is pretty paranoid these days so you should be able to find him on top of the tower, looking for his imaginary navy to finally arrive.
english.completion: Ha, we finally got Largo!  Nice one, $n.
english.completed: Report back to Private Sarlosk at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: Good luck with this one.

text.title: 免受损伤
text.objectives: 从班萨罗兽穴中收集5件坠星圣物。
text.description: 幸运的是，当虫害发生时，西边的兽穴没有德鲁伊处于沉睡状态中。不过，那里对我们来说仍是一处圣地，而且在深处还存放着一些圣器，几百年来都没有被惊动过。$B$B虽然我对地精的灭虫队挺有信心的，但我也……对他们的习惯很了解。请你到兽穴中去，把你找到的所有圣物都拿回来给我，以免损失。它们都存放在遍布兽穴的凹室里的翁中。
text.progress: I hope you found them intact...
text.completion: They may not look like much to you, but these relics hold great value to the people of Starfall.  You are kind, $n.
text.completed: Return to Wynd Nightchaser at Starfall Village in Winterspring.

english.title: Out of Harm's Way
english.objectives: Retrieve 5 Starfall Relics from the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den.
english.description: Luckily, when the infestation occured, no druids were slumbering in the western barrow den. It is still a sacred site to us, however, and its depths hold blessed relics kept there undisturbed for ages.$B$BWhile I am somewhat trusting of the goblin exterminators, I am also... familiar with the habits of their race. Please retrieve any relics you can find in the barrow den and bring them back to me so they are not damaged. They are within urns, nestled in the small alcoves throughout the den.
english.progress: I hope you found them intact...
english.completion: They may not look like much to you, but these relics hold great value to the people of Starfall.  You are kind, $n.
english.completed: Return to Wynd Nightchaser at Starfall Village in Winterspring.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：荆棘谷海角！
text.objectives: 去找荆棘谷海角探险者协会挖掘场的布朗温·斧击。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向探险者协会挖掘场的布朗温·斧击报到。$B$B探险者协会的远征队需要你们的帮助，以确保挖掘场及里面的文物不受游荡食人魔的威胁。从北荆棘谷向南进发，沿路前往探险者协会挖掘场。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: It's good to see you here, $c.

english.title: Hero's Call: The Cape of Stranglethorn!
english.objectives: Report to Bronwyn Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite on the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Bronwyn Hewstrike at the Explorers' League Digsite.$B$BThe Explorers' League expedition needs your help to safeguard its site and findings from marauding ogres. Travel south from Northern Stranglethorn Vale and follow the road to the Explorers' League Digsite.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: It's good to see you here, $c.

text.title: 进入我的兽穴
text.objectives: 杀死10只寒蛰爬虫和5只寒蛰掘洞虫。
text.description: 我依然对这些虫子的来源毫无了解。我猜很可能是大灾变把一些我们没有听说过的地下巢穴给震了出来。$B$B不过呢，反正也是要把它们都杀光的，就不必管这么多啦！
text.completion: Hey, nice work!$b$bIf you ever want to come back and kill some more bugs for absolutely no additional reward, please, feel free!
text.completed: Return to Rinno Curtainfire at the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den in Winterspring.

english.title: Step Into My Barrow
english.objectives: Kill 10 Coldlurk Creepers and 5 Coldlurk Burrowers.
english.description: I've still got no clue where all these bugs came from. My best guess is the cataclysm stirred up some underground nests we never knew about.$B$BNo use getting distracted with that when they need killing, though!
english.completion: Hey, nice work!$b$bIf you ever want to come back and kill some more bugs for absolutely no additional reward, please, feel free!
english.completed: Return to Rinno Curtainfire at the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den in Winterspring.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：荆棘谷海角！
text.objectives: 去找荆棘谷海角硬钳避世乐园的莎希·硬钳。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向硬钳避世乐园的莎希·硬钳报到。她需要你们的帮助，以对付肆虐丛林的海盗和纳迦。$B$B从北荆棘谷向南进发，寻找一座位于古拉巴什竞技场西南方的城镇，即可抵达硬钳避世乐园。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Welcome to Hardwrench Hideaway!

english.title: Warchief's Command: The Cape of Stranglethorn!
english.objectives: Report to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway on the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway. She requires your help to deal with the pirates and naga who have overrun the jungle.$B$BTravel to Hardwrench Hideaway by heading south from Northern Stranglethorn and looking for the town southwest of the Gurubashi Arena.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Welcome to Hardwrench Hideaway!

text.title: 大酋长的命令：外域！
text.objectives:
向地狱火半岛命运阶梯的沃雷恩中将报到。

奥格瑞玛传送门大厅的萨尔玛法师可以帮助你前往该地。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向命运阶梯的沃雷恩中将报到。$B$B外域那片支离破碎的土地上，燃烧军团正在横行无忌，为了对抗他们，你的技艺至关重要。$B$B前往奥格瑞玛前门的传送门大厅，和萨尔玛法师交谈来传送到诅咒之地，然后穿过黑暗之门抵达命运阶梯。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Prepare yourself for battle. The Horde has need of you here.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Outland!
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant General Orion at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Lieutenant General Orion at the Stair of Destiny.$B$BYour skills are needed to fight the Burning Legion's presence on the shattered remnants of Outland.$B$BGo to Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow and use the portal near the mage trainers to reach the Blasted Lands, then travel through the Dark Portal itself to reach Hellfire Peninsula.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Prepare yourself for battle. The Horde has need of you here.

text.title: 向前喷
text.objectives: 将盒装灭虫烟熏器交给班萨罗兽穴中的蕾玛·弹幕。
text.description: 我的同伴已经深入兽穴去对付虫子了，而且他们有些吃不消了。要我说，是时候用烟熏法来解决问题了。$B$B带上这些烟熏器。你可别自己去安装它们，这东西需要受过高度专业训练的人才玩得转，还要有非常精确的时间控制。你只需要找到我的姐妹们，把它交给她们就行。$B$B蕾玛应该是在最靠近入口的地方。从走廊下去，下坡之后沿着右边走。
text.completion: We're bringing out the bug spray, eh? I guess it can't be helped.

english.title: Spray it Forward
english.objectives: Bring the Box of Bugkill Fumigators to Remma Curtainfire inside the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den.
english.description: My fellow siblings are already further down in the den trying to deal with these bugs, and they're starting to get overwhelmed. I say it's time to gas the place.$B$BTake these fumigators. Don't go setting them off yourself; it takes a highly trained professional, and proper timing. Just find my sisters and pass them out.$B$BRemma should be positioned closest to the entrance. Head down the corridor and  keep to your right once you go down the ramp.
english.completion: We're bringing out the bug spray, eh? I guess it can't be helped.

text.title: 再喷一次
text.objectives: 将盒装灭虫烟熏器交给班萨罗兽穴中的玛希·弹幕。
text.description: 我这就开始安装这东西了。$B$B下一个要交给玛希，她在兽穴的更深处。从这条走廊继续朝前走，在下一座主厅里找到她。
text.progress: Wasn't expecting to see a stranger down here!
text.completion: Fumigators? From Rinno? Geez...

english.title: Spray it Again
english.objectives: Bring the Box of Bugkill Fumigators to Marcy Curtainfire inside the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den.
english.description: I'm gonna start setting this up.$B$BNext one goes to Marcy, further down the den. Head down this corridor here and look for her in the next main chamber.
english.progress: Wasn't expecting to see a stranger down here!
english.completion: Fumigators? From Rinno? Geez...

text.title: 英雄的召唤：外域！
text.objectives:
向地狱火半岛命运阶梯的指挥官杜隆报到。

法师区的荣耀堡法师会帮助你前往该地。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向地狱火半岛的指挥官杜隆报到。$B$B远征军需要你们的帮助以压制燃烧军团的恶魔大军！在法师区的高塔中与荣耀堡法师谈一谈，前往诅咒之地，然后穿过黑暗之门，到达命运阶梯。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: The expedition needs your help, $c.

english.title: Hero's Call: Outland!
english.objectives: Report to Commander Duron at the Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Commander Duron in Hellfire Peninsula.$B$BThe expeditionary forces require your help to overcome the demonic armies of the Burning Legion! Use the portal on the middle level of the tower in the Mage District to travel to the Blasted Lands, then travel through the Dark Portal to reach the Stair of Destiny in Outland.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: The expedition needs your help, $c.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：北风苔原！
text.objectives: 去找北风苔原无畏要塞的征募官布莱瑟。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要向北风苔原无畏要塞的征募官布莱瑟报到。$B$B无畏远征军需要你们的帮助，以控制天灾军团并保卫我们的人民和国土！前往暴风城港口，就可以乘坐北面的船前往无畏要塞。$B$B为了联盟的光辉与荣耀！
text.completion: The expedition needs your help, $c.

english.title: Hero's Call: Northrend!
english.objectives: Report to Recruitment Officer Blythe at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Recruitment Officer Blythe at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.$B$BThe Valiance Expedition needs your help to keep the forces of the Scourge under control and safeguard civilized lands! Make your way to the Stormwind Docks and take the ship north to Valiance Keep.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: The expedition needs your help, $c.

text.title: 又喷一次
text.objectives: 将盒装灭虫烟熏器交给班萨罗兽穴中的萨娜·弹幕。
text.description: 我还指望瑞诺会不止派一个单枪匹马的$r下来帮忙呢！真是个寄生虫……$B$B我这就开始安装。从这间屋子往北，穿过走廊去找萨娜。她八成是在最后的房间里迷路了，所以你到那边之后别忘了检查一下旁边的岔路。
text.progress: 你在这里做什麽?
text.completion: Rinno sent you! And you brought... fumigators? Ugh!

english.title: Spray it One More Time
english.objectives: Bring the Box of Bugkill Fumigators to Sana Curtainfire in the Ban'Thallow Barrow Den.
english.description: You'd think Rinno could have sent more than a single $r down here to give us a hand! That freeloader...$B$BI'm gonna set this up. Head north from this room through the corridor and look for Sana. She's probably gotten herself lost in the last chamber, so check the side passages once you get there.
english.progress: What're you doing here?
english.completion: Rinno sent you! And you brought... fumigators? Ugh!

text.title: 大酋长的命令：北风苔原！
text.objectives: 去找北风苔原战歌要塞的战歌征募官。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向战歌要塞的战歌征募官报到。$B$B战歌远征军需要你们的帮助，化解亡灵天灾造成的持续威胁。$B$B在奥格瑞玛的西部飞艇塔上搭乘飞艇，前往战歌要塞，去找征募官。$B$B使命在召唤你们！
text.completion: The Warsong Offensive could use more like you, $c.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Northrend!
english.objectives: Report to the Warsong Recruitment Officer at Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra.
english.description: All able bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to the Warsong Recruitment Officer at Warsong Hold.$B$BThe Warsong Offensive needs your help to overcome the continued threat from the undead Scourge.$B$BTake the zeppelin to Warsong Hold from Orgrimmar's western zeppelin tower and present yourself to the recruitment officer.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: The Warsong Offensive could use more like you, $c.

text.title: 巨龙女王驾到
text.objectives: 去找暮光高地生命法阵的莉拉斯塔萨。
text.description: 你好，$r。真希望我们能在更令人愉悦的场合见面。世界危在旦夕，泰坦苦心经营的一切或许就要化为泡影了。$B$B虽然令我悲伤不已，但这是我最终的决定。死亡之翼——一度是大地守护者的可怕生物，我的朋友——必须被摧毁。$B$B我在高地顶部准备了一块地方，就在朱红庇护所的西边，我要在那里把他结果。去生命法阵跟里面的莉拉斯塔萨谈一谈。我会到那里见你的。
text.completion: Hello again, $r. I hear you were instrumental in our push toward Grim Batol - thank you! Alexstrasza has sanctified this ground in the hopes of luring Deathwing here. She'll perform a ceremony to lure him out... and then destroy him within this sacred circle. Let's hope her plan works.

english.title: Enter the Dragon Queen
english.objectives: Seek out Lirastrasza at the Circle of Life in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Hello, $r. I wish we could meet in more favorable circumstances. The world hangs by a thread, and all that the Titans have wrought may be in jeopardy.$B$BIt saddens me greatly, but my judgment is final. Deathwing - the horrific creature that was once the Earth Warder and once my friend - must be destroyed.$B$BI have prepared a site atop the Highlands, to the west of the Vermillion Redoubt, where I can bring about his end. Seek out the Circle of Life and speak with Lirastrasza within. I will join you there.
english.completion: Hello again, $r. I hear you were instrumental in our push toward Grim Batol - thank you! Alexstrasza has sanctified this ground in the hopes of luring Deathwing here. She'll perform a ceremony to lure him out... and then destroy him within this sacred circle. Let's hope her plan works.

starters.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

text.title: 自然的平衡
text.objectives: 杀死6只夜刃豹幼崽。
text.description: 你好，$n。我是伊尔萨莱恩。我负责在幽影谷训练像你这样年轻的$c，并确保自然的平衡。$b$b今年的春雨下得特别大，导致森林里的某些野兽过度繁殖，已然威胁到其他族群的生存环境。夜刃豹的数量急剧增长，如果不采取捕杀措施，它们将对其他生物造成毁灭性的影响。$b$b年轻的$c，踏上旅途吧，削减夜刃豹的数量，以此维系自然的和谐生态。
text.progress: There is still work to be done, $n. Return to me once you have thinned the nightsaber population.
text.completion: 你的任务完成得很好，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Ilthalaine in Shadowglen.

english.title: The Balance of Nature
english.objectives: Kill 6 Young Nightsabers.
english.description: Greetings, $n. I am Ilthalaine. My purpose in Shadowglen is to train young $cs like you and to ensure that the balance of nature is maintained.$b$bThe spring rains were particularly heavy this year, causing some of the forest's beasts to flourish while others suffered. Unfortunately, the nightsaber numbers grew too large, and they will devastate the other populations if they are not culled.$B$BJourney forth, young $c, and thin saber populations so that nature's harmony will be preserved.
english.progress: There is still work to be done, $n. Return to me once you have thinned the nightsaber population.
english.completion: You performed your duties well, $n.
english.completed: Return to Ilthalaine in Shadowglen.

text.title: 腐化的魔苔
text.objectives: 从伊尔萨莱恩所在位置以西的劣魔身上收集6棵魔苔。
text.description: 看来你很清楚自己在做什么。或许我可以交给你一项更重要的任务。$B$B你大概也知道，我们原以为泰达希尔的污染已被清除。但是腐化的气息依然残留。自然界的生物并没有恢复常态，我们依然要面临各种各样的问题。$B$B我要你对付聚集在西边的劣魔，并从他们身上收集魔苔。我或许可以借此找出污染之源。
text.progress: Satisfy my suspicions, $n. Bring to me fel moss from the grellkin.
text.completion: Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $n. You confirmed my fears, however. The grellkin are still tainted by fel moss, despite Teldrassil's blessing. Something sinister remains within the tree. I can only hope that the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs are free of the corruption, or we are still in grave danger. I will look into this further and contact those who might be of aid. Thank you, $c.
text.completed: Return to Ilthalaine in Shadowglen.

english.title: Fel Moss Corruption
english.objectives: Collect 6 Fel Moss from the grellkin to the west of Ilthalaine.
english.description: You seem to know what you're doing. Perhaps I can task you with something a little more important.$B$BAs you may well know, the corruption in Teldrassil was supposedly wiped away. Yet something lingers. The creatures have not calmed and all manner of problems still plague us.$B$BI need you to deal with the grellkin that have gathered to the west, and while you're there, I want you to search them for fel moss. This will help me determine from where this continuing corruption stems.
english.progress: Satisfy my suspicions, $n. Bring to me fel moss from the grellkin.
english.completion: Your service to the creatures of Shadowglen is worthy of reward, $n. You confirmed my fears, however. The grellkin are still tainted by fel moss, despite Teldrassil's blessing. Something sinister remains within the tree. I can only hope that the Gnarlpine tribe of furbolgs are free of the corruption, or we are still in grave danger. I will look into this further and contact those who might be of aid. Thank you, $c.
english.completed: Return to Ilthalaine in Shadowglen.

text.title: 恶魔窃贼
text.objectives: 在西边劣魔活跃区域找回德林拉尔被盗的背包。
text.description: 邪恶的小劣魔！他们又在开始偷窃我们的粮食储备了。$B$B如果你不介意帮我一把的话，就去西边的劣魔营地夺回被盗的背包。只要你完成任务，我会很乐意奖励你的。
text.progress: I don't have any spare supplies for my customers until my stolen goods are recovered. Have you had any luck?
text.completion: Elune be praised! And you as well, young $c. There are many young night elves in need of these, but I'd be more than happy to give you one of the bags as a reward. I'm sure it will come in handy. Safe travels to you.
text.completed: Return to Melithar Staghelm at Aldrassil.

english.title: Demonic Thieves
english.objectives: Recover Melithar's Stolen Bags near the grellkin to the west.
english.description: Vicious little grell! They've been stealing from our foodstores again.$B$BIf you wouldn't mind lending a hand, they are sure to have my stolen bags within their camps to the west. I would be glad to reward you if you can bring them back to me.
english.progress: I don't have any spare supplies for my customers until my stolen goods are recovered. Have you had any luck?
english.completion: Elune be praised! And you as well, young $c. There are many young night elves in need of these, but I'd be more than happy to give you one of the bags as a reward. I'm sure it will come in handy. Safe travels to you.
english.completed: Return to Melithar Staghelm at Aldrassil.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：暮光高地！
text.objectives: 与暴风城暴风要塞的杰塔瑞斯将军交谈。
text.description: 奉安度因·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，联盟所有身强力壮的公民都要前往暴风要塞的王座大厅报到。$B$B乌瑞恩国王需要一名值得信赖的强大英雄，去执行极其重要的任务。$B$B有意者可以向杰塔瑞斯将军报到。暴风要塞就在暴风城的东部区域。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！
text.completion: We are pleased that you have answered our summons, $c.

english.title: Hero's Call: Twilight Highlands!
english.objectives: Speak with King Varian Wrynn at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to the throne room in Stormwind Keep.$B$BKing Wrynn requires a trustworthy and proven hero for a mission of the utmost importance.$B$BStormwind Keep can be found in the eastern portion of Stormwind City.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance!
english.completion: We are pleased that you have answered our summons, $c.

text.title: 大酋长的命令：暮光高地！
text.objectives: 去奥格瑞玛的格罗玛什要塞找萨鲁法尔大王报告。
text.description: 所有身强力壮的部落成员，从此刻起都要向格罗玛什要塞的萨鲁法尔大王报到。$B$B萨鲁法尔大王需要你们的帮助，以准备向暮光高地发动大规模进攻，击败我们的两大宿敌，联盟和暮光之锤。$B$B到奥格瑞玛力量谷中心的格罗玛什要塞去见他。$B$B命运在召唤！
text.completion: Soon, the assault on the Twilight Highlands will begin, and I intend for you to be a part of it.

english.title: Warchief's Command: Twilight Highlands!
english.objectives: Report to Garrosh Hellscream at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
english.description: All able-bodied members of the Horde are hereby ordered to report to Garrosh Hellscream in Grommash Hold.$B$BThe warchief requires your help to prepare for the glorious assault on the Twilight Highlands and our dual enemies, the Alliance and Twilight's Hammer.$B$BMeet with the warchief in Grommash Hold at the center of Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: Soon, the assault on the Twilight Highlands will begin, and I intend for you to be a part of it.

text.title: 哪里有炊烟，哪里就有美味
text.objectives: 去冬泉谷的精掘烟熏坑寻找杰兹·精掘。
text.description: 我说，$c……你喜欢吃肉吗？或者我应该问，你喜欢金钱吗？$b$b我有个表亲，靠做冻肉生意大发横财。他在北边挖了个烟熏坑，正需要帮手狩猎危险而美味的野兽呢。$b$b食肉者总是肯出大价钱的，朋友。我把大笔的资金投在了这座兽穴——真是脑抽，所以就把好处让你这样乐于助人的$r吧。$b$b我的表亲叫杰兹。去东北方炊烟升起的地方找他吧！
text.completion: Look around you; you're looking at the largest goblin-owned hunting reserve in Kalimdor! I've got the licenses to shoot and eat everything that walks on the snow from here to Everlook... and lemme tell you, they're good eatin'!

english.title: Where There's Smoke, There's Delicious Meat
english.objectives: Find Jez Goodgrub at Goodgrub Smoking Pit in Winterspring.
english.description: Say there, $c... do you like meat?  Even better, do you like money?$b$bI got a second cousin who's making a killing in the frozen meats business.  He's set up a smoking pit up north, and he's looking for help hunting all the dangerous beasties that always tend to taste so good.$b$bCarnivores pay well, friend.  I'm too heavily invested here in this barrow den - what was I thinking? - so I might as well pass the tip on to a helpful $r like yourself.$b$bHis name's Jez.  Head northeast, and look for the smoke!
english.completion: Look around you; you're looking at the largest goblin-owned hunting reserve in Kalimdor! I've got the licenses to shoot and eat everything that walks on the snow from here to Everlook... and lemme tell you, they're good eatin'!

text.title: 偏硬的肉质
text.objectives: 杀死15头碎齿暴熊。
text.description: 许多人都觉得碎齿熊的肉太硬。我不同意这个观点，但是我并不会随意批判他人的口味。$b$b南边生活着碎齿熊的表亲——碎齿暴熊，它们披着棕色的毛皮，肉质细嫩，特别是熊掌。我听说熊鼻子也是难得的美味。$b$b继续狩猎吧，$n。试试你能不能帮老弗朗西斯解决这些碎齿暴熊。
text.completion: <Francis smacks his lips.>$b$bYou've got to try some of this, $n.  These maulers are perfectly tenderized... possibly because of the pummeling you delivered.
text.completed: Return to Francis Morcott at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 我不在乎口感。
text.turninWindow: 那边就有一些熊的肉很不错。

english.title: A Little Gamy
english.objectives: Kill 15 Shardtooth Maulers.
english.description: Many find the meat of the Shardtooth bears to be too gamy for their taste. I disagree, though I'm not one to judge the tastes of others.$b$bThe Shardtooth Maulers, however - their brown-furred cousins, to the south - have much more tender flesh, particularly in their paws. And I've heard that the snout is also considered a delicacy.$b$bContinue your hunt, $n. Let's see if you can bag those maulers for ol' Francis.
english.completion: <Francis smacks his lips.>$b$bYou've got to try some of this, $n.  These maulers are perfectly tenderized... possibly because of the pummeling you delivered.
english.completed: Return to Francis Morcott at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: I don't mind the taste.
english.turninWindow: That's some good bear right there.

text.title: 设身处地
text.objectives: 护送一个法尔森要塞囚犯逃到安全地带。要塞就在岛屿的最北角。
text.description: 前几周，我们派出了至少3支侦察小队，去调查法尔森要塞。可悲的是，他们一个都没回来，更别提什么情报了。$B$B目前，我们只能寄希望于他们被活捉当囚犯了。我要你去潜入那座要塞，帮助我们的士兵逃回来。这可不是一项简单的任务，$n，但是如果说还有谁能上我们的忙的话，就只有你了。
text.completion: You saved our men!  No words can express our gratitude $n.
text.end: 护送法尔森要塞囚犯
text.completed: 完成任务之后，去地狱咆哮之握的指挥官拉尔玛什。
text.giverWindow: 这家伙似乎需要一些帮助。

english.title: Walk A Mile In Their Shoes
english.objectives: Escort a Farson Keep Prisoner to safety.  The hold is located on the northern tip of the island.
english.description: We have sent at least 3 different recon groups to investigate Farson Hold in the last few weeks.  Sadly, not one of them has returned back with any info.$B$BAt this point, all we can hope is that they are being held alive as prisoners.  I need you to infiltrate the keep and help get our soldiers back.  This won't be easy $n, but if anyone can help us, it's you.
english.completion: You saved our men!  No words can express our gratitude $n.
english.end: Farson Prisoner Escorted
english.completed: Report back to Commander Larmash at Hellscream's Grasp when you are done.
english.giverWindow: This guy looks like he could use some help.

text.title: 雪怪恐惧症
text.objectives: 带着乌米的机械雪人去吓唬莱加奇。
text.description: 搞定！$B$B现在，我已经告诉我的朋友莱加奇，说是我有个惊喜要给她看看。这就是你要做的事情！$B$B我要把机械雪人给你，然后你就去给她一个惊喜。她就在永望镇的另一侧，旅店附近。$B$B到她身边去启动机械雪人……我就在这里看乐子！
text.progress: She'll never expect it!
text.completion: Hah! She'll think twice before making fun of my ideas again!$B$BThanks for your help, $n. I couldn't have had so much fun without you!
text.completed: Return to Umi Rumplesnicker at Everlook in Winterspring.

english.title: Yetiphobia
english.objectives: Scare Legacki with Umi's Mechanical Yeti.
english.description: It's all ready, $n!$B$BNow, I told my friend Legacki that I have a surprise for her. This is where you come in!$B$BI'm going to give you my mechanical yeti, and you'll get the honor of using it to surprise her. She's just on the other side of Everlook, near the inn.$B$BGo up to her and turn the yeti on... I'll be watching from here!
english.progress: She'll never expect it!
english.completion: Hah! She'll think twice before making fun of my ideas again!$B$BThanks for your help, $n. I couldn't have had so much fun without you!
english.completed: Return to Umi Rumplesnicker at Everlook in Winterspring.

text.title: 月神女祭司
text.objectives: 跟位于幽影谷中心的两座池塘之间的女祭司德塔莉亚谈一谈。
text.description: 或许你可以帮助我们继续调查幽影谷的污染事件。$B$B月神女祭司德塔莉亚愿意向我们伸出援手。你可以在奥达希尔以北的两座池塘之间找到她。绕树前进，年轻的$c，尽你所能地协助她吧。
text.completion: It is good that you've come. It seems your training progresses quickly.

english.title: Priestess of the Moon
english.objectives: Speak to Dentaria Silverglade between the two pools in the center of Shadowglen.
english.description: Now that you're practiced in your new ability, perhaps you'd be willing to aid us in further pursuing the corruption haunting Shadowglen.$B$BDentaria Silverglade, Priestess of the Moon, has offered to aid us. You should find her between the two pools just north of our great tree. Circle around the tree to reach her and offer her any help that you can, young $c.
english.completion: It is good that you've come. It seems your training progresses quickly.

text.title: 埃沃隆的解药
text.objectives: 收集7朵月牙百合花。
text.description: 我们的朋友埃沃隆被附近的树林蜘蛛咬了，现在已经中毒。我可以尽量使他的病情不再恶化，但是我得找人收集一种材料，才能为他准备解药。$B$B你可以在水池旁找到月牙百合花。这些花朵有着非常好的治疗效果，我可以把它们同我手中已有的材料混合起来，使埃沃隆恢复健康。$B$B你能去帮我收集一些吗？这附近不远处就有许多月牙花分布在水池边。
text.progress: Our dear friend is not doing well, even with my mending. Have you brought the supplies I require?
text.completion: These will do perfectly. Thank you, $n. Your swiftness is appreciated.
text.completed: Return to Dentaria Silverglade between the ponds in Shadowglen.

english.title: Iverron's Antidote
english.objectives: Collect 7 Moonpetal Lilies.
english.description: Our friend Iverron has fallen to poison from the nearby webwood spiders. I can tend to him to keep his state from deteriorating, but I need someone to gather an ingredient to prepare him an antidote.$B$BAll around the ponds you should find Moonpetal Lilies. These flowers have great healing properties, and I can use them with the ingredients I already have to restore Iverron to better health.$B$BWould you gather them for me?  There should be many just in sight of here, near the water's edge.
english.progress: Our dear friend is not doing well, even with my mending. Have you brought the supplies I require?
english.completion: These will do perfectly. Thank you, $n. Your swiftness is appreciated.
english.completed: Return to Dentaria Silverglade between the ponds in Shadowglen.

text.title: 森林守护者
text.objectives: 在幽影谷最北边的黑丝洞找到树妖塔琳德拉。
text.description: 我必须请你去做一件更危险的事。森林之魂的低语给我带来了奇怪的消息。神秘的森林守护者塔琳德拉又回到了幽影谷。$B$B早在泰达希尔受到祝福之前，这位树妖的身影就没有在这片森林中出现过了。她既然回到了这里，就意味着这里一定出了什么事情。$b$b到北边的黑丝洞去找到了塔琳德拉。是有些危险，不过有了解药，我们就不用怕了。
text.completion: I see you found me, young $r.  Dentaria was wise to have sent you.

english.title: The Woodland Protector
english.objectives: Seek out the dryad known as Tarindrella within the Shadowthread Cave at the northern end of Shadowglen.
english.description: I must ask something more dangerous of you. Strange news has traveled to me through the whisperings of the forest spirits. The mysterious woodland protector, Tarindrella, has returned to Shadowglen again.$B$BThe dryad's presence has not been felt in the forests since before the blessing of Teldrassil. Something is surely amiss if she has journeyed back to this land.$b$bSeek out Tarindrella in the Shadowthread cave to the north. It is dangerous, but we will be prepared with this antidote just in case.
english.completion: I see you found me, young $r.  Dentaria was wise to have sent you.

text.title: 树林蜘蛛的腐蚀
text.objectives: 杀死12只树林蜘蛛。
text.description: 我原本希望再也不用为了这种危急的事务返回泰达希尔。我原本希望它的腐蚀已被完全净化。但是某些邪恶的东西仍然挥之不去。$B$B这些蜘蛛受到的腐蚀影响，远比附近的其它野生动物更深。它们已经成为了对你们的人民和整个森林的威胁。我们必须削减它们的数量，但更重要的是，我们必须找到使它们堕落的源头。$B$B我会跟你一起行动，为你提供帮助。
text.progress: This is grim work. It pains me to have to inflict such violence on creature of the forest, corrupt or not.
text.completion: This corruption these spiders suffer from is not simply surface deep. It cannot be magic or subtle mal intent. It is bred into them. It seems our next task is clear.
text.completed: Speak to Tarindrella within the Shadowthread Cave in Shadowglen.

english.title: Webwood Corruption
english.objectives: Kill 12 Webwood Spiders.
english.description: I'd hoped to never return to Teldrassil for such grim business. I'd hoped that its corruption had been wiped away completely.  Something foul lingers.$B$BThese spiders suffer much more deeply from the corruption than the other nearby wildlife. They are becoming a danger to your people and a danger to the forest. We must thin their numbers, but more importantly, we need to find the source of the corruption that plagues them.$B$BI will come with you and aid you in this.
english.progress: This is grim work. It pains me to have to inflict such violence on creature of the forest, corrupt or not.
english.completion: This corruption these spiders suffer from is not simply surface deep. It cannot be magic or subtle mal intent. It is bred into them. It seems our next task is clear.
english.completed: Speak to Tarindrella within the Shadowthread Cave in Shadowglen.

text.title: 邪恶的触摸
text.objectives: 杀死黑丝洞北端的邪恶的基塞伊斯。
text.description: 如果这些蜘蛛生来就是受到腐蚀的，那么它们的母亲一定就是邪恶的根源。$B$B我们继续深入到洞穴的北端，去找到邪恶的基塞伊斯吧。答案就在她的身上。
text.progress: I adore these forests. I want to see the corruption purged from them completely. When next I return, I wand to do so with a lighter heart.
text.completion: Githyiss and her brood were being corrupted by this totem. This is a furbolg totem. This is very troubling indeed. This means the Gnarlpine are still a danger to these forests. We let our guard down too soon.
text.completed: Speak to Tarindrella within the Shadowthread Cave in Shadowglen.
text.giverWindow: 基塞伊斯就是解开幽影谷和整个泰达希尔堕落的关键线索。

english.title: Vile Touch
english.objectives: Kill Githyiss the Vile at the northen end of the Shadowthread Cave.
english.description: If these spiders are born with corruption in their veins, then their broodmother must be at the root of this evil.$B$BLet us make our way to the far north end of the cave and seek out Githyiss the Vile. The answers we seek lie with her.
english.progress: I adore these forests. I want to see the corruption purged from them completely. When next I return, I wand to do so with a lighter heart.
english.completion: Githyiss and her brood were being corrupted by this totem. This is a furbolg totem. This is very troubling indeed. This means the Gnarlpine are still a danger to these forests. We let our guard down too soon.
english.completed: Speak to Tarindrella within the Shadowthread Cave in Shadowglen.
english.giverWindow: With Githyiss lie clues to the corruption of Shadowglen and the rest of Teldrassil.

text.title: 未来的征兆
text.objectives: 与幽影谷北部池塘一带的德塔莉亚·银林交谈。
text.description: 我会顺着瘤背熊怪的踪迹，追查这堕落之源。如果你在多兰纳尔碰到阿斯瑞达斯·熊皮，他对于森林中发生的各种问题非常关注，可以指引你进一步协助解决问题。$B$B我相信我们还会再见面。等我找到了堕落的源头，也许你可以帮助我解决它。眼下，我会带你回到德塔莉亚身边去，这样你就可以完成训练了。感谢你提供的帮助，$n。
text.completion: You've returned! It's good to see you. It seems you've dealt with the source of much of the corruption in Shadowglen. Teldrassil still suffers and will need attention, be we can afford a moment or two for you to finish your training here in Shadowglen.

english.title: Signs of Things to Come
english.objectives: Speak to Dentaria Silverglade between the pools in northern Shadowglen.
english.description: I will pursue the trail of the Gnarlpine and track this corruption to its source. If you ever encounter Athridas Bearmantle in Dolanaar, he knows intimately of the problems that plague this forest, and he can direct you on how to help further.$B$BI'm sure we will meet again with time. Perhaps you can aid me in dealing with the source of this corruption once I locate it. For now, I will take you back to Dentaria so that you may finish your training. Thank you for all that you have done, $n.
english.completion: You've returned! It's good to see you. It seems you've dealt with the source of much of the corruption in Shadowglen. Teldrassil still suffers and will need attention, be we can afford a moment or two for you to finish your training here in Shadowglen.

text.title: 泰达希尔：艾泽拉斯之冠
text.objectives: 在幽影谷东北部的月亮井中装满水晶瓶。
text.description: 作为完成幽影谷训练的一个步骤，你应该首先好好了解我们近代的历史。$b$b有一个你必须去完成的任务，到我们东北边的月亮井里装一瓶水，当你到达那里时，你会看到我们的魔法的闪影，并学习我们的历史。$B$B结束之后，把水拿回来交给我，我会给你新的指引。
text.progress: Our recent history is fraught with strife and violence. There is still much with which we must come to terms.
text.completion: Well done, $n. You have one task left for you before you depart Shadowglen for the open wilds of Teldrassil.
text.completed: Return to Dentaria Silverglade between the pools in northern Shadowglen.

english.title: Teldrassil: Crown of Azeroth
english.objectives: Fill the Crystal Phial at the moonwell in northeast Shadowglen.
english.description: As part of a ritual to complete your training here in Shadowglen, you must learn about our recent history.$b$bThere is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell to our northeast and retrieve a phial of its water. While there, you will witness a glimpse of our magics and learn of our past.$B$BWhen you are done there, bring the water back to me, and I will direct you further.
english.progress: Our recent history is fraught with strife and violence. There is still much with which we must come to terms.
english.completion: Well done, $n. You have one task left for you before you depart Shadowglen for the open wilds of Teldrassil.
english.completed: Return to Dentaria Silverglade between the pools in northern Shadowglen.

text.title: 珍贵的水
text.objectives: 将装满水的水晶瓶交给幽影谷奥达希尔的特纳隆·雷拳。
text.description: 特纳隆·雷拳监督着这片林地中发生的所有事情。他就住在奥达希尔的顶端。$B$B如果你朝南边看的话，就会看到通往他住处的斜坡。顺着这道斜坡上去，完成你的训练。$B$B很高兴能认识你，$n。看到在年轻的暗夜精灵中还有如此无私而充满活力的人，令我感到非常骄傲。你会为我们的人民做出巨大的贡献。你会为这个世界做出巨大的贡献。$B$B再会。
text.progress: The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world. The druids take advantage of its properties, the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, and now even the returning Highborne look to the wells longingly.
text.completion: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more for you to learn and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.

english.title: Precious Waters
english.objectives: Bring the filled crystal phial to Tenaron Stormgrip at the top of Aldrassil in Shadowglen.
english.description: Tenaron Stormgrip oversees all that happens in this glade. He presides at the top of Aldrassil.$B$BIf you look to your south, you will see the underside of the ramp that leads up to him. Ascend this ramp and complete your training.$B$BIt was wonderful to have met you, $n. I swell with pride knowing that among young night elves, there are some so selfless and full of life as you are. You will do great things for our people. You will do great things for this world.$B$BUntil we meet again.
english.progress: The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world. The druids take advantage of its properties, the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, and now even the returning Highborne look to the wells longingly.
english.completion: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more for you to learn and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.

text.title: 泰达希尔：传递信息
text.objectives: 将装着半瓶水的瓶子交给多兰纳尔的科瑞萨斯·月怒。
text.description: 关于月亮井和泰达希尔的点点滴滴实在是太多了，我无法一一告知给你，这需要你自己去探索。科瑞萨斯·月怒正在等着你。我已经把你所带回来的水倒入了这个容器中，把它送到科瑞萨斯那里去吧。$b$b出发吧，科瑞萨斯就在多兰纳尔的月亮井旁。你只需要沿着奥达希尔南边的小路走出幽影谷，沿着鹅卵石铺成的小路一直走，然后向西转就行了。$b$b注意，你要一直沿着路走，$n。最近路旁的森林里出现了许多危险的野兽。
text.progress: 你好，$C。是什么事让我们能在此愉快地会面呢?
text.completion: Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do. Before we get to the task at hand, you should take in the lesson of this moonwell.

english.title: Teldrassil: Passing Awareness
english.objectives: Bring the Partially Filled Vessel to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.
english.description: While there is more I could speak to you of the moonwells and of Teldrassil, I must send you along. Corithras Moonrage will be expecting you. I have poured the phial of water you brought to me into this vessel to bring to him.$b$bSeek out Corithras. You will find him at the moonwell in Dolanaar. Follow the road south from Aldrassil out of Shadowglen, and continue to follow the cobblestones as the road turns west.$b$bMind you stay on the road though, $n. There are dangerous beasts in the forests of late.
english.progress: Greetings, $c. For what purpose do I owe the pleasure of our meeting?
english.completion: Ah, I see. You were sent by Tenaron. Well then, it would seem we have much to talk about, much to do. Before we get to the task at hand, you should take in the lesson of this moonwell.

text.title: 只有一个可能……
text.objectives: 乘坐皮普的挖掘机前往黑石山。
text.description: 拉兹和我被海加尔山守护者招募，调查拉格纳罗斯重新攻入我们这个世界的事件。让我去调查一番他是不是已经回来了，是不是怒火中烧！另外，我们也有证据表明，暮光之锤的教徒正在把元素生物从这里挪到东部王国的黑石岩窟去。$B$B拉兹和我正要去那边进行调查。我们的钻探机里面还有一个空位，不知你是否感兴趣。只需要到里面去找我们，就可以出发了。
text.completion: Oh dear, Raz has been captured! As soon as we entered a dozen cultists and some big fat ogre jumped us. I ran while I Raz tried to fight them off. We need to save him, $n!
text.end: 抵达黑石岩窟。
text.completed: 在黑石岩窟入口里面皮普·急智与见面。

english.title: This Can Only Mean One Thing...
english.objectives: Take Finkle's Mole Machine to Blackrock Mountain.
english.description: Raz and I were enlisted by the Guardians of Hyjal to investigate the re-emergence of Ragnaros into our world. Let me go ahead and confirm that he is back and he is angry! We also have evidence that these Twilight's Hammer cultists are moving elementals from here to Blackrock Caverns, over in the Eastern Kingdoms.$B$BRaz and I were about to head over there to investigate. We've got room for another in the mole machine if you're interested. Just meet us on the inside and we'll begin our journey.
english.completion: Oh dear, Raz has been captured! As soon as we entered a dozen cultists and some big fat ogre jumped us. I ran while I Raz tried to fight them off. We need to save him, $n!
english.end: Arrive at Blackrock Caverns.
english.completed: Find Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.

text.title: 植物学基础
text.objectives: 抵御1大波僵尸攻击。
text.description: 救命啊！救命啊！疯狂的亡灵正在攻击我的农场！药渣农场的那个神经兮兮的看守者，八成就是幕后主使。帮我击退这些僵尸！
text.completion: PHEW! That was close! You're a real natural with these plants, $c. You know, I brought the seeds here with me from Lost Isles. I figure once I get them all figured out I'll make a fortune in the deadly flower business! Wha... LOOK! MORE ARE COMING!
text.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Basic Botany
english.objectives: Survive a Massive Wave of Zombies.
english.description: HELP! HELP! Crazed undead are attacking my farm! That psycho warden over at the Sludge Fields is probably responsible for this mess. Help me fight off the zombies!
english.completion: PHEW! That was close! You're a real natural with these plants, $c. You know, I brought the seeds here with me from Lost Isles. I figure once I get them all figured out I'll make a fortune in the deadly flower business! Wha... LOOK! MORE ARE COMING!
english.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 帮助麦利萨尔
text.objectives: 跟幽影谷的麦利萨尔·鹿盔谈一谈。
text.description: 你应该跟麦利萨尔谈谈。我相信他正为劣魔的事情发愁呢。$B$B如果你能帮他一把的话，他会送你急需的背包的。
text.completion: Ilthalaine sent you? He was wise to do so. I am indeed in need of help.

english.title: A Favor for Melithar
english.objectives: Speak to Melithar Staghelm in Shadowglen.
english.description: You should speak with Melithar. I believe he had some troubles with the grell already.$B$BI expect he can offer you a well needed place to store more of your goods should you aid him.
english.completion: Ilthalaine sent you? He was wise to do so. I am indeed in need of help.

text.title: 前往焚烧之厅！
text.objectives: 杀死摧骨者罗姆欧格。
text.description: 他们早有埋伏，$n！我们刚刚进来，就有一个超胖的食人魔，名叫摧骨者罗姆欧格的，向我们发起了攻击！在我跑去藏起来的时候，拉兹勇敢地保护了我。我亲眼看到他们把他打昏过去，拖进了那个胖子称之为“焚烧之厅”的地方。我觉得它应该就在过桥之后的大厅那边。$B$B我太害怕了，没法走太远。你可以带着我的多功能潜水头盔去找拉兹。我会通过头盔与你联系。$B$B顺便，如果你找到那个食人魔的话，把他杀掉！
text.completion: RAZ! What have they done to him!? FOLLOW HIM!
text.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
text.giverWindow: 这就是绑架了拉兹的大胖子坏蛋。
text.turninWindow: 跟着拉兹！

english.title: To the Chamber of Incineration!
english.objectives: Kill Rom'ogg Bonecrusher.
english.description: It was an ambush, $n! As soon as we walked in a super-fat ogre named Rom'ogg Bonecrusher attacked us! Raz bravely defended me while I ran off to hide. I watched as they beat him unconscious and then dragged him to a place the fat one called the "Chamber of Incineration." I think it's just down the hall across the bridge.$B$BI'm too scared to go any further. Take my all-purpose diving helm and search for Raz. I'll communicate with you through the helm.$B$BAnd if you find that ogre, kill him!
english.completion: RAZ! What have they done to him!? FOLLOW HIM!
english.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
english.giverWindow: This is the fat piece of good-for-nothing that kidnapped Raz.
english.turninWindow: Follow Raz!

text.title: 天降弹雨
text.objectives: 登上被征用的火炮，用它杀死100个司克诺兹步兵。
text.description: 司克诺兹的组织仍有一部分在造物主高地负隅顽抗，杀死任何敢于靠近这一区域的人。$b$b我们的弹药很充足，但是没有好的观察员，我就只能盲目开火。$b$b跳上来帮我个忙。那些士兵肯定死都不知道自己怎么死的！
text.completion: The enemy on Maker's Ascent remain a threat, but with your help we've dealt a serious blow to their numbers and their morale.
text.completed: Speak to the Weathered Nomad in Pilgrim's Precipice.

english.title: Fire From the Sky
english.objectives: Board the Confiscated Artillery and use it to kill 100 Schnottz Infantrymen.
english.description: The remnants of Schnottz's organization persist here on the Maker's Ascent, making the region deadly to any who draw near.$b$bThere's plenty of ammunition, but without a good spotter, I'm just firing blind.$b$bHop in and give me a hand here. Those soldiers won't know what hit them!
english.completion: The enemy on Maker's Ascent remain a threat, but with your help we've dealt a serious blow to their numbers and their morale.
english.completed: Speak to the Weathered Nomad in Pilgrim's Precipice.

text.title: 这是什么地方？
text.objectives: 杀死柯尔拉，暮光之兆。
text.description: <皮普的头盔轻轻震了你一下。>$B$B这是什么地方？他们好像在对那条虚空龙做些什么可怕的勾当。那条龙的能量正在被转移到那位女士体内！我们必须阻止这场仪式！$B$B消灭柯尔拉，穿过这座大厅！
text.completion: We haven't got much time. Raz looked injured. If we get to him in time there might be a chance that I can turn him back into a regular orc! Sorry about that. I figured I'd send through some gold - for your troubles and all that...
text.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
text.giverWindow: 她看起来很坏！
text.turninWindow: 没时间浪费了！拉兹需要我们的帮助！

english.title: What Is This Place?
english.objectives: Kill Corla, Herald of Twilight.
english.description: <Finkle's helm gives you a slight jolt.>$B$BWhat is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual!$B$BKill Corla to get past this hall!
english.completion: We haven't got much time. Raz looked injured. If we get to him in time there might be a chance that I can turn him back into a regular orc! Sorry about that. I figured I'd send through some gold - for your troubles and all that...
english.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
english.giverWindow: She looks mean!
english.turninWindow: There's no time to waste! Raz needs our help!

text.title: 暮光熔炉
text.objectives: 杀死卡尔什·断钢。
text.description: <皮普的头盔发出嗡嗡的声音。>$B$B该死的！拉兹跑个没完没了！他好像是被一种向所有暮光成员复仇的冲动给彻底控制了！如果我们要穿过这间屋子，赶上拉兹，就必须干掉暮光军械师卡尔什·断钢。快点结果了他，$n。
text.completion: That should put a stop to their armory - at least for now. Raz ran off across the ramp on the other side of the forge. GO GO GO!
text.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
text.giverWindow: 我想他也许能掰弯钢铁。
text.turninWindow: 拉兹就在附近。我能听到他的声音。

english.title: The Twilight Forge
english.objectives: Kill Karsh Steelbender.
english.description: <Finkle's helm hums with energy.>$B$BDamn it! Raz won't stop! It's as if he were possessed with a burning vengeance for all things Twilight! It looks like if we're going to get past this room and catch up with Raz we'll need to take out the Twilight armorer, Karsh Steelbender. Kill him quick, $n.
english.completion: That should put a stop to their armory - at least for now. Raz ran off across the ramp on the other side of the forge. GO GO GO!
english.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
english.giverWindow: I think he might be able to bend steel.
english.turninWindow: Raz is close. I can hear him!

text.title: Night Elf Class Skill Tracker Quest

english.title: Night Elf Class Skill Tracker Quest

text.title: 我眼花了吗？
text.objectives: 杀死如花。
text.description: <皮普的头盔中发出了巨大的尖叫声。>$B$B不可能！我……我曾被困在这样一头野兽的肚子里一个月之久。没错，真的是被困在它的胃里。如果不是我的防护服和全功能头盔，我早就被烧成灰了！看看吧，这玩意居然有一窝小崽子！$B$B你……你必须阻止它，$n！我们不能让它或者它的小崽子活着跑出去！
text.completion: Phew... That's one less thing I'll need to worry about if we ever make it out of this place.
text.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
text.giverWindow: 纯粹的邪恶景象！
text.turninWindow: 我可以少接受几年心理治疗了。

english.title: Do My Eyes Deceive Me?
english.objectives: Kill Beauty.
english.description: <Finkle's helm explodes with the sound of a loud girlish scream.>$B$BIT CAN'T BE! I... I was stuck inside one of those beasts for the better part of a month. Yes, literally stuck inside its stomach. If it weren't for my suit and the all-purpose helm I'd have died a fiery death! And look at that, it's had a litter of pups!$B$BY... You gotta stop that thing, $n! We can't let it or its pups make it out of here alive!
english.completion: Phew... That's one less thing I'll need to worry about if we ever make it out of this place.
english.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
english.giverWindow: A vision of pure evil!
english.turninWindow: That will save me from a few years of therapy.

text.title: 升腾者领主奥西迪斯
text.objectives: 杀死升腾者领主奥西迪斯。
text.description: <皮普的头盔嗡嗡作响起来。>$B$B天哪！看看这地方！天花板上的那些……是死亡之翼的爪印吗？！大厅中间的那个怪物是什么？$B$B我没看到拉兹的身影。赶紧把这怪物解决了，去找到拉兹！
text.completion: Poor Raz. He was the best friend a gnome ever had. At least we avenged his death and cleared out this hellish cavern!
text.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
text.giverWindow: 他曾是凡人，现在已升腾为元素领主了。

english.title: Ascendant Lord Obsidius
english.objectives: Kill Ascendant Lord Obsidius.
english.description: <Finkle's helm buzzes.>$B$BGOOD GOLLY! Look at this place! A... Are those Deathwing's claw marks on the ceiling?! And what's that creature in the center of the chamber?$B$BI don't see Raz anywhere. Let's take care of this monster and find Raz!
english.completion: Poor Raz. He was the best friend a gnome ever had. At least we avenged his death and cleared out this hellish cavern!
english.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
english.giverWindow: Once mortal, now an ascended elemental lord.

text.title: 希洛塔姆
text.objectives: 杀死希洛塔姆。
text.description: 伙计，重头戏来了！希洛塔姆潜伏在北方，它是整个族群中最大的霜刃豹。$B$B能执行这项任务，你应该倍感荣幸。对猎人来说，没有比这更激烈的狩猎游戏了……而且要是你知道我愿意为一块希洛塔姆的肉付多少酬金，你肯定会吓死的！$B$B成功猎杀它后就返回营地吧，我可不希望你一天就把附近的霜刃豹杀光了……
text.completion: Amazing, kid. You're a cut above! I went through about five different contracted hunters trying to get that cat.$B$BWell, we found two of them after the Captain got the corpse, but let's not dwell on that...
text.completed: Return to Jez Goodgrub at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 冬泉谷的霜刃豹女王……难得的美味！

english.title: Shy-Rotam
english.objectives: Slay Shy-Rotam.
english.description: Time for the big kill, pal! Shy-Rotam lurks in the north, the largest frostsaber of them all.$B$BYou should feel honored. There's no fiercer game for a hunter to match their skills against... and if you saw the cash I'm being offered by gourmands that want a piece of this fellow, your eyes would pop out!$B$BOnce you've got her, head on back to camp. Don't want to totally exhaust our frostsaber population in one day...
english.completion: Amazing, kid. You're a cut above! I went through about five different contracted hunters trying to get that cat.$B$BWell, we found two of them after the Captain got the corpse, but let's not dwell on that...
english.completed: Return to Jez Goodgrub at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: Pridemother of the Winterspring Frostsabers... and a tasty meal!

text.title: 机尾炮手！
text.objectives: 击落15个司克诺兹王牌飞行员。
text.description: 你想打猎玩玩吗，$N？$B$B跳进来吧！我来飞，你来打！
text.completed: 到維爾納爾水壩和哈里遜‧瓊斯說話。

english.title: Tailgunner!
english.objectives: Shoot down 15 Schnottz Aces.
english.description: You up for a little hunting, $n?$b$bHop in! I'll fly, you shoot!
english.completed: Speak to Harrison Jones at Vir'naal Dam.

text.title: 谷物战僵尸
text.objectives: 抵御2大波僵尸攻击。
text.description: 你真是个高手啊，$n！俨然是训练有素的初级植物学家了！你看，我有一种新的试验用的种子，它叫岩石坚果。用它来阻挡亡灵吧。只要把它种下，就可以阻止亡灵前进。亡灵可真傻！$B$B我们这就来试试看吧！
text.completion: I think that made Stillwater angry. He's sending the heavy-hitters after us now. No time to lose, friend, let's go!
text.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Ghouls Hate My Grains
english.objectives: Survive 2 Massive Waves of Zombies.
english.description: You're a pro at this, $n! A regular junior botanist! Listen, I've got a new seed to try called the rocknut. Use it to block the undead. Just drop it down and they'll stop dead in their tracks. Undead are so stupid!$B$BLet's give it a try!
english.completion: I think that made Stillwater angry. He's sending the heavy-hitters after us now. No time to lose, friend, let's go!
english.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 鸣枭的挽歌
text.objectives: 杀死15只冬泉鸣枭。
text.description: 体型较小的枭真的很美味，但是精掘说继续往南走会遇到体型较大的枭。当地人称其为鸣枭……它们在遇到威胁时就会发出刺耳的叫声！$B$B精掘指出，鸣枭是他吃过以及出售过的最好的枭，我相信他。我跟弗朗西斯的争论还没完呢，不然你去帮我狩猎一些鸣枭来？
text.completion: You've put us in enough owls for us to sell for a month, friend. Gotta hand it to ya.
text.giverWindow: 迫不及待地想得到更多的枭！
text.turninWindow: 这个喋喋不休的家伙令我很困惑。

english.title: Screechy Keen
english.objectives: Slay 15 Winterspring Screechers.
english.description: Them smaller owls are sure tasty, but Goodgrub says there's even bigger ones further south. Screechers, the folk around here call 'em... they make a heck of a noise when you tussle with them!$B$BBut he says they're the best owls he's ever tasted or sold, and I believe him. Why don't you go rustle up some of those for us while I keep arguin' with Francis here?
english.completion: You've put us in enough owls for us to sell for a month, friend. Gotta hand it to ya.
english.giverWindow: Can't wait for more of them owls!
english.turninWindow: This here fancy talky thing just confuses me.

text.title: 突破防御
text.objectives: 进入泰坦控制室。
text.description: 就是这里，$n！$b$b那扇门的后面就是控制室。$b$b我会冲进去，关闭起源重组系统，然后我们就可以回家了。简单明了。$b$b你瞧，$g小伙子:姑娘;，真正的地质学家和寻宝猎人的区别，就在于准备工作的不同。$b$b没必要打草惊蛇。那样只会把事情搞得一塌糊涂……
text.completion: Well, I've got bad news and I've got...$b$bNo, scratch that. There only be bad news.
text.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard in the Vault of Lights in the Halls of Origination.

english.title: Penetrating Their Defenses
english.objectives: Gain entry to the Titan Control Room.
english.description: Here we go, $n!$b$bJust beyond that door lies the control room.$b$bI'll just run in, disable the reorigination mechanism, and then we all go home. Nice an' easy.$b$bYe see, $glad:lass;, it's this level of preparation that separates yer true archaeologist from yer average treasure hunter.$b$bNo sense in stirring up the beasties if ye don't have to. Just makes a mess a' things...
english.completion: Well, I've got bad news and I've got...$b$bNo, scratch that. There only be bad news.
english.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard in the Vault of Lights in the Halls of Origination.

text.title: 南瓜炸弹
text.objectives: 抵御2大波僵尸攻击。
text.description: 你见过这种东西吗？$B$B<布雷泽拿出一只南瓜。>$B$B这可不是普通的南瓜，朋友。看，只要你把它们种下，它们就会一直等待亡灵走过来，然后，轰隆！遍地都是僵尸的碎片啦。动手吧！
text.completion: D... Do you hear that rumblin'? I think Stillwater is comin'! HOLY MOLY LOOK OUT!
text.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Someone Setup the Pumpkin Bomb
english.objectives: Survive 2 Massive Waves of Zombies.
english.description: You ever seen one of these?$B$B<Brazie pulls out a pumpkin.>$B$BThis ain't no ordinary pumpkin, friend. See, once you plant it they'll lay in wait until a zombie shows up and then KABLOOEY! Zombie guts all over the place. Let's go!
english.completion: D... Do you hear that rumblin'? I think Stillwater is comin'! HOLY MOLY LOOK OUT!
english.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 亡者的草坪
text.objectives: 击败看守者斯蒂沃特。
text.description: 是斯蒂沃特！他就要来了！我们要倾尽全力才能击败他！加油！
text.completion: I can't believe we defeated him, $n! That was the toughest fight yet, but there are still hundreds of crazed zombies roaming around Hillsbrad. We'll need to stay alert.
text.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Lawn of the Dead
english.objectives: Defeat Warden Stillwater.
english.description: IT'S STILLWATER! HE'S ALMOST HERE! It's going to take everything that we've got to beat him! Let's do this!
english.completion: I can't believe we defeated him, $n! That was the toughest fight yet, but there are still hundreds of crazed zombies roaming around Hillsbrad. We'll need to stay alert.
english.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: 安多哈尔之战
text.objectives: 与战斗法师伊拉利尔交谈，传送到西瘟疫之地的安多哈尔。然后向安多哈尔城内的萨萨里安报到。
text.description: 我们刚刚收到了从瘟疫之地飞来的狮鹫送达的消息。情况听起来不妙。$b$b有三股势力正在为夺取安多哈尔激烈交战——被遗忘者，联盟，还有天灾。乌瑞恩国王已经做出了决定，派遣一名死亡骑士领军作战，不过我相信他需要尽可能多的帮助。$b$b他们特别要求派一名联盟的$c去执行某些特殊任务。如果你接受这项任命，就再跟我谈谈，我会为你准备一道传送门。
text.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
text.completed: 去西瘟疫之地，找安多哈尔的萨萨里安。

english.title: The Battle for Andorhal
english.objectives: Speak with War-Mage Erallier to be teleported to Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.  Then report to Thassarian within Andorhal.
english.description: We just received a gryphon from the plaguelands, bearing news.  It doesn't sound good.$b$bThe city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge.  King Wrynn has rolled the dice and sent a death knight to lead the charge for his cause, but I'm sure he can use all the help he can get.$b$bThey specifically asked for an Alliance $c to participate in some specialized missions.  If you accept the charge, speak to me again and I will prepare a portal.
english.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
english.completed: Report to Thassarian within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 安多哈尔之战
text.objectives: 与奥法师艾尔曼交谈，传送到西瘟疫之地的安多哈尔。然后向安多哈尔城内的库尔迪拉·织亡者报到。
text.description: 我们刚刚收到了从瘟疫之地飞来的双足飞龙送达的消息。情况听起来不妙。$b$b有三股势力正在为夺取安多哈尔激烈交战——被遗忘者，联盟，还有天灾。看样子，希尔瓦娜斯已经有了动作，有趣的是，她派了死亡骑士库尔迪拉·织亡者领军作战。$b$b他们特别要求派一名部落的$c去执行某些特殊任务。如果你接受这项任命，就再跟我谈谈，我会为你准备一道传送门。
text.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
text.completed: 去找西瘟疫之地安多哈尔的库尔迪拉·织亡者。

english.title: The Battle for Andorhal
english.objectives: Speak with Arcanist Arman to be teleported to Andorhal, in the Western Plaguelands.  Then report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal.
english.description: We just received a windrider from the plaguelands, bearing news.  It doesn't sound good.$b$bThe city of Andorhal is in the middle of a three-way war between the Forsaken, the Alliance, and the Scourge.  It sounds like Sylvanas has made her move, and to make matters interesting, she's put Koltira Deathweaver, the death knight, in command.$b$bThey specifically asked for a Horde $c to participate in some specialized missions.  If you accept the charge, speak to me again and I will prepare a portal.
english.completion: It's about time you arrived, $c.
english.completed: Report to Koltira Deathweaver within Andorhal in Western Plaguelands.

text.title: 照料花园
text.objectives: 抵御2大波僵尸攻击。
text.description: 虽然我们击败了看守者斯蒂沃特，但他的僵尸仍在田野里游荡。看那边，又一波僵尸涌过来了！帮我击退它们，老朋友！准备动手吧！
text.completion: That'll keep 'em out for today, but I know they'll be back tomorrow. Hopefully you'll be around to help me.
text.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

english.title: Tending the Garden
english.objectives: Survive 2 Massive Waves of Zombies.
english.description: Even though we beat Warden Stillwater, his zombies still roam the countryside. Look there, another wave is approaching! Help me fight them off, old buddy! Let's go!
english.completion: That'll keep 'em out for today, but I know they'll be back tomorrow. Hopefully you'll be around to help me.
english.completed: Speak to Brazie the Botanist at Brazie's Farmstead in Hillsbrad Foothills.

text.title: Unstoppable Onslaught
text.description: See how long you can last! Hold off at least 10 waves and I'll give you some coin.

english.title: Unstoppable Onslaught
english.description: See how long you can last! Hold off at least 10 waves and I'll give you some coin.

text.title: 来硬的
text.objectives: 布莱恩·铜须要你消灭伊希斯特、阿穆纳伊、塞特斯，以及拉夏。
text.description: 该死的！$b$b有人把整个系统都污染了！我没办法通过这个控制台进入储藏室。$b$b我们必须得来硬的了，$g小伙子:姑娘;。但愿你和你的朋友做好了战斗准备。$b$b上面一层有四个守护者。除非它们……这么说吧，失效，不然我没法启动这些圆盘。
text.completion: Arrite, then.$b$bLet's deposit these discs and be done with this!
text.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard in the uppermost chamber of the Halls of Origination.

english.title: Doing it the Hard Way
english.objectives: Brann Bronzebeard wants you to kill Isiset, Ammunae, Setesh, and Rajh.
english.description: Blast it all!$b$bSomeone's gone and corrupted the entire system! There be no way fer me ta access the main repository from this console.$b$bWe're gunna hafta do this the hard way, $glad:lass;. I hope you an' yer friends here are up to a fight.$b$bThere be four guardians on the upper level of this place. I won't be able ta utilize these discs 'til they be... uhh, offline, shall we say.
english.completion: Arrite, then.$b$bLet's deposit these discs and be done with this!
english.completed: Speak to Brann Bronzebeard in the uppermost chamber of the Halls of Origination.

text.title: 生命与死亡之战
text.objectives: Help Alexstrasza try to kill Deathwing. Protect the five Lifebinder Stones that surround the circle!
text.description: Alexstrasza has been preparing this site for many years. Once Deathwing is lured into this circle, she will use the rejuvenating powers of its life energy to overwhelm and destroy him.$B$BIt is important that the five lifebinder stones that surround this circle remain uncorrupted during the fight. Deathwing will be concentrating solely on the Queen of Dragons herself; you may escape his notice. Kill any of his minions that try to corrupt the circle.$B$BTalk to me when you are ready to begin!
text.completed: Speak with Calen at the Circle of Life in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Battle of Life and Death
english.objectives: Help Alexstrasza try to kill Deathwing. Protect the five Lifebinder Stones that surround the circle!
english.description: Alexstrasza has been preparing this site for many years. Once Deathwing is lured into this circle, she will use the rejuvenating powers of its life energy to overwhelm and destroy him.$B$BIt is important that the five lifebinder stones that surround this circle remain uncorrupted during the fight. Deathwing will be concentrating solely on the Queen of Dragons herself; you may escape his notice. Kill any of his minions that try to corrupt the circle.$B$BTalk to me when you are ready to begin!
english.completed: Speak with Calen at the Circle of Life in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 白银之手编年史
text.objectives: 从斯坦索姆取回一卷遗失的白银之手编年史。
text.description: 你知道白银之手骑士团吗？他们是最早的一批信仰圣光的圣骑士，他们的成员后来分别加入了银色黎明或血色十字军。虽然很多圣骑士走入了歧途，但他们仍然保留着白银之手骑士团的珍贵圣物。$B$B在斯坦索姆深处，档案管理员加尔福特警惕地看管着白银之手编年史。你找到的每一卷这种书都是圣光之愿礼拜堂求之若渴的珍藏品。
text.progress: Have you recovered any of the lost histories of the Silver Hand?
text.completion: This is indeed one of the lost volumes! Tyrosus will be most pleased when he learns of your find.
text.completed: Return to Lord Raymond George at Light's Hope Chapel.

english.title: Annals of the Silver Hand
english.objectives: Recover a lost volume of the Annals of the Silver Hand from Stratholme.
english.description: Do you know who the Knights of the Silver Hand were? They were the original paladins of the Light, and from their ranks came knights who would later join the Argent Dawn or the Scarlet Crusade. Though many have gone astray, they still possess valuable relics of the Silver Hand.$B$BDeep in Stratholme, under the watchful eye of Instructor Galford, volumes of the Annals of the Silver Hand survive. Any volumes you could recover would be a fitting addition to the rededicated Light's Hope Chapel.
english.progress: Have you recovered any of the lost histories of the Silver Hand?
english.completion: This is indeed one of the lost volumes! Tyrosus will be most pleased when he learns of your find.
english.completed: Return to Lord Raymond George at Light's Hope Chapel.

text.title: 扭曲的骨骸
text.objectives: 在通灵学院的尸骨储藏所中杀死血骨傀儡。
text.description: 生前，我和兄弟们曾经与所有天灾军团的士兵战斗过，但是没有一种能比通灵师更令人憎恨。他们不仅把我们死去的战友复活起来，派他们来与我们厮杀，还创造出以镰刀替代了双手的、扭曲的白骨魔像。$B$B这些怪物杀死了我的许多兄弟，而我们无力把它们全部消灭。我希望你，$n，去完成牺牲者未竟的事业。进入通灵学院的尸骨储藏所，杀死那些怪物中最强大也最危险的一个。
text.completion: Your deeds do honor to those who fell in battle defending this hallowed ground.
text.completed: Return to Lord Raymond George at Light's Hope Chapel.

english.title: Aberrations of Bone
english.objectives: Kill Rattlegore in the Ossuary of Scholomance.
english.description: In life, my brothers and I fought against all the forces of the Scourge, but none were so reviled as the necromancers. It was not enough for them raise our dead comrades and send them against us; no, they created twisted golems of bone with scythes for hands.$B$BThese aberrations slew many of my brothers, and yet we could not destroy them all. I ask you, $n, to carry on the task of the fallen. Venture into the Ossuary of Scholomance and slay the largest and most dangerous of these abominable creatures.
english.completion: Your deeds do honor to those who fell in battle defending this hallowed ground.
english.completed: Return to Lord Raymond George at Light's Hope Chapel.

text.title: 击退敌人！
text.objectives: 杀死6只黑石战狼。
text.description: 你就是来自暴风城的新兵？我是治安官玛克布莱德，这支驻防部队的指挥官。欢迎你前来报到……$B$B<玛克布莱德翻阅着文件。>$B$B$n。你是$n吧？$B$B来得正是时候。黑石兽人从山脉断口处潜入了北郡。驻防部队的士兵们正在竭力奋战，一次次地击退敌人的进攻，但是我担心他们支持不了多久了。$B$B前往西北方的森林，杀死入侵的黑石战狼！帮帮我们吧！
text.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
text.completion: 你為我們爭取了一些時間，$n，但我們還有更大的問題要去解決。
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。

english.title: Beating Them Back!
english.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Battle Worgs.
english.description: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...$B$B<McBride looks through some papers.>$B$B$n. It is $n, right?$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!
english.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
english.completion: You've bought us a little time, $n, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a Blackrock Battle Worg.

text.title: 生命与死亡之战
text.objectives: 骑上朱红先锋。杀死8条暮光暗影幼龙。
text.description: 阿莱克丝塔萨和死亡之翼飞上了格瑞姆巴托的天空！她的计划失败了——巨龙女王正身处在先前布置的生命法阵之外。我们需要尽一切所能援助她。$B$B快！登上我身后的朱红先锋。$B$B要是我们发现有任何暮光幼龙在帮助死亡之翼，就把它们杀掉。骑上去，快点！
text.completion: Thanks to your quick action, the Dragon Queen still lives. She is being brought back to Wyrmrest to recover. But the battle wasn't a complete failure. Deathwing was gravely wounded. I suspect he will go into hiding to recuperate. Alexstrasza has bought us time to strike!
text.completed: Report to Calen at the base of Grim Batol in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Battle of Life and Death
english.objectives: Mount a Vermillion Vanguard. Slay 8 Twilight Shadowdrakes.
english.description: Alexstrasza and Deathwing have taken into the skies over Grim Batol! Her plan unravels - the Dragon Queen is outside the Circle of Life she prepared earlier. We'll need to support her with everything we've got.$B$BHurry! Climb aboard one of the Vermillion Vanguard behind me.$B$BIf we find any Twilight Drakes aiding Deathwing, we will need to kill them off. Mount up, quickly!
english.completion: Thanks to your quick action, the Dragon Queen still lives. She is being brought back to Wyrmrest to recover. But the battle wasn't a complete failure. Deathwing was gravely wounded. I suspect he will go into hiding to recuperate. Alexstrasza has bought us time to strike!
english.completed: Report to Calen at the base of Grim Batol in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 狮入羊口
text.objectives: 消灭8名黑石间谍。
text.description: 入侵的兽人可不傻。他们密切关注着我们的动向，想要抓住有利的时机发起进攻。$B$B黑石间谍就躲藏在西北方的森林里。他们利用望远镜偷窥我们的一举一动，耐心地等待着。我要你除掉他们！$B$B杀死黑石间谍！让这帮家伙明白，我们知道他们在打什么如意算盘，而且我们做好了准备！
text.progress: 殺死那些間諜!
text.completion: 做得好，$n。看來你會是本地駐軍一個很大的助力。到你訓練的時候了!
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 这是一名男性黑石间谍。黑石间谍中不乏女性成员。

english.title: Lions for Lambs
english.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
english.description: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.$B$BIn the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!$B$BKill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!
english.progress: Kill the spies!
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison. It's time for you to train!
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a male Blackrock orc spy. There are females amongst them as well.

text.title: 为奥西斯复仇
text.objectives: 杀死阿萨德。
text.description: 宏伟的奥西斯城受到了气元素大军的攻击。$B$B我们被抓来当了俘虏，但我们已经算是幸运的了。$B$B因为大多数人都死了，被埋葬在令人窒息的沙漠中。$B$B阿萨德是奥拉基尔的西风君王，就是他下令发动攻击……他必须为此付出生命的代价。
text.completion: Blessings upon you.  Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
text.completed: Return to Itesh at the Vortex Pinnacle.
text.giverWindow: 阿萨德在奥拉基尔的命令下，发动了毁灭奥西斯的战争。让他付出代价！

english.title: Vengeance for Orsis
english.objectives: Slay Asaad.
english.description: The great city of Orsis was attacked by the armies of air.$B$BWe were taken prisoner.  We were the lucky ones.$B$BMost died, trapped beneath the choking desert sands.$B$BAsaad, Al'Akir's caliph, ordered the attack... and he must pay with his life.
english.completion: Blessings upon you.  Please accept this as a token of my gratitude.
english.completed: Return to Itesh at the Vortex Pinnacle.
english.giverWindow: Asaad, under Al'Akir's orders, oversaw the devastation of Orsis.  Make him pay!

text.title: 击退敌人！
text.objectives: 杀死6只黑石战狼。
text.description: 你就是来自暴风城的新兵？我是治安官玛克布莱德，这支驻防部队的指挥官。欢迎你前来报到……$B$B<玛克布莱德翻阅着文件。>$B$B$n。你是$n吧？$B$B来得正是时候。黑石兽人从山脉断口处潜入了北郡。驻防部队的士兵们正在竭力奋战，一次次地击退敌人的进攻，但是我担心他们支持不了多久了。$B$B前往西北方的森林，杀死入侵的黑石战狼！帮帮我们吧！
text.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
text.completion: 你為我們爭取了一些時間，$n，但我們還有更大的問題要去解決。
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。

english.title: Beating Them Back!
english.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Battle Worgs.
english.description: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...$B$B<McBride looks through some papers.>$B$B$n. It is $n, right?$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!
english.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
english.completion: You've bought us a little time, $n, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.
