english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a Blackrock Battle Worg.

text.description: 你就是来自暴风城的新兵？我是治安官玛克布莱德，这支驻防部队的指挥官。欢迎你前来报到……$B$B<玛克布莱德翻阅着文件。>$B$B$n。你是$n吧？$B$B来得正是时候。黑石兽人从山脉断口处潜入了北郡。驻防部队的士兵们正在竭力奋战，一次次地击退敌人的进攻，但是我担心他们支持不了多久了。$B$B前往西北方的森林，杀死入侵的黑石座狼！帮帮我们吧！
text.progress: 你擊退黑石座狼了嗎？
text.completion: 你為我們爭取了一些時間，$n，但我們還有更大的問題要去解決。
text.completed: 到艾爾文森林的北郡修道院找治安官瑪克布萊德。
text.giverWindow: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。

english.title: Beating Them Back!
english.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Battle Worgs.
english.description: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...$B$B<McBride looks through some papers.>$B$B$n. It is $n, right?$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!
english.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
english.completion: You've bought us a little time, $n, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.

text.title: 击退敌人！
text.objectives: 杀死6只黑石战狼。
text.description: 你就是来自暴风城的新兵？我是治安官玛克布莱德，这支驻防部队的指挥官。欢迎你前来报到……$B$B<玛克布莱德翻阅着文件。>$B$B$n。你是$n吧？$B$B来得正是时候。黑石兽人从山脉断口处潜入了北郡。驻防部队的士兵们正在竭力奋战，一次次地击退敌人的进攻，但是我担心他们支持不了多久了。$B$B前往西北方的森林，杀死入侵的黑石战狼！帮帮我们吧！
text.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
text.completion: 你為我們爭取了一些時間，$n，但我們還有更大的問題要去解決。
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。

english.title: Beating Them Back!
english.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Battle Worgs.
english.description: So you're the new recruit from Stormwind, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. Glad to have you on board...$B$B<McBride looks through some papers.>$B$B$n. It is $n, right?$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!

text.title: 冬泉谷！
text.objectives: 去找冬泉谷冰火温泉的多诺瓦·雪山。
text.description: 女矮人多诺瓦·雪山是木喉熊怪的朋友。$b$b我们交易火酒。$b$b她在冰火温泉，东边，穿过我们的洞穴。$B$B她需要帮助，打败冬泉熊怪。也许你能帮她。
text.completion: Thank goodness you're here. I've discovered the secret of the fierce Winterfall furbolg.

english.title: Winterspring!
english.objectives: Report to Donova Snowden at Frostfire Hot Springs in Winterspring.
english.description: Donova Snowden, dwarf woman, is friend of the Timbermaw.$b$bWe trade firewater.$b$bShe is at Frostfire Hotsprings, to the east, through our cave.$B$BShe needs help to beat up the Winterfall furbolg.  Maybe you will help her.
english.completion: Thank goodness you're here. I've discovered the secret of the fierce Winterfall furbolg.

text.title: 狮入羊口
text.objectives: 消灭8名黑石间谍。
text.description: 入侵的兽人可不傻。他们密切关注着我们的动向，想要抓住有利的时机发起进攻。$B$B黑石间谍就躲藏在西北方的森林里。他们利用望远镜偷窥我们的一举一动，耐心地等待着。我要你除掉他们！$B$B杀死黑石间谍！让这帮家伙明白，我们知道他们在打什么如意算盘，而且我们做好了准备！
text.progress: 殺死那些間諜!
text.completion: 做得好，$n。看來你會是本地駐軍一個很大的助力。到你訓練的時候了!
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 这是一名男性黑石间谍。黑石间谍中不乏女性成员。

english.title: Lions for Lambs
english.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
english.description: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.$B$BIn the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!$B$BKill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!
english.progress: Kill the spies!
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison. It's time for you to train!
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a male Blackrock orc spy. There are females amongst them as well.

text.title: 破损的毒蛇雕像
text.objectives: 运用你的技能和材料，修复破损的雕像。
text.description: 这只破损的雕像被它的主人扔掉了。不过，只要有合适的材料，再加上你的珠宝加工技能，就可以完全修复它。
text.completed: Completion text.

english.title: Broken Serpent Figurine
english.objectives: Repair the broken figurine using your skill and materials.
english.description: This badly broken figurine was discarded by its last owner.  However, with the right materials and your skill in jewelcrafting, it could be completely restored.
english.completed: Completion text.

text.title: 长途跋涉的回家路
text.objectives: 获得大宰相埃尔坦之核。
text.description: 我觉得，我能侥幸逃出来的原因，坦率地讲，是因为根本没地方可去。$B$B我被困在这些平台上，他们迟早会找到我。除非……$B$B据说，元素贵族的核心可以令持有者获得该类元素生物的属性。那么气元素呢，自然就是在往下跳的时候大有帮助的属性了。$B$B把大宰相埃尔坦的核心给我带来，这样我就可以运用它的魔法力量，安全地降落在奥丹姆的海边。
text.progress: You'd best not suggest I ride with you on... whatever that thing is you flew in on.
text.completion: I thank you, $n.  Even after I had escaped, I did not imagine I'd be able to return home.
text.completed: Return to Itesh at the Vortex Pinnacle.

english.title: A Long Way from Home
english.objectives: Obtain Grand Vizier Ertan's Heart.
english.description: I've a feeling I was able to escape my captors because, frankly, there is nowhere to go.$B$BStranded on these platforms, they are bound to find me sooner or later.  Unless...$B$BIt is said that the heart of an elemental noble can grant whoever holds it the characteristics of that element.  Which, in the case of air, would be most useful during a downward trip.$B$BBring me Grand Vizier Ertan's heart so I can use its magic to land safely on the shoreline of Uldum.
english.progress: You'd best not suggest I ride with you on... whatever that thing is you flew in on.
english.completion: I thank you, $n.  Even after I had escaped, I did not imagine I'd be able to return home.
english.completed: Return to Itesh at the Vortex Pinnacle.

text.title: 加入战斗！
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院后的维里副队长报到。
text.description: 我收到了来自维里副队长的紧急消息。原来黑石兽人雇佣了地精刺客。他们在修道院后面偷袭我们了的军队。维里让我派一名英雄去帮他。就是你了，$n！$B$B到修道院北边的指挥营帐去找维里副队长。出发！
text.completion: 是真的，我們中埋伏了。我不敢冒著失去更多士兵的風險派兵出去。我需要一名自願者，願意冒生命危險的人!
text.giverWindow: 你可以在北郡修道院后的指挥营帐找到维里副队长。

english.title: Join the Battle!
english.objectives: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: While you were out training I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!
english.completion: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!
english.giverWindow: Sergeant Willem can be found at the command tent behind Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 抓住机会
text.objectives: 杀死胡辛姆将军和2个神誓副官。
text.description: 我们是一支由拉穆卡恒的纳顿亲王组建的秘密行动部队的成员。在遭到伏击之后，我们失去了大部分兵力，现在已经无力完成任务了。$B$B如果你能胜任的话，我可以为你提供丰厚的奖励。$B$B我们的任务是抓住一切机会，破坏敌人的军事体系。$B$B我们在前面看到了胡辛姆将军和他的两个副官。帮我们杀掉他们，就是帮了拉穆卡恒的大忙。
text.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Your reputation is well-deserved.
text.completed: Return to Captain Hadan in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
text.giverWindow: 我们必须对尼斐塞特的指挥体系造成致命打击！

english.title: Targets of Opportunity
english.objectives: Slay General Husam and 2 Oathsworn Captains.
english.description: We were part of a clandestine operation put together by Prince Nadun of Ramkahen.  We lost most of our unit during an ambush and we're now unable to finish our mission.$B$BShould you be up for it, I can arrange for a sizable reward for you.$B$BWe were instructed to take out any targets of opportunity that would damage the enemy's military infrastructure.$B$BWe've spotted General Husam and two of his captains up ahead.  Slaying them for us will be a great favor for Ramkahen.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n.  Your reputation is well-deserved.
english.completed: Return to Captain Hadan in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
english.giverWindow: We must deliver a fatal blow to the Neferset command structure!

text.title: 传说之鸟
text.objectives: 杀死地狱尖啸。
text.description: 传说冬泉谷栖息着一只强大的枭，翱翔在最险峻的山巅。人们叫它“死亡之翼”。$b$b很快，大家发现这名字已经被占用了。因此，他们给这只枭取了个同样具有恐惧含义的新绰号：$b$b地狱尖啸。$b$b你可以在西南方的山巅找到它。杀死这只可怕的夜行动物……我们要吃它的肉！
text.completion: Hell-Hoot is slain, and her meat is just as succulent as you'd expect.$b$bToday, we eat a legend.  Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Jeb Guthrie at Goodgrub Smoking Pit in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 杀死它！

english.title: A Bird of Legend
english.objectives: Slay Hell-Hoot.
english.description: Local legend tells of a mighty owl that circles the mountaintops like death on wings.  They named her Deathwing.$b$bSoon afterwards, they were told that that name was already taken.  So they settled on a moniker that evoked a similar sense of horror and dread:$b$bHell-Hoot.$b$bHell-Hoot can be found atop the mountain to the southwest of our smoking pit.  Silence the infernal nocturnal... so we can eat her!
english.completion: Hell-Hoot is slain, and her meat is just as succulent as you'd expect.$b$bToday, we eat a legend.  Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Jeb Guthrie at Goodgrub Smoking Pit in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: Go get her!

text.title: 他们的力量之源
text.objectives: 杀死希亚玛特。
text.description: 在遭到伏击之前，我们进行了大量的侦察工作。$B$B我们发现死亡之翼的特使，希亚玛特，正在向尼斐塞特人提供他们新近发现的力量。$B$B他们声称这种力量已经使他们恢复了古老的荣耀，但与此同时，他们的灵魂却陷入了深深的堕落。$B$B作为四位风领主之一，希亚玛特强大的惊人。但是在这一过程中，那种力量已经被明显削弱了。$B$B趁现在动手吧，这是你杀掉他并结束这种疯狂的大好机会。
text.completion: It is true, then?  The great blight upon our race will soon end now that the Neferset have lost the ability to corrupt any more of our people. Name your reward, $c.  It is the least we can do for you.
text.completed: Return to Captain Hadan in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
text.giverWindow: 希亚玛特将他们新近获得的力量赐予了尼斐塞特！

english.title: The Source of Their Power
english.objectives: Slay Siamat.
english.description: We managed to do extensive scouting before our crew was ambushed.$B$BWe discovered that Deathwing's envoy, Siamat, is giving the Neferset their newfound power.$B$BThey claim it has restored them to the greatness of old, but something else has happened.  Their very souls have been corrupted.$B$BAs one of the four winds, Siamat is incredibly powerful.  But that power has been drained considerably by this process.$B$BStrike now, while it is possible for you to slay him and bring an end to this madness.
english.completion: It is true, then?  The great blight upon our race will soon end now that the Neferset have lost the ability to corrupt any more of our people. Name your reward, $c.  It is the least we can do for you.
english.completed: Return to Captain Hadan in the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
english.giverWindow: Siamat gives the Neferset their newfound power!

text.title: 加入战斗！
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院后的维里副队长报到。
text.description: 我收到了来自维里副队长的紧急消息。原来黑石兽人雇佣了地精刺客。他们在修道院后面偷袭我们了的军队。维里让我派一名英雄去帮他。就是你了，$n！$B$B到修道院北边的指挥营帐去找维里副队长。出发！
text.completion: 是真的，我們中埋伏了。我不敢冒著失去更多士兵的風險派兵出去。我需要一名自願者，願意冒生命危險的人!
text.giverWindow: 你可以在北郡修道院后的指挥营帐找到维里副队长。

english.title: Join the Battle!
english.objectives: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: While you were out training I received an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!
english.completion: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!
english.giverWindow: Sergeant Willem can be found at the command tent behind Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 私人召唤
text.objectives: 先知克洛伽希望你到奥格瑞玛去找他。
text.description: <一种陌生的感觉从你灵魂深处涌出，各种思绪和影像淹没了你的心智。>$b$b听听我的话吧，$n。$b$b我们的世界正面临着一场可怕的危机。$b$b在这绝望的时刻，我召唤你伸出援手。$b$b我是克洛伽。$b$b立刻来找我，你的命运将被揭示。$b$b你可以在奥格瑞玛的暗巷区北边找到我。
text.completion: May your sense of honor and duty serve Azeroth well, $c.

english.title: A Personal Summons
english.objectives: Farseer Krogar wants you to meet him in Orgrimmar.
english.description: <An unfamiliar feeling wells up from deep within you, flooding your mind with thoughts and images.>$b$bHear my words, $n.$b$bOur world finds itself in the grip of a terrible crisis.$b$bI call upon you to lend your aid in this desperate hour.$b$bI am Krogar.$b$bSeek me out at once, and your destiny shall be revealed.$b$bYou can find me north of the Drag in Orgrimmar.
english.completion: May your sense of honor and duty serve Azeroth well, $c.

text.title: 他们派来了刺客
text.objectives: 杀死8名地精刺客。
text.description: 你见过地精吗，$n？这些邪恶的小怪物只喜欢两件东西：金币和他们自己。$B$B黑石兽人招募了一批地精刺客，屠杀我们的士兵。他们就潜伏在北面的草丛中，肉眼很难察觉。$B$B我要你去那里，杀死你撞见的所有地精。得给他们上一课，联盟不是好惹的！
text.progress: 殺死哥布林暗殺者!
text.completion: 那會給那些怪物上一課!下次他們承接獸人的傭兵任務前可要好好想清楚。
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 是地精刺客。邪恶的小怪物！

english.title: They Sent Assassins
english.objectives: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
english.description: Have you ever seen a goblin, $n? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.$B$BThe Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.$B$BI need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!
english.progress: Kill the goblin assassins!
english.completion: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a goblin assassin. Nasty little monster!

english.description: Have you ever seen a goblin, $n? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.$B$BThe Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.$B$BI need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!
english.progress: Kill the goblin assassins!
english.completion: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a goblin assassin. Nasty little monster!

text.completion: Ah ha!  You knew you'd seen this level of craftsmanship before.  Now, with the final piece...

text.completion: Interesting!  It seems as if the Dark Iron dwarves had a strategic plan in the case of an elemental invasion.  As the elemental forces are ageless and unchanging, it seems as if these ancient techniques are still viable even today.

text.title: 风暴之眼
text.objectives: 先知克洛伽要你观察先知之水中的景象。
text.description: 你好，$n。$b$b你在大地之环中可说是声名显赫。$b$b你的功绩和成就数不胜数。你已经为艾泽拉斯做了许多，但现在她又一次向她的英雄们发出了召唤。$b$b我只不过是一名信使。一位熟悉的存在想与你会面。$b$b去看一眼先知之水，亲眼看看我们的世界所面临的命运吧。
text.progress: 再次欢迎你，$N!你是来向我展示你完成狩猎的证明的吗?
text.completion: Now that your eyes have seen the truth, where will you choose to serve?

english.title: The Eye of the Storm
english.objectives: Farseer Krogar wants you to look into the Waters of Farseeing.
english.description: Greetings, friend.$b$bOn behalf of the Earthen Ring I thank you for answering my call.$b$bYou are known to us by name, $n.$b$bYour exploits and accomplishments are many. Azeroth already stands in your debt, and yet again she is in need of her heroes.$b$bI am but a messenger. A familiar presence seeks audience with you.$b$bPeer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the fate of our world.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: Now that your eyes have seen the truth, where will you choose to serve?

objectiveDetails.description: 观察先知之水中的景象

text.title: 别畏惧邪恶
text.objectives: 营救4名受伤的暴风城士兵。
text.description: 你拥抱过圣光吗，$g兄弟:姐妹;？是圣光拯救了我们！是圣光让我有能力治疗这些饱受战火摧残的士兵！如今，圣光也将赋予你踏进北面的战区，营救我们倒下的兄弟的能力和勇气！$B$B带着这本祷言之书，对受伤的士兵施放圣光的治疗之触。
text.progress: 解救我們的士兵!
text.completion: 我想你現在了解了聖光的力量。聖光給予希望，$g兄弟:姊妹;，而聖光驅散黑暗!讚美聖光!
text.completed: Return to Brother Paxton behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Fear No Evil
english.objectives: Revive 4 Injured Stormwind Soldiers.
english.description: Have you embraced the Holy Light yet, $g brother:sister;? It is through the Holy Light that we are saved! It is through the Holy Light that I am able to heal these overly demanding soldiers! And it is through the Holy Light that you will be able to venture out into the field to the north and rescue our fallen brothers!$B$BTake this prayer book with you into the field and cast the Light's healing touch on the injured.
english.progress: Rescue our soldiers!
english.completion: I think you now understand the power of the Light. The Light giveth hope, brother and the Light taketh from the darkness! BLESSED BE THE LIGHT!
english.completed: Return to Brother Paxton behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 专家意见
text.objectives: 把可疑的徽章交给暴风城军情七处总部的马迪亚斯·肖尔。
text.description: <安度因拿起匹配的徽章。>$B$B我们在农场发现的徽章和在萨缪尔森的档案堆里找到那个一样！这不可能是个巧合。我认为萨缪尔森在谋划什么，但在指控父王最信任的守卫之前，我们需要如山的铁证。$B$B我只相信一个人能把事情办妥：马迪亚斯·肖尔，军情七处处长。把徽章拿给他看，听听他怎么说。同时，我会回到城堡，盯着萨缪尔森！
text.progress: What's this you've brought me?
text.completion: Anduin has been investigating the Twilight's Hammer? Weren't you supposed to keep him OUT of trouble? Hmmm. Let me see those badges you've discovered.
text.completed: Bring the Suspicious Badges to Mathias Shaw at SI:7 Headquarters in Stormwind.

english.title: Expert Opinion
english.objectives: Bring the Suspicious Badges to Mathias Shaw at SI:7 Headquarters in Stormwind.
english.description: <Anduin holds up the matching badges.>$B$BThe medallion we found on the farm is identical to the one in Samuelson's notes! It can't be a coincidence. I think Samuelson is up to something, but we need a smoking gun before we can accuse one of my father's most trusted guards.$B$BThere's only one person I trust to sort this all out: Mathias Shaw, the director of SI:7. Show him these badges and see what he thinks. Meanwhile, I'll go back to the keep and watch Samuelson like a hawk!
english.progress: What's this you've brought me?
english.completion: Anduin has been investigating the Twilight's Hammer? Weren't you supposed to keep him OUT of trouble? Hmmm. Let me see those badges you've discovered.
english.completed: Bring the Suspicious Badges to Mathias Shaw at SI:7 Headquarters in Stormwind.

text.title: 追随者与领袖
text.objectives: 杀死高阶女祭司艾苏尔和101个虔诚的追随者。
text.description: 文件中详细记载了高阶女祭司艾苏尔抵达巨石之核的事宜。$B$B里面提到，艾苏尔是暮光议会的高阶成员。另外，她手下超过一百名虔诚的随从正准备举行一场无比黑暗的邪恶仪式。$B$B听起来，这是一件你必须要制止的事情。
text.completion: A high priestess, you say?  And a member of the Twilight Council?$B$BExcellent work.  I hope you find your rewards suitable.
text.completed: Return to Earthwarden Yrsa in the Stonecore.
text.giverWindow: 超过一百名虔诚的追随者……

english.title: Followers and Leaders
english.objectives: Slay High Priestess Azil and 101 Devout Followers.
english.description: The documents detail the arrival of High Priestess Azil to the depths of the Stonecore.$B$BAzil is described as a high-ranking member of the Twilight Council.  Additionally, her entourage of over a hundred devout followers is preparing for an unholy ritual of unforeseen darkness.$B$BSounds like an event you need to put a stop to.
english.completion: A high priestess, you say?  And a member of the Twilight Council?$B$BExcellent work.  I hope you find your rewards suitable.
english.completed: Return to Earthwarden Yrsa in the Stonecore.
english.giverWindow: Over a hundred devout followers...

text.title: 暮光文件
text.objectives: 获得暮光文件。
text.description: 我们跟踪暮光之锤的一个间谍来到这里。他的名字叫米尔豪斯·法力风暴。$B$B我们有理由相信，他携带着重要的文件。$B$B不过，这也是在不影响到保卫大地神殿内部的前提下，我们能走到的最远安全距离了。$B$B去找到米尔豪斯·法力风暴，拿回他携带的文件。
text.progress: These appear to be the right documents.
text.completion: <You open the documents and look for any noteworthy information.>
text.completed: Return to Earthwarden Yrsa in the Stonecore.
text.giverWindow: 获得暮光文件。

english.title: Twilight Documents
english.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Documents.
english.description: We've tailed one of the Twilight's Hammer operatives here.  He goes by the name of Millhouse Manastorm.$B$BWe have reason to believe he's carrying important documents.$B$BThis is as far as we can safely go, however, without neglecting our duty to defend the Temple of Earth's inner perimeter.$B$BTrack down Manastorm and retrieve the documents from him.
english.progress: These appear to be the right documents.
english.completion: <You open the documents and look for any noteworthy information.>
english.completed: Return to Earthwarden Yrsa in the Stonecore.
english.giverWindow: Obtain the Twilight Documents.

text.title: 驶向深渊
text.objectives: 去找杜隆塔尔刃拳海湾的指挥官索拉卡。
text.description: 大地之环已经认定水之国度瓦丝琪尔就是敌人的毁灭性能量的发源地。$b$b我们仍不清楚会在那里面对怎样的危险，所以你所收集到的任何信息都是非常有价值的。$b$b就在我们说话的当口，部落正将战舰派往该区域。如果你要去的话，就跟刃拳海湾的指挥官索拉卡谈谈。$b$b愿灵魂指引你的道路，$n。
text.completion: Lok'tar, brother! You have arrived just in time.

english.title: To the Depths
english.objectives: Report to Commander Thorak at Bladefist Bay in Durotar.
english.description: The Earthen Ring has identified the watery realm of Vashj'ir as a source of the adversary's destructive energies.$b$bIt is still uncertain what dangers might be faced there. Any information you could gather would be of great value.$b$bThe Horde is sending warships to the region as we speak. To gain passage, speak to Commander Thorak at Bladefist Bay.$b$bMay the spirits guide you, $n.
english.completion: Lok'tar, brother! You have arrived just in time.

text.title: 后方已经安全
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院前的治安官玛克布莱德报到。
text.description: 干得好，$n！后面已经安全。剩下的散兵就交给我们来对付吧。我要你返回南面的北郡修道院前，向治安官玛克布莱德复命，告诉他滋事的地精已经被清理了。$B$B再见，$c。
text.completion: 藉由你的幫助，我們成功鞏固了北郡北方和西方的區域。在我們東邊還是有數量龐大的黑石獸人，而他們正開始焚燒森林!

english.title: The Rear is Clear
english.objectives: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: Excellent work, $n! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.$B$BFarewell, $c.
english.completion: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!

text.title: 后方已经安全
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院前的治安官玛克布莱德报到。
text.description: 干得好，$n！后面已经安全。剩下的散兵就交给我们来对付吧。我要你返回南面的北郡修道院前，向治安官玛克布莱德复命，告诉他滋事的地精已经被清理了。$B$B再见，$c。
text.completion: 藉由你的幫助，我們成功鞏固了北郡北方和西方的區域。在我們東邊還是有數量龐大的黑石獸人，而他們正開始焚燒森林!

english.title: The Rear is Clear
english.objectives: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: Excellent work, $n! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.$B$BFarewell, $c.
english.completion: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!
