text.title: 迷途之子
text.objectives: 击败欧泽鲁克。
text.description: 我的孩子中，有一个没有跟我在一起，$n。$B$B他和暮光之锤一起待在大地神殿深处的巨石之核里。$B$B我派了其他孩子去解救他，帮他摆脱黑暗魔法的控制，回到我身边，但是……他并没有受到什么魔法的影响。$B$B进入巨石之核，消灭欧泽鲁克。他必须重归大地。
text.progress: Is it done, $r?
text.completion: Ozruk has been reclaimed by the earth. Take your reward and leave me be, $n.  I wish to be left alone.
text.completed: Return to Therazane at Therazane's Throne.
text.giverWindow: 我的儿子……

english.title: Wayward Child
english.objectives: Slay Ozruk.
english.description: One of my children is not with me, $n.$B$BHe stayed behind with the Twilight's Hammer at the Stonecore deep within the Temple of Earth.$B$BI sent my other children to free him from the dark magic that was surely keeping him from returning here, but... no such magic was placed upon him.$B$BGo into the Stonecore and destroy Ozruk.  He must be reclaimed by the earth.
english.progress: Is it done, $r?
english.completion: Ozruk has been reclaimed by the earth. Take your reward and leave me be, $n.  I wish to be left alone.
english.completed: Return to Therazane at Therazane's Throne.
english.giverWindow: My son...

text.title: 私人召唤
text.objectives: 与暴风城的地语者纳拉特交谈。
text.description: <一种陌生的感觉从你灵魂深处涌出，各种思绪和影像淹没了你的心智。>$b$b听听我的话吧，$n。$b$b我们的世界正面临着一场可怕的危机。$b$b在这绝望的时刻，我召唤你伸出援手。$b$b我是纳拉特。$b$b立刻来找我，你的使命将被揭示。$b$b我在暴风城的东部大地神殿等着你。
text.completion: May your sense of honor and duty serve Azeroth well, $c.

english.title: A Personal Summons
english.objectives: Speak to Naraat the Earthspeaker in Stormwind.
english.description: <An unfamiliar feeling wells up from deep within you, flooding your mind with thoughts and images.>$b$bHear my words, $n.$b$bOur world finds itself in the grip of a terrible crisis.$b$bI call upon you to lend your aid in this desperate hour.$b$bI am Naraat.$b$bSeek me out at once, and your calling shall be revealed.$b$bI await you at the Eastern Earthshrine in Stormwind City.
english.completion: May your sense of honor and duty serve Azeroth well, $c.

text.title: 风暴之眼
text.objectives: 地语者纳拉特希望你观察先知之水中的景象。
text.description: 你好，艾泽拉斯的英雄。$b$b你在大地之环中可说是声名显赫，$n。$b$b你的功绩和成就数不胜数。你已经为艾泽拉斯做了许多，但现在她又一次向她的英雄们发出了召唤。$b$b我只不过是一名信使。一位熟悉的存在想与你会面。$b$b去看一眼先知之水，亲眼看看我们的世界所面临的命运吧。
text.completion: Now that your eyes have seen the truth, where will you choose to serve?

english.title: The Eye of the Storm
english.objectives: Naraat the Earthspeaker wants you to look into the Waters of Farseeing.
english.description: Greetings, hero of Azeroth.$b$bOn behalf of the Earthen Ring I thank you for answering my call.$b$bYou are known to us by name, $n.$b$bYour exploits and accomplishments are many. Azeroth already stands in your debt, and yet again she is in need of her heroes.$b$bI am but a messenger. A powerful presence seeks audience with you.$b$bPeer into the Waters of Farseeing and behold the dilemma of our world.
english.completion: Now that your eyes have seen the truth, where will you choose to serve?

text.title: 驶向深渊
text.objectives: 与暴风城港口的征募官伯恩斯交谈。
text.description: 大地之环已经认定水之国度瓦丝琪尔就是敌人的毁灭性能量的发源地。$b$b我们仍不清楚会在那里面对怎样的危险，所以你所收集到的任何信息都是非常有价值的。$b$b就在我们说话的当口，联盟正将战舰派往该区域。如果你要去的话，就跟刃拳海湾的指挥官索拉卡谈谈。$b$b愿灵魂指引你的道路，$n。
text.completion: All of our war ships are off fighting the Horde. You'll have to take the mercenary ship.

english.title: To the Depths
english.objectives: Speak with Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City.
english.description: The Earthen Ring has identified the watery realm of Vashj'ir as a source of the adversary's destructive energies.$b$bIt is still uncertain what dangers might be faced there, so any information you could gather would be of great value.$b$bThe Alliance is sending warships to the region as we speak. To gain passage, travel northwest of Stormwind and speak to Recruiter Burns at Stormwind Harbor.$b$bMay the spirits guide you, $n.
english.completion: All of our war ships are off fighting the Horde. You'll have to take the mercenary ship.

text.title: 给我蛋
text.objectives: 取回40枚寒风硬壳蛋。
text.description: 我的味蕾并不发达，但是面对冬泉谷奇美拉这样的食材也难以下咽。不过它们的蛋就不同了。$b$b这种蛋温润细滑，营养丰富，是奥格瑞玛以北能找到的最好食材。它的口感比野枭蛋好得多，而且没有枭兽蛋那种刺鼻的气味。$b$b你能收集到多少我就要多少。去东北方的雪地上寻找奇美拉的巢穴吧。
text.progress: Mmmm....
text.completion: Nice. Eggs.$b$bThese will go great with a little bear bacon.  Hey Francis, got any bear meat left over?
text.completed: Return to Jez Goodgrub at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.

english.title: You Gotta Have Eggs
english.objectives: Obtain 40 Chillwind Eggs.
english.description: I don't have a very discerning palate, but even I can't stand the taste of those chimaeras that you'll find around here.  Their eggs, however, are a different story.$b$bChimaera eggs are the richest, most buttery eggs you'll find this side of Orgrimmar.  Way better than boring owl eggs, and not as sulfurous as those weird wildkin eggs.$b$bI'll take as many of them as you can gather.  Head northeast, and look for their nests in the snow.
english.progress: Mmmm....
english.completion: Nice. Eggs.$b$bThese will go great with a little bear bacon.  Hey Francis, got any bear meat left over?
english.completed: Return to Jez Goodgrub at Goodgrub's Smokepit in Winterspring.

text.title: 枭兽凶猛
text.objectives: 在枭翼树丛杀死12只枭兽。
text.description: 你想问我这是出了什么事？听着，$c，仔细听，我的故事就是个巨大的悲剧……$b$b我被派到枭翼树丛来寻找一些圣物。我走到这里的时候，就被突如其来的巨翼和利爪打垮了。$b$b它们大声咆哮着啄倒了我，$c！$b$b现在我这个兽人瘫在这里，心中只有复仇二字。求你了，$c，如果你还有荣誉感的话，就到枭翼树丛中去，帮我找回我的荣誉感。
text.completion: My honor is restored.$b$bPartially.$b$bMy tale continues, $c, for I have left portions of my honor elsewhere in this forest.$b$bIt has not been a very easy journey for me.
text.completed: Return to Jadrag the Slicer at Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring.

english.title: Razor Beak and Antlers Pointy
english.objectives: Slay 12 Owlbeasts in Owl Wing Thicket.
english.description: What happened to me, you ask?  Listen, $c, and listen well, for my tale is one of tragedy...$b$bI was sent here to Owl Wing Thicket to find some relics.  I only made it this far before I was overwhelmed by a flurry of wings and talons.$b$bHow they roared and pecked, $c!$b$bI now lay here, a broken orc, with nothing but vengeance on my mind. Please, $c, if you have any sense of honor, you will go into Owl Wing Thicket and help me regain mine.
english.completion: My honor is restored.$b$bPartially.$b$bMy tale continues, $c, for I have left portions of my honor elsewhere in this forest.$b$bIt has not been a very easy journey for me.
english.completed: Return to Jadrag the Slicer at Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring.

text.title: 切石头
text.objectives: 杀死8个霜槌滚岩巨人。
text.description: 我那神秘的赞助人给我的任务可不止一个。第二个任务是要去更南边的霜语峡谷。我惊讶地发现那道峡谷上的桥已经断成两截，没法从陆地上过去了。$b$b另外，幼年的霜槌滚岩巨人也与他们的父母分开了。我以为我自己有能力击败他们的。$b$b我错了。我被打得抱头鼠窜。$b$b去给这些滚岩巨人一点教训，$n。战胜他们。
text.completion: Be glad that the adult giants are trapped on the other side of that gorge. They are far hardier than these tumblers you fight.$b$bI feel rejuvenated by your courage, $c. Perhaps all hope is not lost after all...
text.completed: Return to Jadrag the Slicer at Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring.

english.title: Chips off the Old Block
english.objectives: Slay 8 Frostmaul Tumblers.
english.description: My mysterious benefactors gave me more than one task. The second task took me farther south, to the Frostwhisper Gorge. I was surprised to learn that the gorge's bridge had been broken in two, preventing land travel from one side to the other.$b$bIn addition, the juvenile Frostmaul tumblers were separated from their stronger adult parents. I thought that I could defeat them in battle.$b$bI was incorrect. I was forced to run away in shame.$b$bTeach these tumblers a lesson, $n. Fight them, and win.
english.completion: Be glad that the adult giants are trapped on the other side of that gorge. They are far hardier than these tumblers you fight.$b$bI feel rejuvenated by your courage, $c. Perhaps all hope is not lost after all...
english.completed: Return to Jadrag the Slicer at Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring.

text.title: 该死的弗迪里克斯
text.objectives: 杀死弗迪里克斯。
text.description: 如果不是那个该死的弗迪里克斯，霜槌巨人就根本不会是个问题。当大地震颤、桥梁断裂的时候，他和他的水元素从地下渗出，控制了霜语峡谷的底部，把巨人逼了出来。$b$b该死的弗迪里克斯！$b$b如果你能把他送回地下，就算是帮了我一个大忙，$c。你可以在南边的峡谷底部找到他。
text.completion: If I survive my wounds, I will always remember your name, $c.$b$bWhenever the wind whistles through the trees, I will always hear your name.$b$bThank you.
text.completed: Return to Jadrag the Slicer at Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring.

english.title: Damn You, Frostilicus
english.objectives: Slay Frostilicus.
english.description: The Frostmaul giants wouldn't have been a problem if it weren't for that damned Frostilicus. When the ground shook and the bridge broke, he and his fellow water elementals seeped out of the earth and took over the bottom of Frostwhisper Gorge, forcing the giants out.$b$bDamn you, Frostilicus!$b$bYou would do me a great honor if you would send him back into the ground, $c. You will find him to the south, at the bottom of the gorge.
english.completion: If I survive my wounds, I will always remember your name, $c.$b$bWhenever the wind whistles through the trees, I will always hear your name.$b$bThank you.
english.completed: Return to Jadrag the Slicer at Owl Wing Thicket in Winterspring.

text.title: 暮光海滩
text.objectives: 跟暮光高地滩头堡的法克斯中尉谈一谈。
text.description: 好了，跳上我身后的水上飞机，我们飞到高地去。$B$B我们得去找一个叫做“法克斯中尉”的家伙。我答应国王我们会火速抵达，因此我有权把任何超重的东西都扔掉。比如说安全带啦、降落伞啦、地图啦、稳定翼啦、起落架啦。$B$B反正这东西从来没着过“陆”。
text.completion: You two are the last thing I expected to see fall from the sky. Highbank is under attack!

english.title: Twilight Shores
english.objectives: Speak with Lieutenant Fawkes at Highbank in Twilight Highlands.
english.description: Right then, just hop in the seaplane behind me and I'll fly yeh to the Highlands.$B$BWe're to report to a feller named "Lieutenant Fawkes." I've promised the King we'd get there lickety-fast, so I took the liberty of ditchin' any excess weight. Like seatbelts. Parachutes. Maps. Stabilizers. Landing gear.$B$BI never actually "land" these things anyways.
english.completion: You two are the last thing I expected to see fall from the sky. Highbank is under attack!

text.title: 营救石语者
text.objectives: 营救石语者埃鲁纳克。
text.description: 很好！你带来了伙伴。$b$b如果我们还打算营救埃鲁纳克的话，你就得快点了。$b$b一路杀过耐普图隆的大厅，找到那个萨满祭司，从这些虫子手中救出他……如果他还活着的话。$b$b不用担心他们会从背后偷袭你。没有人能过得了我这一关！
text.completion: What is this? You... rescuing me? This will take some getting used to.
text.completed: Speak to Erunak Stonespeaker in the Throne of the Tides.

english.title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
english.objectives: Rescue Erunak Stonespeaker.
english.description: Good! You've brought allies.$b$bYou must hurry if we are to rescue Erunak.$b$bFight your way through Neptulon's halls. Find the shaman and free him from these worms... if he still lives.$b$bDon't worry about them coming up from behind you. Nothing's making it past me!
english.completion: What is this? You... rescuing me? This will take some getting used to.
english.completed: Speak to Erunak Stonespeaker in the Throne of the Tides.

text.title: 营救石语者
text.objectives: 营救石语者埃鲁纳克。
text.description: 很好！你带来了伙伴。$b$b如果我们还打算营救埃鲁纳克的话，你就得快点了。$b$b去吧。一路杀过耐普图隆的大厅，找到那个萨满祭司，从这些虫子手中救出他……如果他还活着的话。$b$b不用担心他们会从背后偷袭你。我可以保证没有人能过得了我这一关！
text.completion: What is this? You... rescuing me? This will take some getting used to.
text.completed: Speak to Erunak Stonespeaker in the Throne of the Tides.

english.title: Rescue the Earthspeaker!
english.objectives: Rescue Erunak Stonespeaker.
english.description: Good! You've brought allies.$b$bYou must hurry if we are to rescue Erunak.$b$bGo now. Fight your way through Neptulon's halls. Find the shaman and free him from these worms... if he still lives.$b$bDon't worry about them coming up from behind you. I'll see that nothing makes it past me!
english.completion: What is this? You... rescuing me? This will take some getting used to.
english.completed: Speak to Erunak Stonespeaker in the Throne of the Tides.

text.title: Necessary Refreshment (Backup Groundspawn Quest)
text.objectives: 收集6颗仙人掌果。
text.description: 试炼谷这里真是热得要死。$B$B<戈加尔擦了擦额头。>$B$B如果我有仙人掌果的话，就可以做点清凉果来吃了！没什么能比清凉果更甘甜消暑的。$B$B我跟你说啊，$N，只要你给我弄6颗仙人掌果来，我就帮你做一些清凉果。如果你感兴趣的话，就到这附近去找找仙人掌，采集它们的果子。
text.completed: Return to Galgar at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

english.title: Necessary Refreshment (Backup Groundspawn Quest)
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Cactus Apples.
english.description: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.$B$B<Galgar wipes his brow.>$B$BIf only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.$B$BI'll tell you what, $n. If you bring me 6 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
english.completed: Return to Galgar at Valley of Trials in Durotar.

text.title: 海巫的罪行
text.objectives: 在潮汐王座杀死纳兹夏尔女士。
text.description: 那条邪恶的虫子要为此千刀万剐！$b$b这可不是轻松活儿。她和她的爪牙在这里坚守，不过在与耐普图隆交战之后，她一定已经精疲力尽了。$b$b现在正是进攻的机会！我们可找不到第二次像这样好的机会了。$b$b把她干掉，$n！
text.completion: Well done, $n! Know that without your aid, things would be far different here. Not only would I be long dead, but the naga and their allies would have free reign over the sea. The king himself shall hear of your heroism in this realm.
text.completed: Speak to Captain Taylor in the Throne of the Tides.

english.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
english.objectives: Slay Lady Naz'jar in the Throne of Tides.
english.description: That vile worm has earned a thousand deaths!$b$bIt won't be easy. She and her minions are firmly entrenched in this place, but she's bound to be exhausted from her fight with Neptulon.$b$bNow is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this.$b$bRun her through, $n!
english.completion: Well done, $n! Know that without your aid, things would be far different here. Not only would I be long dead, but the naga and their allies would have free reign over the sea. The king himself shall hear of your heroism in this realm.
english.completed: Speak to Captain Taylor in the Throne of the Tides.

text.title: 异变野兽
text.objectives: 从异变野兽身上收集5个被魔法扭曲的爪子。
text.description: 我们蓝龙被迫离开了自己的家园，麦索瑞尔。一个名叫阿姆布兰希的家伙在我们最为脆弱的时候趁虚而入，占据了这座洞穴。$b$b麦索瑞尔是一处蕴含着巨大魔法能量的地方，而他根本不知道如何运用这种力量。就连野生动物都受到了牵连。$b$b附近的野兽已经发生了变异。求你了，$r，我必须请你帮一个忙。收集它们的爪子，这样我才能知道是否能扭转阿姆布兰希的狂野魔法。
text.progress: Mazthoril belongs to the blue dragonflight. This is not right.
text.completion: Let's see what I can do with these...
text.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Regress in Winterspring.

english.title: Altered Beasts
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Mana-Addled Brains from Altered Beasts.
english.description: We, the blue dragons, have been forced out of our home, Mazthoril. An impostor by the name of Umbranse has taken advantage of us in our weakest hour, and now occupies the cave.$b$bMazthoril is a place of extremely potent magic, and he does not know how to wield it. Even the wildlife suffers.$b$bThe beasts nearby have been altered. Please, $r, I must ask you a favor. Gather their brains, so I can see if I can undo this Umbranse's wild magic.
english.progress: Mazthoril belongs to the blue dragonflight. This is not right.
english.completion: Let's see what I can do with these...
english.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Regress in Winterspring.

text.title: 枭兽的防御
text.objectives: 在丹曼达尔获取一个枭兽摄梦器。
text.description: 真是丢人啊。不管阿姆布兰希做了什么，我都无法扭转他已经施放的魔法。$b$b他比我预想的更聪明。$b$b不过，我有一个备用计划。我曾看到枭兽在麦索瑞尔进进出出，即便是阿姆布兰希控制那里之后。他们身上古老的德鲁伊魔法一定可以压制阿姆布兰希的魔法。幸运的是，我正好对他们的魔法很有研究。$b$b到南边的丹曼达尔去。你可以在那里找到一只箱子，里面有一个摄梦器。$b$b这就是你的第一步。
text.progress: The owlbeasts' magic will be the key to our retaking of Mazthoril.
text.completion: Good. It is just as Jaron described it.
text.turninWindow: 蓝龙一族也不能失去麦索瑞尔。

english.title: The Owlbeasts' Defense
english.objectives: Obtain an Owlbeast Dreamcatcher from Dun Mandarr.
english.description: What a shame. Whatever Umbranse has done, he has prevented me from undoing his magic.$b$bHe is wiser than I had anticipated.$b$bI do have a backup plan, however. I have seen owlbeasts enter and leave Mazthoril, even after Umbranse took control. Their ancient druidic magic must be capable of disabling Umbranse's. Luckily, I happen to be somewhat of an expert in their methods.$b$bTravel south, to Dun Mandarr. You will find a chest with a dreamcatcher in it.$b$bThat will be your first step.
english.progress: The owlbeasts' magic will be the key to our retaking of Mazthoril.
english.completion: Good. It is just as Jaron described it.
english.turninWindow: The blue dragonflight can't afford to lose Mazthoril, too.

text.title: 史前魔法
text.objectives: 收集爪击图腾精华生命图腾精华和月光图腾精华。
text.description: 枭兽的神圣洞穴就在东边。在其中的一些洞穴里，你可以找到图腾。我要你去接近那些图腾，从它们那里收集精华。摄梦器应该会吸收这种精华，供我们在麦索瑞尔里面使用。
text.progress: What are you doing, $n? We need that essence.
text.completion: The dreamcatcher is charged.  We are nearly ready to retake Mazthoril.
text.giverWindow: 他们的图腾是圣物。他们会疯狂地保卫这些图腾。
text.turninWindow: 枭兽的古老魔法非常强大，不过……

english.title: Magic Prehistoric
english.objectives: Obtain the Essence of the Claw-Totem, the Essence of the Life-Totem, and the Essence of the Moon-Totem.
english.description: The owlbeasts' sacred caves are located to the east. Within several of these caves, you should find totems. I want you to approach these totems and gather whatever essence you can from them. The dreamcatcher should absorb this essence for use within Mazthoril.
english.progress: What are you doing, $n? We need that essence.
english.completion: The dreamcatcher is charged.  We are nearly ready to retake Mazthoril.
english.giverWindow: Their totems are sacred objects. They will defend them ferociously.
english.turninWindow: The ancient magic of the owlbeasts is powerful. But still...

text.title: 寒冬之水
text.objectives: 从霜语峡谷的寒冰化身身上收集7份寒冬之水。
text.description: 我可不想赌输了，$n。如果我们失败了，就会暴露目标，使阿姆布兰希有机会完善他的防御体系。这可不行，我们必须一举成功。$b$b南边的霜语峡谷里面有许多我们可以利用的强大的冰元素。那些元素体内的水应该可以增强你的摄梦器的能量，确保我们能够成功。$b$b去弄到这种水，$n。然后回到我们的小营地来。
text.progress: Welcome back.
text.completion: <Haleh applies the water to your dreamcatcher.>$b$bYou've done well, $n.
text.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.
text.giverWindow: 我们不能容忍失败。

english.title: Winterwater
english.objectives: Obtain 7 Winterwater from Ice Avatars in Frostwhisper Gorge.
english.description: I don't want our gambit to fail, $n. Such a failure would only draw attention to our efforts, giving Umbranse an opportunity to hone his defenses. No, we have to do this right the first time.$b$bThe Frostwhisper Gorge, to the south, provides us access to powerful ice elementals. The water within these elementals' hulls should amplify the power of your dreamcatcher, ensuring our efforts.$b$bObtain this water, $n. Then return to our small camp.
english.progress: Welcome back.
english.completion: <Haleh applies the water to your dreamcatcher.>$b$bYou've done well, $n.
english.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.
english.giverWindow: We can't abide failures.

text.title: 洞中的奥术风暴
text.objectives: 使用强能摄梦器，关闭麦索瑞尔里面的5个奥术超立方体。
text.description: 如果使用不当，麦索瑞尔自带的魔法可能造成难以想象的巨大灾难。阿姆布兰希在洞穴里肆意施法，已经打开了若干连接其它世界的裂口——换句话说也就是传送门。如果我要返回麦索瑞尔，就必须先关闭这些裂口。$b$b摄梦器可以关闭传送门，使你可以安全进入阿姆布兰希的老巢。先击败那些从裂口中跑出来的怪物，然后在别的什么东西钻进这个世界之前，迅速使用摄梦器关闭裂口。
text.completion: It will take some time for Mazthoril to recover... but she will.$b$bThe blue dragonflight is far from dead.
text.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.

english.title: The Arcane Storm Within
english.objectives: Use the Empowered Dreamcatcher to close 5 Arcane Tesseracts within Mazthoril.
english.description: Mazthoril's innate magic can wreak unimaginable havoc if mishandled. Umbranse's wanton casting within the cavern has opened up a number of tesseracts - in other words, portals - connecting to other worlds. If I am to return to Mazthoril, these tesseracts must be closed.$b$bThe dreamcatcher will close the portals, buying you safe entrance into Umbranse's lair. First defeat whatever comes out of the tesseracts, then use the dreamcatcher to quickly close them, before anything else spills into this world.
english.completion: It will take some time for Mazthoril to recover... but she will.$b$bThe blue dragonflight is far from dead.
english.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.

text.title: 阿姆布兰希的判决
text.objectives: 杀死灵语者阿姆布兰希。
text.description: 阿姆布兰希藏身于麦索瑞尔的深处。他的末日就要来临了。$b$b不幸的是，这次我不能与你并肩作战。虽然我很想手刃那条毒蛇，但在目前的状态下，麦索瑞尔的魔法会把我撕成碎片。因此，我得让你替我去完成这个任务。$b$b等你搞定这件事后，就使用这枚符咒。它会把你安全地送到出口处。
text.completion: You have our thanks, $n.
text.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.

english.title: Umbranse's Deliverance
english.objectives: Slay Umbranse the Spiritspeaker.
english.description: Umbranse lurks in the back of Mazthoril. His time has come.$b$bUnfortunately, I am unable to join you on this quest. While I'd love to get my hands on that snake, Mazthoril's magic would rip me apart in its current state. No, I need you to finish this for me.$b$bWhen the deed is done, use this charm. It will return you safely to the egress.
english.completion: You have our thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.

text.title: 海巫的罪行
text.objectives: 军团士兵纳兹戈林要你去杀死纳兹夏尔女士。
text.description: 纳兹夏尔！她是这一切麻烦的源头。$b$b她就在这里的某处，$n。在与耐普图隆交战之后，她一定已经精疲力尽了。$b$b现在正是进攻的机会！我们可找不到第二次像这样好的机会了。$b$b我会负责处理所有打算从这个方向增援她的敌人。$b$b去找到她，$n，把她干掉！
text.completion: Hellscream shall know of your deeds here, $n. Without you, things here would be far worse. Lok'tar ogar, my friend!
text.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim at the Throne of Tides.

english.title: Sins of the Sea Witch
english.objectives: Legionnaire Nazgrim wants you to slay Lady Naz'jar.
english.description: Naz'jar! She's the one responsible for this mess.$b$bShe's in here somewhere, $n. She must be exhausted after that fight with Neptulon.$b$bNow is the time to strike! We won't have another opportunity like this.$b$bI'll handle anything that tries to aid her from this direction.$b$bFind her, $n, and run her through!
english.completion: Hellscream shall know of your deeds here, $n. Without you, things here would be far worse. Lok'tar ogar, my friend!
english.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim at the Throne of Tides.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Hyena Harvest
text.objectives: Use Sullah's Hyena Trap to capture 5 Bloodsnarl Hyenas.
text.description: Look, $n!$b$bI have taken your bait and fashioned traps that will be most useful in your next task.$b$bFar to the southeast of here run a dangerous pack of Bloodsnarl Hyenas.$b$bI am confident that they can be tamed and used to great effect in our performance.$b$bLay one of these next to them and they won't be able to resist it.$b$bThen, once they're trapped, you just have to collect them and bring them back.$b$bIt works almost every time!
text.completed: 与苏拉赫的表演场的苏拉赫交谈。

english.title: [DEPRECATED] Hyena Harvest
english.objectives: Use Sullah's Hyena Trap to capture 5 Bloodsnarl Hyenas.
english.description: Look, $n!$b$bI have taken your bait and fashioned traps that will be most useful in your next task.$b$bFar to the southeast of here run a dangerous pack of Bloodsnarl Hyenas.$b$bI am confident that they can be tamed and used to great effect in our performance.$b$bLay one of these next to them and they won't be able to resist it.$b$bThen, once they're trapped, you just have to collect them and bring them back.$b$bIt works almost every time!
english.completed: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.

text.title: 旋云之巅
text.objectives: 在旋云之巅中找到伊特什。
text.description: 我们的一位高级文官被气元素囚禁了。$B$B眼下，他们也许正在拷打他，以获取情报。$B$B前往旋云之巅，那地方是邪恶怪物的老巢，去那里寻找伊特什。$B$B你可以在奥丹姆东南边的海岸上找到旋云之巅的入口。
text.completion: You actually came here looking for me?

english.title: The Vortex Pinnacle
english.objectives: Find Itesh inside the Vortex Pinnacle.
english.description: One of our civilian leaders was taken prisoner by the air elementals.$B$BThey are probably torturing him for information as we speak.$B$BGo to the Vortex Pinnacle, where these foul creatures came from, and look for Itesh.$B$BYou will find the entrance to the Vortex Pinnacle hovering off of the southeastern coast of Uldum.
english.completion: You actually came here looking for me?

text.title: Repel the Paratroopers Accepted Tracking Event

english.title: Repel the Paratroopers Accepted Tracking Event

text.title: 追杀阿姆布兰希
text.objectives: 去找冬泉谷蓝玉避难所的哈尔琳。
text.description: 我们已经找到了阿姆布兰希在冬泉谷的藏身之地。跟我猜想的一样。$b$b阿姆布兰希就在麦索瑞尔，那座位于西南方的洞穴曾经是属于蓝龙的。我的母亲哈尔琳会在那里与你会面。她就在洞穴外面的一处小营地中，与其他几个幸存者在一起。$b$b去找她的篝火吧。
text.completion: You are $n, yes?$b$bGood, you will serve well. I require the aid of a $c such as yourself.

english.title: The Pursuit of Umbranse
english.objectives: Report to Haleh at Beryl Egress in Winterspring.
english.description: We have isolated Umbranse's position here in Winterspring. It is as I suspected.$b$bUmbranse is at Mazthoril, the cavern that once belonged to the blue dragonflight, in the southwest. My mother, Haleh, will greet you there. She is stationed outside of the cave in a small camp with a few other survivors.$b$bLook for her campfire.
english.completion: You are $n, yes?$b$bGood, you will serve well. I require the aid of a $c such as yourself.

text.title: 追踪灵语者
text.objectives: 向冬泉谷永望镇的奈姆报到。
text.description: 我听说过关于阿姆布兰希的故事，可惜我跟他素未谋面。据说他一直在收集魔法器物，但是我不知道他的目的是什么。$b$b最好将这个消息告诉给某位可信的盟友。你可以在永望镇找到高等精灵奈姆，永望镇是位于东北方的一座大型地精城镇。请告诉他我们所知的一切。
text.completion: Umbranse... I see. I will carry this information onto my people.$b$bYou will be contacted if you are needed again.

english.title: Trailing the Spiritspeaker
english.objectives: Report to Nymn at Everlook in Winterspring.
english.description: I have heard tales of Umbranse, though I have not ever met him in person. Rumor has it that he's been collecting magical artifacts, though for what purpose, I couldn't say.$b$bBest pass this information on to a trusted ally. Nymn, the high elf, can be found within Everlook, the large goblin town to the northeast. Tell him all that we learned today.
english.completion: Umbranse... I see. I will carry this information onto my people.$b$bYou will be contacted if you are needed again.

text.title: 暮光天空
text.objectives: 去找艾萨拉南部火箭车终点站的“天旋地转”费利兹。
text.description: 我刚从奥格瑞玛得到消息，酋长要我们开拔。要不是你的帮忙，我们不可能准备好！$B$B按计划，空军立刻起飞，海军紧随其后。地狱咆哮会同空军一同前行，他特别指明要你陪同。$B$B没时间耽搁了！到艾萨拉的南部火箭车终点站，找“天旋地转”费利兹登记。我会把飞艇开过来接你的。
text.completion: Another $c for the Highlands? Here, sign this indemnification waiver...

english.title: Twilight Skies
english.objectives: Check in with Friz Groundspin at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.
english.description: I just got word from Orgrimmar that the Warchief wants us to move out. We wouldn't have been ready if it wasn't for your help!$B$BThe plan is for the air fleet to take off immediately, and for the navy to follow close behind. Hellscream will be accompanying the air fleet and specifically requested that you come along with us.$B$BNo time to delay! Go to the Southern Rocketway Terminus here in Azshara, and check in with Friz Groundspin. I'll bring the zeppelin around to pick you up.
english.completion: Another $c for the Highlands? Here, sign this indemnification waiver...

text.title: 监狱的屋顶
text.objectives: 与吉尔尼斯城斯通沃德监狱楼上的达利乌斯·克罗雷领主交谈。
text.description: 我不明白为什么国王要浪费时间去救他的命，不过如果你也打算冒生命危险的话，请随意。$B$B克罗雷和他的人都躲在楼上，也许正在谋划着什么对国王不利的阴谋！
text.completion: Greymane's right.  These beasts do not give a damn about our politics. Gilneas needs to stand together.

english.title: The Prison Rooftop
english.objectives: Speak to Darius Crowley upstairs in the Stoneward Prison in Gilneas City.
english.description: I don't understand why the king wants to waste time saving his hide, but if you want to risk your life, then be my guest.$B$BCrowley and his men are holed up upstairs, probably plotting against the king as we speak!
english.completion: Greymane's right.  These beasts do not give a damn about our politics. Gilneas needs to stand together.

text.title: [DEPRECATED] Sullah's Sideshow
text.objectives: 与苏拉赫的表演场的苏拉赫交谈。
text.description: Welcome, my friend!$b$bThe fruits of our labor have paid off abundantly! The time has come for us to give a dress rehearsal.$b$bOh, before we begin, I have a favor to ask.$b$bThere was a small snafu with a stubborn pygmy, so I have to ask that you take his place for the performance.$b$bI'm sure you'll be able to pick it right up. You're a natural!$b$bBreak a leg, my friend!

english.title: [DEPRECATED] Sullah's Sideshow
english.objectives: Speak to Sullah at Sullah's Sideshow.
english.description: Welcome, my friend!$b$bThe fruits of our labor have paid off abundantly! The time has come for us to give a dress rehearsal.$b$bOh, before we begin, I have a favor to ask.$b$bThere was a small snafu with a stubborn pygmy, so I have to ask that you take his place for the performance.$b$bI'm sure you'll be able to pick it right up. You're a natural!$b$bBreak a leg, my friend!

text.title: 削弱敌人
text.objectives: 解救格瑞姆巴托中的一条红色幼龙，用它消灭30个穴居人和15个暮光之锤的爪牙。
text.description: 援军终于来了！很高兴你能来帮忙。我们根本没有料到暮光之锤居然如此顽强，而且人数众多！$B$B我们的一些龙被敌人抓住，关在主厅里。请你去击碎他们的锁链，释放他们。$B$B然后，我们就可以用烈焰把这些大厅烧成灰烬。只需爬上一条红龙，然后指示目标就行了。在继续深入废墟作战之前，你最好先削减敌军的数量。
text.completion: This is great news, $n! I'm glad our drakes were able to assist you. Thank you for rescuing them from the clutches of Twilight's Hammer.
text.completed: Return to Velastrasza within the entrance to Grim Batol.

english.title: Soften them Up
english.objectives: Free a Red Drake within Grim Batol and use it to destroy 30 Troggs and 15 Twilight's Hammer minions.
english.description: At last, reinforcements! I'm so glad you're here. We never imagined just how entrenched the Twilight's Hammer forces are. And there are so many!$B$BSeveral of our drakes have been captured just inside the main hall. Please, break their bonds and free them.$B$BOnce free, together we can scourge these halls clean with flame. Just climb aboard a red drake and call out your targets. You will definitely want to cut down the enemy numbers before delving deeper into the ruins.
english.completion: This is great news, $n! I'm glad our drakes were able to assist you. Thank you for rescuing them from the clutches of Twilight's Hammer.
english.completed: Return to Velastrasza within the entrance to Grim Batol.

text.title: 杀死信使
text.objectives: 杀死达加·燃影者，拿到他写给古加尔的信函。
text.description: $c，谢谢你勇敢地在这个黑暗而又可怕的地方奋勇作战。$B$B格瑞姆巴托里面是古加尔的战争机器的核心。如果我们要阻止他的野心波及暮光高地以外，就必须尽可能了解这些深渊中的情况。$B$B去里面找到达加·燃影者。他是古加尔的信使，也就是这里和暮光堡垒之间进行沟通的联络人。我们必须获悉他所携带的秘密。
text.progress: What have you discovered, $c?
text.completion: <Tooranu looks over the documents you discovered.>$B$BIt's all here, $n. Details of how the cult is tearing up the Highlands, who they've sent, where they are, and what they plan to do. Invaluable.$B$BI shall distribute this knowledge to the rest of the Earthen Ring at once. Thank you, friend.
text.completed: Deliver the missive to Farseer Tooranu within the entrance to Grim Batol.
text.giverWindow: 他是古加尔在格瑞姆巴托的眼线和耳朵。我们必须获悉他的秘密。

english.title: Kill the Courier
english.objectives: Kill Drahga Shadowburner and grab his Missive to Cho'gall.
english.description: Thank you, $c, for braving the horrors of this dark and terrible place.$B$BThe bowels of Grim Batol are the heart of Cho'gall's war machine. If we are to stop his machinations throughout the Highlands, we must learn all we can from these depths.$B$BSeek out Drahga Shadowburner within. He is Cho'gall's runner, the link between here and the Bastion of Twilight. We must learn the secrets he carries.
english.progress: What have you discovered, $c?
english.completion: <Tooranu looks over the documents you discovered.>$B$BIt's all here, $n. Details of how the cult is tearing up the Highlands, who they've sent, where they are, and what they plan to do. Invaluable.$B$BI shall distribute this knowledge to the rest of the Earthen Ring at once. Thank you, friend.
english.completed: Deliver the missive to Farseer Tooranu within the entrance to Grim Batol.
english.giverWindow: He is Cho'gall's eyes and ears in Grim Batol. We must learn his secrets.

text.title: 结束黑暗的一章
text.objectives: 杀死地狱公爵埃鲁达克。
text.description: 这个可怕的地方曾是阿莱克丝塔萨的梦魇。在被凡人称为“第二次大战”的时期，她被锁在下面的深渊中，产下备受折磨的后代，供被恶魔腐蚀的部落使用。$B$B阿莱克丝塔萨已经自由了，但是那头被称为埃鲁达克的怪兽仍在下面腐蚀她的子嗣。$B$B<烽焰的躯体愤怒地绷紧了。>$B$B消灭他，$c。彻底摧毁他，永远结束这场梦魇！
text.completion: So it is done.$B$BWould that I could bring this entire mountain down upon itself, I would.
text.completed: Return to Baleflame within the entrance to Grim Batol.
text.giverWindow: 他潜伏在格瑞姆巴托最深的深渊中，继续着邪恶的工作。

english.title: Closing a Dark Chapter
english.objectives: Slay Erudax, the Duke of Below.
english.description: This terrible place was Alexstrasza's nightmare. During what mortals call the second war, she was chained in the depths below, her tormented offspring forced to serve the demon-corrupted Horde.$B$BAlexstrasza may be free, but the beast known as Erudax still corrupts her offspring below.$B$B<Baleflame's body tenses in anger.>$B$BDestroy him, $c. Crush him that we may end these horrors once and for all!
english.completion: So it is done.$B$BWould that I could bring this entire mountain down upon itself, I would.
english.completed: Return to Baleflame within the entrance to Grim Batol.
english.giverWindow: He lurks within the deepest depths of Grim Batol, his foul work unceasing.

text.title: Northern Stranglethorn 4.x: PRK - E - Just Hatched FLAG

english.title: Northern Stranglethorn 4.x: PRK - E - Just Hatched FLAG

text.title: 希利苏斯之沙
text.objectives: 去找希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角。
text.description: 我们来看看……哦，这个不错！希利苏斯！$b$b嗯，显然，塞纳里奥议会需要有人帮他们解决某种虫灾了。$b$b<维兹奇颤抖了一下。>$b$b呃！算了算了，这不适合我。要我去杀虫子，还不如让我冻死在永望镇这冰天雪地的地方算了。$b$b唔……这上面说拜访者要去找唤风者梅恩·长角，去那里最简单的办法就是从安戈洛环形山西北边的悬崖爬上去。$b$b你有兴趣吗？
text.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold.$b$b<Windcaller Proudhorn brushes some snow off of your shoulder.>$b$bYou've certainly come from far off.

english.title: The Sands of Silithus
english.objectives: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
english.description: Let's see... oh, here's a good one! Silithus!$b$bSo, apparently the Cenarion Circle needs assistance with an insect infestation of some sort.$b$b<Vizzie shivers.>$b$bUgh! No thanks, not for me. I'm pefectly happy freezing to death here in Everlook if the alternative is bugs.$b$bHmm... it says here that visitors should speak with Windcaller Proudhorn, and the easiest way to get there is via the path up Un'Goro Crater's northwestern cliffs.$b$bYou interested?
english.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold.$b$b<Windcaller Proudhorn brushes some snow off of your shoulder.>$b$bYou've certainly come from far off.

text.title: 诅咒之地：世界的另一端
text.objectives: 向守望堡的军需官朗格尔斯报到。
text.description: 这里有一张有趣的告示。上面说是要你向诅咒之地守望堡的军需官朗格尔斯报到。那可是你从这个地方所能到达的最远的角落！$B$B上面说，他们遭到了部落的攻击。嗯！我都不知道部落居然在诅咒之地建立了前哨站！按照我的理解，他们大概是希望把更多精力放在对付恶魔上，而不是互相竞争。$b$b你必须横渡无尽之海，然后从悲伤沼泽朝南走。$b$b你感兴趣吗？
text.completion: For decades has the garrison at Nethergarde held firm against the threat of the Horde and we do not intend to surrender now.

english.title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
english.objectives: Report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep.
english.description: Now here's an interesting one. It says to report to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep, in the Blasted Lands. That's just about as far as you can get from here!$B$BIt says they're having trouble with Horde attacks. Hmph! I didn't know the Horde even had an outpost in the Blasted Lands! They tend to worry more about demons and less about rivalries down there, as I understand it.$b$bYou'll have to cross the Great Sea, then travel south from the Swamp of Sorrows.$b$bYou interested?
english.completion: For decades has the garrison at Nethergarde held firm against the threat of the Horde and we do not intend to surrender now.

text.title: 诅咒之地：世界的另一端
text.objectives: 去找诅咒之地巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉。
text.description: 这里有一张有趣的告示。上面说部落的成员应该去找巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉谈谈。$B$B嗯！我都不知道部落已经占领了巨槌要塞！$b$b我猜，这个奥克莉拉需要一些帮助来对付食人魔和联盟。看样子她已经被那里的恶魔搞得焦头烂额啦！$B$B前往巨槌要塞的最佳路线是横渡无尽之海，然后从悲伤沼泽朝南走。$B$B你感兴趣吗？
text.completion: Our enemies are numerous, $c. It will take skill and bravery to overcome them all.

english.title: Blasted Lands: The Other Side of the World
english.objectives: Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in the Blasted Lands.
english.description: Now here's an interesting one.  It says that members of the Horde should talk to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold.$B$BHmph! I didn't even know that the Horde held Dreadmaul Hold!$b$bI guess this Okrilla requires help fighting some ogres and the Alliance. You'd think she'd already have her hands full with all the demons down there!$B$BThe best way to Dreadmaul Hold is to cross the Great Sea, then to take the road south from the Swamp of Sorrows.$B$BYou interested?
english.completion: Our enemies are numerous, $c. It will take skill and bravery to overcome them all.

text.title: 希利苏斯的沙丘
text.objectives: 去找希利苏斯塞纳里奥要塞的唤风者梅恩·长角。
text.description: 希利苏斯的塞纳里奥要塞是卡利姆多最大的德鲁伊营地，几乎和月光林地一样大，伙计。$b$b也许有一天，赞阿利利也会去塞纳里奥要塞……跟暮光之锤作战，治愈被异种虫撕裂的大地……但是赞阿利利的导师让他继续等待。$b$b所以赞阿利利继续等待。$b$b前往那里的最便捷途径是沿着安戈洛环形山西北边的悬崖上去。$b$b如果你没有导师……那就没什么人会阻止你过去了。
text.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold, traveler.

english.title: The Dunes of Silithus
english.objectives: Report to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
english.description: Cenarion Hold, in Silithus, is one of the biggest druid settlements in Kalimdor. Almost as big as Moonglade, mon.$b$bSomeday, maybe Zen'Aliri be headin' on over to Cenarion Hold... fightin' some Twilight's Hammer, healin' the land where the silithid tear it... but Zen'Aliri's master tells him to wait.$b$bSo Zen'Aliri waits.$b$bThe easiest way to get there is that path up Un'Goro Crater's northwestern cliffs.$b$bIf you got no master... there's nothing keepin' you from movin' on.
english.completion: Welcome to Cenarion Hold, traveler.

text.title: 让龙喉安分守己
text.objectives: 杀死龙喉劫掠者，收集8个龙喉徽记。桑德玛尔废墟里有名字的角色也会掉落徽记。
text.description: 多亏了你的帮助，我们把龙喉打得很惨，但他们对桑德玛尔郊外每天的进攻还在持续。我们需要继续施压！$B$B杀回位于南边和西南边的桑德玛尔废墟，战斗还在那里继续。干掉龙喉劫掠者，把他们最强大的战士戴的徽记带回来。
text.progress: How goes the fight, $c?
text.completion: Aye, that's how it's done! With heroes like you taking care of business, I'm proud to be a part of the Alliance.
text.completed: Bring the Insigias to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Keeping the Dragonmaw at Bay
english.objectives: Kill Dragonmaw Marauders and collect 8 Dragonmaw Insignias. Named characters within the Thundermar Ruins will also carry insignias.
english.description: With your help we've thumped the Dragonmaw pretty hard, but still their daily attacks in the Thundermar outskirts persist. We need to keep up the pressure!$B$BWade back into the battle that's raging in the Thundermar ruins to the south and southwest. Kill Dragonmaw marauders and collect the insignias that their greatest warriors wear.
english.progress: How goes the fight, $c?
english.completion: Aye, that's how it's done! With heroes like you taking care of business, I'm proud to be a part of the Alliance.
english.completed: Bring the Insigias to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 像蛮锤一样战斗
text.objectives: 到桑德玛尔废墟找10桶桑德玛尔麦酒。小心——酒劲很大！
text.description: <布朗迪把杯子倒了起来。>$B$B我没酒啦，$n！$B$B趁那些酒还没被邋遢的龙喉糟蹋，去桑德玛尔废墟看看还有没有剩下的。$B$B别客气，尝一两口也没关系。一杯桑德玛尔最好的老酒可以提高你的战斗技巧。
text.progress: Got sumthun'?
text.completion: Oh aye, quite a haul! This'll last me until... oh say probably tomorrow.
text.completed: Bring the Ale back to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Fight Like a Wildhammer
english.objectives: Collect 10 Kegs of Thundermar Ale from the Thundermar Ruins. Carfeul - it's got some kick!
english.description: <Blundy upends his cup.>$B$BI'm all outta ale, $n!$B$BHead out into the Thundermar Ruins and see if there's any left, before those grungy Dragonmaw get their mouths on it.$B$BFeel free to have a few sips, yerself. A mug of ol' Thundermar's finest will fortify yer fightin' skills.
english.progress: Got sumthun'?
english.completion: Oh aye, quite a haul! This'll last me until... oh say probably tomorrow.
english.completed: Bring the Ale back to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 别把晚饭落下了
text.objectives: 在桑德玛尔废墟收集10件蛮锤存粮。
text.description: 躲避战斗的难民还在源源不断地进入桑德玛尔，而我好饿！我是说他们。难民，他们好饿。$B$B给我从桑德玛尔废墟弄点吃的来！搜索南边、东边，还有西南边的废墟，看还有没有什么残余的库存。尤其是大块的火腿。我爱死它们了！呃，难民爱死它们了。$B$B然后看看你能不能也找点鸡尾酒小香肠。
text.progress: Got some eats?
text.completion: Oh hey, yer just in time! I was working up a huge appetite, workin' so hard to feed these hungry refugees. Yessir.
text.completed: Bring the food to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Never Leave a Dinner Behind
english.objectives: Gather 10 Wildhammer Food Stores from the Thundermar Ruins.
english.description: Refugees are still pouring into Thundermar from the fighting, and I'm hungry! I mean them. The refugees, they're hungry.$B$BGet me some food from the Thundermar Ruins! Scour the ruins to the south, east, and southwest for any stores that still remain. Especially them big hocks of ham. I love those! Er, the refugees do.$B$BAnd see if you can find some of them little cocktail weenies.
english.progress: Got some eats?
english.completion: Oh hey, yer just in time! I was working up a huge appetite, workin' so hard to feed these hungry refugees. Yessir.
english.completed: Bring the food to Low Shaman Blundy at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 督军哈萨尔归来
text.objectives: 杀死督军哈萨尔。
text.description: 他又来了，$n。督军哈萨尔……这一带的暴君。有人看见他和他的幼龙在南边桑德玛尔废墟里横行无忌。$B$B杀掉哈萨尔，$n！我们会派一些烙印战士来给你助拳的。
text.completion: Grim business, but well done all the same. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Craw MacGraw at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 他是个吐沫横飞、怒气冲天、风风火火的苦行僧。

english.title: Warlord Halthar is Back
english.objectives: Slay Warlord Halthar.
english.description: He's at it again, $n. Warlord Halthar... terror of the shire. He and his drake were spotted causing trouble to the south, among the Thundermar Ruins.$B$BKill Halthar, $n! We'll send in some warbrands to help out once you engage.
english.completion: Grim business, but well done all the same. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Craw MacGraw at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: He's a whirling dervish of spittle-flinging fury.

text.title: 运啤酒
text.objectives: 跟落雷山东南方路上的哈缪汉德谈一谈，护送补给车队前往库斯海文。
text.description: 妹妹的婚礼之后，我对库德兰从丹莫罗进口的雷霆啤酒上了瘾。他们会大量引进，不过我们的车队老是被龙喉截住！$B$B到落雷山东南边去同车队汇合。到路边找一个叫做哈缪汉德的家伙，帮他把酒给运过小径。$B$B送到库斯海文就行了，我们会在那里接手。
text.completion: Go figure. Never thought I'd develop a taste for imported draft. Thanks, $n!
text.completed: Talk to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Beer Run
english.objectives: Speak with Hammelhand on the road southeast of Thunderstrike Mountain and escort a supply caravan to Kirthaven.
english.description: After my sister's wedding, I developed a taste for that Thunderbrew Lager that Kurdran had imported from Dun Morogh. More is on the way, but our caravan keeps getting jumped by the Dragonmaw!$B$BHead on up to the southeast side of Thunderstrike Mountain and catch up with the caravan. Look for a fellow named Hammelhand at the side of the road, and help him get the booze through the pass.$B$BJust get it as far as Kirthaven, and we'll take it from there.
english.completion: Go figure. Never thought I'd develop a taste for imported draft. Thanks, $n!
english.completed: Talk to Colin Thundermar at Thundermar in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 战争主母的召唤
text.objectives: 去找诅咒之地巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉。
text.description: 我们尊贵的战争主母奥克莉拉派我到世界的各个角落，寻找愿意与我们共事的英雄。你是否有兴趣帮助部落强化在东部王国的控制力呢？那就通过这道传送门前往诅咒之地，向巨槌要塞的奥克莉拉报到吧！
text.completion: Silithus, such a worthless piece of land. It is a wonder that the great cataclysm did not sunder it fully!

english.title: Call of the Warmatron
english.objectives: Report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold in Blasted Lands.
english.description: Our venerable warmatron, Okrilla, has sent me to the far reaches of the world in search of suitable heroes that would join our cause. Are you interested in strengthening the Horde's grasp over the Eastern Kingdoms? Then take this portal to the Blasted Lands and report to Okrilla at Dreadmaul Hold!
english.completion: Silithus, such a worthless piece of land. It is a wonder that the great cataclysm did not sunder it fully!

text.title: 进入巨石之核
text.objectives: 与巨石之核中的大地看守者伊尔萨交谈。
text.description: 你说这个米尔豪斯·法力风暴和高阶女祭司艾苏尔要在巨石之核会面？$B$B听起来很重要。我们最好追踪他们。绝对不能让暮光之锤在我们眼皮底下搞出什么大动静来。$B$B去跟巨石之核中的大地看守者伊尔萨谈谈。她在那里监视暮光之锤，确保他们不能夺回大地神殿。
text.completion: It's about time they sent someone to help. Millhouse Manastorm?  It sounds like we're both after the same person.

english.title: Into the Stonecore
english.objectives: Speak to Earthwarden Yrsa inside the Stonecore.
english.description: You say that this Millhouse Manastorm and High Priestess Azil were to meet inside the Stonecore?$B$BSounds big.  We'd best get on their trail.  We don't want the Twilight's Hammer pulling off something big right under our noses.$B$BSpeak to Earthwarden Yrsa inside the Stonecore.  She's been stationed there to make sure the Twilight's Hammer doesn't try to retake the Temple of Earth.
english.completion: It's about time they sent someone to help. Millhouse Manastorm?  It sounds like we're both after the same person.

text.title: 守望堡需要你！
text.objectives: 与诅咒之地守望堡的军需官朗格尔斯交谈。
text.description: 守望堡需要你，$c！军需官朗格尔斯派我来消灭奥克莉拉的邪恶爪牙，并招募身强力壮的联盟英雄！帮助我们击退部落！$B$B如果你愿意的话，就通过我面前的这道传送门前往诅咒之地，与军需官谈谈。
text.completion: Silithus, not such a great place, eh? We get a lot of you from there...

english.title: Nethergarde Needs You!
english.objectives: Speak to Quartermaster Lungertz at Nethergarde Keep in Blasted Lands.
english.description: Nethergarde needs you, $c! I have been sent here by Quartermaster Lungertz to head off Okrilla's nefarious lackeys and to recruit able-bodied heroes of the Alliance! Help us fight off the Horde!$B$BIf you are willing, take this portal in front of me to the Blasted Lands and speak with the quartermaster.
english.completion: Silithus, not such a great place, eh? We get a lot of you from there...

text.title: 仰视
text.objectives: 对霜鬃营地中的5个霜鬃建造者使用视角均衡器。
text.description: 我们必须阻止霜鬃巨魔的村落继续得到加固。如果放任他们继续加固工事，就更难阻止他们在这里永久定居了。$B$B是时候让他们体验一下侏儒看世界的视角了！带着这台侏儒视角均衡器，用它将那些霜鬃建造者缩小到我们的体型。他们肯定没法再拿起工具，建造工作也就只能陷入停滞了。
text.completion: Well done, $n. That'll teach them not to mess with us in our home!
text.completed: Return to Snivek the Blade at Frostmane Retreat.

english.title: The View from Down Here
english.objectives: Use the Viewpoint Equalizer on 5 Frostmane Builders in Frostmane Retreat.
english.description: We need to halt the construction on this Frostmane village. If we let them get too entrenched, it will be more difficult to keep them from settling here permanently.$B$BIt's time to give those brutes a gnome's-eye view of the world! Take this gnomish viewpoint equalizer and use it on the Frostmane builders to bring them down to our level. They won't be able to lift their tools and construction will come to a standstill.
english.completion: Well done, $n. That'll teach them not to mess with us in our home!
english.completed: Return to Snivek the Blade at Frostmane Retreat.

text.title: 佩波
text.objectives: 与颤石塔林的佩波交谈。如果你在地上站足够长的时间，他就会冒出来。
text.description: 不知你注意到了没有，有一个很小的元素生物挺喜欢你的。如果你在地上多站一会，我相信你肯定可以看到他。$B$B你好像很善于在这里交朋友。这是个不错的天赋。
text.completion: <Pebble seems quite happy to meet you.>

english.title: Pebble
english.objectives: Speak to Pebble in the Shuddering Spires. If you stay on the ground long enough, he should come out of hiding to find you.
english.description: If you hadn't noticed, there's a very small elemental that has taken a liking to you. If you stay on the ground for even a few moments, I'm sure you'll spot him.$B$BYou seem to be quite adept at making friends down here. A good talent to have.
english.completion: <Pebble seems quite happy to meet you.>

text.title: 返回失落之城
text.objectives: 与托维尔失落之城中的哈丹队长交谈。
text.description: 我们占领了尼斐塞特城，但尼斐塞特人又找到了新的力量之源。$B$B拜强大的南风之神希亚玛特所赐，尼斐塞特人变得愈发危险了。$B$B我们刚刚得知，纳顿麾下的一支侦察小队在遭到伏击之后，设法占领了失落之城的入口。$B$B去找到哈丹队长，获得一切你需要的资料，以便除掉希亚玛特和那些尼斐塞特渣滓。
text.completion: Hail, $n.  Nadun spoke highly of you. Are you here to aid us?

english.title: Return to the Lost City
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Hadan inside the Lost City of the Tol'vir.
english.description: We might've taken Neferset City, but the Neferset have a new seat of power.$B$BThanks to Siamat, the powerful djinn of the south wind, the Neferset have become considerably more dangerous.$B$BWe just learned that some of Nadun's ambushed reconnaissance party managed to secure the entrance to the Lost City.$B$BGo find Captain Hadan and get whatever information you need to bring down Siamat and the Neferset scum.
english.completion: Hail, $n.  Nadun spoke highly of you. Are you here to aid us?

text.title: 粉碎蛮锤
text.objectives: 杀死蛮锤烙印战士，收集8个蛮锤徽章。桑德玛尔废墟里有名字的角色也会掉落徽章。
text.description: 蛮锤有联盟撑腰，愈发大胆。他们竟敢渡河而过。把他们赶回去！$B$B去找那些在河床以及北岸桑德玛尔废墟里战斗的蛮锤烙印战士，将他们杀掉。他们中的精英携带着徽记——替我把它们收集过来，证明你对龙喉的忠诚。
text.progress: Show me the insignias you've collected, $c.
text.completion: Look what we have here! A single Horde $c can demolish the Wildhammer by the dozen. What hope do they have now?
text.completed: Bring the Wildhammer Insignias to Malkar at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Crushing the Wildhammer
english.objectives: Kill Wildhammer Warbrands to collect 8 Wildhammer Insignias. Named characters within the Thundermar Ruins will also carry insignias.
english.description: The Wildhammer grow bold with their new Alliance allies. They dare press across the river. Drive them back!$B$BSeek out and crush the Wildhammer warbrands who fight in the riverbed and within the Thundermar Ruins along the north bank. The best among them carry insignias - gather them for me to prove your allegiance to the Dragonmaw cause.
english.progress: Show me the insignias you've collected, $c.
english.completion: Look what we have here! A single Horde $c can demolish the Wildhammer by the dozen. What hope do they have now?
english.completed: Bring the Wildhammer Insignias to Malkar at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 全面战争
text.objectives: 在桑德玛尔废墟打破10桶桑德玛尔麦酒。
text.description: 有些蛮锤还奢望收复北边河对面的桑德玛尔废墟。把他们烧死！打破桑德玛尔麦酒桶。那恶心的玩意着火之后足以产生爆炸。$B$B别问我为什么。$B$B也别问我这东西怎么喝。
text.completion: Yes, yes. Burn them out, as you would flush groundhogs from their holes... Well done, $n.
text.completed: Return to Harkkan at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Total War
english.objectives: Smash 10 Thundermar Ale Kegs within the Thundermar Ruins.
english.description: Some of the Wildhammer still cling to the hope of reclaiming the Thundermar Ruins to the north, across the river. Burn them out! Smash open kegs of Thundermar Ale. That wicked brew is potent enough to explode when set aflame.$B$BDon't ask me why.$B$BAnd don't ask me how they drink the stuff.
english.completion: Yes, yes. Burn them out, as you would flush groundhogs from their holes... Well done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Harkkan at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 又是一张吃饭的嘴
text.objectives: 在桑德玛尔废墟收集10件蛮锤存粮。
text.description: <格里夫的肚子咕咕叫。>$B$B还是饿。好像……每一天，我都饿。$B$B我听说北边河对岸的桑德玛尔废墟打仗的地方存着不少吃的。给我带点来。
text.progress: <Griff licks his lips.>
text.completion: Great! This'll tide me over for ... hours!
text.completed: Bring the food back to Griff at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Another Maw to Feed
english.objectives: Gather 10 Wildhammer Food Stores from the Thundermar Ruins.
english.description: <Griff's stomach growls.>$B$BStill hungry. It's like ... every day, I'm hungry.$B$BI hear there's more food stashed up in the Thundermar Ruins across the river to the north, where all the fighting is. Bring some to my mouth.
english.progress: <Griff licks his lips.>
english.completion: Great! This'll tide me over for ... hours!
english.completed: Bring the food back to Griff at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 把他们钩下来
text.objectives: 用尖利的肉钩让4名桑德玛尔狮鹫骑手掉下来，然后将他们消灭掉。
text.description: 蛮锤训练战斗狮鹫的速度比我们控制幼龙的速度要快。我们不能让他们继续保持这一数量优势！$B$B去捕杀在溅血谷地北边河流上空飞翔的狮鹫骑士。拿上这个钩子，等他们飞过来的时候丢出去。那劲头会把他们从坐骑上甩下来，掉到你的脚下。把那些落下来的狮鹫骑手给杀掉！
text.completion: You made that look easy, $n. Get the Wildhammer off of their mounts and they're nothing!
text.completed: Return to Harkkan at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Hook 'em High
english.objectives: Use the Barbed Fleshhook to dismount and kill 4 Thundermar Gryphon Riders.
english.description: The Wildhammer can train war gryphons faster than we can subvert and control drakes. We can't let them continue to outnumber us!$B$BHunt gryphon riders flying over the river north of Bloodgulch. Take this hook and fling it at them as they fly by. Their momentum will hurl them from their mount, right to your feet. Kill the dismounted gryphon riders!
english.completion: You made that look easy, $n. Get the Wildhammer off of their mounts and they're nothing!
english.completed: Return to Harkkan at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 打倒高阶萨满
text.objectives: 击败高阶萨满麦克凯利根。
text.description: 我们前线的斥候报告说高阶萨满麦克凯利根已经从桑德玛尔出发，正在河对岸西北边的桑德玛尔废墟里战斗。$B$B他是个危险的家伙，$n，许多龙喉都死在了他的手里。一定要把他消灭，这是毫无疑问的。$B$B问题在于：你是否愿意去干掉他，赢得这份荣誉？
text.completion: The High Shaman has been brought down! Thundermar will no doubt try to send others, but on this day, the Dragonmaw are triumphant.
text.completed: Return to Grot Deathblow at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.
text.giverWindow: 不能让他再杀人了！

english.title: Bring Down the High Shaman
english.objectives: Slay High Shaman MacKilligan.
english.description: Our scouts in the field report that High Shaman MacKilligan has moved out of Thundermar and is fighting amidst the Thundermar Ruins northwest of here, across the river.$B$BHe's a dangerous one, $n, responsible for the deaths of many a Dragonmaw. He WILL be destroyed, that is not the question.$B$BThe question is: will you be the one to earn the glory of the kill?
english.completion: The High Shaman has been brought down! Thundermar will no doubt try to send others, but on this day, the Dragonmaw are triumphant.
english.completed: Return to Grot Deathblow at Bloodgulch in Twilight Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Must not be allowed to kill again!

text.title: 前往莫尔杉壁垒
text.objectives: 去找北贫瘠之地和灰谷边境处莫尔杉壁垒的卡德拉克。
text.description: 北边莫尔杉壁垒的卡德拉克正在寻求帮助。$B$B壁垒坐落在北贫瘠之地和灰谷的边境上，那可是我们与联盟交战的前线。$B$B我们正在将暗夜精灵逐出森林，夺取其中的资源，为部落所用！$B$B要前往壁垒，就沿着十字路口北边的黄金之路走。$B$B去吧，命运在召唤你！
text.completion: You're the reinforcements that Thork sent? You'll do fine as long you can kill night elves. The forest is crawling with them.

english.title: To the Mor'shan Rampart
english.objectives: Report to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale.
english.description: Kadrak at the Mor'shan Rampart to the north is calling for aid.$B$BThe rampart rests on the border between the Northern Barrens and Ashenvale. It is the front line in the fight against the Alliance.$B$BWe're driving the night elves out of the forest. We'll claim its resources for the Horde!$B$BTo get there, take the Gold Road north out of the Crossroads.$B$BDestiny calls!
english.completion: You're the reinforcements that Thork sent? You'll do fine as long you can kill night elves. The forest is crawling with them.

text.title: 人们叫他快刀。他专杀鹰身人。
text.objectives: 去北贫瘠之地找到达索克·快刀。
text.description: 西边住着一位兽人，紧挨着大灾变破坏地带的边缘。$B$B人们叫他快刀，$n。这是因为……他的……其实我觉得那只是名字而已。$B$B<诺兹波特耸了耸肩。>$B$B总之，他就是鹰身人杀戮机器啦。达索克很喜欢杀鹰身人，并以此为生。去找他吧！了解他的手法，体验他的梦想。你说不定也会考虑将其作为自己的事业的。
text.completion: I suppose my reputation grows. Yes, yes I kill harpies. I don't enjoy it. But their raids on our supply caravans must cease, and someone's got to organize a resistance.

english.title: They Call Him Swiftdagger. He Kills Harpies.
english.objectives: Locate Darsok Swiftdagger in Northern Barrens.
english.description: There's an orc who lives in the west. At the frayed edge of the cataclysm's swath of destruction.$B$BThey call him Swiftdagger, $n. They call him that because ... his ... actually I think that's just his name.$B$B<Nozzlepot shrugs.>$B$BAnyway, he's a harpy-killing machine. He kills harpies. Loves it. It's a living. Go and see him! See how it's done. Live the dream. You might make a career out of it.
english.completion: I suppose my reputation grows. Yes, yes I kill harpies. I don't enjoy it. But their raids on our supply caravans must cease, and someone's got to organize a resistance.

text.title: 冬幕节礼物
text.completion: A small tag on this present reads:$B$BHappy holidays, $n!

english.title: A Winter Veil Gift
english.completion: A small tag on this present reads:$B$BHappy holidays, $n!

text.title: 返回孤儿院
text.objectives: 将你的监护对象送回到达拉然孤儿院，把神谕者孤儿哨交给达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
text.description: 我们和你一起渡过了一段最美好的时光，$n。真希望你会是我们的$g爸爸:妈妈;。但你现在必须带我回达拉然的孤儿院里。$B$B也许你什么时候能再来看我们？我们喜欢去看冬鳞小鱼人和巨龙女王。绝不会有人相信，我们竟然见到了造物主！$B$B我们会想念你的，$n。一定要给我们写信，我们也会给你写信的，好吗？
text.completion: It sounds like little Roo had a great time this week. I know he was getting awfully lonely in the orphanage and was eager to make some new friends. Thank you so much for agreeing to look after him.
text.completed: 去找达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。

english.title: Back To The Orphanage
english.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Oracle Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
english.description: We had the best time with you, $n. We wish you could be our $g daddy : mama; now, but you have to take us back to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.$B$BMaybe you could come visit us again sometime? We loved meeting Winterfin hatchlings and getting to see the dragon queen. No one will believe us when we say we met a Great One!$B$BWe going to miss you, $n. We promise to write letter sometime, oki?
english.completion: It sounds like little Roo had a great time this week. I know he was getting awfully lonely in the orphanage and was eager to make some new friends. Thank you so much for agreeing to look after him.
english.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

text.title: 返回孤儿院
text.objectives: 将你的监护对象送回到达拉然孤儿院，把狼獾人孤儿哨交给达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。
text.description: 你知道吗？你不是个坏人，$n。你带着科科去了许多有趣的地方。科科遇到了不少新朋友，还经历了一些其他孩子根本想象不到的事情。$B$B你与赫米特·奈辛瓦里和飘雪林地的小孩全都成了科科最好的朋友。也许你能把那本绿色山丘书带给科科？科科答应了要不时给你写一些东西，让你知道他的情况。也许，作为一个大舌头怪的孩子也是有些好处的。$B$B科科现在要回到孤儿监护员艾蕊娅那里去了，要回到紫色人的城市去了。
text.completion: Thank you for agreeing to care for Kekek this week. I know he can be a handful, but I think that with more individual attention and a few more friends, he'll do a lot better. No doubt he's going to be telling stories of his adventures with you for weeks.
text.completed: 去找达拉然的孤儿监护员艾蕊娅。

english.title: Back To The Orphanage
english.objectives: Return your ward to the Dalaran orphanage by handing in the Wolvar Orphan Whistle to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.
english.description: Know what? You not so bad after all, $n. You take Kekek a lot of fun places. Kekek meet a lot of new friends and do things no other pup get to do.$B$BYou, and Hemet Nesingwary, and Snowfall Glade pups all new best friends. Maybe sometime you bring Kekek that green hills book? Kekek promise to write sometimes, too, tell you how things go. Maybe even be nice to big-tongue kids sometimes.$B$BKekek gotta go back to orphan-lady Aria now, back in purple human city.
english.completion: Thank you for agreeing to care for Kekek this week. I know he can be a handful, but I think that with more individual attention and a few more friends, he'll do a lot better. No doubt he's going to be telling stories of his adventures with you for weeks.
english.completed: Return to Orphan Matron Aria in Dalaran.

text.title: 勘察员古斯坦
text.objectives: 去找塔纳利斯南月废墟的勘察员古斯坦。
text.description: 这么说……你还没去过南月废墟，对吧？啊呀，你可一定得去一趟。那里遍地都是奇妙的泰坦神器。到西边去找到探险者协会的帐篷吧。
text.completion: What, you here to help?

english.title: Prospector Gunstan
english.objectives: Report to Prospector Gunstan at Southmoon Ruins in Tanaris.
english.description: Say... you haven't been to Southmoon Ruins yet, have you?  Oh you simply MUST.  They have all sorts of fascinating titan artifacts.  Head west, and look for the Explorers' League tents.
english.completion: What, you here to help?

text.title: 托尔巴拉德的胜利
text.objectives: 赢得一场托尔巴拉德之战的胜利，然后去找托尔巴拉德半岛巴拉丁营地的士官长玛尔斯登。
text.description: 我们拼尽全力要在这块烂石头上站住脚跟，绝对不能让部落扰乱我们的计划。保持对托尔巴拉德的控制是我们的首要任务，而我们需要你的帮助，$n。在托尔巴拉德取胜，然后向我汇报得胜的好消息吧。
text.progress: 你有帶回勝利的消息嗎?
text.completion: What's that smell?  Ah.....Smells like victory.  Your efforts in Tol Barad are a great triumph for the entire Alliance, your contributions will not be forgotten.
text.end: 在托尔巴拉德取胜
text.completed: 去找托尔巴拉德半岛的士官长玛尔斯登。

english.title: Victory in Tol Barad
english.objectives: Win a Tol Barad battle and return to Major Marsden at Baradin Base Camp in Tol Barad Peninsula.
english.description: We fought hard to get a foothold on this ugly rock and there is no way we are going to let the Horde get in the way of our plans.  Keeping control of Tol Barad is our first priority and we need your help, $n.  Fight your way to victory in Tol Barad and return to me word of your triumph.
english.completion: What's that smell?  Ah.....Smells like victory.  Your efforts in Tol Barad are a great triumph for the entire Alliance, your contributions will not be forgotten.
english.end: Victory in Tol Barad
english.completed: Return to Major Marsden in Tol Barad Peninsula.

text.title: 托尔巴拉德的胜利
text.objectives: 赢得一场托尔巴拉德之战的胜利，然后去找托尔巴拉德半岛地狱咆哮之握的卡尔扎格上校。
text.description: 保持对于托尔巴拉德的控制是我们在东部王国的战略之关键，$r。我们必须不惜一切代价阻止联盟登岛，所以我们需要你的帮助。尽力去赢得托尔巴拉德的控制权，然后向我汇报胜利的好消息吧。
text.progress: Were you victorious against the Alliance?
text.completion: You bring word of victory, just as I expected!  Any triumph in Tol Barad is in turn a triumph for the Horde.  Have no doubt, your efforts here will be rewarded.
text.end: 在托尔巴拉德取胜
text.completed: 去找托尔巴拉德半岛的卡尔扎格上校。

english.title: Victory in Tol Barad
english.objectives: Win a Tol Barad battle and return to Colonel Karzag at Hellscream's Grasp in Tol Barad Peninsula.
english.description: Maintaining control of Tol Barad is the key to our strategic plans here in the Eastern Kingdoms, $r.  We must do whatever it takes to keep the Alliance off this island and that means we need your help.  Fight with everything you have to win control of Tol Barad and bring me word of victory.
english.progress: Were you victorious against the Alliance?
english.completion: You bring word of victory, just as I expected!  Any triumph in Tol Barad is in turn a triumph for the Horde.  Have no doubt, your efforts here will be rewarded.
english.end: Victory in Tol Barad
english.completed: Return to Colonel Karzag in Tol Barad Peninsula.

text.title: 金矿先生的疯狂之旅
text.objectives: 与见习萨满金矿一起乘坐矿车前往轨道的终点。
text.description: 好了，$n，我们要到洞穴深处的大地传送门去。$B$B我“弄到”了交通工具。有拉风的代步工具，又何必走路呢？希望你不介意使用矿车。$B$B等你准备好了，就告诉我一声。
text.completion: Oh no! My weapons and totems! They're destroyed!!!
text.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine inside the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Mr. Goldmine's Wild Ride
english.objectives: Ride the mine cart with Initiate Goldmine to the end of the line.
english.description: Okay, $n, we need to get to the earth portal at the back of the cave.$B$BI've "procured" a ride for us. Why walk when we can ride in style? I hope you don't mind mine carts.$B$BLet me know when you're ready.
english.completion: Oh no! My weapons and totems! They're destroyed!!!
english.completed: Speak with Initiate Goldmine inside the Elementium Depths in the Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 废土
text.objectives: 把拉比恩的信交给南风村附近的莱耶·星击。
text.description: 这里是希利苏斯，$C……一片荒芜严酷的废土。现在已经很少有人知道，在古老的年代中，这里曾经爆发过一场宏大的战争，对阵双方是暗夜精灵和一股邪恶的异界力量。现在，这股邪恶力量已经被封印，但我们怀疑它依旧在努力散播……无可形容的恐怖。$B$B找到我的斥候莱耶·星击。我派他去了东南方的南风村遗迹。$B$B把这封信交给他，他就会完全信任你了。

english.title: Wasteland
english.objectives: Deliver Rabine's Letter to Laylo Starstrike near Southwind Village.
english.description: This is Silithus, $c... a harsh and brutal wasteland. Few know that an ancient war was waged here between the night elves and a malign, alien power. The evil was sealed, but now we suspect that forces work to stir this... unspeakable horror.$B$BSeek out Layo Starstrike, one of my agents. I have sent him to the southeast to investigate the ruins of Southwind Village.$B$BGive him this letter, and he will give you his trust accordingly.

text.title: 南风村的灵魂
text.objectives: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village.
text.description: 在我们的西南方有个悲惨的地方——南风村的遗迹。我们就从那里开始吧，$N。$B$B根据我所掌握的情报，那座村庄曾经是暗夜精灵在希利苏斯的基地。很久以前异种蝎群攻陷那里，并将其夷为一片废墟。我简直不敢去想象南风村被虫群吞没的恐怖景象……$B$B那些饱受痛苦的德鲁伊和哨兵的亡魂在那座遗迹中漫无目标地游荡。探索那个地区，并释放那些悲惨的灵魂。
text.completed: Return to Layo Starstrike at Southwind Village in Silithus.

english.title: The Spirits of Southwind
english.objectives: Free the spirits of 8 Tortured Druids and 8 Tortured Sentinels in Southwind Village.
english.description: To our southwest lies a tragic site - the ruins of Southwind Village.  This is where our work should begin, $n.$B$BFrom what we've learned, this village was once a night elf base of operations for Silithus.  It's long since overrun by the silithid hives that infest the wastes.  I can only imagine the horror of the village's initial sundering...$B$BThe tortured spirits of fallen druids and sentinels wander the ruins aimlessly.  Explore this locale, freeing the souls of these wretched beings as needed.
english.completed: Return to Layo Starstrike at Southwind Village in Silithus.

text.title: 塔中之巢
text.objectives: Recover the Encrusted Silithid Object.
text.description: 我们必须找到南风村的异种蝎巢穴，而我知道有一个方法可以找到它。以我的经验来看，它们对于周围的环境很敏感，这也就解释了为什么它们会在听到灵魂的死亡嚎叫之后发起攻击。$B$B塔里的异种蝎群最为强大——就是那座有很多飞虫围绕着的塔。爬上那座塔，然后骚扰虫巢。向我汇报你所发现的东西！如果你找到了什么有价值的东西，就把它带回来给我。
text.completed: Return to Layo Starstrike in Silithus.

english.title: Hive in the Tower
english.objectives: Recover the Encrusted Silithid Object.
english.description: The hive needs to be addressed in Southwind Village, and I think I know a way to get at them.  It's been my experience that the silithid hives are very sensitive to their environment; this explains their attacks when hearing the death wails of the spirits.$B$BThe silithid are strongest in the tower - the one with the mass of wasps circling it.  Scale the tower and jostle the hive into activity.  Report back what you learn, but be careful!  If you uncover anything that might help, bring it to me.
english.completed: Return to Layo Starstrike in Silithus.

text.title: 档案管理员阿姆伯尔
text.objectives: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber.
text.description: Analyzing this is key. If it's a journal inside this sticky chitin, then the Circle would finally have a window into the past!$B$BGive this to my friend over there.  His name is Umber, and the man's brilliant.  Touched, sure, but brilliant nonetheless!  Umber's salvaged tomes in far worse shape than this.  If it can be saved, he can do it.

His name is Umber, and the man's brilliant.  Touched, sure, but brilliant nonetheless!  Umber's salvaged tomes in far worse shape than this.  If it can be saved, he can do it.

text.title: 发现过去的秘密
text.objectives: Speak with Rabine Saturna at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
text.description: Anyway, you should check back with me relatively soon... that is if you want to know what was in here.  As soon as I find out what it is, and if it's indeed a book, I'd be happy to share that information with you.$B$BIn the meantime, I'd check in with our dear "den mother" Rabine.  No doubt he'll want to know what crazy antics you've been up to.  Never leave the den mother waiting, $n... that is, unless you want to be doused in honey.$B$BIt's happened, trust me.

text.title: 打扰风声的东西
text.objectives: 消灭10个沙漠奔行者。
text.description: 你居然愚蠢到来这里，$C。但即便是蠢货可能也有用武之地。$B$B多年来，我一直警觉地站在这里，守护着我主人的牢笼。没有什么可以打扰我，即使是肆虐此地的大地爪牙也不允许打搅风的领土……$B$B我藐视他们！我可以轻易毁灭所有胆敢靠近的敌人，但我可不能允许我在那些小虫子身上浪费时间。当然了，如果你有兴趣帮忙，我会大大奖励你…
text.completed: Return to Highlord Demitrian at the Ravaged Twilight Camp in Silithus.

english.title: Befoulers of the Wind
english.objectives: Destroy 10 Desert Rumblers.
english.description: You are foolish to even have come to a place such as this, $c. But I might have use for even a fool.$B$BI stand vigil here over my master's prison, keeping watch across the years. Nothing may interrupt me. Not even the disgusting minions of the earth that roam here, intruders upon the territory of wind...$B$BI despise them! I destroy those that venture close, but I cannot allow myself to waste time on such pests. If you were to do so, however, I could reward you for it...
english.completed: Return to Highlord Demitrian at the Ravaged Twilight Camp in Silithus.

text.title: 召唤
text.objectives: 在格拉卡隆之骨使用召唤雕文，召唤异种虫的新主人。
text.description: 这些雕文上显示了一名其拉使者与三个异种虫将在一头巨龙的骨骸处会面。他们上面还有一段代码……我认识这种代码。当安其拉之门重新开启时，我曾经破译过它。$B$B但其拉早已经被打败了……现在又是谁在用它来控制异种虫？带着这些召唤雕文前往塞纳里奥要塞南边的格拉卡隆之骨。在那里使用它们，看看会有什么东西冒出来。一定要小心，冒出来的东西应该不会很友善。
text.completed: Return to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Recalling
english.objectives: Use the Glyphs of Calling at the Bones of Grakkarond to summon the new master of the silithid.
english.description: The glyphs illustrate an emissary of the Qiraji meeting with three silithid at the bones of a large dragon, and above them is a code... I know this code. I deciphered it when the gates of Ahn'Qiraj reopened.$B$BBut the Qiraji are long defeated... who is controlling the silithid with this? Take the Glyphs of Calling to the Bones of Grakkarond, south of Cenarion Hold. Use them there and see who shows up. They likely won't be friendly... be careful.
english.completed: Return to Geologist Larksbane at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: Baristolth's Plan
text.objectives: Speak with Baristolth of the Shifting Sands in Cenarion Hold.
text.description: The guards here mentioned they've seen the Twilight's Hammer cultists moving closer to Hive'Ashi recently. Could they be amassing forces inside the hive, in secret?$B$BWe've got to get to the bottom of this before they have a chance to put whatever foul plot they're brewing into motion.$B$BBaristolth, the hunter just across the way in front of me, has hunted through the hives of Silithus since before you or I were born. He may have a way for you to get inside Hive'Ashi unnoticed...

text.title: Secretion and Subterfuge
text.objectives: Collect 8 Hive'Ashi Secretion Glands from any Silithid in Hive'Ashi.
text.description: I've seen no cultists wandering the surface of Hive'Ashi to the north. With any luck, we can make our preparations without being noticed.$B$BOne of the organs of the silithid is used to secrete a thick sludge that hardens in the air. This is used to build hives, and by some to lay eggs.$B$BBring me enough of these organs to cover someone twice your height, and do not venture far into the hives just yet.
text.completed: Return to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: Riding in Plain Sight
text.objectives: Use the Primed Silithid Mucous near the Hive'Ashi Egg pile to infiltrate the hive.
text.description: We are prepared. Take this box. Upon opening it, you will be engulfed in silithid mucus and encased within a temporary egg. $B$BUse it near other eggs on the surface of Hive'Ashi, and the drones should carry you within the hive, unknown to their twilight guardians. The egg should break before you run out of air.
text.turninWindow: Do not risk speaking... simply listen.

text.title: Mysteries of the Twilight Hive
text.objectives: Search Hive'Ashi for evidence of the Twilight Hammer's plot, and kill 10 Twilight's Hammer cultists.
text.description: It's as we suspected... this hive is a hidden base of operations for the Twilight's Hammer cult. They have kept their increased activity a secret this way.$B$BWe must find what they are plotting. Search the hive for any clues to their plans, and make sure you leave enough of the lunatics dead to keep them from further scheming.
text.completed: Return to Baristolth of the Shifting Sands at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
text.giverWindow: Show no mercy to those who wish to end the world.

text.title: 疯狂的囚犯
text.objectives: 救出5名亚什虫巢囚犯。
text.description: 你！到这边来！是的，到蛋这边来！让我能把你看清楚一点。$B$B看样子，巴里斯托尔斯在给你的伪装上做了一些改进……我却只能在这种破玩意里凑合。我是他之前派到这里的探子。$B$B不，不，你没有时间帮助我了！你必须去帮助其他人！他们全都被抓住，囚禁在这个虫巢里……赶快找到并救出他们。$B$B我自己能从这东西里钻出来……这有什么难的？
text.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

english.title: Prisoners of Madness
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Hive'Ashi Prisoners.
english.description: You! Come here! Yes, to the egg! I can just barely see you.$B$BIt looks like Baristolth improved his disguise before you tried it... I'm still stuck in this thing. I'm the scout he sent ahead here.$B$BNo, no, there's no time to assist me! You have to help the others! They've got prisoners all throughout this hive... Find them and rescue them.$B$BI'll get out of this thing myself... how hard could it be?
english.completed: Return to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

text.title: 随机英雄日常 （第一次）（大地的裂变）
萨乌拉诺克会指明方向
text.objectives: 与和奥格瑞玛格罗玛什要塞中的秘法师萨乌拉诺克谈谈。
text.description: 我看你还没和大酋长的……另外一个顾问……秘法师萨乌拉诺克聊过。自诺森德战役以来他一直在辅佐我。$B$B要突袭暮光高地，我们首先需要一张海岸线的地图。之前我已命令萨乌拉诺克去获取这些信息。去看看他是否用得上你的协助！
text.completed: 与和奥格瑞玛格罗玛什要塞中的秘法师萨乌拉诺克谈谈。

english.title: Sauranok Will Point the Way
english.objectives: Speak with Sauranok the Mystic at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.
english.description: I see you haven't yet spoken to my advisor, Sauranok the Mystic. He has been at my side since our campaign together in Northrend.$B$BTo assault the Twilight Highlands, we're going to need a map of the shoreline. I have tasked Sauranok with digging up this information. See if he can use your assistance! He is standing right next to me.
english.completed: Speak with Sauranok the Mystic at Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 粉碎皇冠药剂公司
text.objectives: 消灭5个皇冠技师，并使用滑栓的氪金炸弹摧毁奥丹姆卡塔图陵墓东边的一台药剂车。然后返回暴风城，去见探员斯尼普·滑栓。
text.description: 这账本上提到了多处地点，我需要你前去调查并采取相应的行动，伙计。不能再拖下去了。$b$b这是我要你调查的一处地点：就在奥丹姆的卡塔图陵墓东边，靠近塔纳利斯的入口。他们肯定不会干什么好事。到那儿去解决掉他们。$b$b噢，对了，如果你发现了某些危险的大玩意儿需要当场销毁的话，就朝它丢这个炸弹。
text.completion: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.
text.completed: Return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind's Trade District.

english.title: Crushing the Crown
english.objectives: Kill 5 Crown Technicians and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to destroy one chemical wagon east of the Tomb of Khartut in Uldum, then return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind.
english.description: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it looks like it's in the Uldum, just east of the Tomb of Khartut, close to the entrance from Tanaris. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.
english.completion: Good job, kid. You deserve a little somethin'. And hey, come back tomorrow if you get the time; I might have a job for ya.
english.completed: Return to Inspector Snip Snagglebolt in Stormwind's Trade District.

text.description: 这本分类账有很多处地点，我需要你前去调查并采取相应的行动，伙计。不能再拖下去了。$b$b这是我要你调查的一处地点：就在奥丹姆的卡塔图陵墓东边，靠近塔纳利斯的入口。到那儿去解决掉他们。$b$b噢，对了，如果你看到大件的东西而且又很危险的话，朝它丢这个炸弹。

text.title: 矿工的宝贝
text.objectives: 从风险投资公司的某个监督或者执行者那里夺取猫眼翡翠。
text.description: 嗨，$r，对宝藏感兴趣嘛？我这里有点猛料。$b$b最近我听到了一些消息，是关于风险投资公司在淤泥沼泽东北的石矿洞的。有个矿工挖出了一枚足有拳头大小的翡翠石。$B$B我知道有一些买主肯掏钱买那么大的一块宝石，如果你帮我搞到那块宝石的话，那么我愿意和你五五分成，你看怎么样？
text.progress: 只要我们知道是哪个矿工找到了翡翠，那麽得到它就是轻而易举的事情了……
text.completion: $N，看看这块大宝石!我们就要成富翁了!根据我对安德麦的各种宝石的估价，我来算算你应该分到多少，怎麽样?$B$B让我想想……我觉得这个价格应该没什麽问题。$N，很高兴与你做生意。$B$B
text.completed: Bring the Emerald to Brak Blusterpipe in Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Miner's Fortune
english.objectives: Retrieve the Cats Eye Emerald from one of the Venture Co. Overseers or Enforcers.
english.description: Hey $r, you interested in treasure? I knew that would get your attention.$b$bWord from the river dock here is that one of the miners in the Venture Company's Boulder Lode mine just northeast of here discovered an emerald the size of your fist.$B$BI know a few buyers who'd be interested in getting their hands on something like that, and I'd be willing to go half and half on its sale. You in?
english.progress: If only we knew which one of the miners had found the emerald, it'd be a walk in the park...
english.completion: Look at the size of that thing! We're going to be rich! Let's see, according to the rates I've seen on gems going into Undermine, I should be able to figure out your cut - fifty percent, don't worry!$B$BNow let's see... I think this should do about right. Pleasure doing business with you, $n.
english.completed: Bring the Emerald to Brak Blusterpipe in Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.
