text.title: 什么什么平衡器
text.objectives: 在风险投资公司研究基地里找到控制台。
text.description: 风险投资公司最近在西边设立了小型的研究设备，就在淤泥沼泽过去一点点。我对他们在做的东西并不了解，只知道他们正在试验一种名叫“主动式负载平衡器”的装备。$b$b那个主动式负载平衡器到底是什么东西呢？不管它是什么，我都想研究研究它，所以我需要找个人来帮我把它弄到手。$b$b我手里有控制系统操作手册的副本，你应该知道该怎么把那什么平衡器卸下来。
text.completion: 控制台的表面淩乱地布满了众多的按钮、控制杆和不断闪烁的指示灯。一部小型仪表显示这台设备正处於最佳的工作状态下，一至三号控制阀门已经打开。在控制面板的右下方有一个插钥匙的小孔。$B$B
text.completed: 在北贫瘠之地风险投资公司研究基地里找到控制台。

english.title: Samophlange
english.objectives: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site.
english.description: The Venture Company have a small research facility west of here, just past the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange".$b$bNow what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it.$b$bI obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
english.completion: A variety of buttons, levers, and blinking lights are somewhat erratically arrayed on the face of the control console. A small gauge indicates that the apparatus is currently operating within optimal levels, and indicates that control valves one through three are currently open. There is a small keyhole set into the lower right side of the control panel.
english.completed: Access the control console at the Venture Company research site in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 什么什么平衡器
text.objectives: 关闭燃油控制阀、调节阀和主控制阀，然后再使用控制台。
text.description: 三个控制阀门都处于打开状态。根据控制面板上的指示说明，在拆卸零件之前必须要把这三个阀门关闭。
text.completion: 关闭了三个控制阀之後，绿色指示灯慢慢变为黄色，阀门已经关闭，现在你可以使用这套设备的控制开关了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Outpost in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Samophlange
english.objectives: Close off the Fuel Control Valve, the Regulator Valve and the Main Control Valve then use the control console again.
english.description: The three control valves are currently opened. The various readings on the control panel lead you to presume that they must be shut off before the apparatus can be shut off.
english.completion: The lights indicating the three control valves dim as they are shut off. Green lights slowly fade into yellow, and the switch controlling the apparatus is now moveable, with the valves closed, it can be turned off.
english.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 什么什么平衡器
text.objectives: 从工匠斯尼格斯那里拿到控制台的钥匙。
text.description: 关闭设备后就可以开启控制面板，从控制台中移出主动式负载平衡器。一切准备就绪，现在你需要做的就是取得可以打开控制台的钥匙。
text.progress: 控制灯熄灭了，各种仪表都指向了零刻度，整台设备顿时停了下来。
text.completion: 你把钥匙插入锁中，打开了控制台。控制台上方的红灯熄灭了，终端的所有能源全都被切断了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Post in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Samophlange
english.objectives: Get the Console Key from Tinkerer Sniggles.
english.description: With the apparatus deactivated, the control panel can be opened up and the samophlange removed from the console. With everything else in place, all that is left is to acquire the key to unlock the console.
english.progress: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
english.completion: Turning the key in the lock, the control console unlocks. A red light at the top of the console turns off and all power drains from the terminal.
english.completed: Return to the Control Console at the Venture Company Research Post in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 什么什么平衡器
text.objectives: 把主动式负载平衡器交给北贫瘠之地诺兹波特的哨站的斯布特瓦夫。
text.description: 揭开控制台的盖子之后，你看见了密密麻麻缠绕在一起的电线、管子和其它各种奇形怪状的机械装备——其中大多数看起来没有什么实际用途。你把它们拨向一边，在控制台的最里边找到了主动式负载平衡器。你花了好大劲儿才把它从机架上拽了出来。
text.progress: 哦，你回来了，$N!你找到主动式负载平衡器了吗?
text.completion: 这个……嗯……有趣的东西……没错，我要马上把它送到安德麦的技工协会总部去。我确信，在经过仔细的检查和研究之後，他们能弄清楚这个东西到底是干什麽用的。$B$B
text.completed: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Samophlange
english.objectives: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.
english.description: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
english.progress: Oh, you're back, $n! Do you have the samophlange?
english.completion: This is... er... interesting... yes. A device this complex is best analyzed by a team of skilled engineers in a clean room, painstakingly reverse engineering each component in a controlled environment. But who has that kind of time? Let's just fire this thing up and see what it does...
english.completed: Return the Samophlange to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in Northern Barrens.

text.title: 修理主动式负载平衡器
text.objectives: 将损坏的主动式负载平衡器交给营地里的布拉克·布拉斯派普。
text.description: 事与愿违，我想我把它搞坏了。$B$B不过别紧张。帮我个忙，把这个给对面营地里的布拉克送去。他转眼就能把这个破玩意修好！
text.completed: 将损坏的主动式负载平衡器交给营地里的布拉克·布拉斯派普。

english.title: Samophlange Repair
english.objectives: Walk the Broken Samophlange over to Brak Blusterpipe within the encampment.
english.description: Well that didn't go as expected. I think I busted it.$B$BNo need to panic, though. Do me a favor and walk this across the way to Brak here in the camp. He'll bang this sucker back into shape real quick!
english.completed: Walk the Broken Samophlange over to Brak Blusterpipe within the encampment.

text.title: 维妮·布特巴克
text.objectives: 将损坏的主动式负载平衡器交给维妮·布特巴克。与布拉克交谈可以直接传送到她身边。
text.description: 我想我可能把主动式负载平衡器给弄坏了——好像是把负载电容弄到了整流器的轮辐中。我们必须想办法修好它，很简单的。我认识一个三联活塞设备方面的专家，她肯定很乐意修理这个主动式负载平衡器。把坏掉的主动式负载平衡器交给维妮·布特巴克，她就在莫尔杉壁垒的南边。她会修好它的。$B$B嘿，你不用走路——这正是测试我的单人传送设备的好机会呀！
text.progress: 我正忙着干活哪，$C。除非你有事找我，不然你最好该干什麽干什麽去……
text.completion: 哦，这是什麽?主动式负载平衡器?啥叫主动式负载平衡器??$B$B呃……这里面有复杂的齿轮传动结构运转时发出的声音。啊，天哪!我要修好它，看看它到底是干什麽用的，好吗??$B$B
text.completed: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket in Northern Barrens. Talk to Brak to teleport directly to her.

english.title: Wenikee Boltbucket
english.objectives: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket. Talk to Brak to teleport directly to her.
english.description: I think I really put my foot into that one - it looks like I might have knocked one of the load-bearing fluxors into the spokes of the deregulator gear. We can fix this, easy. I know an expert on triple-expansion piston drives who would love to get her hands on a samophlange. Take the broken samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket, just south of Mor'shan Rampart, she'll patch 'er right up.$B$BHey, no need to walk - this gives me the perfect opportunity to test my personal people porter device!
english.progress: I'm very busy with my work, $C.  Unless you have something for me, it'd be best if you moved along...
english.completion: Oh, what's this? A samophlange, you say? What's a samophlange??$B$BAh... but look at the way it moves when you handle it.  And there's the sound of intricate gears inside. Oh my! I want to fix it and see what it does, don't you??
english.completed: Bring the Broken and Battered Samophlange to Wenikee Boltbucket in Northern Barrens. Talk to Brak to teleport directly to her.

text.title: 高强度齿轮
text.objectives: 在西南方火刃农场的小篮子中收集10个高强度齿轮。
text.description: 我想修好这个主动式负载平衡器，但是，我需要一些材料。我用光了17.5规格的高强度齿轮，而我需要很多这样的东西才能继续工作。$B$B不幸的是，要弄到这种齿轮的话，最近的地方是西南方的火刃农场。那里有很多敌人，所以一定要小心。但为了主动式负载平衡器而冒险是值得的。检查一下你在那里找到的工具篮，当你搜集了足够的高强度齿轮后再回到我这里来。
text.progress: 你拿到高强度齿轮了吗，$N?我一直在盯着这个主动式负载平衡器，而且在急切地盼望着能开始动手修补它。
text.completion: 太好了，你搞到齿轮了!我马上就开始工作……$B$B
text.completed: Bring the Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in Northern Barrens.

english.title: Nugget Slugs
english.objectives: Collect 10 Nugget Slugs from buckets around the Burning Blade farm to the southwest.
english.description: I want to fix this samophlange, but to do that I'm going to need some supplies. I ran out of seventeen-point-five gauge nugget slugs and I'm going to need a bunch of those for the work ahead.$B$BUnfortunately, the closest place to get them is the Burning Blade farm to the southwest. The place will be heavily guarded, so be careful, but the samophlange just might be worth the risk. Search the tool buckets, then return to me when you've gathered enough nugget slugs.
english.progress: Do you have the nugget slugs, $n?  I've been eyeing this Samophlange and I can't wait to tinker with it.
english.completion: Great, you got them!  Now I can get to work...
english.completed: Bring the Nugget Slugs to Wenikee Boltbucket in Northern Barrens.

text.title: Into Jaedenar
text.objectives: Find Andalar Shadevale in Jaedenar.
text.description: The Shadow Council corrupts this once beautiful forest from their stronghold, Jaedenar, in the northwest.$B$BNow, one of our own is missing. We sent a lone scout by the name of Andalar Shadevale to Jaedenar, in hopes of thinning the enemy's ranks by stealth. $B$BWe have not heard from him in days, and we fear the worst. There is a small chance he may still be alive. $n, please go at once and find him!
text.completed: Find Andalar Shadevale in Jaedenar.

english.title: Into Jaedenar
english.objectives: Find Andalar Shadevale in Jaedenar.
english.description: The Shadow Council corrupts this once beautiful forest from their stronghold, Jaedenar, in the northwest.$B$BNow, one of our own is missing. We sent a lone scout by the name of Andalar Shadevale to Jaedenar, in hopes of thinning the enemy's ranks by stealth. $B$BWe have not heard from him in days, and we fear the worst. There is a small chance he may still be alive. $n, please go at once and find him!
english.completed: Find Andalar Shadevale in Jaedenar.

text.title: 死亡知识
text.objectives: 将装满的水壶交给安达拉尔·荫谷。
text.description: <腐败的水泛着泡沫，仿佛是想从现有的状态中挣脱出来。>$B$B将这种水交给我们在战场上的斥候。他应该能将这种水净化，为我们进攻暗影堡做好准备！
text.completed: 将装满的水壶交给安达拉尔·荫谷。

english.title: Dying Knowledge
english.objectives: Take the filled canteen to Andalar Shadevale.
english.description: <The corrupted water bubbles and froths, as if trying to break free from itself.>$B$BTake this water to our scout in the field. He should be able to purify it for our attack on the Shadow Hold's defenses!
english.completed: Take the filled canteen to Andalar Shadevale.

text.title: 祭拜这团火焰
text.objectives: 祭拜海加尔的大地之环篝火。
text.description: 仲夏火焰节是敬拜元素的时刻。火焰元素会在我们所有人心中点燃激情。在许多时候，这种激情会喷发出来，演变成侵略性的行动。但在这个地方，我们将心中的激情变为虔诚的祭拜。$b$b我们会遵循传统，为火焰举行庆典。你愿意和我们一同敬拜火焰吗，$n？
text.completion: Honor the Mount Hyjal flame.
text.end: 祭拜海加尔的大地之环篝火。

english.title: Honor the Flame
english.objectives: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Hyjal.
english.description: The Midsummer Fire Festival is a time to honor the elements.  The element of fire stirs passion within us all.  Many times, that passion pours out into aggressive actions.  But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?
english.completion: Honor the Mount Hyjal flame.
english.end: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Hyjal.

text.title: 祭拜这团火焰
text.objectives: 祭拜瓦丝琪尔的大地之环篝火。
text.description: 仲夏火焰节是敬拜元素的时刻。火焰元素会在我们所有人心中点燃激情。在许多时候，这种激情会喷发出来，演变成侵略性的行动。但在这个地方，我们将心中的激情变为虔诚的祭拜。$b$b我们会遵循传统，为火焰举行庆典。你愿意和我们一同敬拜火焰吗，$n？
text.completion: Honor the Vashj'ir flame.
text.end: 祭拜瓦丝琪尔的大地之环篝火。

But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?

english.end: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 趁它们小的时候得到它们
text.objectives: 从霜刀石周围的巢穴中收集8头霜刃豹幼崽。
text.description: 我可以教导你骑乘冬泉霜刃豹，但这需要你付出一定的时间和精力。要进行这种骑乘，霜刃豹和骑手都必须接受严格训练，并建立牢固的信任关系。$B$B霜刃豹只有在幼崽时期才能接受训练，接纳一名骑手。霜刀石周围的一些巢穴中能找到年龄刚好适合进行训练的霜刃豹幼崽。如果你能帮我找到一些最有训练潜质的幼崽，我就能帮你训练你自己的霜刃豹幼崽。
text.progress: We must get the saber cubs while they're still young enough to bond with people. If they get too old, the cats will remain feral forever.
text.completion: These cubs are just the right age to begin their training. A few of them even have the proper traits to be trained as mounts. As promised, I'll select one of these cubs for you to train. This fellow here seems to have an affinity for you.$B$BI'll train the more common, docile cubs for the market in Darnassus.
text.completed: Return to Rivern Frostwind at Frostsaber Rock.

english.title: Get Them While They're Young
english.objectives: Gather 8 Frostsaber Cubs from the dens around Frostsaber Rock.
english.description: I can teach you to ride a Winterspring frostsaber, but it takes time and dedication. For this to work, both saber and rider must be highly trained and both must share a bond of deep trust.$B$BThe cubs are only receptive to this training if they're introduced to their riders at a young age. Some of the cubs in the dens surrounding Frostsaber Rock are at the proper age to begin their training. If you help me gather the most promising of those cubs, I'll allow you to begin training with your own cub.
english.progress: We must get the saber cubs while they're still young enough to bond with people. If they get too old, the cats will remain feral forever.
english.completion: These cubs are just the right age to begin their training. A few of them even have the proper traits to be trained as mounts. As promised, I'll select one of these cubs for you to train. This fellow here seems to have an affinity for you.$B$BI'll train the more common, docile cubs for the market in Darnassus.
english.completed: Return to Rivern Frostwind at Frostsaber Rock.

text.title: 飞速成长
text.objectives: 收集你的冬泉豹幼崽掉落的20根冬泉豹幼崽的胡须。将这些胡须以及20块符文布、20块硬甲皮和80金币交给雷沃·霜翼。
text.description: 我相信，这个小家伙一定会成为你的好伙伴。$B$B这只幼崽需要你的悉心关照，才能强壮而健康地成长。你应该每天至少查看它一次。喂养和照料你的冬泉豹幼崽是和他建立信任和友谊的最好办法。$B$B在你的幼崽成长过程中，他的旧胡须会脱落，生出与他的体形相匹配的新胡须。等你的幼崽脱落了二十根胡须，就带他来见我。同时还要带来另外一些材料，让我给你制做骑鞍。
text.progress: How fares your young saber?
text.completion: It looks like you've done an admirable job of raising your cub, $n. Your saber has grown up to be strong, healthy, and loyal. Both of you are well-matched.$B$BYour Winterspring frostsaber will respond to your call anytime you wish to ride together.
text.completed: Return to Rivern Frostwind at Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring.

english.title: They Grow Up So Fast
english.objectives: Accumulate 20 Winterspring Cub Whiskers shed by your Winterspring Cub. Bring the whiskers, 20 Runecloth, 20 Rugged Leather, and 80 gold to Rivern Frostwind.
english.description: I think this little fellow will be a good match for you.$B$BThis cub is going to require a lot of attention to ensure that he grows up strong and healthy. You should check up on your cub at least once each day. Feeding and caring for your Winterspring cub is the best way to build a bond of trust with him.$B$BAs your cub grows, he will shed his old whiskers and grow new ones appropriate to his size. Once your cub has shed twenty whiskers, bring him back to me along with some materials for your saddle.
english.progress: How fares your young saber?
english.completion: It looks like you've done an admirable job of raising your cub, $n. Your saber has grown up to be strong, healthy, and loyal. Both of you are well-matched.$B$BYour Winterspring frostsaber will respond to your call anytime you wish to ride together.
english.completed: Return to Rivern Frostwind at Frostsaber Rock in Winterspring.

text.title: 幼崽的渴望
text.objectives: 从冬泉谷的各种碎齿熊身上收集到6块碎齿熊肉，把它们喂给你的冬泉豹幼崽。
text.description: 你的冬泉豹幼崽看着你，不停地舔着舌头。这只小猫一定是饿了。为它准备一顿好饭正是你的责任。$B$B雷沃·霜翼曾经说过，他总是会在手边准备一些碎齿熊肉，好喂他的霜刃豹幼崽。也许你的幼崽同样会喜欢新鲜的碎齿熊肉。你在冬泉谷各处都能找到各种碎齿熊。
text.completion: Your Winterspring cub looks happy, satisfied, and ready to curl up for a nap.
text.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

english.title: A Cub's Cravings
english.objectives: Gather 6 pieces of Shardtooth Meat from any of the Shardtooth bears in Winterspring and feed them to your Winterspring Cub.
english.description: Your Winterspring cub looks at you and licks its lips. The little cat must be hungry and it's up to you to find a suitable meal for your charge.$B$BRivern Frostwind mentioned keeping some shardtooth bear meat on hand for feeding his frostsaber cubs. Perhaps your cub would enjoy some fresh shardtooth meat of its own. Various kinds of shardtooth bears can be found all over Winterspring.
english.completion: Your Winterspring cub looks happy, satisfied, and ready to curl up for a nap.
english.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

objectiveDetails.description: 喂碎齿熊肉给冬泉豹幼崽

text.title: 祭拜这团火焰
text.objectives: 祭拜深岩之洲的大地之环篝火。
text.description: 仲夏火焰节是敬拜元素的时刻。火焰元素会在我们所有人心中点燃激情。在许多时候，这种激情会喷发出来，演变成侵略性的行动。但在这个地方，我们将心中的激情变为虔诚的祭拜。$b$b我们会遵循传统，为火焰举行庆典。你愿意和我们一同敬拜火焰吗，$n？
text.completion: Honor the Deepholm flame.
text.end: 祭拜深岩之洲的大地之环篝火。

But here, in this land, we focus our passion on reverence.$b$bWe will honor the flame as tradition dictates.  Will you honor the flame with us, $n?
english.completion: Honor the Deepholm flame.
english.end: Honor the Earthen Ring Bonfire in Deepholm.

text.title: “借”自冬泉
text.objectives: 从冬泉谷的两处冬泉熊怪营地中取得6块熏肉，把它们喂给你的冬泉豹幼崽。
text.description: 你的幼崽期待地看着你。它想要什么？$B$B这只小猫舔着嘴唇。一定是又到它的吃饭时间了！作为它的代理$g父亲:母亲;，你有责任为它提供肉食，直到它能够自己狩猎。$B$B不过你也可以让其他人完成狩猎工作。冬泉谷的两座冬泉熊怪营地里，冬泉熊怪们通常都会在手边准备许多熏肉。当然，他们不会在乎少几块肉。而你的幼崽也可以尝试一下新食物。
text.completion: Your cub looks satisfied for now.
text.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

english.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
english.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Smoked Meat from either Winterfall furbolg camp in Winterspring and feed them to your Winterspring Cub.
english.description: Your cub looks at you expectantly. What could it want now?$B$BThe little cat licks its lips. It must be meal time again! As the cub's surrogate $gfather:mother; you're responsible for providing meat until it can hunt on its own.$B$BBut what if you let someone else do the hunting? The Winterfall furbolg of Winterspring usually have a lot of smoked meat on hand in both of their camps. Surely, they wouldn't miss a few pieces and your cub would get to try something new.
english.completion: Your cub looks satisfied for now.
english.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

text.title: 狩猎练习
text.objectives: 带你的幼崽靠近冬泉谷北部被积雪覆盖的地洞，如是进行5次，帮助冬泉豹幼崽学习狩猎极地野兔。
text.description: 你的冬泉豹幼崽兴致勃勃地用爪子拍打着你的手掌。在没有玩伴的情况下，这只幼崽几乎没有机会练习它的捕猎技巧。$B$B也许你应该带你的幼崽去狩猎冬泉谷北部雪地中那些穴居的小极地野兔。带你的幼崽靠近覆盖住野兔洞的雪堆，等待幼崽依靠本能猎捕野兔。
text.completion: Your Winterspring cub looks tired, content, and perhaps a bit more experienced.
text.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

english.title: Hunting Practice
english.objectives: Bring your cub near snow-covered burrows in northern Winterspring 5 times to help it learn how to hunt arctic hares.
english.description: Your Winterspring cub paws playfully at your hands. Without any playmates, the cub has few chances to practice its hunting skills.$B$BPerhaps you should take your cub hunting for the small arctic hares that burrow in the snow of northern Winterspring. Bring your cub close to the mounds of snow covering the hare burrows and wait for the cub's instincts to take over.
english.completion: Your Winterspring cub looks tired, content, and perhaps a bit more experienced.
english.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

text.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

text.title: 幼崽的第一个玩具
text.objectives: 从冰蓟雪人那里得到1张坚实的雪人毛皮；收集5根枭兽羽毛。用它们制造一件冬泉豹玩具，用它同你的冬泉豹幼崽玩耍。
text.description: 冬泉豹幼崽玩弄着一小撮从某一头大兽身上掉落的软毛，不停地拍打着它。看起来，你的幼崽很喜欢这种新鲜的游戏。你觉得一个真正的猫玩具肯定会更让它喜欢。$B$B只需要一小块雪人皮和一些发疯枭兽的羽毛，你就能做出一件漂亮的玩具。你可以在永望镇东南的冰蓟岭找到雪人皮，在隐秘小林或枭翼树丛找到枭兽羽毛。
text.completion: Your Wintersrping cub seems thrilled with its new toy, but there's no telling how well it will survive the cub's enthusiasm.
text.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

english.title: Cub's First Toy
english.objectives: Obtain a Tough Yeti Hide from any Ice Thistle Yeti and 5 Wildkin feathers. Combine them to make a Winterspring Cat Toy and use it to play with your Winterspring Cub.
english.description: The winterspring cub plays with a small tuft of fur from a large animal, batting the discarded hair about. While your cub looks like it's enjoying the new game, you wonder if it might get more enjoyment from a proper cat toy.$B$BWith a little bit of leather from a yeti pelt and some feathers from crazed moonkin, you could make a respectable toy. You'll need a hide from the yeti in the Ice Thistle Hills southeast of Everlook and feathers from the moonkin at the Hidden Grove or Owl Wing Thicket.
english.completion: Your Wintersrping cub seems thrilled with its new toy, but there's no telling how well it will survive the cub's enthusiasm.
english.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

text.title: 度假天堂欢迎你
text.objectives: 消灭6只纵火焰鬼
text.description: 啊哈哈！$B$B哦我的天哪，我还以为你和他们是一伙的。$B$B你是谁？$N？知道吗，我们正迫切需要你的帮助。$B$B<拉珊听你询问这里到底出了什么事。>$B$B你瞎了吗？难道没有看见整个度假地都已经燃烧起来了！那些可恶的小纵火焰鬼在这里到处乱跑，用他们肮脏的小爪子点燃了这里的每一样东西。赶快消灭他们，否则我们的利润就要受到严重损失了！
text.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

english.title: Welcome to Paradise
english.objectives: Kill 6 Flamekin Firestarters
english.description: Eaaaauuuugggghhhh!$B$BOh my goodness, I thought you were one of THEM.$B$BWho are you? $n? Look, we could really use your help.$B$B<Lasha listens as you ask what's going on.>$B$BAre you blind? The entire resort's on fire! These pesky little Flamekin Firestarters are running around the place, torching everything they can get their grubby little claws on. Kill them all before our profits suffer!
english.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Kitchen Clean-Up
text.objectives: Collect 8 Empty Kaja'Cola cans
text.description: Why would anyone want to attack us? We're not hurting anybody! Anyway, it's a good thing you showed up when you did.$B$BLook $n, I need to find out who's sabotaging us before I lose my job. You're going to go undercover and dig up as much information as you can. First though, you need to show me you can blend in as one of our staff.$B$BFirst thing we need to do is keep this place clean. Go down to the beach to the west and clean up any empty cans that you see.
text.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

First though, you need to show me you can blend in as one of our staff.$B$BFirst thing we need to do is keep this place clean. Go down to the beach to the west and clean up any empty cans that you see.
english.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Lunch Break
text.objectives: Deliver lunch to 5 Resort Staff
text.description: Are you the new assistant that Lasha's been talking about?$B$B<Dodd looks you up and down, not even trying to conceal a look of distaste.>$B$BI need you to deliver these leftover lunches to the rest of the Resort Staff. I don't like my Staff taking their own meal breaks - they run the risk of wandering into forbidden places, loitering, or even gossiping. Filthy habits! Make sure they eat the food!
text.completed: Return to Assistant Resort Director Dodd Finnert at The Steam Pools in Feralas

english.completed: Return to Assistant Resort Director Dodd Finnert at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: No Child of Mine
text.objectives: Harness 5 Children.
text.description: The only thing I detest more than sunshine and rainbows are children. And our omnipresent guests are always bringing their brats along on their so-called family vacations! The pests run around, make loud noises, and are forever tainting my resort with their fun.$B$B<Assistant Resort Director Finnert makes a look of disgust.>$B$BTake this certified Child Safety Harness and bring them back to the child play area. They shouldn't be running free around these grounds!
text.completed: Return to Assistant Resort Director Dodd Finnert at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Fit for a King
text.objectives: Collect 6 King Crawler legs
text.description: Now that the resort's back up and running, I've got a lot of mouths to feed and no time to waste! I'm going to make crab risotto and we're running low on meat. Bring me back some crab meat from the crawlers around the pools.

text.title: Chef's Challenge: Steelback
text.objectives: Bring back Steelback's Claw
text.description: Those king crawlers you killed earlier are nothing compared to the ultimate crustacean - Steelback. He lives up to his name, but I have faith in you, $n. Now prove that you're a worthy student and bring me his claw!
text.completed: Return to Gordon Tramsay at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Chef's Challenge: Faewing
text.objectives: Bring back Faewing's Horn
text.description: I've heard of an enormous moth that inhabits the lake shore to the west. Moth horn is an incredible delicacy, and I'm planning to use it for an unforgettable dish. Go hunt down Faewing and bring me back its horn.
text.completed: Return to Gordon Tramsay at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Chef's Challenge: Grumpfin
text.objectives: Bring back Grumpfin's Eye
text.description: There's a fish here that's eluded me for years. He lives at the bottom of the largest lake, and we've named him Grumpfin for his personality. I think it's time to catch him and cook him! Bring him to me, but be careful - he's an ornery old devil.
text.completed: Return to Gordon Tramsay at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Out of Gas
text.objectives: Use the Goblin Gas Tank to siphon oil from 8 dead Oil Slimes
text.description: So you need a boat, eh? Well my sweetheart here can take you across the lake, but the Lucky Bucket's plum lucked out of gas!$B$BListen, there are some Oil Slimes in the mountains to the south. If you can go fill up my gas tank, we'll have enough juice for a nice boat ride. Whaddaya say?
text.completed: Return to Trip Hullbolt at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: 幼崽的渴望
text.objectives: 从冬泉谷的各种碎齿熊身上收集到6块碎齿熊肉，把它们喂给你的冬泉豹幼崽。
text.description: 你的冬泉豹幼崽看着你，不停地舔着舌头。这只小猫一定是饿了。为它准备一顿好饭正是你的责任。$B$B雷沃·霜翼曾经说过，他总是会在手边准备一些碎齿熊肉，好喂他的霜刃豹幼崽。也许你的幼崽同样会喜欢新鲜的碎齿熊肉。你在冬泉谷各处都能找到各种碎齿熊。
text.completion: Your Winterspring cub looks happy, satisfied, and ready to curl up for a nap.
text.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

english.title: A Cub's Cravings
english.objectives: Gather 6 pieces of Shardtooth Meat from any of the Shardtooth bears in Winterspring and feed them to your Winterspring Cub.
english.description: Your Winterspring cub looks at you and licks its lips. The little cat must be hungry and it's up to you to find a suitable meal for your charge.$B$BRivern Frostwind mentioned keeping some shardtooth bear meat on hand for feeding his frostsaber cubs. Perhaps your cub would enjoy some fresh shardtooth meat of its own. Various kinds of shardtooth bears can be found all over Winterspring.
english.completion: Your Winterspring cub looks happy, satisfied, and ready to curl up for a nap.
english.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

text.title: “借”自冬泉
text.objectives: 从冬泉谷的两处冬泉熊怪营地中取得6块熏肉，把它们喂给你的冬泉豹幼崽。
text.description: 你的幼崽期待地看着你。它想要什么？$B$B这只小猫舔着嘴唇。一定是又到它的吃饭时间了！作为它的代理$G父亲:母亲;，你有责任为它提供肉食，直到它能够自己狩猎。$B$B不过你也可以让其他人完成狩猎工作。冬泉谷的两座冬泉熊怪营地里，冬泉熊怪们通常都会在手边准备许多熏肉。当然，他们不会在乎少几块肉。而你的幼崽也可以尝试一下新食物。
text.completion: Your cub looks satisfied for now.
text.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

english.title: 'Borrowing' From the Winterfall
english.objectives: Obtain 6 pieces of Smoked Meat from either Winterfall furbolg camp in Winterspring and feed them to your Winterspring Cub.
english.description: Your cub looks at you expectantly. What could it want now?$B$BThe little cat licks its lips. It must be meal time again! As the cub's surrogate $gfather:mother; you're responsible for providing meat until it can hunt on its own.$B$BBut what if you let someone else do the hunting? The Winterfall furbolg of Winterspring usually have a lot of smoked meat on hand in both of their camps. Surely, they wouldn't miss a few pieces and your cub would get to try something new.
english.completion: Your cub looks satisfied for now.
english.completed: Talk to your Winterspring Cub.

text.title: 臭气弹轰炸！
text.objectives: 与格尔楚德·芬劳交谈，然后乘坐扫帚，向幽暗城投掷臭气弹。
text.description: 你好，$c！祝你万圣节快乐。呸，别再说这些废话了……让我们谈正事吧。你一定知道幽暗城吧。他们借助巫婆的邪恶魔法，对我们的城市发动了卑鄙的攻击。有人会说，不要理会幼稚的部落。可要我说，我们得给它们点颜色瞧瞧！$b$b去跟我的姐妹格尔楚德谈谈，她会送你骑上我们的扫帚，把臭气弹扔进幽暗城。
text.completion: That will show those foolish crones who the strongest is.$B$BTake these treats and treat yourself to something nice, $c.
text.completed: Return to Gretchen Fenlow outside of Stormwind.

english.title: Stink Bombs Away!
english.objectives: Speak to Gertrude Fenlow to gain access to a broom, then drop stink bombs in the Undercity.
english.description: Greetings, $c!  I hope Hallow's End is treating you well.  Bah, enough of the small talk... Let's get down to business.  Undercity.  They have employed Hags and foul magic to launch petty attacks on our town.  Some may say, ignore the childish Horde.  I say, let's show them!$b$bSpeak to my sister, Gertrude, and she will send you on your way to toss some stink bombs in Undercity.
english.completion: That will show those foolish crones who the strongest is.$B$BTake these treats and treat yourself to something nice, $c.
english.completed: Return to Gretchen Fenlow outside of Stormwind.

text.title: Float My Boat
text.objectives: Take a ride around the lake on Trip's boat
text.description: We're all set! Just hop on the boat and we'll get going!
text.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

english.title: Float My Boat
english.objectives: Take a ride around the lake on Trip's boat
english.description: We're all set! Just hop on the boat and we'll get going!
english.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Fruit Round-Up
text.objectives: Collect 8 coconuts
text.description: You're Lasha's little helper, aren't you? Well she said something about a special errand, and she asked me to whip up some special drinks for our guests. Apparently, there are some new brews that are all the rage in Stormwind and Orgrimmar, but I'm missing a major ingredient - coconut! Luckily, they grow in the palm trees right around the camp. Fly up there now and get some for me, will you?
text.completed: Return to Chef Gordon Tramsay at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Firebeak
text.objectives: Fight Firebeak and weaken him
text.description: Okay $n, that's it. I'm not surprised in the slightest that Dodd was behind this. I never liked him, or his stupid moustache! It's time to FIGHT BACK!$B$BIn the mountains to the east lives a powerful creature known as Firebeak. He is the key to the Twilight Cultists' destruction.$B$BFight the beast and show him that you're its master. When he is weakened, ride him down the pools to rain destruction upon our enemies!

text.title: Roc Collection
text.objectives: Gather12 Roc Guts
text.description: Okay, now we're in a real crisis, and you know what? I'm MAD! No one tries to destroy MY resort! Especially not that little worm Dodd Finnert. I've always disliked him, especially his stupid moustache!!!$B$BListen $n, we're going to try one last, crazy plan that should get rid of the Twilight cultists once and for all. The greater rocs that live in the mountains to the east have enormously fireproof qualities. We're going to fashion a fireproof bridle out of their guts. 12 should do it.

text.title: At Your Service
text.objectives: Serve 6 Resort Guests and gather 4 Twilight Cultist clues
text.description: Now that you've had a chance to blend in, I need you to do go undercover among the guests. We've pinpointed our recent troubles on a surviving branch of the Twilight's Hammer, and we think some of guests might be working for them.$B$BTake these drinks and see if you can gather up any clues about the Cultists posing as guests. Some of the customers may need their tongues loosened, so make sure you're serving them the right kind of drink.
text.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: Finding the Cultist
text.objectives: Question Resort Guests to find the Twilight Evidence
text.description: It sounds like we have a member of the Twilight's Hammer in our presence.$B$B$n, it's up to you to expose the spy. Question the Resort Guests and accuse anyone who matches the description of a Twilight Cultist!$B$BRemember, the suspect is:$B$BTALL$bRUDE$BWEARING THE COLOR RED$B$BThis isn't a task for the weak - if the culprit gives you any trouble, you may have to beat the information out of them.

text.title: We Need a Boat
text.objectives: Speak to Trip Hullbolt
text.description: It all makes sense now! Initial architectural surveys of this area revealed quite an energetic anomaly. It's the same energy that powers these superheated mineral pools.$B$BJudging from the evidence, the Twilight's Hammer is going to harness the energy to open a portal to the elemental plane of water! If that happens, our whole venture - and a lot of lives of course - is sunk.$B$B$n, you need to investigate immediately! Go talk to Trip Hullbolt. He has a boat that can take you to the spot on the map.
text.completed: Speak to Trip Hullbolt

text.title: 异世界之物
text.objectives: 摧毁6只暮光图腾
text.description: 我们这里的麻烦真是无穷无尽，$N！食物和用水供给不断遭到破坏。而现在，又出了这种事！火灾这种事情实在是难以预料。我们当然不想让这种事发生在这里！$B$B现在最大的问题是，想要除掉我们的那个恶棍在这里布置了许多图腾。如果我们摧毁了这些图腾，那些该死的喷火魔鬼就不会持续不断地在这里出现了。$B$B摧毁你看到的所有图腾，不要等到我们被彻底毁灭的时候！
text.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

english.title: Out of This World
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Twilight Totems
english.description: We've had no end of trouble here, $n! Sabotaged food shipments, tampered water supply, and now this! You can't send a more unsubtle message than fire. We clearly aren't wanted here!$B$BBut first things first. Whoever is trying to get rid of us has summoned vile totems all around the grounds. If we destroy those totems, those blasted Flamekin demons will stop appearing.$B$BDestroy any totems that you see before we're overrun!
english.completed: Return to Lasha Gearwheel at The Steam Pools in Feralas

text.title: 好消息……和坏消息
text.objectives: 与艾森娜林地的麦托克劳聊聊。
text.description: <黑角使用索恩博尔的黑暗精华挣脱了他的束缚。但至少炼狱火海看起来是消退了。>$B$B<麦托克劳一定想知道这里到底发生了些什么事情。她正在艾森娜林地等着你。>
text.completion: What? Blackhorn helped you combat the inferno but escaped in the process? That crafty weasel!$B$BIt's not your fault, $n. He'd probably been plotting this the moment he saw the flames begin creeping up the mountain. We'll have to deal with him later.
text.completed: 去找海加尔山艾森娜林地的麦托克劳。

english.title: Good News... and Bad News
english.objectives: Talk to Matoclaw at the Grove of Aessina in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <Blackhorn used the power of Thol'embaar's remains to slip his bonds. But at least the inferno seems to be subsiding.>$B$B<Matoclaw will want to know what happened here. She's waiting for you back at the Grove of Aessina.>
english.completion: What? Blackhorn helped you combat the inferno but escaped in the process? That crafty weasel!$B$BIt's not your fault, $n. He'd probably been plotting this the moment he saw the flames begin creeping up the mountain. We'll have to deal with him later.
english.completed: Talk to Matoclaw at the Grove of Aessina in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 药水大师
text.objectives: 给任意主城的炼金训练师带去大量药水。
text.description: 药水，药水，药水。你问我能不能教你药水学的知识？！$b$b你必须给我带几瓶自己制作的药水来，这样我才能知道你是否做好了准备。$b$b记住，$n，你只能学一项专精，所以如果你完成了药水专精的训练，那么就不能再学习药剂和转化专精了。
text.progress: Have you the potions?
text.completion: Excellent!
text.completed: Return to Linzy Blackbolt at Ironwall Dam in Icecrown.

english.title: Elixir Specialist
english.progress: Have you the potions?
english.completion: Excellent!
english.completed: Return to Linzy Blackbolt at Ironwall Dam in Icecrown.

text.title: Potion Specialist
text.completed: Return to Linzy Blackbolt at Ironwall Dam in Icecrown.

english.title: Potion Specialist

text.title: 暮光困境
text.objectives: Kill 10 Twilight Cultists

english.title: Twilight Plight
english.objectives: Kill 10 Twilight Cultists

text.title: 赶往暴风城！
text.completion: Veterans of Northrend, King Wrynn and the Alliance need your help! Stormwind and the Alliance face unprecedented threats from Deathwing and his Twilight's Hammer minions!$B$BPlease find the enclosed hearthstone and use it to transport yourself to Stormwind. The crown has arranged lodging for all returning heroes at the The Golden Keg in the Dwarven District.

english.title: Make Haste to Stormwind!
english.completion: Veterans of Northrend, King Wrynn and the Alliance need your help! Stormwind and the Alliance face unprecedented threats from Deathwing and his Twilight's Hammer minions!$B$BPlease find the enclosed hearthstone and use it to transport yourself to Stormwind. The crown has arranged lodging for all returning heroes at the The Golden Keg in the Dwarven District.

text.title: Last Resort, Literally
text.objectives: Kill Ahti
text.description: We've managed to stop the assault temporarily, leaving Dodd vulnerable.$B$BHowever, in all the chaos, he was able to summon Ahti, a powerful elemental lord, across the rift and into our world. With Ahti's allegiance, the Twilight's Hammer will pour into the nearby regions, killing thousands of innocents.$B$BThis is bigger than me or this resort. We must stand against them here and now. I ask of you one last task - kill Ahti and save us all.

english.title: Last Resort, Literally
english.objectives: Kill Ahti
english.description: We've managed to stop the assault temporarily, leaving Dodd vulnerable.$B$BHowever, in all the chaos, he was able to summon Ahti, a powerful elemental lord, across the rift and into our world. With Ahti's allegiance, the Twilight's Hammer will pour into the nearby regions, killing thousands of innocents.$B$BThis is bigger than me or this resort. We must stand against them here and now. I ask of you one last task - kill Ahti and save us all.

text.title: 赶往奥格瑞玛！
text.completion: Veterans of Northrend, Warchief Garrosh commands you to return to Orgrimmar at once! You will be the blade the Horde wields against Deathwing and his Twilight's Hammer minions.$B$BUse the attached hearthstone to transport yourself to Orgrimmar. Our allies await your return, hero.

english.title: Make Haste to Orgrimmar!
english.completion: Veterans of Northrend, Warchief Garrosh commands you to return to Orgrimmar at once! You will be the blade the Horde wields against Deathwing and his Twilight's Hammer minions.$B$BUse the attached hearthstone to transport yourself to Orgrimmar. Our allies await your return, hero.

text.title: 庆祝的季节
text.objectives: 与暴风城大门外的丰收女巫塞莱斯廷交谈。
text.description: 见到你真高兴，$c！$B$B万圣节是欢庆和反思的时刻，但许多人已经忘记了它的由来。许多节日活动，例如稻草人仪式，已经湮没在了历史的长河中……直到吉尔尼斯人重返联盟。$B$B到暴风城门外去，和丰收女巫塞莱斯廷谈谈。她会向你介绍更多关于稻草人仪式的知识。
text.completion: The Wickerman ceremony is a time honored tradition.  It is good to see the Alliance celebrating it once again.

english.title: A Season for Celebration
english.objectives: Speak with Celestine of the Harvest just outside the gates of Stormwind.
english.description: Merry met, $c!$B$BHallow's End is a time for celebration and reflection, though many of us have forgotten why. Indeed some aspects of the festival, like the Wickerman, have been lost to time... until now, with the return of the Gilneans to the Alliance fold.$B$BTravel outside the gates of Stormwind and speak to Celestine of the Harvest.  She can tell you more about the Wickerman ceremony.
english.completion: The Wickerman ceremony is a time honored tradition.  It is good to see the Alliance celebrating it once again.

text.title: 收获的时刻
text.objectives: 使用稻草人前面的篝火。
text.description: 你好，$c。你面前的稻草人代表着“自我”。而烧尽它的火焰是净化之火。$b$b根据传统，我们需要将沉重的负担付之一炬。我们要在冬季来临时卸下肩头的重担，这是收获安宁与静谧的时刻。加入我们传统的庆典吧，$c。$b$b从身旁的篝火堆里抽出一根燃烧的树枝，把它掷向稻草人吧。
text.completion: Do not let your burdens trouble you any longer.  Any time you are feeling burdened, remember the Wickerman.
text.completed: Return to Celestine of the Harvest in front of Stormwind.

english.title: A Time to Gain
english.objectives: Use the bonfire in front of the Wickerman.
english.description: Greetings, $c.  The Wickerman you see before you symbolizes self.  The flames that burn it are a cleansing fire.$b$bTradition states that we take our burdens and give them to the fires.  We let go of our burdens as we approach the winter season and we gain clarity and peace.  Join us in our tradition, $c.$b$bTake a branch from the nearby bonfire and hurl it at the Wickerman.
english.completion: Do not let your burdens trouble you any longer.  Any time you are feeling burdened, remember the Wickerman.
english.completed: Return to Celestine of the Harvest in front of Stormwind.

text.title: 凯文的测试任务
text.objectives: Just complete it.
text.description: A testing quest

english.title: Kevin's Test Quest
english.objectives: Just complete it.
english.description: A testing quest

text.title: What Hath Dodd Wrought
text.objectives: Kill 50 Seething Water Elementals and 20 Twilight Summoners
text.description: I can't believe it! You actually bested Firebeak! Jump onto his back, fly down to the lake, and blast the invaders out of the water! Kill every last one of them!

english.title: What Hath Dodd Wrought
english.objectives: Kill 50 Seething Water Elementals and 20 Twilight Summoners
english.description: I can't believe it! You actually bested Firebeak! Jump onto his back, fly down to the lake, and blast the invaders out of the water! Kill every last one of them!

text.title: 击退敌人！
text.objectives: 杀死6只黑石战狼。
text.description: 又一名联盟的新兵？我是治安官玛克布莱德，这支驻防部队的指挥官。你们种族的人在这儿可不常见，$r，但你们肯定能帮上我们的忙。$B$B你来得正是时候，黑石兽人从山脉断口处潜入了北郡。驻防部队的士兵们正在竭力奋战，一次次地击退敌人的进攻，但是我担心他们支持不了多久了。$B$B前往西北方的森林，杀死入侵的黑石战狼！帮帮我们吧！
text.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
text.completion: 你為我們爭取了一些時間，$n，但我們還有更大的問題要去解決。
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 黑石战狼是凶猛的掠食者。

english.title: Beating Them Back!
english.objectives: Kill 6 Blackrock Battle Worgs.
english.description: Another Alliance recruit, eh? I'm Marshal McBride, commander of this garrison. We don't see many of your kind here, $r, but we could sure use the help.$B$BYou've arrived just in time. The Blackrock orcs have managed to sneak into Northshire through a break in the mountain. My soldiers are doing the best that they can to push them back, but I fear they will be overwhelmed soon.$B$BHead northwest into the forest and kill the attacking Blackrock worgs! Help my soldiers!
english.progress: Have you beaten back the Blackrock battle worgs?
english.completion: You've bought us a little time, $n, but we've got even bigger problems to deal with now.
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a Blackrock Battle Worg.

text.title: 狮入羊口
text.objectives: 消灭8名黑石间谍。
text.description: 入侵的兽人可不傻。他们密切关注着我们的动向，想要抓住有利的时机发起进攻。$B$B黑石间谍就躲藏在西北方的森林里。他们利用望远镜偷窥我们的一举一动，耐心地等待着。我要你除掉他们！$B$B杀死黑石间谍！让这帮家伙明白，我们知道他们在打什么如意算盘，而且我们做好了准备！
text.progress: 殺死那些間諜!
text.completion: 做得好，$n。看來你會是本地駐軍一個很大的助力。到你訓練的時候了!
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 这是一名男性黑石间谍。黑石间谍中也不乏女性成员。

english.title: Lions for Lambs
english.objectives: Kill 8 Blackrock Spies.
english.description: The invading orcs aren't fools. They are sizing us up, making sure that when they attack it will be to their advantage.$B$BIn the forest, to the northwest, are Blackrock spies. They peer at us through spyglasses, watching our every move - waiting. I want you take the fight to them!$B$BKill the Blackrock spies! We must show them that we know they are watching us and that we are prepared!
english.progress: Kill the spies!
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. You've turned out to be quite an asset to this garrison.$B$BFeel free to speak with any of our trainers within and around the abbey if you need to sharpen any of your combat skills.$B$BWhen you're ready, I have another assignment for you...
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride at Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a male Blackrock orc spy. There are females amongst them as well.

text.title: 加入战斗！
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院后的维里副队长报到。
text.description: 我收到了一条来自维里副队长的紧急消息。原来黑石兽人雇佣了地精刺客。他们在修道院后面偷袭我们的军队。维里让我派一名英雄去帮他。就是你了，$n！$B$B去修道院以北的指挥营帐找维里副队长吧。出发！
text.completion: 是真的，我們中埋伏了。我不敢冒著失去更多士兵的風險派兵出去。我需要一名自願者，願意冒生命危險的人!
text.giverWindow: 你可以在北郡修道院后的指挥营帐找到维里副队长。

english.title: Join the Battle!
english.objectives: Report to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: I have here an urgent message from Sergeant Willem. Turns out that the Blackrock orcs have hired goblin assassins. They ambushed our battalion behind the abbey. Willem has asked me to send him a hero. You have to go help them, $n!$B$BFind Sergeant Willem north of the abbey at the command tent. Go!
english.completion: It's true, we were ambushed. I don't dare send any more soldiers out there and risk losing them too. I need a volunteer. Someone willing to risk their life!
english.giverWindow: Sergeant Willem can be found at the command tent behind Northshire Abbey.

text.title: 他们派来了刺客
text.objectives: 杀死8名地精刺客。
text.description: 你见过地精吗，$n？这些邪恶的小怪物只喜欢两件东西：金币和他们自己。$B$B黑石兽人招募了一批地精刺客，屠杀我们的士兵。他们就潜伏在北面的草丛中，肉眼很难察觉。$B$B我要你去那里，杀死你撞见的所有地精。得给他们上一课，联盟不是好惹的！
text.progress: 殺死哥布林暗殺者!
text.completion: 那會給那些怪物上一課!下次他們承接獸人的傭兵任務前可要好好想清楚。
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: 是地精刺客。邪恶的小怪物！

english.title: They Sent Assassins
english.objectives: Kill 8 Goblin Assassins.
english.description: Have you ever seen a goblin, $n? They're wretched little green-skinned monsters that love only two things: gold and themselves.$B$BThe Blackrock orcs have enlisted the aid of goblin assassins to kill our soldiers. If you look to the field in the north you can barely make out their silhouettes, sneaking about in the grass.$B$BI need you to head out there and kill every goblin that you see. They need to learn that nobody messes with the Alliance!
english.progress: Kill the goblin assassins!
english.completion: That will teach those monsters! They'll think twice before taking another mercenary job for orcs.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Willem behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: This is a goblin assassin. Nasty little monster!

text.title: 别畏惧邪恶
text.objectives: 营救4名受伤的暴风城士兵。
text.description: 你拥抱过圣光吗，$g兄弟:姐妹;？是圣光拯救了我们！是圣光让我有能力治疗这些饱受战火摧残的士兵！如今，圣光也将赋予你踏进北面的战区，营救我们倒下的兄弟的能力和勇气！$B$B带着这本祷言之书，对受伤的士兵施放圣光的治疗之触。
text.progress: 解救我們的士兵!
text.completion: 我想你現在了解了聖光的力量。聖光給予希望，$g兄弟:姊妹;，而聖光驅散黑暗!讚美聖光!
text.completed: Return to Brother Paxton behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Fear No Evil
english.objectives: Revive 4 Injured Stormwind Soldiers.
english.description: Have you embraced the Holy Light yet, $g brother:sister;? It is through the Holy Light that we are saved! It is through the Holy Light that I am able to heal these overly demanding soldiers! And it is through the Holy Light that you will be able to venture out into the field to the north and rescue our fallen brothers!$B$BTake this prayer book with you into the field and cast the Light's healing touch on the injured.
english.progress: Rescue our soldiers!
english.completion: I think you now understand the power of the Light. The Light giveth hope, brother and the Light taketh from the darkness! BLESSED BE THE LIGHT!
english.completed: Return to Brother Paxton behind Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 后方已经安全
text.objectives: 向艾尔文森林北郡修道院前的治安官玛克布莱德报到。
text.description: 干得好，$n！后面已经安全。剩下的散兵就交给我们来对付吧。我要你返回南面的北郡修道院前，向治安官玛克布莱德复命，告诉他滋事的地精已经被清理了。$B$B再见，$c。
text.completion: 藉由你的幫助，我們成功鞏固了北郡北方和西方的區域。在我們東邊還是有數量龐大的黑石獸人，而他們正開始焚燒森林!

english.title: The Rear is Clear
english.objectives: Report to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: Excellent work, $n! The rear is now officially clear. We'll take care of the stragglers. I want you to go back to Marshal McBride, standing in front of Northshire Abbey, south of here, and let him know that the goblin situation is under control.$B$BFarewell, $c.
english.completion: With your help we have managed to secure the northern and western sectors of Northshire. We still have a rather large contingency of Blackrock orcs to the east and they've begun burning down the forest!

text.title: 经典旧世随机 35-39级 （第一次）
竞争再竞争
text.objectives: 从风险投资公司苦工、风险投资公司雇佣兵和风险投资公司雇工身上收集到6份斯布特瓦夫的设计图。
text.description: 我只是个小不点，一心想建立起我独立的事业，为我的艾泽拉斯梦而努力，你明白吗？$B$B但我的商店刚开张，邻门的风险投资公司就想要排挤我出局。他们不断地给我寄来充满威胁的信件。信里全都是“停止”，“终止”这样的字眼。$B$B最糟糕的是，我最新仪器的设计图丢失了。我很清楚，一定是那个公司的小偷偷走了它们！赶快去淤泥沼泽，撂倒几个风险投资公司的雇员。他们一定藏着我们的设计图！
text.progress: I can't believe they would stoop so low! Did you get my blueprints back?
text.completion: Thanks for recovering my blueprints. Now my work on the Silver Bullet X-831 can continue.
text.completed: Return to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.

english.title: Competition Schmompetition
english.objectives: Recover 6 of Sputtervalve's Blueprints from Venture Co. Drudgers, Mercenaries, or Peons.
english.description: I'm just a little guy, trying to set up my own independent business. Working hard toward the Azerothian dream, ya know?$B$BWell soon as I set up shop, the Venture Co. next door decided they wanted me out. They've been harrassing me with threatening letters, using words like 'cease' and 'desist.' $B$BWorst of all, the schematics for my newest machine are missing, and I know those corporate pilferers stole them! Go to the Sludge Fen and knock out some of their employees. I know they're hiding my blueprints!
english.progress: I can't believe they would stoop so low! Did you get my blueprints back?
english.completion: Thanks for recovering my blueprints. Now my work on the Silver Bullet X-831 can continue.
english.completed: Return to Sputtervalve at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 调查泥巴
text.objectives: 在淤泥沼泽调查5个沾泥的脚印。
text.description: 嗨，$n，有没有看到这个脚印？昨晚我们在营地各处都发现了这种脚印！没有任何东西丢失，但我们所有的物品……都被翻检过了。这种沾有泥巴的足迹一直通向淤泥沼泽。$B$B有什么人正在偷偷摸摸地探查这里。我一点也不喜欢这种事。你能不能到西边的淤泥沼泽去，在那里进行调查？去那里找找这种足迹吧！
text.completion: You look around and notice the lake is covered in slick oil. This once beautiful oasis has been ravaged. You feel a deep sense of foreboding.

english.title: Sludge Investigation
english.objectives: Investigate 5 Muddy Tracks at the Sludge Fen.
english.description: Hey $n, do you see this footprint? We found them all over the camp last night! Nothing's missing, but all our belongings have been...examined. The muddy trails lead back toward the Sludge Fen.$B$BSomeone's been sniffing around, and I don't like it one bit. Can you go west to the Sludge Fen and investigate? See if you can find any more tracks just like this one!
english.completion: You look around and notice the lake is covered in slick oil. This once beautiful oasis has been ravaged. You feel a deep sense of foreboding.

text.title: 消灭土狼
text.objectives: 消灭6头乱齿土狼。
text.description: 嗨，$n，我们这里遇到了一个真正的麻烦。在西边的淤泥沼泽盘踞了大量土狼。它们正在对我们造成越来越多大损害。$B$B如果我再听上一晚它们的嚎叫，我一定会发疯的！那边的维尔隆说土狼甚至叼走了他的一只猪。我们不能容忍这种情况继续下去了。$B$B你能不能去削减一下那些土狼的数量？到西边去，你就能看到那些在光天化日之下横行无忌的土狼了。
text.completion: Good riddance! Those filthy pests are more trouble than they're worth.
text.completed: Return to Nozzlepot at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.

english.title: Hyena Extermination
english.objectives: Kill 6 Hecklefang Hyenas.
english.description: Hey $n, we've got a real problem here. There's an overpopulation of hyenas just west of the Sludge Fen, and they're starting to become a menace.$B$BIf I have to listen to them caterwauling one more night, I just might go crazy! Vernon over there says the hyenas might even have made off with one of his stabled pigs. We can't have that happening.$B$BCan you go thin out the hyena numbers? You'll find them parading in broad daylight to the west.
english.completion: Good riddance! Those filthy pests are more trouble than they're worth.
english.completed: Return to Nozzlepot at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 泥巴怪兽！
text.objectives: 调查淤泥兽的巢穴，消灭从里面出来的一切东西。
text.description: 藏在淤泥沼泽的东西应该不是人类。从它的足迹判断，它一定还非常危险。$B$B你决定跟踪这种足迹直到湖底，寻找那头怪兽的巢穴。
text.completion: You saw sludge being dumped straight into the lake? I wouldn't be surprised if the Sludge Beast were a product of the Venture Co.'s carelessness.
text.completed: Return to Nozzlepot at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.

english.title: Sludge Beast!
english.objectives: Investigate the Sludge Beast's resting place and kill whatever comes out.
english.description: Whatever is lurking around the Sludge Fen, it doesn't appear to be human. Judging from the remains around its tracks, it's also dangerous.$B$BYou decide to follow the tracks down to the bottom of the lake and look for the creature's resting place.
english.completion: You saw sludge being dumped straight into the lake? I wouldn't be surprised if the Sludge Beast were a product of the Venture Co.'s carelessness.
english.completed: Return to Nozzlepot at Nozzlepot's Outpost in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 火刃的威胁
text.objectives: 在西南方的农场里消灭8名火刃氏族的成员。
text.description: 当我们专心应付眼前的劫难时，更需要有人帮我们提防从背后偷袭的敌人。我们的领袖正全力以赴地与死亡之翼作战，而火刃氏族却在阴谋策划颠覆我们的行动。$B$B就在我们谈话时，他们已经开始在西南方的农场集结兵员和战备物资了。我可不打算死在燃烧军团的手里。所以我们必须把局势掌握在自己的手中。$B$B$n，你能否帮助我抵御那些敌人？去消灭那些恶棍吧。再晚可能就来不及了。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. This old orc will sleep more safely at night.
text.completed: Return to Brogor at Wenikee Boltbucket's camp in the Northern Barrens.

english.title: A Burning Threat
english.objectives: Kill 8 members of the Burning Blade at the farm to the southwest.
english.description: While we cast our eyes toward the cataclysm, who watches our backs? While our leaders take up arms against Deathwing, the Burning Blade plots our downfall.$B$BEven as we speak, they are gathering recruits and supplies at the farm to the southwest. I care not to meet death at the hands of the Burning Legion. It's time we take matters into our own hands.$B$B$n, will you help me keep the vigil? Go and slaughter their ranks before it's too late.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. This old orc will sleep more safely at night.
english.completed: Return to Brogor at Wenikee Boltbucket's camp in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 告知长者
text.objectives: 前往一座主城，同那里的大地之环长者交谈。
text.description: 这个消息必须尽快让大地之环的成员全都知道。 我还不知道该如何去做，不过派遣你执行这一任务的长者应该会有方案。请回去见长者，确认下一个行动步骤。我们一定要采取行动！
text.completion: This is grave news indeed. We must do everything in our power to stop this war from coming to pass.

english.title: Inform the Elder
english.objectives: Travel to a capital city and speak to the Earthen Ring Elder.
english.description: This information must be spread to the entirety of the Earthen Ring. I'm not certain how to proceed, but the elder who set you on this task in the first place may. Please, return to the elder and seek the next course of action - we must do something!
english.completion: This is grave news indeed. We must do everything in our power to stop this war from coming to pass.

text.title: 地怒裂口游览记
text.objectives: 前往西部荒野的哨兵岭，骑上租赁摩托车，带着你的孤儿游览地怒裂口。
text.description: 有个朋友告诉我，西部荒野有个蒸汽坦克技师在向游客出租摩托车。我的朋友已经骑过一次了！$B$B我见过有人骑着摩托车经过孤儿院。它们绝对是这个世界上跑得最快的家伙！而且还会发出很大很大的噪音。我真想坐上去试一试！$B$B我们能不能到西部荒野的哨兵岭去，坐一次摩托车？求求你，我一定好好听话。而且我们还能看看那个在世界改变之后出现在地面上的大洞呢！
text.completion: That was the best! I want to come back and do this again next year. When I grow up, I'm going to have a chopper, except I'm gonna make it myself, and take all my friends for a ride!
text.end: 地怒裂口的摩托车之旅
text.completed: 去找你的人类孤儿。

english.title: Cruisin' the Chasm
english.objectives: Travel to Sentinel Hill in Westfall and climb aboard a Rental Chopper to tour the Raging Chasm with your orphan.
english.description: One of my friends says that a steam tank mechanic in Westfall lets visitors use his choppers. My friend even got to ride one!$B$BI've seen people ride by the orphanage in choppers. They're real loud and just about the fastest thing I've ever seen! I want to try one out!$B$BCould we go to Sentinel Hill in Westfall and ride one of those choppers? Please? I promise to behave myself and we could see the crazy giant hole left when the world changed!
english.completion: That was the best! I want to come back and do this again next year. When I grow up, I'm going to have a chopper, except I'm gonna make it myself, and take all my friends for a ride!
english.end: Chopper Tour of the Raging Chasm
english.completed: Return to your Human Orphan.

text.title: 飞速回家
text.objectives: 驾驶银子弹X-831。
text.description: 看样子，你在这里的工作已经完成了，$c。你最好回到十字路口去。$B$B你的运气很不错，我的银子弹X-831原型机已经完成了，正准备进行测试。能不能最后帮我个忙？完成她的试运行？$B$B我的一名助手会陪同你进行这一工作。那个最最甜美的小座驾就等在我身后的平台上。准备好了就跳上去吧。
text.completion: I thought you were a goner. Glad to see you're still in one piece.
text.completed: Speak to Darsok Swiftdagger in the Northern Barrens.

english.title: The Short Way Home
english.objectives: Take a ride on the Silver Bullet X-831.
english.description: Looks like your work here is done, $c. You'd better head back to the Crossroads.$B$BLuckily for you, my Silver Bullet X-831 prototype is finished, and she's ready for a test drive. Whaddaya say you do me one last favor and take her for a little spin?$B$BOne of my assistants will accompany you. Your sweet, sweet ride is waiting on the platform behind me. Just hop on when you're ready.
english.completion: I thought you were a goner. Glad to see you're still in one piece.
english.completed: Speak to Darsok Swiftdagger in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 向索克报告
text.objectives: 向北贫瘠之地，十字路口的索克报告。
text.description: 现在，这里的威胁已经被消除了。你应该回到十字路口去。索克很想和你谈谈。$B$B再见，朋友。
text.completion: Hello $n. I have heard of your deeds from Darsok. You are a valuable $C of the Horde, indeed.
text.completed: 向北贫瘠之地，十字路口的索克报告。

english.title: Report to Thork
english.objectives: Report to Thork at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens.
english.description: Now that the threat here has been stilled, you should return to the Crossroads. Thork would like to speak to you.$B$BFarewell, friend.
english.completion: Hello $n. I have heard of your deeds from Darsok. You are a valuable $C of the Horde, indeed.
english.completed: Report to Thork at the Crossroads in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 莫尔杉商队启动
text.objectives: 同罗克·维普杉克交谈，然后随同莫尔杉商队向北进发。
text.description: Rocco Whipshank waits for you at the road north out of the Crossroads. Let him know you are ready to accompany the caravan.
text.completed: Speak to Rocco Whipshank and ride north with the Mor'shan Caravan.

english.title: Mor'shan Caravan Pick-Up
english.objectives: Speak to Rocco Whipshank and ride north with the Mor'shan Caravan.
english.description: Rocco Whipshank waits for you at the road north out of the Crossroads. Let him know you are ready to accompany the caravan.
english.completed: Speak to Rocco Whipshank and ride north with the Mor'shan Caravan.
