text.title: 布温巴之魂
text.objectives: 警告荆棘谷的人们，并找到另一名暗矛大使。
text.description: 对暗矛巨魔来说，现在真是困难的时期。赞达拉部族正在集结所有巨魔部落，想要收回所有他们失去的领土。$b$b我们想警告尽可能多的人，但恐怕已经太晚了。$b$b已经有另一个暗矛战士去荆棘谷警告他们了，但在荆棘谷单独出行并不安全。$b$b帮助我找到他，并警告荆棘谷的人们，巨魔部落即将重新崛起。$b$b我会让我的灵魂跟随你，如此一来，你赶到荆棘谷的时候，我将可以帮助你。
text.progress: Dis won't be no easy task, $n.
text.completion: Dere ya have it, $n.  It look like we gonna lead an assault on da Gurubashi in Zul'Gurub.$B$BDese be dire times for us Darkspear.  But dey be even more dire for da Zandalar.  Dey goin' too far.$B$BYa been good to Bwemba, hopefully ya gonna continue to help out all of Stranglethorn.$B$BSpirits be wit' ya, $n.

english.title: Bwemba's Spirit
english.objectives: Warn the people of Stranglethorn and find the other Darkspear emissary.
english.description: Dese be troublin' times for us Darkspear.  Da Zandalar be reuniting all da troll clans an' plan to take back da lands dey lost.$b$bWe tryin' to warn all dat we can.  But it might be too late.$b$bAnother Darkspear gone down to Stranglethorn to warn da people.  But it ain't safe to travel alone in Stranglethorn.$b$bHelp me find him and make sure da people in Stranglethorn are warned of da rise of da troll tribes.$b$bI gonna bind my spirit wit' ya.  When ya get to Stranglethorn, I be able to aid ya.
english.progress: Dis won't be no easy task, $n.
english.completion: Dere ya have it, $n.  It look like we gonna lead an assault on da Gurubashi in Zul'Gurub.$B$BDese be dire times for us Darkspear.  But dey be even more dire for da Zandalar.  Dey goin' too far.$B$BYa been good to Bwemba, hopefully ya gonna continue to help out all of Stranglethorn.$B$BSpirits be wit' ya, $n.

objectiveDetails.description: 帮助布温巴找到暗矛大使

text.title: 踢飞季节
text.objectives: 将5只托尔托拉之子踢回水里。
text.description: 小海龟很可爱，虽然它们有时候会咬人。$B$B<米露恩举起了绑着绷带的手指。>$B$B不过它们的腿太短，跑得一点都不快，无法逃脱那些攻击海加尔山的火焰怪物！$B$B<米露恩双手合十。>$B$B请救救它们，$n！把小海龟捡起来，踢进暗灰湖中。不要担心会踢伤它们，它们的壳硬着呢。$B$B另外它们的牙齿也很尖，所以可千万别去碰它们的嘴。
text.completion: You saved the wee turtles, $n! I hope you gently, lovingly kicked them as hard as you possibly could.
text.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.turninWindow: 可怜的小硬壳儿们……

english.title: Punting Season
english.objectives: Punt 5 Children of Tortolla into water.
english.description: Baby turtles are sweet, even if they can be somewhat bitey.$b$b<Mylune holds up a bandaged finger.>$B$BBut they're so slow with their tiny little legs, they can't escape the fire creatures who are attacking Hyjal!$b$b<Mylune claps her hands together.>$b$bPLEASE save them, $n! Pick up the wee turtles and punt them into the water of the Ashen Lake. Don't worry about the kicking, they have hard shells.$B$BThey also have hard teeth, so don't pick them up by the mouth.
english.completion: You saved the wee turtles, $n! I hope you gently, lovingly kicked them as hard as you possibly could.
english.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.turninWindow: Poor little shelly-shells...

objectiveDetails.description: 将托尔托拉之子踢回水里

text.title: 前往利文斯顿营地
text.objectives: 前往北荆棘谷的利文斯顿营地寻找暗矛大使。
text.description: 这将是我们侦察的第一个营地，也是最可能遭到进攻的地点。$b$b利文斯顿营地被巨魔废墟环绕着……很容易被当作目标。$b$b也许我们可以在那里找到大使。希望一切还没太晚。
text.completion: Another Darkspear emissary passed through some time ago telling us to be on our guard.$B$BHe mentioned some other trolls may show up, but not in spirit form, and not escorted by a $R $C.
text.end: 前往北荆棘谷的利文斯顿营地。

english.title: To Fort Livingston
english.objectives: Head to Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn Vale to find the Darkspear emissary.
english.description: Da first place we check gonna be da place most likely to be attacked first.  You call it Fort Livingston.$b$bFort Livingston be surrounded by troll ruins... It make for an easy target.$b$bMaybe we find da emissary dere.  Hopefully it ain't too late.
english.completion: Another Darkspear emissary passed through some time ago telling us to be on our guard.$B$BHe mentioned some other trolls may show up, but not in spirit form, and not escorted by a $R $C.
english.end: Head to Fort Livingston in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 毒蛇与毒药
text.objectives: 杀死丛林毒蛇，调查中毒冒险者，让布温巴治疗他们。
text.description: 因为使者的警告，我们集结了更多冒险者来防御营地。我们本以为我们是要和巨魔战斗。$b$b然而我们却遭到了这些毒蛇的围攻！$b$b它们仿佛遍地都是，我们几乎快坚持不住了，而且我估计情况只会越来越糟糕。$b$b帮助我们消灭毒蛇，也许你的巨魔朋友可以使用魔法来治疗中毒的人。
text.completion: Thanks for the help, $n.  These serpents, there doesn't appear to be an end to them.
text.completed: Return to Fort Livingston

english.title: Serpents and Poison
english.objectives: Kill Jungle Serpents and inspect the poisoned adventurers to allow Bwemba to heal them.
english.description: Because of the emissary's warning we were able to gather more adventurers to help defend.  But we thought we were going to be fighting trolls.$b$bInstead we found ourselves overwhelmed by serpents!$b$bThey seem to have come from everywhere.  We are barely able to hold on, and I only suspect it's going to get worse.$b$bHelp us and eliminate the serpents and perhaps your troll friend here can use some magic to cure the poisoned.
english.completion: Thanks for the help, $n.  These serpents, there doesn't appear to be an end to them.
english.completed: Return to Fort Livingston

text.title: 灵魂与我们同在
text.objectives: 为布温巴的仪式准备利文斯顿营地的篝火。
text.description: 这些毒蛇让我觉得有些怪异，$n。它们的毒液中有某种邪恶的魔精，这绝对不是自然界所应该有的。$b$b我们可以利用营地中心的篝火进行一个仪式。$b$b刺激这些毒蛇发动攻击的幕后操控者很可能还在监视着它们。$b$b$n，现在的问题是，我只能以灵魂的形式出现在这里，我需要你作为我的双手，到那堆篝火旁边，为我做好准备。剩下的事情就交给我好了。
text.completion: Venoxis... Dis can't be good, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

english.title: Spirits Are With Us
english.objectives: Prepare the bonfire in Fort Livingston for Bwemba's ritual.
english.description: Dere was somethin' not right about dem serpents, $n.  Dere was a trace of some bad mojo in da poison an' dat don't happen naturally.$b$bDa bonfire in da middle of da camp, we can use dat to perform a ritual.$b$bWhatever be makin' dese serpents attack, dey probably still watchin' over dem.$b$bDa only problem, $n, is dat I only be here in spirit form.  I need you to be my hands.  I need you to go to da fire an' prepare it for me.  Den I'll handle da rest.
english.completion: Venoxis... Dis can't be good, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用利文斯顿营地的篝火

text.title: 无所不知的奈辛瓦里
text.objectives: 提醒北荆棘谷奈辛瓦里远征队的猎手们。
text.description: 太好了，这正是我们所需要掌握的信息：暴怒的古拉巴什正在使用毒蛇发起进攻。起码那是我们所掌握到的情报。$b$b不出意外的话，奈辛瓦里远征队的猎手们对此一定有独到的见解，他们至少知道和这些毒蛇作战的技巧。$b$b前去将你在这里看到的情况告诉他们，告诉他们巨魔正在使用毒蛇作为他们的武器。
text.completion: We know all about the serpents, $n.  But there is something else out there lurking...  The jungle has come to life, $C!
text.end: 前往奈辛瓦里远征队营地。

english.title: Nesingwary Will Know
english.objectives: Warn the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.description: Great, just what we need, the Gurubashi on the rampage using serpents to lead the charge.  Well at least we know that much.$b$bIt's probably a safe bet that the hunters at Nesingwary's Expedition have some insight into this.  If they don't they at least know how to fight the serpents.$b$bHead there and let them know what you saw here.  Let them know that the trolls are using serpents as their weapon.
english.completion: We know all about the serpents, $n.  But there is something else out there lurking...  The jungle has come to life, $C!
english.end: Head to Nesingwary's Expedition.

text.title: 史上最大钻石！
text.objectives: 带着你的人类孤儿进入王座厅下面的旧铁炉堡。如果你到那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 我听说铁炉堡曾经的国王麦格尼·铜须变成了一颗巨大的钻石！这是真的？一个人怎么会变成钻石呢？也许只有国王才能变成钻石，所以他才会是第一个变成钻石的人。$B$B我们能去看看他吗？他应该是在铁炉堡中，王座厅下面那个被称为旧铁炉堡的地方。
text.completion: So King Magni didn't wanna become a diamond? That's really sad.$B$BHey, shamans work with rocks and the earth all the time, right? Maybe one day, they'll be able to help him become a dwarf again!
text.end: 在旧铁炉堡中拜访麦格尼国王
text.completed: 去找你的人类孤儿。

english.title: The Biggest Diamond Ever!
english.objectives: Take your Human Orphan into Old Ironforge, beneath the High Seat, to visit the resting place of King Magni Bronzebeard. Make sure to call for him if he is not present when you arrive.
english.description: I heard that Magni Bronzebeard, who used to be the king of Ironforge, turned into a giant diamond! Is that true? How does someone just turn into a diamond? Maybe you have to be a king and that's why no one's done it before.$B$BCan we go see him? He should be in the part of Ironforge called Old Ironforge underneath the High Seat.
english.completion: So King Magni didn't wanna become a diamond? That's really sad.$B$BHey, shamans work with rocks and the earth all the time, right? Maybe one day, they'll be able to help him become a dwarf again!
english.end: Visit King Magni in Old Ironforge
english.completed: Return to your Human Orphan.

text.title: 玛法里奥回来了！
text.objectives: 带领你的人类孤儿去达纳苏斯的月神殿拜见玛法里奥·怒风。如果你到那里的时候，他不在你身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 我听说玛法里奥·怒风从翡翠梦境中回来了。我还不知道翡翠梦境在哪里，但那一定是很遥远的地方。$B$B现在他一定是在达纳苏斯月神殿的顶部，和那里的高阶女祭司在一起。我们能去那里看他一眼吗？他可是艾泽拉斯历史上最强的德鲁伊！
text.completion: That was the best! Did you see when Malfurion cast those wings on me? The other orphans are going to be sorry they missed out on this trip!
text.end: 带领你的孤儿拜访玛法里奥·怒风
text.completed: 去找你的人类孤儿。

english.title: Malfurion Has Returned!
english.objectives: Take your Human Orphan to meet Malfurion Stormrage in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. If your orphan is not present when you arrive, call for him.
english.description: I heard that Malfurion Stormrage came back from the Emerald Dream. I don't know where that is, but it sounds like it's really far away.$B$BAnyway, he's supposed to be at the top of the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus with the High Priestess. D'you think we could go meet him? He's got to be the most powerful druid in the history of Azeroth!
english.completion: That was the best! Did you see when Malfurion cast those wings on me? The other orphans are going to be sorry they missed out on this trip!
english.end: Visit Malfurion Stormrage with your orphan
english.completed: Return to your Human Orphan.

text.title: 莫尔杉商队启动
text.objectives: 同罗克·维普杉克交谈，然后随同莫尔杉商队向北进发。
text.description: 灰谷的鏖战丝毫没有缓和的迹象。我们在莫尔杉壁垒的部队急需援军和供给物资。$B$B我们已经准备好大量药品和食物要运往北方。但我需要一名像你这样优秀的$c保护这支运输队。$B$B罗克·维普杉克就在十字路口北边的大道旁等你。做好护送商队的准备之后，就去找他吧。
text.completion: This is terrible news! $n, at least you arrived safely.
text.completed: Speak to Nagala Whipshank at the base of Dreadmist Peak in the Northern Barrens.

english.title: Mor'shan Caravan Pick-Up
english.objectives: Speak to Rocco Whipshank and ride north with the Mor'shan Caravan.
english.description: The battle in Ashenvale rages on without relent. Our forces at the Mor'shan Ramparts are in desperate need of reinforcements and supplies.$B$BWe have a major shipment of medicines and food headed north, and I need a capable $c like you to guard it.$B$BRocco Whipshank waits for you at the road north out of the Crossroads. Let him know you are ready to accompany the caravan.
english.completion: This is terrible news! $n, at least you arrived safely.
english.completed: Speak to Nagala Whipshank at the base of Dreadmist Peak in the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 莫尔杉商队救援
text.objectives: 营救巴尔格·维普杉克。
text.description: 他们就在我们的家门口劫走了巴尔格和供给物资！$B$B对于我们在灰谷与联盟的战争，那些物资是我们取得胜利的关键！而巴尔格……如果我亲爱的小弟出了什么事，我会亲手撕碎所有的火刃匪徒。$B$B$n，我需要你去营救巴尔格和被抢走的物资车辆。沿道路向北方前进，直到鬼雾峰。不要放过那些火刃狗子。
text.completion: $n, you came for me!
text.completed: 营救巴尔格·维普杉克。

english.title: Mor'shan Caravan Rescue
english.objectives: Rescue Balgor Whipshank.
english.description: They took Balgor and the caravan supplies from our very doorstep!$B$BThose supplies are vital for our victory against the Alliance in Ashenvale, and Balgor...if anything happens to my dear little brother, I will rip every Burning Blade member to shreds myself.$B$B$n, I need you to rescue Balgor and the captured caravan. Follow the path just north of us, up onto Dreadmist Peak. Do not let any of those Burning Blade dogs live.
english.completion: $n, you came for me!
english.completed: Rescue Balgor Whipshank.

text.title: 莫尔杉商队护送
text.objectives: 保卫莫尔杉商队。
text.description: 我们的巡逻兵报告说，在你大闹火刃巢穴之后，那些匪徒正重新集结力量，准备发动攻击。$B$B你一定要在他们杀过来之前护送商队到达目的地。我们已经将物资整备完毕，科多兽也得到了充分休息。希望你不要介意，我已经对你的枪支进行了一些调校。$B$B如果你遭遇任何攻击，一定要先射击，再发问。$B$B赶快行动！他们就要来了！准备好离开之后就再来找我吧。
text.completion: Some days we gain quarter, other days we are beaten back behind our walls. Every day, we bury more of our brothers and sisters.$B$B<Kadrak pauses and takes a deep breath.>$B$BNot only have the supplies you brought strengthened our troops, but your heroic deeds have inspired them as well. Thank you, $C.
text.completed: Speak to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Ramparts in the Northern Barrens.

english.title: Mor'shan Caravan Delivery
english.objectives: Defend the Mor'shan Caravan.
english.description: You've managed to stir the Burning Blade's nest. Our scouts report that they are gathering for an attack.$B$BYou must complete the caravan's journey before they arrive. The supplies are packed, the kodos are rested, and I hope you don't mind but I made a few adjustments to your gun.$B$BIf you meet up with any resistance, shoot first and ask questions later.$B$BQuickly! They come! Speak to me when you are ready to leave.
english.completion: Some days we gain quarter, other days we are beaten back behind our walls. Every day, we bury more of our brothers and sisters.$B$B<Kadrak pauses and takes a deep breath.>$B$BNot only have the supplies you brought strengthened our troops, but your heroic deeds have inspired them as well. Thank you, $C.
english.completed: Speak to Kadrak at the Mor'shan Ramparts in the Northern Barrens.

objectiveDetails.description: 同娜格拉·维普杉克交谈

text.title: 恶魔之种
text.objectives: 获得恶魔之种。
text.description: 听着，$n，我们还不能马上离开。在他们准备祭献仪式的时候，我偷听到了他们的行动计划。$B$B他们打算使用一件名叫恶魔之种的强大宝物，对部落发动全面攻击。现在那件宝物就在那个洞中，被他们严加看管。$B$B如果你能找到恶魔之种，我们就能把它交给我的姐姐娜格拉。她会知道该如何处理它。
text.progress: What did you find at the top of the mountain?
text.completion: $n, you're back! Balgor made it down before you, and he's already eaten two bowls of raptor stew. Considering that his appetite hasn't suffered, I'm sure he will be fit to travel in no time.$B$BI'll make sure that this artifact is taken care of. You've done us a great service today.
text.completed: Take the Demon Seed to Nagala Whipshank at the foot of Dreadmist Mountain the Northern Barrens.

english.title: Demon Seed
english.objectives: Obtain the Demon Seed.
english.description: Listen $n, we can't leave quite yet. I managed to overhear their plans while they were preparing for the ritual sacrifice.$B$BThey're planning to use a powerful artifact called the Demon Seed to launch a full scale attack on the Horde. They're keeping it under close guard over in that cave.$B$BIf you can get your hands on the Demon Seed, we should take it to my sister Nagala. She'll know what to do with it.
english.progress: What did you find at the top of the mountain?
english.completion: $n, you're back! Balgor made it down before you, and he's already eaten two bowls of raptor stew. Considering that his appetite hasn't suffered, I'm sure he will be fit to travel in no time.$B$BI'll make sure that this artifact is taken care of. You've done us a great service today.
english.completed: Take the Demon Seed to Nagala Whipshank at the foot of Dreadmist Mountain the Northern Barrens.

text.title: 追踪那野兽
text.objectives: 在北荆棘谷找到格伦特·恐锤。
text.description: 我们已经抵御毒蛇的进攻好多天了，$n。但和丛林里的某样东西比起来，这些毒蛇根本就不算什么。$b$b我们是猎手，却被当成了猎物。$b$b一只名叫玛乌提的猎豹正不断猎杀我的手下，将他们拖入草丛的深处。$b$b我们派去了我们最好的猎手之一——格伦特·恐锤——去追踪这个野兽。$b$b恐锤去了东边，也许你可以在那里找到他们。
text.completion: Shhh....

english.title: Track the Tracker
english.objectives: Find Grent Direhammer in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.description: We've been fending off serpents for days now, $n.  But the serpents are nothing compared to what else is out in that jungle.$b$bWe hunters are being hunted.$b$bA large panther named Mauti has been dragging my men off into the bush.$b$bWe sent Grent Direhammer, one of our best hunters, to track this beast down.$b$bDirehammer headed off to the east, perhaps you can find them there.
english.completion: Shhh....

text.title: 猎手的复仇
text.objectives: 给格伦特·恐锤一个交代，杀死玛乌提。
text.description: 我一直在猎杀……那个猎杀我们的野兽。$b$b玛乌提，就是他的名字。他是个聪明的家伙，但他犯了个巨大的错误，就是杀死了我的兄弟。现在，这个错误将让他付出代价。恐锤已经找到了他的踪迹。$b$b我注意到他就在库尔森的营地上方游荡。如果我们赶快行动，我们可以消灭他。$b$b准备好了吗，$n？
text.end: 带领格伦特·恐锤到玛乌提的尸体旁

english.title: The Hunter's Revenge
english.objectives: Give Grent Direhammer the closure he needs by killing Mauti.
english.description: The beast that's been hunting us... I've been hunting it.$b$bWe call him Mauti.  He's a clever one.  But he made a grave mistake when he killed my brother.  Now that mistake is going to cost him.  Ol' Direhammer has got his scent.$b$bI've noticed him roaming just above Kurzen's Compound.  If we act fast, we can take him down.$b$bAre you ready, $n?
english.end: Bring Grent Direhammer to the body of Mauti

text.title: 追踪猛兽
text.objectives: 找出玛乌提把格伦特·恐锤藏在了哪里。
text.description: 很好，这解释了为什么玛乌提看起来那么小……格伦特·恐锤被真正的玛乌提抓走了，但作为一个聪明的猎手，他发射了信号弹以便我们可以追踪他的行迹。赶快去找恐锤吧，否则一切都晚了！
text.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
text.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

english.title: Follow That Cat
english.objectives: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
english.description: Well, that explains why Mauti seemed smaller...  The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!
english.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
english.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

text.title: 我们去放风筝
text.objectives: 从暴风城的克拉格·摇塞那里购买一个风筝龙玩具包，用它和你的人类孤儿一起放风筝。如果你的孤儿不在身边，一定要召唤他过来。
text.description: 有一天，监护员带我们出去玩的时候，我看见一个侏儒推着一辆装满了玩具的小车。那车上有布娃娃、黄铜小跑车、皮球，还有一些风筝。我一直都想有一个风筝龙。监护员说过，如果我把所有的钱都攒起来，就能买一个。但我要攒好长时间。$B$B我记得那个侏儒的名字好象是叫克拉格·摇塞。如果我们能找到他，能不能从他那里买一个风筝，把它放起来？我见过他在贸易区外的运河边上走来走去。
text.completion: Thanks for the kite, $n. Every time I fly it, I'll remember the day you gave it to me!
text.end: 和你的孤儿一同放起风筝龙
text.completed: 去找你的人类孤儿。

english.title: Let's Go Fly a Kite
english.objectives: Purchase a Dragon Kite Two-Pack from Craggle Wobbletop in Stormwind and then use it to fly kites with your Human Orphan. If your orphan is not present, call for him.
english.description: The other day, when some of us were out with the matron, I saw a gnome pushing a cart filled with toys. He had dolls, copper racers, leather balls, and some kites. I've always wanted to get a dragon kite and the matron said that if I saved all my money I could buy one, but that's going to be a long time.$B$BI think the gnome's name was Craggle Wobbletop or something like that. If we can find him, could we get some kites and fly them together? I saw him walking around the canals outside the Trade District.
english.completion: Thanks for the kite, $n. Every time I fly it, I'll remember the day you gave it to me!
english.end: Fly Dragon Kites with your orphan
english.completed: Return to your Human Orphan.

text.title: 追踪猛兽
text.objectives: 找出玛乌提把格伦特·恐锤藏在了哪里。
text.description: 真正的玛乌提已经把格伦特·恐锤抓走了，但作为一个聪明的猎手，他发射了信号弹以便我们追踪他的行迹。赶快去找恐锤吧，否则一切都晚了！
text.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
text.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

english.title: Follow That Cat
english.objectives: Find where Mauti has taken Grent Direhammer.
english.description: The real Mauti has run off with Grent Direhammer, but being the wise hunter that he is, he has fired flares off so you can track him.  Find Direhammer before it's too late!
english.completion: We be here... Da hunter, he be in da cave.  Da beast... Sometin' ain't right about her...
english.completed: Speak to Bwemba.

text.title: 你吃一口，我吃一口……
text.objectives: 在冰锥甜筒购买冰激凌，并与你的孤儿一同分享。
text.description: 暴风城有了一家全新的冰激凌店，而且里面卖的也不是那种老式冰激凌了。它的冰激凌都是魔法师做的！你根本不会想到，如果我吃了它，十五分钟之后它就会从我的肚子里消失了！$B$B我打赌，那一定非常好吃。我们赶快去试试吧！$B$B其他小孩都在和我说这个呢。他们说那家店叫冰锥甜筒，就在法师区的蓝色隐士旁边。
text.completion: Do you think the apprentices mind freezing all that ice cream? I wish I got to make ice cream at school. That would make lessons a lot more fun, don't you think?
text.end: 带你的孤儿去吃冰激凌。
text.completed: 去找你的人类孤儿。

english.title: You Scream, I Scream...
english.objectives: Purchase ice cream at The Cone of Cold and then share it with your orphan.
english.description: There's a brand new ice cream shop in Stormwind, and it's not just any old ice cream either. This ice cream is made by mages! You don't think I'm going to be hungry fifteen minutes after eating it, do you?$B$BI bet it tastes really good. Let's go try it!$B$BI heard some of the other kids talking about it, and they were saying the store is called The Cone of Cold and it's over near the Blue Recluse in the Mage Quarter.
english.completion: Do you think the apprentices mind freezing all that ice cream? I wish I got to make ice cream at school. That would make lessons a lot more fun, don't you think?
english.end: Take your orphan out for ice cream.
english.completed: Return to your Human Orphan.

text.title: 玛乌提
text.objectives: 将布温巴带到玛乌提的尸体旁边。
text.description: 我感觉那头猎豹不太对劲，$n。太不自然了。我需要在尸体上进行一些仪式。杀掉玛乌提，然后我们看看能有什么发现，$n。
text.completion: High Priestess Kilnara be behind dis abomination.  Dis ain't looking good.  We should see to da dwarf and then make our way to see what other trouble be going on.
text.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

english.title: Mauti
english.objectives: Bring Bwemba to the remains of Mauti.
english.description: I got da feeling dat somethin' ain't right wit' dat panther, $n.  It ain't natural.  I gonna need to perform some rituals over da body.  Put Mauti down, an' den let's see what we can find out, $n.
english.completion: High Priestess Kilnara be behind dis abomination.  Dis ain't looking good.  We should see to da dwarf and then make our way to see what other trouble be going on.
english.completed: Speak with Bwemba.

text.title: 与靴同葬……
text.objectives: 找到格伦特·恐锤的靴子。
text.description: 啊……是你啊，$n。玛乌提……他死了？我终于活到了为我兄弟报仇的这一刻。我对你只有一个请求……这头小豹崽在这里挠我的脚很久了。作为一个矮人，我不该光着脚去死。$b$b求求你，让我穿着靴子下葬。
text.progress: Do ya have me boots?  Grant a dwarf his last request will ya?
text.completion: Th-thank ye, lad.$B$BPappy...?$B$B$BIs that...$B$B$B$Byou...$B$B$B$B$B...
text.completed: Return to Grent Direhammer.

english.title: Bury Me With Me Boots...
english.objectives: Collect Grent Direhammer's boots.
english.description: Ah... It's you, $n.  Mauti... He's dead?  Then my brother has been avenged.  I've only one request from ya... This scamp here, he's been pawing at me bare feet.  No dwarf should go to the earth with bare feet.$b$bPlease, bury me with me boots.
english.progress: Do ya have me boots?  Grant a dwarf his last request will ya?
english.completion: Th-thank ye, lad.$B$BPappy...?$B$B$BIs that...$B$B$B$Byou...$B$B$B$B$B...
english.completed: Return to Grent Direhammer.

text.title: 涅墨西斯的回声
text.objectives: 与图加交谈，召唤并消灭涅墨西斯。站在图加的壳下以躲避涅墨西斯的熔岩之怒。
text.description: <米露恩悦耳的声音在你脑中响起。>$B$B还记得那个从火焰之地来的可怕的烈焰海龟涅墨西斯吗？他已经死啦！但他的回音还在试图进入海加尔山。$B$B我要你去暗灰湖的礁石那里见见我的朋友，图加。告诉他你已经准备好迎战涅墨西斯的回音了，然后图加就会把他引到这个世界中来。然后你就可以攻击他了！狠狠地打！$B$B如果他开始爆发，就躲到图加的壳里去。
text.completion: Hooray! It just goes to show you, when a turtle puts his mind to something -
text.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: 涅墨西斯的灵魂碎片仍旧残留在我们的维度之中。

english.title: Echoes of Nemesis
english.objectives: Speak with Tooga to summon and kill Nemesis. Stand under Tooga's shell to protect you from Nemesis' Molten Fury.
english.description: <Mylune's voice sings like a melody in your head.>$B$BRemember that awful fire turtle, Nemesis, from the Firelands? He's dead now (yay!) but echoes of him keep trying to break through to Mount Hyjal.$B$BGo to the shores of the Ashen Lake and speak with my friend Tooga. Let him know you're ready to fight an echo of Nemesis, and the turtles will draw him into this world. Then you can hit him! Hard!$B$BHide inside of Tooga's shell if he starts to erupt.
english.completion: Hooray! It just goes to show you, when a turtle puts his mind to something -
english.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Portions of Nemesis' spirit still linger between our dimensions.

text.title: 灭火之怒
text.objectives: 在复苏之地或塞西莉亚的栖地中击败任意6名来自火焰之地的入侵者。
text.description: 我们在海加尔的任务之中，最紧迫的任务很简单：消灭那些入侵者。火焰的本质就是吞噬一切。如果有片刻松懈，它就会将眼前的一切烧成灰烬。$b$b干掉任何你看见的烈焰入侵者。每一名敌人的倒下，都会为海加尔争取时间。
text.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while.$B$BHyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Rage Against the Flames
english.objectives: Kill any 6 invaders from the Firelands in the Regrowth or Sethria's Roost.
english.description: Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.$b$bKill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.
english.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while.$B$BHyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死来自火焰之地的入侵者

text.title: 警告反抗军营地
text.objectives: 赶到反抗军营地。
text.description: 他不会白白牺牲的，$n。我们认为基尔娜拉还潜伏在暗处中寻找新的猎物，所以情况并不妙。$b$b我们最好去看看北部的反抗军营地，也许我们可以在那找到我的联络人。
text.completion: First we had snakes, then we had panthers, now we have trolls.$B$BIt's good that you're here, we could use all the help we can get.

english.title: Warn the Rebel Camp
english.objectives: Make your way to the Rebel Camp.
english.description: Dis death ain't be in vain, $n.  We figure out dat Kilnara be on da prowl.  Tings don't look good.$b$bWe better check out da Rebel Camp to da north.  Maybe we find my contact dere.
english.completion: First we had snakes, then we had panthers, now we have trolls.$B$BIt's good that you're here, we could use all the help we can get.

text.title: 林木之间
text.objectives: 靠近玛洛恩之魂，捕捉其中的三个。
text.description: 玛洛恩的灵魂碎片——在我们凡人眼里只是一些幽灵白鹿——还在那些密林中嬉戏。尽管玛洛恩不在了，但他的灵魂碎片仍能为我们所用。$b$b向东走，走进那片森林。如果你能靠近那些灵魂碎片，它会赐予你力量。$b$b哦，带上这玩意。你会用的着的。
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: Well done, $n. With the horns of Malorne on our side, we stand a chance against one of the Firelands' most difficult foes: Galenges.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.turninWindow: 我已经能感受到你体内的白鹿之力了。

english.title: Between the Trees
english.objectives: Catch three Spirits of Malorne by walking close to them.
english.description: Spirit fragments of Malorne - seen to us mortals as ghostly white deer - still frolic through these forests. While Malorne is no longer with us, these pieces of his spirit may be of use to us.$b$bTravel east and walk among the trees. If you are able to get close enough to one of the spirit fragments, it will bestow its power to you.$b$bOh, and take this staff. You may need it later.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: Well done, $n. With the horns of Malorne on our side, we stand a chance against one of the Firelands' most difficult foes: Galenges.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.turninWindow: I can already sense the power of the stag within you.

text.title: 玛洛恩的力量
text.objectives: 使用守护者之杖来召唤玛洛恩并击败盖伦格斯。
text.description: <麦托克劳的声音继续响起。>$b$b我们东边有一面已经开启了的传送门，它的守护者是一名强大的火妖，叫做盖伦格斯。想要击败他，我们需要玛洛恩的全力支持。$b$b你还记得我之前给你的那根法杖吗？把它插在传送门前的灰烬堆里。然后祈求玛洛恩来协助你。
text.completion: Galenges has fallen, the unbreakable is broken... but our work is not done.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: 等候玛洛恩的进攻，然后全力开火！

english.title: The Power of Malorne
english.objectives: Use the Guardian's Staff to summon and defeat Galenges.
english.description: <Matoclaw's voice continues.>$b$bThe portal that opened up to our east is guarded by a powerful flamewaker by the name of Galenges. We will need all of Malorne's help in defeating him.$b$bDo you remember the staff that I gave you? Place it in the pile of ash in front of the portal. Then pray that Malorne comes to your aid.
english.completion: Galenges has fallen, the unbreakable is broken... but our work is not done.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Wait for Malorne to attack, then unload on him!

text.title: 灭火之怒
text.objectives: 在复苏之地或塞西莉亚的栖地中击败任意8名来自火焰之地的入侵者。
text.description: 我们在海加尔的任务之中，最紧迫的任务很简单：消灭那些入侵者。火焰的本质就是吞噬一切。如果有片刻松懈，它就会将眼前的一切烧成灰烬。$b$b干掉任何你看见的烈焰入侵者。每一名敌人的倒下，都会为海加尔争取时间。
text.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while.$B$BHyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Rage Against the Flames
english.objectives: Kill any 8 invaders from the Firelands in the Regrowth or Sethria's Roost.
english.description: Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.$b$bKill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.
english.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while.$B$BHyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死来自火焰之地的入侵者

text.title: 海加尔的保卫者
text.objectives: 击败6只火焰巨兽或炙热的葬火领主。
text.description: 我们需要对塞西莉亚的栖地的入侵营施加压力。拉格纳罗斯的爪牙在利用这片区域作为向海加尔边缘推进的战略前线。我会让你率领一支小队来对付它们。$b$b我已经挑选了一支精英小队来协助你。去塞西莉亚的栖地。等你到了，你的同胞会立刻赶来与你会合。然后一同终结元素的入侵吧。
text.completion: A job well done, soldier. While our mission in the Firelands is critical, we must not forget about the well-being of Hyjal.$B$BSpeak with my brother again tomorrow, and he will have another squad prepared for you.
text.completed: Report to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: The Protectors of Hyjal
english.objectives: Slay 6 Fiery Behemoths or Seething Pyrelords.
english.description: We need to place pressure on the assault camp at Sethria's Roost. Ragnaros' minions are using this area as a point to push their battlefront beyond the bounds of Hyjal. I'm putting you in charge of a small squad to deal with them.$b$bI have selected an elite group of fighters to assist you. Travel to Sethria's Roost. Your compatriots have been instructed to meet you once you arrive. Then put an end to the elementals' assault.
english.completion: A job well done, soldier. While our mission in the Firelands is critical, we must not forget about the well-being of Hyjal.$B$BSpeak with my brother again tomorrow, and he will have another squad prepared for you.
english.completed: Report to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

objectiveDetails.description: 在塞西莉亚的栖地消灭入侵者

text.title: 传奇的邀请
text.objectives: 与时光之穴的阿纳克洛斯交谈。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$c。$b$b<齐拉多尔米微笑起来。>$b$b感谢你能这么迅速的赶来。$b$b虽然我不知道原因，但我的主人想要见你。$b$b我劝你认真对待这个邀请。阿纳克洛斯很少接见凡人。如果你够明智的话，最好立即前往时光之穴去见他。$b$b你准备好了就告诉我，我会亲自送你过去。
text.completion: It is no whimsical dalliance that brings you here, mortal.$B$BMuster every fiber of your courage for what you are about to behold.

english.title: A Legendary Engagement
english.objectives: Speak to Anachronos in the Caverns of Time.
english.description: A pleasure, $c.$b$b<Ziradormi smiles.>$b$bIt was kind of you to arrive so quickly.$b$bFor reasons unknown to me, my master seeks audience with you.$b$bI would counsel you not to take this invitation lightly. Anachronos seldom has cause to interact with mortals. Wisdom would dictate that you seek him out in the Caverns of Time at once.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready and I shall personally deliver you.
english.completion: It is no whimsical dalliance that brings you here, mortal.$B$BMuster every fiber of your courage for what you are about to behold.

text.title: 坚守营地
text.objectives: 坚守反抗军营地三分钟。
text.description: 我陷入了麻烦，$n。你的巨魔朋友来过这里，警告我们事态会愈发严重，但我没想到会严重至此。$b$b我们正在尽全力抵御那些巨魔，如果你能多少提供一些帮助的话那就太好了。
text.completion: Thanks for giving us a bit of a breather, $n.$B$BLike I said before, your troll friend was here for a small amount of time.  He warned us and then left.$B$BJames Stillair helped get him to his next destination, maybe he can help you out.$B$BGood luck out there, $n.
text.end: 守卫营地
text.completed: 同多伦上尉交谈。

english.title: Defend the Rebel Camp
english.objectives: Help defend the Rebel Camp for three minutes.
english.description: We are in trouble here, $n.  Your troll friend has been through here and warned us that things were going to get serious, but I didn't think it would be this bad.$b$bWe are doing our best to hold off these trolls.  But any help you can offer would greatly help.
english.completion: Thanks for giving us a bit of a breather, $n.$B$BLike I said before, your troll friend was here for a small amount of time.  He warned us and then left.$B$BJames Stillair helped get him to his next destination, maybe he can help you out.$B$BGood luck out there, $n.
english.end: Help Defend the Camp
english.completed: Speak to Lieutenant Doren.

text.title: 传奇的邀请
text.objectives: 与时光之穴的阿纳克洛斯交谈。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$c。$b$b<克里多尔米微笑起来。>$b$b感谢你能这么迅速的赶来。$b$b出于我不知道的原因，我的主人需要见你。$b$b我劝诫你认真对待这个邀请，$n。阿纳克洛斯很少有事需要接见凡人。你的智慧应该让你明白，立刻前往时光之穴去找他才是正确的。$b$b准备好了就来找我，我将亲自送你过去。
text.completion: It is no whimsical dalliance that brings you here, mortal.$B$BMuster every fiber of your courage for what you are about to behold.

english.title: A Legendary Engagement
english.objectives: Speak to Anachronos in the Caverns of Time.
english.description: I expected that I would find you here, $c. But then, we of the bronze flight have somewhat of an advantage when it comes to such things.$b$b<Coridormi smiles.>$b$bFor reasons unknown to me, my master seeks audience with you.$b$bI would counsel you not to take this invitation lightly, $n. Anachronos seldom has cause to interact with mortals. Wisdom would dictate that you seek him out in the Caverns of Time at once.$b$bSpeak to me when you are ready and I shall personally deliver you.
english.completion: It is no whimsical dalliance that brings you here, mortal.$B$BMuster every fiber of your courage for what you are about to behold.

text.title: 前往挖掘场
text.objectives: 前往南荆棘谷的探险者协会挖掘场。
text.description: 另一名暗矛使者来过这里，但很快就离开了。他着急赶往下一站目的地去警告他们，我让他飞去荆棘谷海角的探险者协会挖掘场了，希望他能来得及。$b$b我会让你使用我其中一只狮鹫，这样你可以直飞目的地。$b$b准备好了就和我说一声，$n。
text.completion: Dis don't look very good, $n.

english.title: To the Digsite
english.objectives: Head to the Explorers' League Digsite in Southern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.description: The other Darkspear emissary was here briefly.  He was eager to get to the next location and warn them.   I sent him on a flight to the Explorers' League Digsite in the Cape of Stranglethorn.  I hope he wasn't too late.$b$bI will give you use of one of my gryphons, a direct flight there.$b$bTalk to me when you are ready to go, $n.
english.completion: Dis don't look very good, $n.

text.title: 时间的波澜
text.objectives: 同时光之穴中的阿纳克洛斯交谈，见证艾泽拉斯的未来。
text.description: 仔细听着，$c，我们虽然只是刚刚开始，时间却已经所剩不多。如果我们失败，随之而来的将是无法想象的灾难。$b$b刚刚过去不久的一个事件在我的视野中却变得模糊不清，一定是某种最强大的魔法遮蔽了它。不管怎样，现在它还没有造成任何实质性的影响。$b$b但如果我们不采取行动以改变这股时间流的未来，其结果将是显而易见的。$b$b发挥你的全部力量，凡人，为艾泽拉斯的未来而战。
text.completion: Now, $R, you know the reasoning behind your summons.

english.title: A Wrinkle in Time
english.objectives: Speak to Anachronos in the Caverns of Time to witness the future of Azeroth.
english.description: Listen carefully, $c, for though we are only beginning, time already grows short and the consequences of our failure are unfathomable.$b$bAn event in the recent past has been obscured from my vision by the most powerful of magics. Its impact, however, has not.$b$bIf action is not taken to change the course of this timeline's future, the outcome is clear.$b$bBrace yourself, mortal, and behold the future of Azeroth.
english.completion: Now, $R, you know the reasoning behind your summons.

text.title: 全视之眼
text.objectives: 在火焰之地收集25个永恒余烬，另外还要收集3份时之砂。
text.description: 我能够感知那些在你的脑海中燃烧的问题，必须承认，在这些问题面前，我像你一样无知……这是我极少会遇到的情况，也是最让人感到不安的情况。$b$b我要搜索过去，寻找这一模糊事件的蛛丝马迹。而你则必须帮助我创造出一只眼睛。它是揭开这团迷雾所必需的工具，也是你证明自身价值的一个契机。$b$b进入火元素位面，$c，收集永恒余烬。把它们和时之砂一同带给我。然后我就能创造出那只眼睛。
text.progress: Well, $C?$B$BHave you acquired the necessary materials?
text.completion: You have done well, friend.$B$BBe still as I weave ancient magics to create the Timeless Eye.
text.completed: 与时光之穴的阿纳克洛斯交谈。

english.title: All-Seeing Eye
english.objectives: Collect 25 Eternal Embers from The Firelands and 3 Sands of Time.
english.description: I perceive the questions that burn within your mind and I must confess that I share in your uncertainty... a rare position for one such as I, and a most unsettling one.$b$bAs I scour time to find traces of this obscured event, you must aid me in the creation of an Eye, both to test your worthiness, and to provide an essential tool in the unraveling of this mystery.$b$bVenture into the Plane of Fire, $c, and gather Eternal Embers. Bring them to me with Sands of Time and I will create the Eye.
english.progress: Well, $C?$B$BHave you acquired the necessary materials?
english.completion: You have done well, friend.$B$BBe still as I weave ancient magics to create the Timeless Eye.
english.completed: Speak to Anachronos in the Caverns of Time.

text.title: 突破防御
text.objectives: 杀死5条熔岩破坏者。
text.description: 岩浆虫在我们的后方破土而出，破坏了我们的阵型，让元素能够趁虚而入。现在北边的整条战线上到处都是岩浆虫，连灰烬旷野也无法幸免。$B$B快把它们赶回地洞里去。
text.completion: We're grateful for your support. Your presence on the battlefield gives us the time we need to refortify. Your efforts make all the difference.
text.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: Breach in the Defenses
english.objectives: Kill 5 Lava Bursters.
english.description: Lava worms are bursting through the ground behind our lines, breaking our formations and allowing elementals to slip through. You'll find them scattered throughout our entire front to the north, and upon the Ashen Fields further out.$B$BStomp them back into their holes.
english.completion: We're grateful for your support. Your presence on the battlefield gives us the time we need to refortify. Your efforts make all the difference.
english.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 烧伤患者
text.objectives: 治疗8名受伤的海加尔防御者。
text.description: 我们的不少战士因为伤痛而在战场上倒下，而我们大部分德鲁伊都忙于战斗，无法给予他们足够的援助。我要你到北方去，前往灰烬旷野，治疗他们的伤势，至少让他们能够安全地回来。$B$B要是你缺乏绷带或者不会治疗法术，我让莱茵制作的这些药膏应该也可以缓解他们的伤势。
text.progress: To our fortune, Ragnaros' forces far more often injure our warriors than outright kill them. Their attacks naturally cauterize the wounds they inflict. It's very painful, but it's better than death.
text.completion: I saw several of our warriors make it back to safety shortly after you departed. It seems your efforts were quite effective. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Captain Irontree at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: Burn Victims
english.objectives: Heal 8 Wounded Hyjal Defenders.
english.description: We have warriors out in the field who are falling wounded, and many of our druids are too busy fighting to give them proper aid. I need you to go to the north, towards the Ashen Fields, and tend their wounds at least enough that they can make it back to safety.$B$BIf you haven't any bandages or healing spells, I had Rayne put together this salve, which should prove sufficient to get them on their feet.
english.progress: To our fortune, Ragnaros' forces far more often injure our warriors than outright kill them. Their attacks naturally cauterize the wounds they inflict. It's very painful, but it's better than death.
english.completion: I saw several of our warriors make it back to safety shortly after you departed. It seems your efforts were quite effective. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Captain Irontree at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

objectiveDetails.description: 援救受伤的海加尔防御者

text.title: 顽强生长
text.objectives: 在灰烬旷野的燃灰堆里种下5颗窒息之藤的种子。
text.description: 我们的战士在尽全力抵御元素的攻击，但元素生物的数量无穷无尽。我们需要做点什么，来减缓它们的攻势。$B$B去北边的灰烬旷野找些合适的泥土或者灰堆，把这些种子种下去。它们会长成致命的藤蔓，可以稍稍拖住敌人。效果不是很大，但聊胜于无。
text.progress: Did you find some places to plant them? I realize it's a bit barren out there.
text.completion: We will win this battle. Whatever it takes, we will not let these elementals back into Hyjal.
text.completed: Return to Rayne Feathersong at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: Aggressive Growth
english.objectives: Plant 5 Smothervine Seeds in the Ash Piles in the Ashen Fields.
english.description: Our warriors are doing everything they can to hold back the elementals, but their numbers are endless. We need to do something to slow down the assault.$B$BFind some suitable patches of dirt or ash out on the Ashen Fields to our north and plant these seeds. They will grow deadly vines that may slow down our enemies a bit. It's not much, but every bit helps.
english.progress: Did you find some places to plant them? I realize it's a bit barren out there.
english.completion: We will win this battle. Whatever it takes, we will not let these elementals back into Hyjal.
english.completed: Return to Rayne Feathersong at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: Under the Skylord's Gaze
text.description: This is the wrong choice. Accept the quest, "The Warden's Charge." Those quests are more fleshed out.

english.title: Under the Skylord's Gaze
english.description: This is the wrong choice. Accept the quest, "The Warden's Charge." Those quests are more fleshed out.

text.title: 摔得更惨
text.objectives: 消灭3头熔火巨兽。
text.description: 熔火巨兽加入了元素阵营，它们正在战场上碾压着我们的前线。我要你去阻止他们的攻势。$B$B你会发现这些畜生动作缓慢而笨拙，用点计策就能轻松打败它们。可要是被它们的拳头打中，那可是毁灭性的一击。机灵点，$c。
text.completion: The elementals shall grow to fear you.
text.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: The Harder They Fall
english.objectives: Kill 3 Molten Behemoths.
english.description: Molten Behemoths have joined the elementals upon the battlefield. They are crushing our front lines. I need you to halt their momentum.$B$BYou'll find the beasts slow and clumsy. They can easily be outmaneuvered, but they will pack a devastating punch if they hit you. Be nimble, $c.
english.completion: The elementals shall grow to fear you.
english.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 叛徒归来
text.objectives: 击败3名火焰德鲁伊。
text.description: 烈焰德鲁伊冲击着我们的前线，$n。$B$B这些邪恶的生物背弃了艾露恩的教诲，转而崇拜火焰领主拉格纳罗斯。他们被其疯狂的力量所扭曲，一心想要将我们燃为灰烬。$B$B我们必须立刻展开反击！
text.completion: Good. Our enemies now know that our strength is to be feared.
text.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: Traitors Return
english.objectives: Kill 3 Druids of the Flame.
english.description: The Druids of the Flame assault our front line, $n.$B$BThese vile creatures have turned their backs on Elune's teachings and worship instead the Fire Lord, Ragnaros. Twisted by his insane power, they desire nothing more than to bury us in ash.$B$BWe must counter their attack immediately!
english.completion: Good. Our enemies now know that our strength is to be feared.
english.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 小精灵出发
text.objectives: 带领海加尔小精灵前往灰烬旷野的某一座火焰传送门，并保护它，直到传送门被关闭为止。如果你弄丢了海加尔小精灵，就去玛法里奥突破口找莱茵·羽歌。
text.description: 在灰烬旷野的那头，火元素正源源不断地从传送门中蜂拥而出。我们需要有人去关闭那些传送门，从而切断它们的增援。$B$B我们的小精灵十分擅长放逐此类的元素魔法，你可以带一只走。你得把它领到一扇传送门前，并在它完成使命之前保护它不要牺牲。
text.completion: Well done, $c. I'll have to make more use of your skills in the future.
text.completed: Return to Rayne Feathersong at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: Wisp Away
english.objectives: Lead a Hyjal Wisp to one of the fire portals in the Ashen Fields, and protect the wisp until it closes the portal. If you lose your wisp, return to Rayne Feathersong at Malfurion's Breach.
english.description: The fire elementals are pouring out of portals on the far side of the Ashen Fields. We need someone to close them. Cut off some of their reinforcements.$B$BBanishing these kinds of elemental magics is something our wisps are perfectly suited for. One will come with you. Lead it to a portal and keep it alive until it finishes.
english.completion: Well done, $c. I'll have to make more use of your skills in the future.
english.completed: Return to Rayne Feathersong at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 暴风城大扫除
text.objectives: 使用奥术清洁剂来清除暴风城周围的臭气弹。
text.description: 你好，$c！喜欢万圣节吗？看样子，为了报复我们对幽暗城的臭气弹行动，部落也打算向我们的城市投放臭气弹。而且他们这次使用的臭气弹威力更强。松树的芬芳已经不够了。我们需要一些更强效的东西。使用这个奥术清洁剂去清除城中的臭气弹吧。
text.completion: Ah, much better, $n.  Those crones in the Undercity have no idea how powerful we have become.  Now I suppose you would like a reward.
text.completed: Return to Gretchen Fenlow outside of Stormwind.

english.title: Clean Up in Stormwind
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Cleanser to remove stink bombs around Stormwind.
english.description: Greetings, $c!  Are you enjoying Hallow's End?  It seems that in response to our stinkbombing the Undercity, the Horde has decided to stink bomb our city.  The stink bombs they drop are more potent than the ones used in the past.  The power of pine won't be enough.  We will need something with a little more power.  Use this Arcane Cleanser to remove the stink bombs from the city.
english.completion: Ah, much better, $n.  Those crones in the Undercity have no idea how powerful we have become.  Now I suppose you would like a reward.
english.completed: Return to Gretchen Fenlow outside of Stormwind.

text.title: 开门
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山诺尔度之脊的大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾。
text.description: 你来的有点晚。哈缪尔，玛法里奥以及我们的一些贵客已经动身前往悬崖顶端的入侵点了。$b$b通往火焰之地的门还没有完工，不过很快了。我们越快冲破那道门，形势就对我们越有利。$b$b快去吧！哈缪尔见到你会很高兴的。
text.completion: $n. It is good to see you again. Our gate is nearly opened.

english.title: Opening the Door
english.objectives: Report to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem at Nordune Ridge in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: You're a bit late. Hamuul, Malfurion, and some of our esteemed guests have already traveled to the invasion point, atop that cliff.$b$bOur gate to the Firelands is not yet completed, but it will be shortly. The sooner we can break through, the better.$b$bGo on! Hamuul will be expecting you.
english.completion: $n. It is good to see you again. Our gate is nearly opened.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 乘坐火箭车
text.objectives: 前往艾萨拉的南部火箭车终点站，登上塔顶的红猎犬火箭双座型原型机。
text.description: 我听说地精们在艾萨拉建起了一条疯狂的高速公路，在上面穿行的是火箭！你能想象吗？我听说过这件事之后，就一直想去看看。我问过监护员巴特维尔那是什么，她说那叫火箭车！$B$B她还告诉了我，地精们正在打造有两个座位的原型火箭。我们能不能去看看它，说不定还可以试乘一段呢？我打赌，用于实验的原型火箭一定就在火箭车南端的秘密实验室附近……
text.completion: That was great! I even learned how to control the rocket and everything! Did you see how I saved us? I'm gonna be a rocket pilot when I grow up!
text.end: 带领你的孤儿去乘坐火箭车
text.completed: 去找你的兽人孤儿。

english.title: Ridin' the Rocketway
english.objectives: Head to the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara and board the Redhound Two-Seater prototype at the top of the tower.
english.description: I heard that the newest members of the Horde, the goblins, built a crazy road in Azshara and it's just for rockets! Can you imagine? Ever since I heard about it, I've wanted to pay a visit. I asked Matron Battlewail about it and she said it's called the Rocketway!$B$BShe even told me they're working on a prototype rocket with two seats. D'you wanna go there and see if we can try it out? I bet the experimental rocket is near the Secret Lab at the south end of the Rocketway...
english.completion: That was great! I even learned how to control the rocket and everything! Did you see how I saved us? I'm gonna be a rocket pilot when I grow up!
english.end: Take Your Orphan to Ride the Rocketway
english.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

text.title: 召唤鸟群
text.objectives: 使用你的召唤鸟群技能来召集12只高山鸣雀、5只森林猫头鹰和2只金翼雄鹰。
text.description: 今天，我们终于有机会对拉格纳罗斯的左膀右臂之一：米拉盖佐尔再次发动进攻了。然而我们首先需要寻求援助。$b$b<麦托克劳举起一片巨大而又柔软的羽毛。>$b$b使用这个神器来祈求艾维娜的力量。等你祈求到力量后，去西北边召唤她的鸟群，并召集它们。$b$b完成后就回来找我，这样我们就可以着手对抗米拉盖佐尔了。
text.progress: Yes?
text.completion: Well done, $r. Now that the flock is assembled, we strike.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.turninWindow: 我们已经准备好对米拉盖佐尔发动进攻了。

english.title: Call the Flock
english.objectives: Use your Call the Flock ability to gather 12 Alpine Songbirds, 5 Forest Owls, and 2 Goldwing Hawks.
english.description: Today, we have an opportunity to make another assault against one of Ragnaros' greater minions: Millagazor. However, we first need to get some assistance.$b$b<Matoclaw holds up a large, silky feather.>$b$bUse this artifact to invoke the power of Aviana. Once you have done so, travel northwest and gather some of her flock by calling out to them.$b$bOnce you have done so, we may proceed against Millagazor.
english.progress: Yes?
english.completion: Well done, $r. Now that the flock is assembled, we strike.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.turninWindow: We are ready to take on Millagazor.

text.title: 羽翼烈焰
text.objectives: 使用群鸟女王的翎羽来召唤并击败米拉盖佐尔。
text.description: <麦托克劳的声音继续在你的脑海中回响>$b$b米拉盖佐尔是只烈焰生物，但是从很多方面来说，他仍然是一只鸟。故此，艾维娜的神器也许还能把他召唤出来。$b$b他就在西边那座熊熊燃烧的传送门旁边。在传送门入口处使用这根羽毛，然后准备一场恶战吧。
text.completion: Well done, champion.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: 把他从传送门里拉出来，然后消灭他！

english.title: Wings Aflame
english.objectives: Use the Quill of the Bird-Queen to summon and defeat Millagazor.
english.description: <Matoclaw's voice continues to echo within your head.>$b$bMillagazor is a creature of flame, but in many ways, he is not unlike the birds of this land. As such, Aviana's artifacts may still have the power to summon him.$b$bThe fiery portal to the west is where you will find him. Use the quill near the portal's entrance, then prepare for a fierce battle.
english.completion: Well done, champion.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Pull him out of that portal, and destroy him!

text.title: 灭火之怒
text.objectives: 在复苏之地或塞西莉亚的栖地中击败任意7名来自火焰之地的入侵者。
text.description: 我们在海加尔的任务之中，最紧迫的任务很简单：消灭那些入侵者。火焰的本质就是吞噬一切。如果有片刻松懈，它就会将眼前的一切烧成灰烬。$b$b干掉任何你看见的烈焰入侵者。每一名敌人的倒下，都会为海加尔争取时间。
text.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while.$B$BHyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Rage Against the Flames
english.objectives: Kill any 7 invaders from the Firelands in the Regrowth or Sethria's Roost.
english.description: Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.$b$bKill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.
english.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while.$B$BHyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死来自火焰之地的入侵者

text.title: 巫毒僵尸
text.objectives: 拯救10名挖掘场幸存者。
text.description: 那些人……他们都成了僵尸，还是巫毒僵尸！这看起来可不妙，$n。$b$b你必须杀了他们。$b$b他们被杀死后的那段时间，我可以拯救他们，把他们变回曾经的人形。$b$b我们必须赶快行动，僵尸可不会休息。
text.completion: We done enough, $n.  We can't keep fighting dese zombies.  We need to figure out da source of dis voodoo.  An' I tink I know where to start...

english.title: Voodoo Zombies
english.objectives: Rescue 10 Digsite Survivors.
english.description: Da people... Dey all zombies, voodoo zombies!  Dis ain't gonna be pretty, $n.$b$bYou gotta kill dem.$b$bBut once dey killed, dere is a moment where I can save dem.  Change dem back into da person dey were before.$b$bWe gotta act fast.  Da zombies don' rest.
english.completion: We done enough, $n.  We can't keep fighting dese zombies.  We need to figure out da source of dis voodoo.  An' I tink I know where to start...

text.title: 不良供给
text.objectives: 检查探险者协会挖掘场的食物补给。
text.description: 有些幸存者提到了食物，$n。我们最好赶快检查下食物补给，我有种不祥的预感。
text.completion: Zanzil... Dis is all startin' to come together now.  If I can find my contact den we can formulate a plan of attack.  A way to end dis madness.

english.title: Bad Supplies
english.objectives: Check out the food supplies at the Explorers' League Digsite.
english.description: Some of da survivors mentioned food, $n.  We better check da food supplies.  I gotta a bad feelin' about dis.
english.completion: Zanzil... Dis is all startin' to come together now.  If I can find my contact den we can formulate a plan of attack.  A way to end dis madness.

text.title: 取得联络
text.objectives: 前往藏宝海湾并找到布温巴的联络人。
text.description: 你不是僵尸……$b$b你在找一个巨魔？我确实看到过一个，就在战斗爆发之前……他警告了我们，督促我们提高警惕……但一切都太晚了。$b$b你的巨魔朋友已经赶往藏宝海湾去警告那里的人了……
text.completion: I be tellin' Baron Revilgaz about da Zandalar threat now...

english.title: Making Contact
english.objectives: Head to Booty Bay and find Bwemba's contact.
english.description: You aren't one of the zombies...$b$bA troll?  I did see one, just before the outbreak...  He warned us, told us to be on our guard... But it was too late.$b$bYour troll friend headed to Booty Bay to warn them...
english.completion: I be tellin' Baron Revilgaz about da Zandalar threat now...

text.title: 藏宝海湾的利益
text.objectives: 取回一件可以将祖尔格拉布巨魔驱逐出藏宝海湾的神器。
text.description: 听着，$n，至此你已经帮了很大的忙了，但那还远远不够。我们必须阻止这些疯狂的巨魔，至少成功把他们挡在藏宝海湾的大门外。$b$b我会派人去指挥整个行动，但我需要你进入祖尔格拉布，帮我做些事情。$b$b就是说，我需要你为我找来一个可以将这些巨魔赶出藏宝海湾的物件。$b$b你要是能做到的话，我们不会亏待你的。
text.progress: Did you find something, $n?
text.completion: You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.$B$BAh, but what's that you have?$B$BYou say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?$B$BNow we are talking!$B$BOh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay or Overseer Blingbang inside Zul'Gurub.

english.title: Booty Bay's Interests
english.objectives: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
english.description: Look, $n.  You've helped out plenty so far, but that's not going to be enough.  I need these crazy trolls stopped, or at least stopped from getting into Booty Bay.$b$bI'm going to send a man in to oversee the action, but I want you to go into Zul'Gurub and make something happen.$b$bAt the very least, I want you to find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.$b$bYou do that and we'll treat you right.
english.progress: Did you find something, $n?
english.completion: You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.$B$BAh, but what's that you have?$B$BYou say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?$B$BNow we are talking!$B$BOh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay or Overseer Blingbang inside Zul'Gurub.

text.title: 藏宝海湾的利益
text.objectives: 取回一件可以将祖尔格拉布巨魔驱逐出藏宝海湾的神器。
text.description: 藏宝海湾的大财主里维加兹派我到这里的目的，就是确保这次巨魔的威胁可以有效地被遏止，至少成功把他们挡在藏宝海湾的大门外。$b$b我需要大家马上行动，取得成效。$b$b所以你应该到那里去，奋勇杀敌。$b$b然后你要找到一样可以把巨魔从藏宝海湾驱逐走的物件。$b$b你要是能做到的话，我们会给予你报酬的。
text.progress: Did you find something, $n?
text.completion: You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.$B$BAh, but what's that you have?$B$BYou say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?$B$BNow we are talking!$B$BOh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.
text.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay or Overseer Blingbang inside Zul'Gurub.

english.title: Booty Bay's Interests
english.objectives: Recover an artifact that might keep the Zul'Gurub trolls out of Booty Bay.
english.description: I've been sent here by Baron Revilgaz of Booty Bay to make sure this troll menace is halted.  Or that it is at least halted at the gates of Booty Bay.$b$bI want action and I want results.$b$bI want you to get in there and kill.$b$bI want you to get in there and find me something that will help keep these trolls out of Booty Bay.$b$bYou do that and we'll make sure you get paid.
english.progress: Did you find something, $n?
english.completion: You killed them all?  I wish that would ease my mind, but these guys seem to have a habit of coming back from the dead.$B$BAh, but what's that you have?$B$BYou say it might keep them out of Booty Bay?$B$BNow we are talking!$B$BOh right, I said I had a reward for you?  Sure... Just give me a minute to find it.
english.completed: Return to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay or Overseer Blingbang inside Zul'Gurub.

text.title: 闪亮的报酬
text.objectives: 到加尼罗哨站的雕像下取得你的奖赏。
text.description: 就在荆棘谷藏宝海湾的西北边，有一处藏宝点位于加尼罗哨站的雕像附近。$b$b前往那个雕像领取你的奖赏，$c。
text.completion: Loot at last!

english.title: A Shiny Reward
english.objectives: Get your reward from a chest in the statue at Janeiro's Point.
english.description: There is a stash of loot located in the statue on Janeiro's Point just northwest of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.$b$bHead to the statue and claim your prize, $c.
english.completion: Loot at last!

text.title: 巨魔来袭
text.objectives: 同暴风城港口的指挥官沙普交谈。
text.description: 一队自称为暗矛氏族代表的巨魔刚刚袭击了暴风城港口。我们的卫兵暂时挡住了他们。$b$b暴风城港口卫兵正在寻找有能力的冒险者，帮助他们从港口击退这些巨魔。去向暴风城港口的指挥官沙普报到吧。
text.completion: Oh good, a $C.  Maybe you'll have better luck in dealing with these trolls.$B$BSee what they want and then try to get rid of them.

english.title: The Troll Incursion
english.objectives: Speak with Commander Sharp in Stormwind Harbor.
english.description: A group of trolls, claiming to represent the Darkspear tribe, have arrived at Stormwind Harbor.  Our guards are keeping them at bay, for now.$b$bThe Stormwind Harbor Guards are seeking seasoned adventurers for help in removing the trolls from the harbor.  Report to Commander Sharp at Stormwind Harbor.
english.completion: Oh good, a $C.  Maybe you'll have better luck in dealing with these trolls.$B$BSee what they want and then try to get rid of them.

text.title: 赞达拉的威胁
text.objectives: 去奥格瑞玛的精神谷，见布温巴。
text.description: 赞达拉巨魔正在荆棘谷活动！$b$b如果你想援助暗矛巨魔，就去奥格瑞玛的精神谷向布温巴报到吧。
text.completion: Greetings, $R.  Dese be desperate times.  Da Zandalar trolls be ready to take back dere lands.

english.title: The Zandalari Menace
english.objectives: Speak with Bwemba in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
english.description: The Zandalar trolls are on the move in Stranglethorn Vale!$b$bIf you wish to help the Darkspear trolls, report to Bwemba in Orgrimmar's Valley of Spirits.
english.completion: Greetings, $R.  Dese be desperate times.  Da Zandalar trolls be ready to take back dere lands.

text.title: 赞达拉代表
text.objectives: 到暴风城港口见布温巴。
text.description: $C！响应我的号召，荆棘谷需要你的援助！很久以前你帮助过赞达拉。我们不会忘记你的英勇事迹，所以我们希望再次请求你的援助。到港口找我。
text.giverWindow: 赞达拉代表

english.title: The Zandalar Representative
english.objectives: Meet Bwemba at Stormwind Harbor.
english.description: $C!  Heed my call.  Stranglethorn Vale has need of your assistance! Long ago you helped da Zandalar out before.  We not be forgetting your deeds.  It be because of your past help dat we come to you for help.  Come to me at the harbor.
english.giverWindow: Zandalar Representative

text.title: 火蜘蛛恐惧症
text.objectives: 杀死8只烬网织网蛛或烬网爬虫。
text.description: 为了保住这个地区，我们奋力拼杀，但是成效甚微。$B$B我们的侦察兵报告说周边地区充斥着可怕的火蜘蛛。它们都是那头凶恶的母蛛，贝丝缇拉克的子嗣。$B$B把烬网织网蛛或烬网爬虫从这一地区清除出去，帮我们守住阵线。看见孩子们被杀，贝丝缇拉克一定会抓狂的。
text.completion: Wonderful! The more spiders we clear out, the easier it will be to push forward.
text.completed: Return to Deldren Ravenelm at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

english.title: Pyrorachnophobia
english.objectives: Kill 8 Cinderweb Spinners or Cinderweb Creepers.
english.description: We've fought hard to secure this area, but our foothold is tenuous.$B$BOur scouts report that the area around us is teeming with vicious fire spiders. They are the spawn of the vicious brood widow, Beth'tilac.$B$BHelp us hold our line by clearing the area of Cinderweb Spinners or Cinderweb Creepers. It will drive her mad to see her children slain.
english.completion: Wonderful! The more spiders we clear out, the easier it will be to push forward.
english.completed: Return to Deldren Ravenelm at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

text.title: 蛋打蛛亡
text.objectives: 去寡妇之巢的石柱里收集20枚烬网蛛卵。
text.description: 我们遇到大麻烦了。附近的蜘蛛不但凶恶、富有攻击性，它们的数量也是源源不绝。$B$B我们必须阻止它们的队伍继续壮大。要想扼杀它们，就得从蛛卵，而不是从战场上下手。$B$B烬网织网蛛的卵就下在北边的石柱中。去收集20枚蛛卵，然后把它们交给我。
text.progress: It appears the Cinderweb Spinners are the caretakers of Beth'tilac's brood.
text.completion: Wonderful work, $C. Let's hope those little spider bites aren't infectious.
text.completed: Return to Deldren Ravenelm at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

english.title: Egg-stinction
english.objectives: Collect 20 Cinderweb Eggs from the pillars in The Widow's Clutch.
english.description: We have a real problem on our hands. Not only are the nearby spiders vicious and predatory, their numbers appear to be endless.$B$BWe need to stop the growth of their army. Cut their heads off in the egg, not on the battlefield.$B$BThe Cinderweb Spinners' eggs are laid among the stone pillars to the north. Collect 20 eggs and bring them back to me.
english.progress: It appears the Cinderweb Spinners are the caretakers of Beth'tilac's brood.
english.completion: Wonderful work, $C. Let's hope those little spider bites aren't infectious.
english.completed: Return to Deldren Ravenelm at the Forlorn Spire in the Firelands.

text.title: 熊就在那里
text.objectives: 爬到呼啸林地的树上，抓住受困的海加尔幼熊，然后把它们从树顶丢到软垫上去。那里绝对安全。
text.description: 哦，看在山莓的份上！我们刚从树顶救下来了最后一只熊宝宝，可火焰又转身而至，熊熊们又被吓跑了！$b$b我不知道你明不明白这一点，熊宝宝可是非常珍贵娇嫩的。$B$B你得远赴西北边的呼啸林地里去寻找它们。爬到树上，轻轻把那些熊宝宝抓下来，然后再把它们安全地抛到林地中间的软垫上。一定要小心！$b$b<米露恩的情绪突然变得很激动，她哭了起来。>$b$b小小小小小熊！你，你一定要去帮它们，$n！
text.completion: Oh, you did it, $n! The baby bears are so happy. I'm beginning to think they've started doing this on purpose.
text.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.turninWindow: 哦耶！

english.title: Those Bears Up There
english.objectives: Climb up trees in the Whistling Grove, grab stranded Hyjal Bear Cubs, and then hurl them at the Soft Target from the top of the tree. This is perfectly safe.
english.description: Oh, raspberries! Just when we had saved the last bear cub from the treetops, the fires returned and scared them again!$b$bI don't know if you know this, but baby bears are precious and soft.$B$BGo to the Whistling Grove, far to the northwest. Climb the trees, grab the bear cubs, and chuck them - gently! - to the soft target in the center of the grove.$B$B<Without warning, Mylune suddenly smashes you against her bosom and begins sobbing.>$B$BLil' b-b-b-baby bears! Save them, $n!
english.completion: Oh, you did it, $n! The baby bears are so happy. I'm beginning to think they've started doing this on purpose.
english.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.turninWindow: Oh, yay!

objectiveDetails.description: 海加尔幼熊到达安全地点

text.title: 自然的祝福
text.objectives: 使用艾森娜的翡翠来召唤并击败派拉齐尼斯。
text.description: <米露恩的声音在你脑中回响，像鸟儿欢快的歌唱。>$B$B我爱森林中的所有生物，甚至包括蜘蛛，虽然它们都粘糊糊的。但是火焰之地的蜘蛛可不仅仅是粘糊糊那么糟糕而已。它们一直在燃烧，而且它们不属于这里。$B$B找到复苏之地西部的火焰传送门，用我刚才给你的宝石打开它。当火焰蜘蛛冲出来时，就把它踩死！当然了，如果它很大，你就得用点$c的手段了。$B$B哦，对了，如果你中了蜘蛛的毒，就用宝石解毒吧。
text.completion: Oh NO you're covered in SPIDER-SPORCH! You're such a brave $r. I hope you'll go into the Firelands soon and step on ALL the spiders.
text.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: 使用翡翠来清毒！

english.title: Nature's Blessing
english.objectives: Use the Emerald of Aessina to summon and kill Pyrachnis.
english.description: <Mylune's voice rings in your head, like the sound of birds chirping.>$B$BI love all creatures of the forest, even spiders, despite the fact that they are icky. But the spiders from the Firelands are worse than icky. They're burny, and don't belong here.$B$BFind the fire portal in the western Regrowth, and use the gem I gave you earlier to force it open. When a fire spider emerges, step on it! Unless it's big. Then, do something $cy to it.$B$BOh, and use the gem if spider venom makes you woozy!
english.completion: Oh NO you're covered in SPIDER-SPORCH! You're such a brave $r. I hope you'll go into the Firelands soon and step on ALL the spiders.
english.completed: Return to Mylune at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Use the Emerald to remove its poison!

text.title: 灭火之怒
text.objectives: 在复苏之地或塞西莉亚的栖地中击败任意9名来自火焰之地的入侵者。
text.description: 我们在海加尔的任务之中，最紧迫的任务很简单：消灭那些入侵者。火焰的本质就是吞噬一切。如果有片刻松懈，它就会将眼前的一切烧成灰烬。$b$b干掉任何你看见的烈焰入侵者。每一名敌人的倒下，都会为海加尔争取时间。
text.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while. Hyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Rage Against the Flames
english.objectives: Kill any 9 invaders from the Firelands in the Regrowth or Sethria's Roost.
english.description: Of all of our tasks here in Hyjal, the most pressing is simple: destroy these invaders. The very nature of fire is that it is all-consuming. Lower your defense for just a moment and it will destroy everything in sight.$b$bKill any of the fiery invaders you find. Every enemy defeated purchases more time for Hyjal.
english.completion: Well-fought, $n. Take a break from the flames for a while. Hyjal will live to see another day, and when that day comes, I will need you alive.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死来自火焰之地的入侵者

text.title: 让你的吼声更完美
text.objectives: 在复苏之地内，消灭10名火焰之地入侵者，并在击败它们的地方使用狼的尖牙。
text.description: 远古之狼，洛戈什——哦，你们习惯叫它戈德林，有很多能力，但最容易被低估的是他的嗥叫。今天，我们就要用这种能力来召唤并击败莱拉克斯，一名潜伏在火焰之地的烈焰将领。$b$b击败任何一只复苏之地的烈焰生物，然后在它倒下的地方嚎叫。很快，你的吼声就会响彻全卡利姆多。
text.completion: Yes, $n, you are ready. Now, we strike against Lylagar.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.turninWindow: 你的吼声真带劲，朋友。

english.title: Perfecting Your Howl
english.objectives: Use the Fang of the Wolf atop the corpses of 10 Firelands invaders within the Regrowth.
english.description: The wolf ancient, Lo'gosh - or, if you prefer, Goldrinn - has many weapons available to him, but always the most underestimated is his howl. Today, we will use this weapon to summon and defeat Lylagar, one of the lieutenants of flame that lurk within the Firelands.$b$bDefeat any of the creatures of flame within the Regrowth, and then use the Fang of the Wolf while standing atop their corpse. Soon, your howl will echo across all of Kalimdor.
english.completion: Yes, $n, you are ready. Now, we strike against Lylagar.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.turninWindow: Your howl is inspired, friend.

objectiveDetails.description: 在被击败的入侵者身上发出嚎叫

text.title: 召唤兽群
text.objectives: 使用狼的尖牙来召唤并击败莱拉克斯。
text.description: <麦托克劳继续说道：>$b$b最东边的烈焰传送门是莱拉克斯的地盘。你站在传送门前，然后发出挑衅的吼声，引诱那只烈焰猛兽出来与你一战。
text.completion: I heard your triumphant cries echo across the mountain cliffs. I also heard Lylagar utter a... different type of cry.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
text.giverWindow: 该是遛狗的时候了……然后干掉它。

english.title: The Call of the Pack
english.objectives: Use the Fang of the Wolf to summon and defeat Lylagar.
english.description: <Matoclaw continues:>$b$bThe easternmost portal of flame is the domain of Lylagar. Stand before the portal, deliver a challenging howl, and then force the fiery beast to submit.
english.completion: I heard your triumphant cries echo across the mountain cliffs. I also heard Lylagar utter a... different type of cry.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.giverWindow: Time to take the dog out for a walk... and then KILL IT.

text.title: 送往前线的补给
text.objectives: 采集7个蓝根藤
text.description: 我们德鲁伊面临的最大威胁之一就是在火焰之地战斗，很容易脱水。我们的人花了大量的时间来为另一面的军队准备伙食。然而，我们还有其他办法。$b$b在东边有片蓊郁的林地，你可以在那里找到一些还没有被烧尽的蓝根藤。那些植物的根茎中储藏着大量的水分，同样也能给疲惫的士兵补充能量。
text.progress: Let's see... how many have you managed to gather?
text.completion: I will have these packaged and shipped off right away.
text.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Supplies for the Other Side
english.objectives: Obtain 7 Blueroot Vines.
english.description: One of the biggest dangers that our druids face when fighting within the Firelands is simple dehydration. Our proveditors spend a significant amount of time preparing canteens for the troops on the other side. We do have other methods, however.$b$bIn the greener thickets to the east, you should still find some blueroot vines which have not yet burned. These plants hold a tremendous amount of water in their roots - and also provide some energy for the weary soldier.
english.progress: Let's see... how many have you managed to gather?
english.completion: I will have these packaged and shipped off right away.
english.completed: Return to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 女妖之王
text.objectives: 带领你的孤儿去见幽暗城皇家区的希尔瓦娜斯·风行者。当你到达那里时，如果你的孤儿不在身边，就召唤他过来。
text.description: 希尔瓦娜斯女王是部落一流的战士，也许她就是因为这个才当上大酋长的吧！$B$B我一直都想和她见一面，$n。也许像你这样的冒险者就有资格觐见她！你能带我去幽暗城的皇家区，见一见希尔瓦娜斯女王么？去那里的路很远，而且我打赌，那些卫兵一定不会让我一个人进去！
text.completion: She's just as fierce as I thought she'd be! But that ambassador sure got real mad when I started talking to Lady Sylvanas.
text.end: 与希尔瓦娜斯·风行者女王见面
text.completed: 去找你的兽人孤儿。

english.title: The Banshee Queen
english.objectives: Take your orphan to meet Lady Sylvanas Windrunner in the Royal Quarter of the Undercity. Call for your orphan if he is not present when you arrive.
english.description: Lady Sylvanas, leader of the Forsaken, is s'posed to be one of the best warriors in the Horde, maybe even as good as the warchief himself!$B$BI've always wanted to meet her, $n. Maybe an adventurer like you could get an audience with her! Would you take me to the Royal Quarter of the Undercity to meet Lady Sylvanas? It's a long way away and I bet the guards would never let me in by myself!
english.completion: She's just as fierce as I thought she'd be! But that ambassador sure got real mad when I started talking to Lady Sylvanas.
english.end: Meeting with Lady Sylvanas Windrunner
english.completed: Return to your Orcish Orphan.

text.title: 第二目标
text.objectives: 在祖尔格拉布中消灭搬运者伽乌里马、撕裂者莫尔雷克和死亡丧钟莫尔塔克斯。
text.description: 古拉巴什巨魔已经召集起他们最强大的盟友，重新建起祖尔格拉布，占据了荆棘谷。$B$B他们的头领是两个巨大恐怖的巨魔：搬运者伽乌里马和撕裂者莫尔雷克，以及一个被称为莫尔塔克斯的强大窃魂者。$B$B虽然他们并不是祖尔格拉布的统治者，但打败这些强大的巨魔爪牙能够有力地帮助我们阻止古拉巴什崛起。
text.completed: Speak to Chabal inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: Jin'Do has powerful allies.

english.title: Secondary Targets
english.objectives: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub.
english.description: The Gurubashi trolls have gathered their most powerful allies to rebuild Zul'Gurub and re-take Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BChief among them are two monstrous trolls: Kaulema the Mover and Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.$B$BThough they are not the leaders of Zul'Gurub, defeating these powerful minions will aid us greatly preventing the rise of the Gurubashi.
english.completed: Speak to Chabal inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: Jin'Do has powerful allies.

text.title: 暗藏的猛兽
text.objectives: 消灭祖尔格拉布中的花翼巢穴女王、沉睡者托尔图恩和一个加兹兰卡的失落后裔。
text.description: <梅维克紧张得有些坐立不安。>$B$B哈卡败亡之后，都市古拉巴什也逐渐破败坍塌，丛莽覆盖了祖尔格拉布的大部分地区。现在，一些强大的猛兽正潜伏在这座古代都市的残垣断壁中。$B$B我们已经见到过那些古拉巴什牧师的力量——他们利用剧毒调和物，让植物成为我们的敌人。英雄们，请赶快行动，除掉那些猛兽，不要让它们失去自我意识，成为金度以及其爪牙的奴仆！
text.completed: Speak to Maywiki inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: 我們不能讓古拉巴什控制牠們!

english.title: The Beasts Within
english.objectives: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub.
english.description: <Maywiki shuffles nervously.>$B$BAfter the fall of Hakkar, the city of the Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and the jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own.  Several powerful beasts now reside in the cracks and hollows of the ancient city.$B$BWe have seen the powers that the Gurubashi priests wield - they turn the very plantlife against us with their venomous concoctions.  Please, heroes, dispose of these beasts, before they become mindless agents of Jin'Do and his minions!
english.completed: Speak to Maywiki inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: We can't let the Gurubashi control them!

text.title: UNUSED REUSE
text.objectives: Kill Corla, Herald of Twilight.
text.description: <Finkle's helm gives you a slight jolt.>$B$BWhat is this place? It looks like they're doing something terrible to that nether dragon. The energy is being siphoned from the creature into that lady! We need to stop this ritual!$B$BKill Corla to get past this hall!
text.completed: Speak to Finkle Einhorn inside Blackrock Caverns at Blackrock Mountain.
text.giverWindow: She looks mean!
text.turninWindow: There's no time to waste! Raz needs our help!

english.giverWindow: She looks mean!

text.title: 暗藏的猛兽
text.objectives: 消灭英雄难度祖尔格拉布中的花翼巢穴女王、沉睡者托尔图恩和一个加兹兰卡的失落后裔。
text.description: <鲜血杀手塔莱看了你一会儿。>$B$B哈卡败亡之后，古拉巴什遗城也逐渐破败坍塌，丛莽覆盖了祖尔格拉布的大部分地区。现在，一些强大的猛兽正潜伏在这座古代都市的残垣断壁中。$B$B我们已经见到过那些古拉巴什牧师的力量——他们利用剧毒调和物，让植物成为我们的敌人。英雄们，请赶快行动，除掉那些猛兽，不要让它们失去自我意识，成为金度以及其爪牙的奴仆！
text.completion: You done well. We gonna rest easy tonight knowin' Jin'do an' Zanzil ain't gonna bind dem powerful beasts against us.
text.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: 我们不能让古拉巴什控制它们！

english.title: The Beasts Within
english.objectives: Kill the Florawing Hive Queen, Tor-Tun the Slumberer, and a Lost Offspring of Ghaz'Ranka inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: <Bloodslayer T'ara eyes you for a moment.>$B$BAfter de fall of Hakkar, de city of de Gurubashi fell into disrepair, and de jungle claimed most of Zul'Gurub for its own. Some powerful beasts now be livin' in da cracks an' hollows of de ancient city. $B$BWe seen de powers dem Gurubashi priests wield - dey turn de very plantlife against us wit' venomous concoctions. You tink you be strong? Dispose of dese beasts, before dey become mindless agents of Jin'do.
english.completion: You done well. We gonna rest easy tonight knowin' Jin'do an' Zanzil ain't gonna bind dem powerful beasts against us.
english.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: We can't let the Gurubashi control them!

text.title: 第二目标
text.objectives: 在英雄难度的祖尔格拉布消灭搬运者伽乌里马、撕裂者莫尔雷克和死亡丧钟莫尔塔克斯。
text.description: 古拉巴什巨魔已经召集起他们最强大的盟友，重新建起祖尔格拉布，占据了荆棘谷。$B$B他们的头领是两个巨大恐怖的巨魔：搬运者伽乌里马和撕裂者莫尔雷克，以及一个被称为莫尔塔克斯的强大窃魂者。$B$B虽然他们并不是祖尔格拉布的统治者，但打败这些强大的巨魔爪牙能够有力地帮助我们阻止古拉巴什崛起。
text.completion: Jin'do's empire crumbles around him like da ruins of dis forsaken city.
text.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: 金度拥有强大的盟军。

english.title: Secondary Targets
english.objectives: Kill Kaulema the Mover, Mor'Lek the Dismantler, and Mortaxx, the Tolling Bell inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: Da Gurubashi trolls gathered dere most powerful allies ta rebuild Zul'Gurub an' re-take Stranglethorn Vale.$B$BChief among dem be two monstrous trolls: Kaulema da Mover an' Mor'Lek da Dismantler, an' a powerful soul-stealer called Mortaxx.$B$BDey don't be leaders of da Gurubashi, but killing dem powerful minions gonna help us prevent da rise of da Gurubashi.
english.completion: Jin'do's empire crumbles around him like da ruins of dis forsaken city.
english.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: Jin'do has powerful allies.

text.title: 毁灭性打击
text.objectives: 消灭祖尔格拉布中的伽布和古拉巴什厨师长。
text.description: 祖尔格拉布这种城市就像你在这里看到的那些参天大树。$B$B也许它的树干粗大坚固，树冠遮天蔽日，但如果没有遥远下方的根系提供营养，这棵树就会枯萎死亡。$B$B金度的军队给养很大一部分来自于两个古拉巴什巨魔小分队。切断这些根系，这座城市就只能崩塌了。
text.completed: Speak to Al'tabim inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: You must disrupt their supply lines!

english.title: Break Their Spirits
english.objectives: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub.
english.description: A city like Zul'Gurub is similar to one of the many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BThe trunk may be thick, and the canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from the roots far below, the tree will wither and fall.$B$BJin'Do's army is fed largely by the actions of two minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever these roots, and the city will fall all the easier.
english.completed: Speak to Al'tabim inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: You must disrupt their supply lines!

text.title: 毁灭性打击
text.objectives: 消灭英雄难度祖尔格拉布中的伽布和古拉巴什厨师长。
text.description: 祖尔格拉布这种城市就像你在这里看到的那些参天大树。$B$B也许它的树干粗大坚固，树冠遮天蔽日，但如果没有遥远下方的根系提供营养，这棵树就会枯萎死亡。$B$B金度的军队给养很大一部分来自于两个古拉巴什巨魔小分队。切断这些根系，这座城市就只能崩塌了。
text.completion: Da great Gurubashi empire begin ta wither already. It be only a matter of time, now.
text.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
text.giverWindow: 你必须破坏他们的供给线！

english.title: Break Their Spirits
english.objectives: Kill Gub and the Gurubashi Master Chef inside of Zul'Gurub on Heroic difficulty.
english.description: A city like Zul'Gurub be similar ta one of de many towering trees you see nearby.$B$BDe trunk may be thick, and de canopy vast and leafy, but without nutrients from de roots far below, de tree gonna wither and fall.$B$BJin'do's army be fed largely by de actions of a couple a' minor Gurubashi trolls.  Sever dem roots, and de city gonna fall.
english.completion: Da great Gurubashi empire begin ta wither already. It be only a matter of time, now.
english.completed: Speak to Bloodslayer T'ara inside Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn Vale.
english.giverWindow: You must disrupt their supply lines!

text.title: 逝去的酋长
text.objectives: 带领你的孤儿前往赤色石，访问凯恩·血蹄的火葬堆。如果你的孤儿不在身边，就召唤他过来。
text.description: 监护员巴特维尔说，凯恩·血蹄死去之后，部落失去了一个“睿智的声音”。我不知道这是什么意思，但我一直都希望能见到他。另一些孤儿甚至还有他的蹄子印呢。$B$B你愿意带我去莫高雷吗？我们的老师说，牛头人会把他们的死者送到一个叫赤色石的地方，在那里追悼他们。我们应该到那里去，看看是否能在那里找到凯恩。
text.completion: Someday, I'm going to be a great warrior, just like Cairne or the warchief. Everyone will remember my deeds, and the ancestors will welcome my spirit too!
text.end: 带领你的孤儿去访问赤色石
text.completed: 去找你的兽人孤儿。

english.title: The Fallen Chieftain
english.objectives: Take your orphan to Red Rocks to visit the funeral pyre of Cairne Bloodhoof. Call for your orphan if he is not present when you arrive.
english.description: Matron Battlewail says that when Cairne Bloodhoof died, the Horde lost a 'voice of wisdom'. I don't know what that means, but I always wanted to meet him.
