english.objectives: Obtain 5 Luciferns.
english.description: My fellow druid, Choluna, has asked us to collect any specimens of plant life that we might find here in the Firelands...$b$b...I don't know whose idea it was to bring scholars to a warfront.$b$bNevertheless, you will already be in the cave - killing things - so be on the lookout for anything growing out of the ground.

text.title: 善心之举
text.description: 这样多的暴力，这样多的死亡。兄弟们死去了，母亲死去了。而现在，如果没有人照顾这只豹崽，它同样会死去。$b$b你能不能暂停一下暴力的行为，来照顾一下豹子的幼崽？

english.title: Some Good Will Come
english.description: So much violence, so much death.  Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.$b$bWill you take a pause from the violence to help care for a panther cub?

text.title: 善心之举
text.objectives: 照顾这只豹崽，毕竟是你杀死了它的母亲。
text.description: 这样多的暴力，这样多的死亡。兄弟们死去了，母亲死去了。而现在，如果没有人照顾这只豹崽，它同样会死去。$b$b你能不能暂停一下暴力的行为，来照顾一下豹子的幼崽？
text.completion: The panther cub looks at you with a look in its eyes that says, "Will you be my new $g dad:mom;?"

english.description: So much violence, so much death.  Brothers have died, a mother has died, and now a panther cub will die if there is no one to take care of it.$b$bWill you take a break from the violence and help care for a panther cub?
english.completion: The panther cub looks at you with a look in its eyes that says, "Will you be my new $g dad:mom;?"

text.title: 化为一体
text.objectives: 跟卡雷苟斯谈一谈，同意他的请求。
text.description: 我受命保护她，可到头来她还是为了我牺牲了自己。$b$b我无法忍受失去她的痛苦，$n。我要交给你一件庄重的任务。$b$b从来没有一名凡人能够承载纯粹的龙族精华，但只要你允许，我会破这个例。$b$b趁她尚有余息，请问你，你是否愿意让我把泰蕾苟萨同你结合在一起？
text.completion: I am grateful, $n.$B$BWere you not present, or had you refused, Tarecgosa would be lost to me.
text.end: 去考达拉跟卡雷苟斯谈一谈。
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

english.title: At One
english.objectives: Speak to Kalecgos to agree to his proposition.
english.description: I was charged with her protection, yet it was she who sacrificed herself for my sake.$b$bI cannot bear to lose her, $n. I must make a solemn request of you.$b$bNever has a mortal borne the essence of a true dragon, but with your permission I would make an exception.$b$bPlease, while there is life in her, will you allow me to bind Tarecgosa to you?
english.completion: I am grateful, $n.$B$BWere you not present, or had you refused, Tarecgosa would be lost to me.
english.end: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

objectiveDetails.description: 同泰蕾苟萨的精华结合

text.title: 光阴苦短
text.objectives: 从火焰之地收集1000份沸燃之烬。
text.description: 泰蕾苟萨已经和你融合在了一起，$n，但这只是暂时的。只有守护巨龙才有能力永久封住她的精魂。$b$b玛里苟斯的继任者要在艾泽拉斯的下一个月蚀之时才会被选出，而你们之间的联系无法持续那么久。$b$b幸运的是，有一个办法可以帮我们争取到必要的时间。强大的元素存在可以延长仪式的效果。其中一些在火元素位面就能找到，相信你已经很熟悉了。$b$b拿到它们，$c，让泰蕾苟萨撑到月蚀之时。
text.progress: It is good to see you again, $n.
text.completion: I sense that Tarecgosa is still with you.$B$BYou have done well, my friend.
text.completed: Speak with Kalecgos in Coldarra

english.title: Time Grows Short
english.objectives: Collect 1000 Seething Cinders from the Firelands.
english.description: Tarecgosa is bound to you, $n, but only temporarily. An aspect's power is required to permanently seal her essence.$b$bMalygos's successor will not be chosen until Azeroth's moons next eclipse, and the bond you share will not last until then.$b$bFortunately, there is a way to buy us the time we need. Powerful elements exist that can extend the ritual's effects. Some of these can be found in the Plane of Fire, with which you've become familiar.$b$bObtain them, $c, and sustain Tarecgosa until the eclipse.
english.progress: It is good to see you again, $n.
english.completion: I sense that Tarecgosa is still with you.$B$BYou have done well, my friend.

text.description: We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.

text.title: 到底有多热
text.objectives: 使用索罗的温度计测量火羽峰的三个大岩浆池的温度。
text.description: 火羽峰的火鹰可以忍受难以置信的高温。你可能经常会看到它们在天空中翱翔，可要知道它们也能在熔火的岩浆中畅游。$b$b对不对，安伦？$b$b我们想知道岩浆到底能有多烫。火羽峰有三个大岩浆池。用这个装置去每一处测量一下那里的温度吧。
text.completion: These results will go a long way to help us understand the fire hawks, and - more importantly - Alysrazor, their new, fiery queen.$B$BTholo and I are thankful that you've been helping us out.

english.objectives: Use Tholo's Thermometer to measure the temperature of the three large lava pools on Fireplume Peak.
english.description: The fire hawks of Fireplume Peak can withstand incredible temperatures. While you'll often find them circling the skies above, they're also known to swim in molten lava.$b$bIsn't that right, Anren?$b$bWe'd like to know just how hot that lava can get. Fireplume Peak has three large lava pools. Use this to measure the temperature of each.
english.completion: These results will go a long way to help us understand the fire hawks, and - more importantly - Alysrazor, their new, fiery queen.$B$BTholo and I are thankful that you've been helping us out.

text.title: 沙恩诺克斯的猎狗
text.objectives: 收集6份猎狗骨灰。
text.description: 在火焰之地最大的一座岛屿上，我们的部队在面对火妖猎手沙恩诺克斯时遇到了麻烦。他不仅是个神射手，而且还豢养着训练有素的猎狗，让我们的部队吃尽了苦头。$b$b聪明绝顶的索罗认为我们最好研究一下这些猎狗的生物学现象。而我呢，当然，和索罗意见一致。$b$b你可以在熔炉下的熔火激流里找到不少猎狗。我们需要它们的灰烬来进行研究，
text.progress: Any information we can get will be instrumental in helping our men defeat Shannox.
text.completion: This ash may seem indistinguishable from any other type of ash you find on this forsaken island, but trust me... you have found the right stuff.$B$BWe will have it analyzed immediately.$B$BReturn again soon. While I do enjoy spending time with Anren, we also appreciate your company, $n.
text.completed: Return to Tholo Whitehoof at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: Hounds of Shannox
english.objectives: Obtain 6 small piles of Houndbone Ash.
english.description: On the Firelands' largest island, our troops have been having trouble against Shannox, the flamewaker hunter. Not only does he have impeccable aim, but he keeps trained hounds that give our troops no end of trouble.$b$bTholo, in all his wisdom, thinks it would be a good idea to study the biology of these hounds. I, of course, agree with Tholo.$b$bYou will find several hounds in the Molten Flow, beneath the Furnace. We will need their ashes to study.
english.progress: Any information we can get will be instrumental in helping our men defeat Shannox.
english.completion: This ash may seem indistinguishable from any other type of ash you find on this forsaken island, but trust me... you have found the right stuff.$B$BWe will have it analyzed immediately.$B$BReturn again soon. While I do enjoy spending time with Anren, we also appreciate your company, $n.
english.completed: Return to Tholo Whitehoof at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: 范达尔的研究
text.objectives: 获得一根烈焰德鲁伊法杖、一本烈焰德鲁伊法术书、一只烈焰德鲁伊材料包，以及一尊烈焰德鲁伊神像。
text.description: 烈焰德鲁伊……几个星期前，索罗和我甚至都没听说过这个德鲁伊教派。而现在，在范达尔·鹿盔的领导下，他们精湛的火焰法术已经威胁到了我们的任务。$b$b他们似乎在东北边的火岩深渊储存了一些物资。如果我们能弄一些物资来的话，或许就能在和范达尔对抗的时候占点优势。
text.progress: Trust me - whatever information we can gather here will go far to helping us understand the source of Fandral's powers.
text.completion: Anren, look what $n found! This is exactly what we needed!$B$BIt will take us some time to look through these supplies. For now, you have our thanks.
text.completed: Return to Tholo Whitehoof at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: Fandral's Methods
english.objectives: Obtain a Flame Druid Staff, a Flame Druid Spellbook, a Flame Druid Reagent Pouch, and a Flame Druid Idol.
english.description: The Druids of the Flame... an order of druids that, up until a few weeks ago, Tholo and I had never even heard of. Now, under the leadership of Fandral Staghelm, they threaten our mission's success with their mastery of fire.$b$bIt would appear that they store some supplies in the Igneous Depths, to the northeast. Perhaps, if we can get some of those supplies, we will have more luck when we take the fight to Fandral.
english.progress: Trust me - whatever information we can gather here will go far to helping us understand the source of Fandral's powers.
english.completion: Anren, look what $n found! This is exactly what we needed!$B$BIt will take us some time to look through these supplies. For now, you have our thanks.
english.completed: Return to Tholo Whitehoof at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: 烈焰蛛后
text.objectives: 获得8份火热毒液样本及8份滚烫的蛛网分泌液样本。
text.description: 东北边的寡妇之巢是以烈焰蜘蛛的巨型蛛后，贝丝缇拉克而命名的。她的蛛网和毒液让我们的进攻主力疲于奔命。$b$b我们相信，如果我们对熔火前线的火焰蜘蛛进行研究的话，就能找到战胜贝丝缇拉克的方法。不管用什么办法，你都要将它们的毒液和蛛网分泌液收集起来，然后去找我最可靠的朋友安伦。
text.progress: Be careful with those fluids, $n. We don't want them spilling anywhere.
text.completion: You are an asset to our cause, $n. Tholo and I thank you.
text.completed: Return to Anren Shadowseeker at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: The Flame Spider Queen
english.objectives: Obtain 8 samples of Flame Venom and 8 samples of Searing Web Fluid.
english.description: The Widow's Clutch, to the northeast, is named after Beth'tilac, the enormous queen of the flame spiders. Her webs and her poison are a nagging threat to our main offensive force.$b$bWe believe that if we study the flame spiders here on the Molten Front, we can use that information to find success against Beth'tilac. Use whatever methods you can to gather their venom and their web fluid, then return to my trusted friend Anren.
english.progress: Be careful with those fluids, $n. We don't want them spilling anywhere.
english.completion: You are an asset to our cause, $n. Tholo and I thank you.
english.completed: Return to Anren Shadowseeker at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: 活体黑曜石
text.objectives: 收集10颗黑曜石陨星。
text.description: 你看到那些从天而降的火球了吗？我看到过一颗，就砸在北边的旷野里，那块石头完全是由活体黑曜石构成的！$B$B我可以用这种材料，为我们的部队打造出超级耐热的盔甲和武器。你能不能给我弄一点来？$B$B你可以去熔岩之泉触摸那些磁石。你要看好火球的落点，小心别被砸到了。然后在石头崩解之前，把它们收集起来。
text.progress: How's it going? Found any meteorites yet?
text.completion: Fantastic! Now ah kin get ta work.
text.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

english.title: Living Obsidium
english.objectives: Retrieve 10 Obsidium Meteorites.
english.description: Have you seen those fireballs falling out of the sky? I saw one crash in the fields to the north, and the rock that landed was made of pure Living Obsidium!$B$BI can use the material to craft ultra-sturdy heat proof armor and weapons for our troops. Can you bring me a lode?$B$BGo to the Magma Springs and touch one of the magnetic stones. Just watch where you're standing when the rain of fire hits, and gather up the rocks before they crumble from the impact.
english.progress: How's it going? Found any meteorites yet?
english.completion: Fantastic! Now ah kin get ta work.
english.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

text.title: 注满月井
text.objectives: 获得125个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 我们造了一口月井，但是在我们用永恒之井的圣水注满它之前，这口井的功能很有限。$B$B只要有了功能齐备的月井，我们就能祝福储备的食物，还可以利用月井的祝福来帮你防护火焰的侵袭。$B$B等你获得了足够多的印记，就去跟玛洛恩庇护所的麦托克劳谈一谈。她会安排你护送圣水的。
text.progress: How can I be of aid, $n?
text.completion: Of course. I will see to it that the sacred waters are transported through the portal right away.$B$BThank you, $C.
text.completed: Secure sacred water for the moonwell from Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Filling the Moonwell
english.objectives: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: We've constructed this moonwell, but it serves little purpose until it is filled with the sacred waters of the Well of Eternity.$B$BWith an active moonwell, we would be able to bless our food stores, and we may also be able to use the blessing to offer you some protection from fire as well.$B$BWhen you've obtained enough marks, speak to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. She'll be able to secure transport of the sacred waters.
english.progress: How can I be of aid, $n?
english.completion: Of course. I will see to it that the sacred waters are transported through the portal right away.$B$BThank you, $C.
english.completed: Secure sacred water for the moonwell from Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 滋养之水
text.objectives: 去跟玛法里奥突破口的艾拉·影暴谈一谈。
text.description: 按照你的要求，我已经将月亮井的圣水送往玛法里奥突破口了。艾拉接受过这类工作的专门训练。你应该去找她，看看她为你准备了什么惊喜。
text.completion: You will pleased to know that the waters arrived safely. With the moonwell filled, and the shade of the Sentinel Tree upon us, I can almost forget we're in the Firelands for moments at a time.$B$BI've spread the moonwell's blessing upon these trees and bushes. Take the fruit with you before you venture out. It is more refreshing than you can possibly imagine.

english.title: Nourishing Waters
english.objectives: Speak to Ayla Shadowstorm at Malfurion's Breach.
english.description: I have dispatched the sacred moonwell waters to Malfurion's Breach, as you requested. Ayla is well trained in tending to them. You should return to her and see the boons she weaves for you there.
english.completion: You will pleased to know that the waters arrived safely. With the moonwell filled, and the shade of the Sentinel Tree upon us, I can almost forget we're in the Firelands for moments at a time.$B$BI've spread the moonwell's blessing upon these trees and bushes. Take the fruit with you before you venture out. It is more refreshing than you can possibly imagine.

text.title: 追加军火
text.objectives: 获得125个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 那些德鲁伊没有合用的家伙来应付这里的问题。我有个哥们就在玛洛恩那头老鹿的圣殿里，穿过传送门就是。只要让我们凑到一块儿，就一定能搞出点真家伙来对付拉格纳罗斯那老小子和他的爪牙。$B$B去弄点他们那种什么印记，然后去找麦托克劳。问问她莉吉特在哪里。我们需要她来协助我们搞点大乱子。
text.progress: 嗯，$N?
text.completion: I was wondering if those two would come in handy. They've seemed quite out of place ever since they arrived.$B$BI saw Ricket around here just a moment ago. I'll gladly send her back through the portal with you. She's less likely to be blowing up any local plant life on that side of things anyway.$B$BLet's see... where is she...
text.completed: Seek out Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Additional Armaments
english.objectives: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: These druids be lackin' the tools ta properly handle the job out 'ere. I got meself a buddy back at day ol' stag shrine through the portal though. If we were ta be gettin' reunited, we'd sure have some real toys ta use against ol' Ragboy and 'is cronies.$B$BTake some of dem mark things an' go find Matoclaw. Ask her fer Ricket. We need'r here so we can be causin' some real trouble.
english.progress: Yes, $n?
english.completion: I was wondering if those two would come in handy. They've seemed quite out of place ever since they arrived.$B$BI saw Ricket around here just a moment ago. I'll gladly send her back through the portal with you. She's less likely to be blowing up any local plant life on that side of things anyway.$B$BLet's see... where is she...
english.completed: Seek out Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 全副武装
text.objectives: 去跟玛法里奥突破口的莉吉特谈一谈。
text.description: 按照你的要求，莉吉特应该已经和达默克在玛法里奥突破口待命了。但我不知道你是否真的明白和这两个家伙共事意味着什么。$B$B说到这里，你应该赶紧去看看……别让他们把哨卫之树给炸了。你只要吩咐他们专心与元素周旋，那么突破口这里发生“事故”的概率就会大大降低。
text.completion: Hey you! Good to see you again!$B$BI'm settled in good and fine, actually! It's good to be with good old Damek again. I never thought I'd be mixing with a dwarf so well, but he and I, we've got like minds on all the important stuff.$B$BYou go do your thing. Don't be worrying about us. If we cook up any good toys for you, we'll be sure to let ya know!

english.title: Well Armed
english.objectives: Speak to Ricket at Malfurion's Breach.
english.description: Ricket should be at Malfurion's Breach with Damek, as you requested. I'm not sure you fully know what you're getting into with those two though.$B$BSpeaking of which, you should probably go check on them... make sure they haven't managed to blow up the Sentinel Tree itself. As long as you keep them busy with the elementals, the chances of "accidents" at the breach should lessen dramatically.
english.completion: Hey you! Good to see you again!$B$BI'm settled in good and fine, actually! It's good to be with good old Damek again. I never thought I'd be mixing with a dwarf so well, but he and I, we've got like minds on all the important stuff.$B$BYou go do your thing. Don't be worrying about us. If we cook up any good toys for you, we'll be sure to let ya know!

text.title: 呼唤古树
text.objectives: 获得125个世界之树的印记。
text.description: 古树们都在海加尔山待命。考虑到他们的……身体构造，火焰之地对他们来说实在太过危险，不过为了战胜拉格纳罗斯的副手，他们的力量必不可少。$B$B去收集点印记，并且去找玛洛恩庇护所的老树干。如果古树要加入我们，那么只有他才能带领他们穿过传送门。
text.progress: Greetings to you, young one.
text.completion: I understand. We are prepared. We shall join the march and meet you on the far side of the portal.
text.completed: Secure the aid of the Ancients from Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Calling the Ancients
english.objectives: Obtain 125 Marks of the World Tree.
english.description: The ancients await in Hyjal. The Firelands will prove a dangerous place for them considering their... composition, but their strength will be of great use to us if we are to face any of Ragnaros' lieutenants.$B$BGather your marks, and seek out Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne. If they are to march with us, he would be the one leading them through the portal.
english.progress: Greetings to you, young one.
english.completion: I understand. We are prepared. We shall join the march and meet you on the far side of the portal.
english.completed: Secure the aid of the Ancients from Elderlimb at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 古树的援助
text.objectives: 去跟玛法里奥突破口的老树干谈一谈。
text.description: 古树们已经认识到了你的睿智所具有的价值，他们已经在玛法里奥突破口扎根落脚。你应该去找老树干。他一定在等你的消息。
text.completion: You chose a wise time to call upon us, $C. I was concerned for our ability to stand against the elements in this realm, but the protection of the Sentinel Tree has proven far more than sufficient shelter.$B$BWe will do anything we can to aid your efforts here. Witherbranch has met with your other allies and is discussing a way to corner some of Ragnaros' lieutenants. You should speak with them when the time comes.

english.title: Aid of the Ancients
english.objectives: Speak to Elderlimb at Malfurion's Breach.
english.description: The ancients have seen the value of your wisdom, and have set root at Malfurion's Breach. You should seek out Elderlimb. I am certain he would like to hear from you.
english.completion: You chose a wise time to call upon us, $C. I was concerned for our ability to stand against the elements in this realm, but the protection of the Sentinel Tree has proven far more than sufficient shelter.$B$BWe will do anything we can to aid your efforts here. Witherbranch has met with your other allies and is discussing a way to corner some of Ragnaros' lieutenants. You should speak with them when the time comes.

text.title: 结盟
text.objectives: 陪伴卡雷苟斯前往蓝龙议会。$b$b准备好了就去考达拉跟他谈谈。
text.description: 选举即将开始，$n。$b$b尽管议会只允许蓝龙军团的成员参加，但是与泰蕾苟萨融合之后，你也必须参加这次选举了。$b$b我要你以她的形态，代表她进行投票。$b$b速速动身。月蚀之时就要到来了……
text.progress: It is done, $c.
text.completion: Arygos's machinations have been undone, thanks in great part to you, $c.$B$BAs my first act as aspect of the blue dragonflight, your bond with Tarecgosa is now made stable.$B$BThe power that once sustained that bond I now infuse into your staff.$B$BMay the Runestaff of Nordrassil serve you well!
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

english.title: Alignment
english.objectives: Accompany Kalecgos to the blue dragon council.$b$bSpeak to Kalecgos in Coldarra when ready.
english.description: The time of choosing has arrived, $n.$b$bWhile only members of the blue dragonflight may attend, Tarecgosa's binding makes your presence requisite.$b$bI must ask that you take on her form and vote on her behalf.$b$bDo not tarry. The moment of the eclipse draws near....
english.progress: It is done, $c.
english.completion: Arygos's machinations have been undone, thanks in great part to you, $c.$B$BAs my first act as aspect of the blue dragonflight, your bond with Tarecgosa is now made stable.$B$BThe power that once sustained that bond I now infuse into your staff.$B$BMay the Runestaff of Nordrassil serve you well!
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos in Coldarra.

text.title: 事起山峰
text.objectives: 从火羽峰顶获得一颗火鹰蛋。
text.description: 这些火鹰都是火焰生物，但它们的习性和我们老家的鸟类没什么两样。因此我在想，它们到底源自何处。$B$B话说回来——我觉得咱们应该能驯服它们。把它们驯化，用它们的力量来对付敌人。$B$B我要你去火羽峰顶弄一颗火鹰蛋回来。如果你能将其安全带回来的话，剩下来的事情可以交给我。
text.progress: Were you able to recover an egg?
text.completion: This will do perfectly! Come see me again in a day or two and we'll see how things have progressed.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Peaked Interest
english.objectives: Retrieve a Fire Hawk Egg from the top of Fireplume Peak.
english.description: These fire hawks are beings of fire, but they exhibit much of the same behavior that we've seen in birds back home. It makes me wonder from where they originate.$B$BBack to the point - I think we might be able to train them. Domesticate them if you will. Use them against our enemies.$B$BI'd like you to retrieve one of their eggs from the top of Fireplume Peak. If you can bring it back to me safely, I will see to the rest.
english.progress: Were you able to recover an egg?
english.completion: This will do perfectly! Come see me again in a day or two and we'll see how things have progressed.
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: 从小抓起
text.objectives: 带回5只火鹰雏鸟。
text.description: 我们的侦察兵回报说，山峰上到处都是火鹰的雏鸟……它们一定是最近刚从蛋里孵出来的。更妙的是，它们似乎还十分温顺。$B$B我知道这个要求听起来可能很奇怪，甚至有些过分，不过你能不能帮我带几只雏鸟回来，这样我就能训练它们，帮我们作战。$B$B你愿意吗？
text.progress: I can't make up my mind on how to regard these creatures. They act like much like other avians, but they are very obviously native to this fiery place.$B$BI wonder why Ragnaros and his minions have not made attempts to rally them against us...
text.completion: They look to have singed your gloves a bit, but I don't see any damage otherwise. Well done, $C.$B$BCome by again within the next few days to see how the training has gone.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Starting Young
english.objectives: Recover 5 Fire Hawk Hatchlings.
english.description: Our scouts are bringing back reports of fire hawk hatchlings all over the peak... their eggs must have hatched very recently. Better yet, it seems that they're extremely docile.$B$BI know it may sound a strange and perhaps unsavory request, but if you were able to bring some of those hatchlings back to me, I might be able to train them to aid us in our war efforts.$B$BAre you willing?
english.progress: I can't make up my mind on how to regard these creatures. They act like much like other avians, but they are very obviously native to this fiery place.$B$BI wonder why Ragnaros and his minions have not made attempts to rally them against us...
english.completion: They look to have singed your gloves a bit, but I don't see any damage otherwise. Well done, $C.$B$BCome by again within the next few days to see how the training has gone.
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Mother's Malice
text.objectives: Defeat the Fire Hawk Matriarch.
text.description: Unsurprisingly, their matriarch has taken offense to us taking her young to train for our own uses. It's understandable... and a bit tragic actually. We are very much the villains in this exchange.$B$BNow is not the time for such thoughts. These creatures are beings of fire, and on more than one occasion, they've claimed the lives of our kin. With their matriarch angered, the danger has grown immensely.$B$BI need someone to quiet her rage, and I fear you may be the most capable.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Mother's Malice
english.objectives: Defeat the Fire Hawk Matriarch.
english.description: Unsurprisingly, their matriarch has taken offense to us taking her young to train for our own uses. It's understandable... and a bit tragic actually. We are very much the villains in this exchange.$B$BNow is not the time for such thoughts. These creatures are beings of fire, and on more than one occasion, they've claimed the lives of our kin. With their matriarch angered, the danger has grown immensely.$B$BI need someone to quiet her rage, and I fear you may be the most capable.
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: 天空中的火焰
text.objectives: 利用驯服的火鹰消灭聚集在火焰之地的100只火妖、40只烬网蜘蛛，以及3名熔火领主。
text.description: 瞧啊！真是不可思议！它两天前才刚孵出来，如今已经完全长大了。遗憾的是，我怀疑它们的生命周期恐怕也同样短暂，因此我们必须抓紧一切可以利用的时间。$B$B他的训练十分顺利。我要你把它带出去，将它放到拉格纳罗斯要塞附近的敌军中去。$B$B不要对敌人手软，$r。
text.completion: I take it your assault was a success! Brilliant. This could be a key moment in opening up Ragnaros' defenses.
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Fire in the Skies
english.objectives: Use the Trained Fire Hawk to kill 100 of the Flamewaker Salamanders, 40 of the Cinderweb Spiders, and 3 of the Molten Lords that are amassing in the Firelands.
english.description: Look at that! It's incredible! Born less than two days ago and already full grown. Sadly, I suspect their life cycle is similarly short, so we'll have to take advantage of any time we have.$B$BHis training went remarkably well. I want you to be the one to take him out and unleash him on the bulk of the enemy forces gathered near Ragnaros' keep.$B$BShow no mercy, $r.
english.completion: I take it your assault was a success! Brilliant. This could be a key moment in opening up Ragnaros' defenses.
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Straight Chuting
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Straight Chuting
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Hawk Fire
text.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Hawk Fire
english.completed: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: 焦黑的羽翼
text.objectives: 去火羽峰营救5名受伤的猛禽德鲁伊。
text.description: 我们派了不少风暴乌鸦前往山峰，尝试取得火鹰的蛋，但是恐怕很难成功。空中的热浪使飞行变得非常危险而困难，更何况火鹰也不是那么友好。$B$B我要你去那儿尽全力营救德鲁伊们。我准备了夹板、绷带、烧伤药、嗅盐……只要他们还活着，就可以用这些东西来进行临时的救助。请你尽力去帮助每一位你遇到的德鲁伊。
text.completion: Several of our brothers and sisters passed by while returning to the safety of the Sentinel Tree. You did very well out there, $n. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Singed Wings
english.objectives: Rescue 5 Injured Druids of the Talon on Fireplume Peak.
english.description: Many of our Storm Crows have gone ahead to scout the peak and attempt to retrieve some of the fire hawk eggs, but to very little success I'm afraid. The thermals make it nearly impossible to fly safely, and the fire hawks aren't exactly friendly either.$B$BI need you to head over there and rescue any druids that you can. I've got splints, bandages, burn salves, smelling salts... anything you'll need to get them back on their feet, assuming they're still alive. Please hurry and help anyone you can find.
english.completion: Several of our brothers and sisters passed by while returning to the safety of the Sentinel Tree. You did very well out there, $n. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: Animate Embers
text.objectives: Retrieve 6 Animate Embers.
text.description: Several of our scouts have reported seeing what seemed to be living flames skittering around the surfaces of Fireplume Peak.$B$BIf the reports are accurate, we need these for study immediately. We've yet to fully understand where all of the attacking elementals come from, and these could well lend us significant insight.
text.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Animate Embers
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Animate Embers.
english.description: Several of our scouts have reported seeing what seemed to be living flames skittering around the surfaces of Fireplume Peak.$B$BIf the reports are accurate, we need these for study immediately. We've yet to fully understand where all of the attacking elementals come from, and these could well lend us significant insight.
english.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: 它们越大
text.objectives: 从火羽峰的黑曜石惩罚者那里获得10份活体黑曜石。
text.description: 你不是想就穿成这样去对付那些火焰巨兽吧？如果你不穿上我制造的黑曜石装备，那你瞬间就会被点着！就算你的装备是黑曜石的，这种好东西总归是多多益善。$B$B你瞧，好$G兄弟:姐妹;，我为你打造的装备，绝对是你能花钱买到的最好的装备，但我首先需要高纯度、未熔炼的活体黑曜石。$B$B火羽峰的黑曜石惩罚者就是由这种物质构成的。去把它们收拾掉，然后把掉落的碎片带来给我。
text.progress: Did you bring me the goods?
text.completion: This'll do. Nice work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: The Bigger They Are
english.objectives: Collect 10 Living Obsidium from the Obsidium Punishers on Fireplume Peak.
english.description: You're not going to take on fiery behemoths wearing THAT, are you? If you aren't wearing my obsidium crafted goods, you're going to burn right up! And even if you are, you can never have enough of the good stuff.$B$BLook $Gbrother:sister;, I can craft you the best armor that gold can buy, but I need pure, unsmelted Living Obsidium first.$B$BThe Obsidium Punishers on Fireplume Peak are literally made of the stuff. Go kill them and gather their pieces.
english.progress: Did you bring me the goods?
english.completion: This'll do. Nice work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

text.title: 鸟儿的领地意识
text.objectives: 杀死5只火鹰。
text.description: 我们的久居不去让火鹰十分不安。它们变得极具攻击性，且已经远远超出了保护领地的需要。我担心继续置之不理的话，它们不久就会对我们的大树展开进攻，我也不知道我们是否能够应付它们。$B$B我要你到火羽峰去，尽可能地压制住它们。如今我们的安全远比它们的重要，所以别拖泥带水的。
text.completion: Well done, $n. It's good to know I can count on you.
text.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

english.title: Territorial Birds
english.objectives: Slay 5 Fire Hawks.
english.description: The fire hawks are upset by our continued presence. They're getting extremely hostile, and not just in the usual territorial ways. I worry that if we leave them unchecked, they will soon be joining the assault on our tree, and I'm not sure we're capable of handling that.$B$BGo across the way to Fireplume Peak and do what you have to to keep them in check. I'm far more concerned with our safety right now than theirs, so be decisive about it.
english.completion: Well done, $n. It's good to know I can count on you.
english.completed: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

text.title: 再见小鸟
text.objectives: 用戳鸟之矛击败3名处于火鸦形态的烈焰德鲁伊。
text.description: 鹿盔的德鲁伊们在东北边野火哨站发动了猛烈的攻势。$B$B他们变成火鸦，打得我们的人猝不及防。而我却老够不着他们，真是恶心。呸！$B$B要不是达默克把他的飞矛借给了我们，我们还真要束手无策了。他说即使在这样稠密的空气中，这种武器也可以笔直地飞向目标。$B$B带上那矮人的飞矛，把那些德鲁伊从天上射下来。
text.completion: Those blasted burds are dead? Good riddance!
text.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

english.title: Bye Bye Burdy
english.objectives: Kill 3 Druids of the Flame, while in Fire Crow form, with the Burd Sticker.
english.description: Staghelm's druids are putting up a fierce fight at Wildflame Point to the northeast.$B$BThe druids fly above us in fire crow form, then strike when we least expect it. Worst part is, they know exactly how to stay out of our reach!$B$BWe would be totally helpless, except Damek lent me his trusty harpoon. He says these weapons will fly straight and true even in this super dense air.$B$BTake the dwarf's weapon and shoot some birds out of the sky!
english.completion: Those blasted burds are dead? Good riddance!
english.completed: Return to Damek Bloombeard at Malfurion's Breach in the Molten Front.

objectiveDetails.description: 杀死火鸦形态的烈焰德鲁伊

text.title: 一条烟熏过的坠饰
text.objectives: 把烟熏过的坠饰交给月光林地，永夜港的拉比恩·萨图纳。
text.description: 这条坠饰的表面上刻着小小的叶子形的花样，不过其他的细节都被时光侵蚀了，要么就是在火焰中遭到了损毁。它看上去似乎出自德鲁伊的手笔。$b$b大部分德鲁伊在试炼时都会经过月光林地。如果说有什么人能帮你查清这条坠饰的来历，那么就只有永夜港的拉比恩·萨图纳了。
text.progress: Yes, young $R?
text.completion: What have we here? A necklace? No, a locket...$B$BOh, my...
text.completed: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: A Smoke-Stained Locket
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.
english.description: This locket has a few small leaf-shaped carvings etched into its face, but any other details have been rubbed away with time, or burned away with fire. It appears to be druidic in nature.$b$bMost druids pass through Moonglade during their training. If anybody can help you decipher where this locket came from, it would be Rabine Saturna of Nighthaven.
english.progress: Yes, young $R?
english.completion: What have we here? A necklace? No, a locket...$B$BOh, my...
english.completed: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 热情如火
text.objectives: 观察火红鞭笞者汲取6个灰烬之池。熔焰蝎虫只有在战斗中才会喷出灰烬之池。
text.description: 我的研究有进展了，$n。根据我们对当地植被系统的观察，你的鞭笞者很可能也可以吸收高温液体作为养分。$B$B我想让你帮我做一个小实验。居住在北边熔岩之泉的熔焰蝎虫会在战斗中喷出燃烧的火焰团。$B$B把鞭笞者带上，看看它对那些蝎子的灰烬之池有什么反应。
text.completion: Did it work? So my theory was correct?
text.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

english.title: Some Like It Hot
english.objectives: Observe the Crimson Lasher drinking from 6 Ember Pools. Ember Pools are created by fighting Emberspit Scorpions.
english.description: I've been making progress in my research, $n. Based on what we've witnessed in the local flora, it's quite possible that your Lasher also accepts superheated liquids as a principal source of nutrition.$B$BI'd like you to help me with a little experiment. The Emberspit Scorpions that inhabit the Magma Springs to the north spew out burning pools of fire during combat.$B$BTake the Lasher and observe his reaction to the scorpions' Ember Pools.
english.completion: Did it work? So my theory was correct?
english.completed: Return to Avrilla at Malfurion's Breach in the Firelands.

objectiveDetails.description: 帮助火红鞭笞者从灰烬之池中汲取养分

text.title: 解开其中的秘密
text.objectives: 观看烟熏过的坠饰中储存的记忆。
text.description: 坠饰上面的名字缩写已经模糊了，但我能感觉到一种力量，这说明坠饰的主人只可能是一个人：$b$b烈焰德鲁伊莱雅娜。$b$b退后，我们来看看这条坠饰里有些怎样的惊喜。
text.completion: If Leyara bore witness to the War of the Shifting Sands, then it seems likely she knew Fandral - and his late son, Valstann - far more closely than any of us suspected.$B$BIt would seem that your journey does not end here, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: Unlocking the Secrets Within
english.objectives: Witness the memories stored within the Smoke-Stained Locket.
english.description: The initials seem to have worn off of this locket, but I can sense a power within it that suggests only one possible owner:$b$bLeyara, the Druid of the Flame.$b$bStand back, and we shall see what surprises this locket contains.
english.completion: If Leyara bore witness to the War of the Shifting Sands, then it seems likely she knew Fandral - and his late son, Valstann - far more closely than any of us suspected.$B$BIt would seem that your journey does not end here, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Rabine Saturna at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 悲剧与家庭
text.objectives: 把烟熏过的坠饰带到灰谷的阿斯特兰纳附近的暗夜精灵坟地去。
text.description: 你将坠饰交给我十分明智，$n。很少有人知道瓦斯坦恩遗体所在，而我恰巧是其中之一。$b$b你可以在灰谷的阿斯特兰纳东南边的一个小坟场里找到他的遗冢。把这条坠饰带去，它或许会解开更多的回忆。$b$b再会了，$n，愿你旅途好运。
text.completion: If the vision is to be believed, Leyara's ties to the Staghelm family were quite strong. It's no wonder that she clung so fiercely to Fandral's new order of flame.

english.title: Tragedy and Family
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Night Elf Grave near Astranaar in Ashenvale.
english.description: You were insightful to bring this locket to me, $n. I am among the few who know where Valstann's body lays.$b$bYou can find his resting site in a small graveyard, southeast of Astranaar, in Ashenvale. Bring this locket to the site, and it may unlock more memories.$b$bFarewell, $n, and good luck on your journey.
english.completion: If the vision is to be believed, Leyara's ties to the Staghelm family were quite strong. It's no wonder that she clung so fiercely to Fandral's new order of flame.

objectiveDetails.description: 窥视莱雅娜的深层记忆

text.title: 犬祸
text.objectives: 杀死5条灼焦恶犬或上古灼焦恶犬。
text.description: 我们的部队因为突然冒出来的怪物——灼焦恶犬而阵脚大乱。$B$B这些狗无所畏惧，在它们的嗜血欲望得到满足之前，它们是不会停下来的。我们的部队费了好大工夫才把它们挡住。$B$B去加入灰烬旷野或熔火激流的防御部队。也许你可以削减它们的数量。
text.completion: Good, $C. The enemy may be tough, but you have proven today that you are tougher.
text.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: The Dogs of War
english.objectives: Kill 5 Charhounds or Ancient Charhounds.
english.description: Our forces are falling beneath an unleashed monstrosity - Charhounds from the molten depths.$B$BThese dogs fear nothing and will not stop until their lust for blood is satisfied. Our forces are barely holding them back.$B$BGo join the defenders in the Ashen Fields or in the Molten Flow. Perhaps you can make a dent in their numbers.
english.completion: Good, $C. The enemy may be tough, but you have proven today that you are tougher.
english.completed: Return to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 直击要害
text.objectives: 击败烈焰副官。
text.description: 拉格纳罗斯的一名副官出现在了拉格纳罗斯的领域，就是我们东北边那个用墙围起来的地方。$B$B我想等你一回来就直接派你前去，可是我怀疑枯枝和我们的一些人眼下已经加入了战斗。你最好赶快。$B$B你可以从这里的峭壁上直接降到下面，这样就能快点和他们汇合。
text.completion: Very well done, $n! This should delay them significantly.$B$BIf we keep this up, we can easily push the fight back to Ragnaros himself.
text.completed: Return to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

english.title: Strike at the Heart
english.objectives: Kill the Lieutenant of Flame.
english.description: One of Ragnaros' Lieutenants has shown himself at Ragnaros' Reach, the walled area to our northeast.$B$BI hoped to send you as soon as you returned, but I suspect Witherbranch and some of our forces have already joined the fight by now. You should hurry.$B$BYou should be able to drop down the cliff wall right here and reach them quickly.
english.completion: Very well done, $n! This should delay them significantly.$B$BIf we keep this up, we can easily push the fight back to Ragnaros himself.
english.completed: Return to Skylord Omnuron at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

text.title: 烈焰之心
text.objectives: 用250份阴燃精华为诺达希尔符文法杖充能，并获得烈焰之心。
text.description: 你是第一个亲眼看到巨龙议会的凡人，$n，也是整个艾泽拉斯唯一能够参与守护巨龙选举的生物。$b$b我晋升之后，获得了不可思议的力量。我已经擅自强化了你与泰蕾苟萨之间的融合，尽管她需要的是一个更加……稳定的家。$b$b我要你再闯一次火元素位面，给我带来拉格纳罗斯的心脏。$b$b当我们下次再会时，我会好好褒奖你所做的一切。
text.progress: A fine day for a ceremony. Don't you think, $n?
text.completion:
You have done well, $n.

Now prepare to receive a hero's reward.
text.completed: Speak to Hallegosa  in Stormwind.

english.title: Heart of Flame
english.objectives: Empower the Runestaff of Nordrassil with 250 Smouldering Essences and obtain the Heart of Flame.
english.description: You are the first mortal to witness a dragon council, $n, and among the only beings in Azeroth to take part in the choosing of an Aspect.$b$bMy ascension has endowed me with incredible power. I have taken the liberty to strengthen Tarecgosa's bond with you, though she will require a more... permanent home.$b$bI would have you venture one last time into the Plane of Fire and bring me the heart of Ragnaros.$b$bWhen next we meet, I will be able to suitably thank you for all that you have done.
english.progress: A fine day for a ceremony. Don't you think, $n?
english.completion:
You have done well, $n.

Now prepare to receive a hero's reward.
english.completed: Speak to Hallegosa  in Stormwind.

text.title: 烈焰之心
text.objectives: 用250份阴燃精华为诺达希尔符文法杖充能，并获得烈焰之心。
text.description: 你是第一个亲眼看到巨龙议会的凡人，$n，也是整个艾泽拉斯唯一能够参与守护巨龙选举的生物。$b$b我晋升之后，获得了不可思议的力量。我已经擅自强化了你与泰蕾苟萨之间的融合，尽管她需要的是一个更加……稳定的家。$b$b我要你再闯一次火元素位面，给我带来拉格纳罗斯的心脏。$b$b当我们下次再会时，我会好好褒奖你所做的一切。
text.progress: A fine day for a ceremony. Don't you think, $n?
text.completion:
You have done well, $n.

Now prepare to receive a hero's reward.
text.completed: Speak to Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Heart of Flame
english.objectives: Empower the Runestaff of Nordrassil with 250 Soul Flame Essences and obtain the Heart of Flame.
english.description: You are the first mortal to witness a dragon council, $n, and among the only beings in Azeroth to take part in the choosing of an Aspect.$b$bMy ascension has endowed me with incredible power. I have taken the liberty to strengthen Tarecgosa's bond with you, though she will require a more... permanent home.$b$bI would have you venture one last time into the Plane of Fire and bring me the heart of Ragnaros.$b$bWhen next we meet, I will be able to suitably thank you for all that you have done.
english.progress: A fine day for a ceremony. Don't you think, $n?
english.completion:
You have done well, $n.

Now prepare to receive a hero's reward.
english.completed: Speak to Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 出神入化
text.objectives: 跟赫雷苟萨谈一谈。
text.description: 能同你结识真是不胜荣幸，$r。$b$b你的名声响彻艾泽拉斯，妇孺皆知。$b$b我将在卡雷苟斯到达时，向他献上拉格纳罗斯的心脏。它的力量将被用来进一步地强化你的武器。$b$b典礼马上就要开始了。我被指派来当你的护卫，等你准备好了，咱们就出发。
text.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
text.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

english.title: The Stuff of Legends
english.objectives: Speak to Hallegosa.
english.description: It is an honor to make your acquaintance, $r.$b$bYour deeds echo in the ears of Azeroth's creatures, mortal and immortal alike.$b$bI shall present the heart of Ragnaros to Kalecgos when he arrives. Its power is to be harnessed to further endow your weapon.$b$bThe ceremony is to begin shortly. I have been appointed to escort you there when you are ready.
english.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
english.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Orgrimmar.

enders.name: 巨龙之怒，泰蕾苟萨的寄魂杖

objectiveDetails.description: 去奥格瑞玛参加巨龙之怒典礼

text.title: 临界点
text.objectives: 把烟熏过的坠饰带到海加尔山，莱雅娜的哀伤那里的小墓碑前去。
text.description: 莱雅娜袭击哈缪尔的那天，她就在复苏之地西北边海加尔山附近的遗迹里等待。那时她行为十分异常：冷静、沉默，眼睛盯着远处看。也许那个地方对她来说意义非凡。$b$b如果把坠饰带到那里去，它或许会有所反应。
text.completion: First Valstann, now this...

english.title: The Tipping Point
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Small Gravestone at Leyara's Sorrow in Hyjal.
english.description: On the day when Leyara attacked Hamuul, she was waiting near some ruins in Hyjal, northwest of the Regrowth. She acted strangely at the time: calm, silent, and staring off into the distance. Perhaps that location is of some importance to her.$b$bThe locket might react if brought to that location.
english.completion: First Valstann, now this...

objectiveDetails.description: 窥视莱雅娜的深层记忆

text.title: 皆不可考
text.objectives: 把烟熏过的坠饰带给熔火前线的玛法里奥。
text.description: 在她的记忆中，莱雅娜提到了玛法里奥。她往日的悲剧——至少，在她看来是这样的——很大一部分就是拜他所赐。$b$b玛法里奥一定还记得莱雅娜在成为烈焰德鲁伊之前的事情。你决定把坠饰带到火焰之地给他看。但愿他能解答遗留下来的诸多问题。
text.completion: Yes, I knew Leyara, and I was aware of her anger even before she joined the Druids of the Flame. She was a promising young druid, once. Unfortunately, the bonds of family are often stronger than the power of reason, and ultimately, she chose to follow Fandral down his treacherous path.$B$BYou should keep this locket, $n. May it remind you that each of us walks our own path through life... and that some paths are easier than others.
text.completed: 把烟熏过的坠饰带给熔火前线的玛法里奥。

english.title: The Rest is History
english.objectives: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Malfurion in the Molten Front.
english.description: In her memories, Leyara spoke of Malfurion. The tragedies of her past - at least, in her opinion - are largely due to his actions.$b$bMalfurion must remember Leyara from before she became a druid of the flame. You resolve to bring the locket to him in the Firelands. Hopefully he can answer any remaining questions.
english.completion: Yes, I knew Leyara, and I was aware of her anger even before she joined the Druids of the Flame. She was a promising young druid, once. Unfortunately, the bonds of family are often stronger than the power of reason, and ultimately, she chose to follow Fandral down his treacherous path.$B$BYou should keep this locket, $n. May it remind you that each of us walks our own path through life... and that some paths are easier than others.
english.completed: Bring the Smoke-Stained Locket to the Malfurion in the Molten Front.

text.title: 出神入化
text.objectives: 跟赫雷苟萨谈一谈。
text.description: 能同你结识真是不胜荣幸，$r。$b$b你的名声响彻艾泽拉斯，妇孺皆知。$b$b我将在卡雷苟斯到达时，向他献上拉格纳罗斯的心脏。它的力量将被用来进一步地强化你的武器。$b$b典礼马上就要开始了。我被指派来当你的护卫，等你准备好了，咱们就出发。
text.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
text.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Stormwind.

english.title: The Stuff of Legends
english.objectives: Speak to Hallegosa.
english.description: It is an honor to make your acquaintance, $r.$b$bYour deeds echo in the ears of Azeroth's creatures, mortal and immortal alike.$b$bI shall present the heart of Ragnaros to Kalecgos when he arrives. Its power is to be harnessed to further endow your weapon.$b$bThe ceremony is to begin shortly. I have been appointed to escort you there when you are ready.
english.progress: Behold! Dragonwrath, Tarecgosa's Rest.
english.completion: Your heroic deeds will never be forgotten, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Hallegosa in Stormwind.

enders.name: 巨龙之怒，泰蕾苟萨的寄魂杖

objectiveDetails.description: 去暴风城参加巨龙之怒典礼

text.title: 完美泡菜的秘密
text.objectives: 在达纳苏斯找到8只埋藏的泡菜坛。
text.description: $n，我的家族从这座城市诞生以来就一直在制做达纳苏斯最好的泡菜。其实，这其中的秘诀很简单，但它会让我们的泡菜完全与众不同。$B$B我们将泡菜坛埋入地下，直到它完成发酵。我最近做好的一批泡菜应该刚好到出土时间了。你可以在城中各处找到埋藏那些坛子的土堆。能不能帮我把这些成熟的泡菜找回来？
text.progress: Were you able to find the jars?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. There's no way I could've found them all in time and it would be a shame to miss out on so much good kimchi!
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: The Secret to Perfect Kimchi
english.objectives: Find 8 Buried Kimchi Jars in Darnassus.
english.description: My family has been making the best kimchi in Darnassus for generations, $n. The secret is something simple, but it makes all the difference.$B$BWe bury the jars in the ground until it's ready to serve and my latest batch has just reached that point. You can find the jars buried in earthen mounds all over the city. Would you help me gather them while the contents are just right?
english.progress: Were you able to find the jars?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. There's no way I could've found them all in time and it would be a shame to miss out on so much good kimchi!
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 纪念祖先
text.objectives: 收集受祝福的米糕，并送往月神殿。
text.description: 需要供养的并不仅仅是生者。我的职责之一就是准备用来供奉祖先的米糕。一般来说，只有我的资深学徒才能得到将这些糕点送往月神殿，在那里接受赐福，然后将它们敬献给祖先的荣誉。但今天，她出城去了。你愿意代替她完成这一使命吗？
text.progress: This is the shrine the trainer mentioned.
text.completion: <You lay out the rice cakes around the shrine, which begins to glow softly. A faint sense of approval washes over you.>
text.completed: Offer the Blessed Rice Cakes at the Shrine of the Ancestors in Darnassus.

english.title: Remembering the Ancestors
english.objectives: Collect the Blessed Rice Cakes from the Temple of the Moon.
english.description: The living are not the only ones who require sustenance. One of my duties is to prepare the rice cakes that are left for the ancestors. Normally, my senior apprentice has the honor of taking the cakes to the Temple of the Moon for blessing and then presenting them to the ancestors. Since she is out of the city today, would you mind performing the duty in her place?
english.progress: This is the shrine the trainer mentioned.
english.completion: <You lay out the rice cakes around the shrine, which begins to glow softly. A faint sense of approval washes over you.>
english.completed: Offer the Blessed Rice Cakes at the Shrine of the Ancestors in Darnassus.

text.title: 我们的蘑菇
text.objectives: 采集12个下水道伞菇。将这些蘑菇交给幽暗城的尤奈斯·伯奇。
text.description: 一些厨师抱怨说，我们热爱的幽暗城里没有制做真正美味的优秀食材。$B$B他们全都是拖鼻涕的小白痴。这里有许多美味的食物！$B$B在幽暗城西北方的下水道里采集一些冒臭气的，黏滑的下水道伞菇，然后把它们交给我。
text.progress: Did you find enough Sewer Caps?
text.completion: These smell absolutely wretched. Perfect!
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Fungus Among Us
english.objectives: Obtain 12 Sewer Caps.  Deliver the fungus to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
english.description: Some chefs complain that our beloved Undercity doesn't boast the ingredients to create truly fine fare.$B$BSuch mewling little cretins. Delicious delights abound!$B$BGather some of the rank, slimy Sewer Caps growing in Undercity's northwest sewer line and return them to me.
english.progress: Did you find enough Sewer Caps?
english.completion: These smell absolutely wretched. Perfect!
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 回归基本
text.objectives: 帮助工匠区和贸易区的居民制做米粉。办法是捣击米筐中的东西。
text.description: 有一些东西是从家庭厨师到厨艺大师的每一个人都需要的。这座城市最重要的出产物之一就是米粉。大部分家庭都会长期储备至少一筐大米。工匠区和贸易区的居民也都一样。$B$B我经常会要求我的学生们去帮助居民将大米捣成米粉。因为这一工作永远都需要有人去做，而且又是一种很好的练习。为什么你不去试一试？
text.completion: It takes a lot of effort to ensure that there's enough flour for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, $n.
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: Back to Basics
english.objectives: Help the inhabitants of the Craftsmen's Terrace and Tradesmen's Terrace make rice flour by pounding the contents of Rice Baskets.
english.description: There are certain things that everyone needs, from the basic household cook to the master chef. One of the city's most important staples is rice flour. Most families keep at least one basket of rice in their houses and the residents of the Craftsmen's Terrace and Tradesmen's Terrace are no different.$B$BI often ask my students to help with the task of pounding rice into flour since it's good practice and an endless task. Why don't you give it a try?
english.completion: It takes a lot of effort to ensure that there's enough flour for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, $n.
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 钓起零件
text.objectives: 阿曼德·克伦威尔想让你在幽暗城中为大药剂师法拉尼尔钓起炼金傀儡的零件。
text.description: 一个兽人卫兵和大药剂师法拉尼尔的炼金傀儡之间……出了……一点事故。$B$B很显然，那个库卡隆监督者把那个炼金傀儡大卸八块，并把某些零件踢进了粘液池。$B$B法拉尼尔的学徒们找了好几个小时，却怎么也找不到那东西。想不想把它钓出来？相信那个老家伙一定会感谢你的。
text.progress: You haven't by any chance come across a severed abomination head, have you...?
text.completion: Ah! THERE it is! How ever did you find it?$B$BWell, no matter. My apprentices weren't able to recover the head despite hours splashing about in the slime, though they DID recover this bag of shiny things... perhaps you've a use for what's inside?$B$BMy thanks.
text.completed: Return the severed head to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.

english.title: Fish Head
english.objectives: Armand Cromwell wants you to fish up a Severed Abomination Head in Undercity for Master Apothecary Faranell.
english.description: There was an... incident... with an orc guard and one of Master Apothecary Faranell's abominations.$B$BApparently, the Kor'kron Overseer chopped its head clean off and kicked it into the slime.$B$BFaranell's apprentices searched for hours but they can't find the thing. Care to try fishing it up? I'm sure the old fellow'd be grateful.
english.progress: You haven't by any chance come across a severed abomination head, have you...?
english.completion: Ah! THERE it is! How ever did you find it?$B$BWell, no matter. My apprentices weren't able to recover the head despite hours splashing about in the slime, though they DID recover this bag of shiny things... perhaps you've a use for what's inside?$B$BMy thanks.
english.completed: Return the severed head to Master Apothecary Faranell in Undercity.

text.title: 为哨兵准备肋排
text.objectives: 在炉子或篝火附近使用生肋排，将它们烤熟，然后用它们喂饱5名达纳苏斯哨兵。
text.description: 我的责任之一就是为执勤的达纳苏斯哨兵提供伙食。这任务十分耗费时间，但我很乐于承担。这同样是你练习技巧的一个不错的途径。愿不愿意帮我准备今天的哨兵伙食？拿上这些肋排，在炉子或火堆旁边将它们烤熟，然后把它们送给城中各处的哨兵就行了。
text.completion: Feeding all those sentinels is much easier with your help. Nobody had to wait in line for their meal this time.
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: Ribs for the Sentinels
english.objectives: Use the Uncooked Ribs near a stove or campfire to cook them and then use them to feed 5 Darnassus Sentinels.
english.description: One of my responsibilities is to feed the sentinels of Darnassus while they're on duty. It's a time-consuming task, but one I'm happy to undertake. It's also a great way to practice your skills. Would you mind helping me with today's meal? Simply take these ribs, cook them near a stove or fire, and distribute them to sentinels throughout the city.
english.completion: Feeding all those sentinels is much easier with your help. Nobody had to wait in line for their meal this time.
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 恐怖蝌蚪
text.objectives: 幽暗城的阿曼德·克伦威尔想让你给他带去8条巨型食肉蝌蚪。
text.description: 我们的某些药剂师总喜欢把挥发性化学废料倒进静水池……嗯，我们只能说，没有人会想知道那些变异的食肉蟾蜍能长到多大。$B$B你能不能去钓一些还没有变成蟾蜍的巨型食肉蝌蚪来？可不要空手去抓它们。
text.progress: Catch any mutant tadpoles? Don't try to handle them with your bare hands.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. I'll see that these are, ah, disposed of immediately.$B$BAfter all, what would our fine apothecaries want with an army of monstrous, poison-spitting, flesh-eating super-toads?
text.completed: Return the tadpoles to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

english.title: Tadpole Terror
english.objectives: Armand Cromwell in Undercity wants you to bring him 8 Giant Flesh-Eating Tadpoles.
english.description: Some of our apothecaries took to dumping their more volatile waste chemicals into Stillwater Pond and... well, let's just say that no one wants to know how big mutant flesh-eating toads can grow.$B$BWould you consider fishing up some Giant Flesh-Eating Tadpoles before it gets to that? Just don't try to handle them with your bare hands.
english.progress: Catch any mutant tadpoles? Don't try to handle them with your bare hands.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. I'll see that these are, ah, disposed of immediately.$B$BAfter all, what would our fine apothecaries want with an army of monstrous, poison-spitting, flesh-eating super-toads?
english.completed: Return the tadpoles to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

text.title: 喜欢梭子鱼？
text.objectives: 在洛丹伦废墟的庭院里挖出一条尸虫，将它作为诱饵，钓到一条食尸梭子鱼。食尸梭子鱼可以在幽暗城东北方的澈水湖中钓到。
text.description: 你在澈水湖钓过鱼，对不对？$B$B在那里钓鱼能得到的一种辉煌战果就是那湖中的大型食尸梭子鱼。不过，要钓到它们，就必须有一种非常特别的诱饵——尸虫。$B$B在上面庭院中的坟墓里找一找，你应该能找到一些。
text.progress: Catch that pike, yet?
text.completion: That's a fine, fat pike, $n.  Well done.
text.completed: Return the pike to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

english.title: Like Pike?
english.objectives: Dig up a Corpse Worm in the Ruins of Lordaeron courtyard and use it as bait to catch a Corpse-Fed Pike.  Corpse-Fed Pike can be fished up in Brightwater Lake, northeast of Undercity.
english.description: You've fished in Brightwater Lake, yes?$B$BThe prize catch there is one of the lake's massive corpse-fed pikes. However, they only bite on a very specific type of bait... corpse worms.$B$BSearch the graves in the courtyard up top and you should find some.
english.progress: Catch that pike, yet?
english.completion: That's a fine, fat pike, $n.  Well done.
english.completed: Return the pike to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

text.title: 快乐挖蚌人
text.objectives: 从鲁瑟兰村附近的海岸上收集10只泰达希尔蚌肉。
text.description: 我认识的所有人都喜欢蚌肉，只有我完全受不了它们！它们又腥又黏，而且要找到它们，就一定要在泥巴里挖坑。与其这样，我宁愿用钓竿和鱼饵渡过一天时间。$B$B不过，我还是想用一桶新鲜的蛤蜊给我的兄弟来一个惊喜。如果你愿意为我去收集那些蛤蜊，我会给你奖励的。$B$B通过传送门到鲁瑟兰村去，在那里的岸边浅滩上寻找蚌肉吧。
text.progress: Did you find enough clams?
text.completion: Yuck, they're so gross-looking, but they're my brother's favorite. Thanks for sparing me from that messy job!
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: Happy as a Clam Digger
english.objectives: Gather 10 Teldrassil Clams from the shores near Rut'theran Village.
english.description: It seems like everyone I know loves clams, but I can't stand them! They're smelly and slimy, and harvesting them means digging through mud. Give me a fishing pole and some bait any day.$B$BStill, I want to surprise my brother with a bucket of fresh clams. I'd reward you if you were willing to gather those clams for me.$B$BJust go through the portal to Rut'theran Village and look for the clams in the shallows near the shore.
english.progress: Did you find enough clams?
english.completion: Yuck, they're so gross-looking, but they're my brother's favorite. Thanks for sparing me from that messy job!
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 粘液时刻
text.objectives: 收集10个蠕动黏菌。将它们交给幽暗城的阿曼德·克伦威尔。
text.description: 幽暗城冒泡的粘液水道里蕴藏着一些非常特别的好东西。你是否自认为有能力抓到那些在那里滑来滑去，不停蠕动，极为敏感的黏菌？$B$B你可以试试钓它们上来，但它们相当狡猾。所以你最好是跳进粘液里，把它们抓出来。$B$B记住，它们只有活着并完整无缺的时候才是有用的……谁会想吃死掉的黏菌？真恶心。
text.progress: Difficult to catch, aren't they?
text.completion: These slimes look perfect.  I will send these along to Eunice for preparation, thank you.
text.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

english.title: Time for Slime
english.objectives: Collect 10 Squirming Slime Molds. Deliver them to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.
english.description: It takes a special sort of fisherman to reap the bounty of Undercity's burbling slime troughs. Think you can handle gathering some of the squirming, sentient slime mold slithering about down there?$B$BYou can try to fish them up, but they're wily; you might be better off just diving into the ooze and grabbing them.$B$BRemember, they're only useful alive and intact... who'd want to eat a dead slime mold?! Disgusting.
english.progress: Difficult to catch, aren't they?
english.completion: These slimes look perfect.  I will send these along to Eunice for preparation, thank you.
english.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

text.title: 食品储备
text.objectives: 在达纳苏斯钓到5条湖生白鲑。
text.description: 为了养活难民和那些家园生计都毁于一旦的人们，我们已经用光了绝大部分的食品储备。如果我们不补充食品，当下次风暴或者部落来袭的时候，我们就全都有危险了。$B$B也许你愿意帮助我们捉一些湖生白鲑来，补充我们的食品储备。你可以在达纳苏斯的任何地方捉到它们。把它们晒干之后，就能储存起来，以备不时之需了。
text.progress: If all of our fishermen pitch in, it won't take long to rebuild our supplies.
text.completion: These are beautiful! Thank you, $n. I'll set them out to dry.
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: Stocking Up
english.objectives: Catch 5 Lake Whitefish by fishing in Darnassus.
english.description: We've used up most of our food stores in taking care of refugees and feeding those whose homes and livelihoods were destroyed. If we don't replenish our stores, we'll all be in danger next time there's a bad storm or a Horde invasion.$B$BPerhaps you'd be willing to help me build up our stock of lake whitefish. You can catch it anywhere in Darnassus, and once it's dried, it'll keep until it's needed.
english.progress: If all of our fishermen pitch in, it won't take long to rebuild our supplies.
english.completion: These are beautiful! Thank you, $n. I'll set them out to dry.
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 姐妹的坠饰
text.objectives: 从一条巨鲶鱼的肚子里找到艾奎恩妮的月亮坠饰。你可以在达纳苏斯一切能钓鱼的地方钓到它们。
text.description: 你遇到过艾奎恩妮吗？她和我一起在多兰纳尔受过训。最近，她来到这座城市，在月神殿中求学。我们有一次乘船的时候，那个笨舵手把船弄翻了！$B$B等我们回到岸上的时候，艾奎恩妮的月亮坠饰不见了，达纳苏斯的湖泊中生活着许多大鲶鱼。它们会吞下一切闪光的东西！$B$B我已经抓了不少鲶鱼，希望能在其中一条鱼的肚子里找到她的坠饰。你能帮一下忙吗？
text.progress: Have you had any luck finding Aquinne's missing pendant? I must've caught fifty of those monsters and I have nothing to show for it!
text.completion: <Astaia takes the pendant from you.>$B$BUnderneath all the slime and tarnish, I think this is it! Aquinne will be so happy to have this back... after a thorough cleaning, of course. I can't thank you enough, $n.
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: The Sister's Pendant
english.objectives: Retrieve Aquinne's Moon Pendant from the belly of a Giant Catfish. You should be able to catch them anywhere you can fish in Darnassus.
english.description: Have you met Sister Aquinne? She and I grew up together in Dolanaar, and she recently came to the city to study at the Temple of the Moon. We decided to go for a boat ride, but the clumsy oarsman managed to capsize the craft!$B$BWhen we got back to the shore, Aquinne's moon pendant was missing. The lakes in Darnassus are full of giant catfish who will gobble up anything shiny!$B$BI've been catching them nonstop, hoping to find the one with her pendant. I don't suppose you want to help?
english.progress: Have you had any luck finding Aquinne's missing pendant? I must've caught fifty of those monsters and I have nothing to show for it!
english.completion: <Astaia takes the pendant from you.>$B$BUnderneath all the slime and tarnish, I think this is it! Aquinne will be so happy to have this back... after a thorough cleaning, of course. I can't thank you enough, $n.
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 滑溜溜的小吃
text.objectives: 从鲁瑟兰村附近的浅水中收集6条小章鱼。
text.description: 有没有吃过章鱼肉？没吃过的人可能会不太适应，但那可是我的最爱！我甚至知道有的人会在那种东西活着的时候把它整条吃掉！$B$B我自己并不计划这么做，不过我现在已经没有新鲜章鱼了。你能帮我找些过来吗？它们就栖息在鲁瑟兰村岸边附近的浅水中。
text.progress: It's impossible to catch octopi with a fishing line, so you're just going to have to grab them!
text.completion: These are going to be delicious, I can already tell! Thanks, $n!
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: A Slippery Snack
english.objectives: Gather 6 Baby Octopi from the shallow water near Rut'theran Village.
english.description: Have you ever eaten octopus meat? It takes some getting used to, but it's my favorite! I even know some people who like to eat the whole thing while it's alive!$B$BI don't plan on trying that anytime soon, but I am out of fresh octopi at the moment. Will you help me gather some more? They live in the shallow water off the shore near Rut'theran Village.
english.progress: It's impossible to catch octopi with a fishing line, so you're just going to have to grab them!
english.completion: These are going to be delicious, I can already tell! Thanks, $n!
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 诺达希尔之巅
text.objectives: 去海加尔山跟世界之树下的萨尔谈一谈，见证大地之环的仪式。
text.description: 你好，$c！我在大地之环的兄弟姐妹们对你在大灾变中的表现评价甚高。但想要治愈这个破碎的世界，我们还有好多事情要做。$B$B同我一起走走吧，朋友。我们正在准备一道仪式，希望能够借此扭转对暮光之锤的战局。$B$B当一切结束的时候，你将要把我们的捷报传向四方。
text.completion: It can't be over. We mustn't give up hope!
text.completed: Speak with Aggra under the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: The Nordrassil Summit
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall under the World Tree in Mount Hyjal and witness the Earthen Ring ceremony.
english.description: Hello, $c! My brothers and sisters of the Earthen Ring have spoken well of your deeds in the wake of the Cataclysm. But much remains to be done if we are to heal this broken world.$B$BWalk with me, friend. Preparations for a ceremony are underway, a ritual that I hope will be a turning point in our battle against the Twilight's Hammer.$B$BWhen all is done, you will be able to spread the word about our triumph here.
english.completion: It can't be over. We mustn't give up hope!
english.completed: Speak with Aggra under the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 元素誓约：疑惑
text.objectives: 跟塞克隆纳斯交谈，去找萨尔。然后打败折磨他的风元素，将他救出来。
text.description: 我知道你要找的那个人……但是我不知道寻找他是否明智。他将自己投入了旋风之中。气流撕扯着他的身心，除了肉体和疑惑的碎片之外什么也不剩。$b$b去找他的话，你只能落得一样的下场。狂风会将万物切得体无完肤。$b$b我已经警告过你了。现在你打算怎么做？
text.completion: What is this... water?
text.completed: Speak with Aggra in Uldum.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Doubt
english.objectives: Speak with Cyclonas to secure passage to Thrall. Then, fight the wind elementals that torment him until he is freed.
english.description: I do know the one you seek... but I do not know if it is wise for you to follow him. He has cast himself into the cyclone. The winds now tear at his body and mind, leaving nothing but shreds of flesh and doubt.$b$bChasing after him would only expose you to the same fate. The wind's edge leaves nothing uncut.$b$bYou have been warned. Now what will you do?
english.completion: What is this... water?
english.completed: Speak with Aggra in Uldum.

objectiveDetails.description: 保护萨尔不受元素的侵害

text.title: 元素誓约：渴望
text.objectives: 击败深渊裂口附近的渴求之潮和渴求漩涡，把萨尔从它们的手里解救出来。
text.description: $c，我还是需要你的帮助，才能平息这场风暴。你得帮我将那些不稳定的元素击退。只有那样，我们才能救出古伊尔！
text.completion: Air, water... now earth?
text.completed: Return to Aggra at the edge of the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths of Vashj'ir.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Desire
english.objectives: Slay the Tides of Longing and Vortexes of Longing near the Abyssal Breach until Thrall is free of their grasp.
english.description: Once again, $c, I cannot do this without your help. I will try to quiet this tempest, but you will need to fight back the unstable elementals that whirl around it. Only then can we free Go'el!
english.completion: Air, water... now earth?
english.completed: Return to Aggra at the edge of the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths of Vashj'ir.

objectiveDetails.description: 保护萨尔不受元素的侵害
保护阿格娜不受元素的侵害

text.title: 元素誓约：耐心
text.objectives: 做好援助萨尔的准备后，就去和阿格娜谈一谈。然后打败关押他的耐心的石元素和耐心之石核。
text.description: 有了石母的祝福，我就能把咱们带往古伊尔被关押的所在。$b$b我们一定要小心。暮光之锤到处都有眼线。我会尝试找到古伊尔，而你则要帮我顶住他们的进攻！$b$b准备好了就跟我谈谈，我会把你带到他那儿去。
text.completion: <Aggra clenches her fists, and stares at the spot where Thrall stood moments ago.>
text.completed: Speak with Aggra on the Staidridge in Deepholm.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Patience
english.objectives: Speak with Aggra when you are ready to help Thrall. Then defeat the Elements of Patience and Corestones of Patience that are holding him captive.
english.description: With the Stonemother's blessing, I can take us to where Go'el is being held.$b$bWe must be careful. The Twilight's Hammer has agents all around. You help me hold them off while I attempt to get through to Go'el!$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready, and I will take you to him.
english.completion: <Aggra clenches her fists, and stares at the spot where Thrall stood moments ago.>
english.completed: Speak with Aggra on the Staidridge in Deepholm.

objectiveDetails.description: 帮助萨尔从石头监狱中逃脱

text.title: 元素誓约：怒火
text.objectives: 去平台西边悬崖找到阿格娜的空气图腾，击败旁边的元素，直到图腾激活为止。然后接着去找阿格娜的水图腾、阿格娜的大地图腾，以及阿格娜的火焰图腾。
text.description: 那些图腾，$n！我们得激活它们，不然古伊尔就完了！$b$b去平台悬崖边上找到我的图腾，把边上的元素都消灭掉。一旦激活四座图腾，我们就能把古伊尔最后一部分的灵魂解放出来！
text.completion: Despite all odds, Thrall has been saved. Aggra was right to hold out hope for the world-shaman.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: Fury
english.objectives: Kill fire elementals next to Aggra's Air Totem, on the western edge of the plateau, until it activates. Then continue to Aggra's Water Totem, Aggra's Earth Totem, and Aggra's Fire Totem.
english.description: The totems, $n! We need to activate them, or Go'el is lost!$b$bKill the elementals next to each of my totems, located around the edges of this plateau. Once all four totems are activated, we should be able to free the last piece of Go'el's soul!
english.completion: Despite all odds, Thrall has been saved. Aggra was right to hold out hope for the world-shaman.

objectiveDetails.description: 激活阿格娜的图腾，解救萨尔

text.title: 元素誓约：誓言
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的诺达希尔跟萨尔谈谈。
text.description: 在迈入通往海尔加山的传送门之前，萨尔要你跟他走。他要让你做个见证。
text.completion: Thanks to you, my friend - I live again! And due to the combined efforts of the Cenarion Circle and the Earthen Ring - the World Tree will bring new life to Azeroth as well.$B$BWhile Deathwing and the rest of our foes remain to be dealt with, I wish to share something with you.

english.title: Elemental Bonds: The Vow
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall at Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Before he passed through the portal to Mount Hyjal, Thrall asked you to follow him. There is something he would like you to witness.
english.completion: Thanks to you, my friend - I live again! And due to the combined efforts of the Cenarion Circle and the Earthen Ring - the World Tree will bring new life to Azeroth as well.$B$BWhile Deathwing and the rest of our foes remain to be dealt with, I wish to share something with you.

text.title: 美丽的睡莲
text.objectives: 获得10朵静水池睡莲。将它们交给幽暗城的尤奈斯·伯奇。
text.description: 在静水池周围生长的睡莲能熬出一种美味的肉汤。$B$B唔……我说的“美味”是指“不会令喝下它的兽人当场反胃”。$B$B你不如就去为我采集一些这种睡莲吧？不过要小心那些吃肉的巨型蝌蚪。
text.progress: Did you find enough Stillwater Lilies?
text.completion: Ah, what a luscious batch of lilies. Bravo! I'll boil them down right away...
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Lily, Oh Lily
english.objectives: Obtain 10 Stillwater Lilies.  Deliver the plants to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
english.description: The lilies that grow around Stillwater Pond can be rendered down into a delightful broth.$B$BWell... by "delightful," I mean "won't immediately sicken any orc who drinks it."$B$BWhy don't you go gather some for me, hmmm? Just watch out for the giant flesh-eating tadpoles.
english.progress: Did you find enough Stillwater Lilies?
english.completion: Ah, what a luscious batch of lilies. Bravo! I'll boil them down right away...
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 蜗牛快跑
text.objectives: 收集8只澈水蜗牛。将它们交给幽暗城的尤奈斯·伯奇。
text.description: 兽人卫兵总是抱怨说幽暗城的食物又烂又没味道，就好象他们受不了蘑菇和烂肉是我们的错一样。不过我想，我可以为他们烹调一些异国情调的菜肴。$B$B在澈水湖下收集一些淡水生的蜗牛。我要让他们知道，什么是厨艺大师的作品。
text.progress: Gather those freshwater snails, yet?
text.completion: You must be quite the swimmer... all I can manage is the dead man's float.$B$BIn any case, excellent batch of snails you've gathered. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Escargot A Go-Go
english.objectives: Collect 8 Brightwater Snails. Deliver them to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
english.description: The orc guards are always grumbling about bland and moldering Undercity fare - as if it's OUR fault they can't get by on a diet of mushrooms and old corpses - so I think it's time they learn just the sort of exotic delights we can cook up when we've a mind to.$B$BGather some of the freshwater snails ambling about beneath Brightwater Lake and I'll show them what a true culinary master can create.
english.progress: Gather those freshwater snails, yet?
english.completion: You must be quite the swimmer... all I can manage is the dead man's float.$B$BIn any case, excellent batch of snails you've gathered. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 蟑螂小屋
text.objectives: 取得20只肥蟑螂。将它们交给幽暗城的厨师奥德蕾。
text.description: 库卡隆监督者虽然对幽暗城的食品抱怨不断，但有一样东西他们永远都吃不厌。那就是我的姐妹奥德蕾的三倍香料焦脆炖肉。$B$B但这种食品的广受欢迎也导致奥德蕾的烹饪材料永远都不够用。你能不能帮她取得一些烹饪原料？她就在她出售食物的大车那里。$B$B你可以在全城各处找到蟑螂陷阱，只需要拿出陷阱里的东西，交给奥德蕾就好了。
text.progress: I call my little traps "Cockroach Cabins."$B$BCockroaches check in, but they don't check out!
text.completion: Oh, and just as I was nearly out. Thank you!
text.completed: Return to Chef Audrey in Undercity.

english.title: Roach Coach
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Plump Cockroaches.  Deliver the insects to Chef Audrey in Undercity.
english.description: For all the grousing those Kor'kron Overseers do about Undercity food, there's ONE thing they'll eat in spades: My sister Audrey's Thrice-Spiced Crunchy Stew.$B$BIts popularity means she's always running low on ingredients. Could you gather some for her at the coach she sells them from?$B$BYou'll find traps all over the city; just take their contents to Audrey and she'll handle the rest!
english.progress: I call my little traps "Cockroach Cabins."$B$BCockroaches check in, but they don't check out!
english.completion: Oh, and just as I was nearly out. Thank you!
english.completed: Return to Chef Audrey in Undercity.

text.title: 迎接刺骨的狂风
text.objectives: 去奥丹姆的南风之崖跟塞克隆纳斯谈一谈。
text.description: $C，我不相信古伊尔永远离我们而去了。他的灵魂散落在不同的元素位面中。只要哪怕一小部分还存在着，我们就能找到他。但我需要你的帮助。$b$b我们将从空气元素位面开始着手。$b$b跟我谈一谈，然后我们一起前往旋云之巅，去找一名叫做塞克隆纳斯的元素。他变幻莫测，但他能够洞察空气国度的一切。如果我的爱人在那里，塞克隆纳斯一定知道他的处境如何。
text.completion: <You feel the wind racing over your arms, your face, your weapons and armor...>$B$B<Cyclonas is looking you over.>

english.title: Into Slashing Winds
english.objectives: Speak with Cyclonas on the Bluff of the South Wind in Uldum.
english.description: $C, I refuse to believe my Go'el is lost forever. His spirit has been scattered across the elemental planes. If even a part of him still exists, we can find him, but I will need your help.$b$bWe will start with the plane of air.$b$bSpeak to me and we will travel to the Vortex Pinnacle together. We must speak with an elemental, Cyclonas. He's capricious, but he sees everything in the realm of air. If my love is there, Cyclonas will know what's become of him.
english.completion: <You feel the wind racing over your arms, your face, your weapons and armor...>$B$B<Cyclonas is looking you over.>

text.title: 扑向无常的潮水
text.objectives: 去瓦丝琪尔的无底海渊，跟深渊裂口的海卓里斯谈一谈。
text.description: 古伊尔一定就在水元素位面……在深渊之喉里面！我真不敢想他在那里会遭到怎样的命运。$b$b去深渊裂口附近找到海卓里斯。这个元素认识古伊尔，并且对我们同拉格纳罗斯的战斗表示支持。在那里你能依靠的人也只有他了。$b$b我们在瓦丝琪尔的海潮下见，$r……
text.completion: I will do what I can to aid you, $C.

english.title: Into Coaxing Tides
english.objectives: Speak with Hydrius at the Abyssal Breach in the Abyssal Depths of Vashj'ir.
english.description: Go'el must be in the plane of water... the Abyssal Maw itself! I shudder to imagine what fate awaits him there.$b$bFind the elemental, Hydrius, near the Abyssal Breach. He knows of Go'el and is sympathetic to our fight against Ragnaros. If anyone can help you there, it's him.$b$bI will meet you beneath the tides of Vashj'ir, $r...
english.completion: I will do what I can to aid you, $C.

text.title: 进入连绵的大地
text.objectives: 去深岩之洲跟塞拉赞恩的王座的塞拉赞恩谈一谈。$b$b阿格娜可以把你从深渊裂口传送到塞拉赞恩的王座去。
text.description: 时间紧迫！我的爱人就在深岩之洲。你准备好了以后我们就出发，我们将会去见石母塞拉赞恩。
text.completion: I already know what it is you seek, fleshlings. And I have chosen to aid you.
text.completed: 去深岩之洲跟塞拉赞恩的王座的塞拉赞恩谈一谈。

english.title: Into Constant Earth
english.objectives: Speak with Therazane at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.$b$bAggra can teleport you to Therazane's Throne from the Abyssal Breach.
english.description: Time is short! My love lies in Deepholm. I will take us there when you are ready, and we will speak with Therazane the Stonemother.
english.completion: I already know what it is you seek, fleshlings. And I have chosen to aid you.
english.completed: Speak with Therazane at Therazane's Throne in Deepholm.

text.title: 投身不熄的火焰
text.objectives: 去深岩之洲的顽石岭跟阿格娜谈一谈，前往火焰之地。
text.description: 现在我们必须前往火焰之地。在那个国度，古伊尔燃烧的灵魂可能会像拉格纳罗斯本人一样可怕！做好准备，我们就要孤身进入一个充满敌意的世界。$b$b准备好了就和我谈谈……愿先祖保佑我们！
text.completion: Be ready, $n.
text.completed: Speak with Aggra at Ragnaros' Reach in the Molten Flow.

english.title: Into Unrelenting Flame
english.objectives: Speak with Aggra on the Staidridge in Deepholm to secure passage to the Firelands.
english.description: We must travel now to the Firelands. Within that realm, Go'el's burning spirit could become as terrible as Ragnaros himself! Prepare yourself, for we will be alone in a hostile world.$b$bSpeak with me when you are ready... and may the ancestors protect us!
english.completion: Be ready, $n.
english.completed: Speak with Aggra at Ragnaros' Reach in the Molten Flow.

text.title: 寒水垂钓
text.objectives: 在丹莫罗的盔枕湖钓起5条寒水鲑鱼。
text.description: $n，不要去听别人胡说八道，这世上最美味的鱼生活就在丹莫罗冰冷的湖水里。那就是我的最爱——寒水鲑鱼，也是铁炉堡最受欢迎的美味，只有我们的故乡出产。$B$B我总说，这是铁炉堡送给全世界的礼物！$B$B嘿，你为什么去试试运气，亲手抓几条回来呢？最容易钓起寒水鲑鱼的地方是盔枕湖，就在丹莫罗的最东边。
text.progress: 抓到那些鮭魚了嗎？
text.completion: 這些魚太漂亮了，$n!我覺得你現在已經駕輕就熟了。
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: Cold Water Fishing
english.objectives: Catch 5 Arctic Char by fishing in Helm's Bed Lake in Dun Morogh.
english.description: The best tastin' fish live in the cold waters o' Dun Morogh, $n, an' don't let anyone else tell ye otherwise! Me favorite, an' the most popular one in Ironforge, is the arctic char, which only comes from our ancestral lands.$B$BI like tae think o' it as Ironforge's gift t' the world!$B$BWhy don't ye try yer hand at catchin' a few yerself? The best place tae find 'em is down in Helm's Bed Lake, in the eastern end o' Dun Morogh.
english.progress: Have ye tried to catch those char?
english.completion: These are beautiful, $n! I think ye've got the hang of it.
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 少不更事
text.objectives: 在铁炉堡荒弃的洞穴里钓起一条小铁腭，并将它展示在图书馆的空展位旁。
text.description: 我敢打包票，你肯定听过那条鱼的传说——铁炉堡荒弃的洞穴里最有名，最神出鬼没的老铁腭。在它漫长的一生中，老铁腭还留下了许多小铁腭后裔。但别被他们的名字给骗了，$n，那些小东西的狡猾可是一分一毫也不输给他们的老爹，顶多有点“经验不足”。$B$B如果你的耐性足够好，说不定能钓起一条小铁腭来。要是你真的钓起来了，就把它带到铁炉堡图书馆的博物馆里，让大家都围观围观。
text.completion: Well done, $n! Maybe seein' yer catch will inspire more dwarves to take up fishin'!
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: One fer the Ages
english.objectives: Catch a Young Ironjaw in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern and display it in the Library near the Empty Plaque.
english.description: I'm sure by now ye've heard the tale o' Old Ironjaw, the most famous and elusive fish in the waters o' Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern. Well, in his many years, he's been responsible for the rise o' many young ironjaws. Don't let the name fool ye, $n, these young'uns are every bit as clever as their dad, but somewhat lackin' in experience.$B$BWith skill an' patience, ye could probably catch one, an' when ye do, bring it to the museum in Ironforge's Library an' put it on display fer all to see!
english.completion: Well done, $n! Maybe seein' yer catch will inspire more dwarves to take up fishin'!
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 给滑滑的鱼
text.objectives: 在荒弃的洞穴里钓起3条盲眼鱼苗并喂给滑滑。
text.description: 我向你介绍过我的宠物滑滑了吗？我打算把他训练成一个钓鱼高手。现在呢，我正在用洞穴里钓起的鱼苗来喂他。$B$B你要不要试着喂他吃点？把你的鱼饵丢进那边的池塘里，然后把钓起来的鱼苗喂给滑滑。他会爱死你的！
text.completion: Ye've done a good job. Squirky seems happy and I've had some time to make some new lures. Thank ye fer the help!
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: Fish fer Squirky
english.objectives: Catch 3 Blind Minnows in the pool in the Forlorn Cavern and feed them to Squirky.
english.description: Hae I introduced ye tae me pet, Squirky? I'm teachin' him tae fish all proper-like. Fer now, I've been feedin' him minnows fished from the pool in this cavern.$B$BMaybe ye'd like tae give it a try? Just cast yer lure in the pool over there and feed Squirky any minnows ye happen tae fish up. He'll love ye ferever!
english.completion: Ye've done a good job. Squirky seems happy and I've had some time to make some new lures. Thank ye fer the help!
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 池塘猛兽
text.objectives: 雷霆崖的卡尔·迷雾行者需要8条来自雷霆崖池塘的艾萨拉蛇头鱼。
text.description: 一个好心的地精客人将艾萨拉蛇头鱼引入我们的水域中。现在，它们已经在池塘里泛滥成灾了。$B$B如果你能去捕捉一些这种贪婪的肉食鱼，以免雷霆崖的所有小鱼和泥鳅都被它们吃光，我会非常感谢你的。
text.progress: Have you caught any Azshara snakeheads, yet?
text.completion: Good work, $n. It's up to all of Thunder Bluff's fishers to keep this vicious creature out of Mulgore's waters.
text.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Pond Predators
english.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 8 Azshara Snakehead fish from the Thunder Bluff pond.
