english.description: A well-meaning goblin visitor introduced Azshara snakeheads to our waters and now they're overrunning the pond.$B$BPlease, if you can catch some of these voracious predatory fish before they eat every smallfish and mud snapper in Thunder Bluff, I'd be terribly grateful.
english.progress: Have you caught any Azshara snakeheads, yet?
english.completion: Good work, $n. It's up to all of Thunder Bluff's fishers to keep this vicious creature out of Mulgore's waters.
english.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 戒指事件
text.objectives: 从预见之池中钓起盲眼洞穴鱼，然后将其切开，检查里面是否有被吞掉的戒指。
text.description: 预见之池的一名被遗忘者来找我，说他的戒指被那里的一条瞎眼的洞穴鱼吞掉了。$B$B也许他说的是“指头”，但他的下巴根本就不会动，他说的兽人语也不比我更好。$B$B不管怎样，如果你能捉住洞穴鱼，从它们的肚子里找到那枚戒指或者别的什么东西，我们不同寻常的客人一定会很高兴的。$B$B如何，愿意帮忙吗？
text.progress: You haven't seen a ring about, have you? I think one of the cavefish might have swallowed it...
text.completion: You found my ring, did you? I'm most grateful.$B$BTo be honest, I've no idea why I keep the thing. I'm not even certain how I acquired it... I suppose I am simply a creature of habit.$B$BStill, as I said, I am grateful. Say... I found these things while searching for it myself. Perhaps they'd be of some use to you?
text.completed: Deliver the Poshken's Ring to Poshken Hardbinder in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: The Ring's the Thing
english.objectives: Fish up a Blind Cavefish from the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.  Once you catch a cavefish, fillet it and check if it swallowed the ring.
english.description: One of the Forsaken from the Pools of Vision came to me and said he'd lost his ring to a blind cavefish in the waters there.$B$BOr perhaps it was his finger. It was hard to tell; his jaw did not move and his Orcish was no better than mine.$B$BIn any case, I thought it would be a kind gesture towards our unusual visitors to catch and gut cavefish until the ring - or finger - was found.$B$BWould you help?
english.progress: You haven't seen a ring about, have you? I think one of the cavefish might have swallowed it...
english.completion: You found my ring, did you? I'm most grateful.$B$BTo be honest, I've no idea why I keep the thing. I'm not even certain how I acquired it... I suppose I am simply a creature of habit.$B$BStill, as I said, I am grateful. Say... I found these things while searching for it myself. Perhaps they'd be of some use to you?
english.completed: Deliver the Poshken's Ring to Poshken Hardbinder in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 活饵
text.objectives: 对你自己使用格瑞诺尔的饵料，然后跳进丹莫罗的盔枕湖里。
text.description: 如果你钓过小龙虾，就一定知道用活饵来钓小龙虾是最好不过了。而且诱饵越多，效果越好。想试试我新研制的龙虾饵吗？把这东西涂在你的身上，然后跳进丹莫罗东边的盔枕湖里。$B$B抓住猎物之后，把它交给我的朋友——厨师格瑞姆，他就在盔枕湖西边的古博拉采掘场。他可是烹调这些超级大虾米的大师！
text.completion: 太漂亮了，$n!格瑞諾爾聽到這個消息的時候一定會感到很驕傲的!$B$B噢，他曾說過如果計畫成功的話，要把這個交給你。
text.completed: Bring your crayfish to Cook Ghilm at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh.

english.title: Live Bait
english.objectives: Use Grimnur's Bait on yourself, then jump into Helm's Bed Lake in Dun Morogh.
english.description: If ye've ever fished fer crayfish, ye know they respond best to live bait, an' the more bait, the better. Would ye like to test my new bait? Simply smear this on yerself an' hop into Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh.$B$BAfter ye've got the catch, take it to me friend, Cook Ghilm at Gol'Bolar Quarry, west of the lake. He's an expert at cookin' those oversized bugs!
english.completion: These are beautiful, $n! Grimnur's goin' tae be so proud when he hears about this!$B$BOh, he did say tae pass this along tae ye, if the scheme worked.
english.completed: Bring your crayfish to Cook Ghilm at the Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh.

objectiveDetails.description: 将小龙虾交给厨师格瑞姆

text.title: 种群恢复
text.objectives: 雷霆崖的卡尔·迷雾行者要你从莫高雷石牛湖中带回2条产卵期小鱼和2条交配期泥鳅。
text.description: 雷霆崖的池塘里挤满了贪吃的艾萨拉蛇头鱼，小鱼和泥鳅几乎都要绝种了。$B$B我们已经让渔夫去尽可能地消灭它们了。你能不能再帮我们引一些鱼种来，重新恢复池塘里的鱼类种群？$B$B如果你能从石牛湖钓些鱼上来，把它们带到雷霆崖来，我会非常感激你的。
text.progress: Did you bring those fish from Stonebull Lake, yet?
text.completion: Your help is much appreciated, $n.$B$BHopefully these fish will go a long way towards restocking our fishing pond.
text.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: The Race to Restock
english.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 2 Randy Smallfish and 2 Amorous Mud Snappers from Stonebull Lake in Mulgore.
english.description: Thunder Bluff's fishing pond is being overrun with voracious Azshara snakeheads; there are hardly any smallfish or mud snappers left.$B$BWe already have fishers trying to kill as many snakeheads as they can, but can you assist us in our restocking efforts?$B$BIf you could gather some fish from Stonebull Lake and bring them here to Thunder Bluff, I would be very grateful.
english.progress: Did you bring those fish from Stonebull Lake, yet?
english.completion: Your help is much appreciated, $n.$B$BHopefully these fish will go a long way towards restocking our fishing pond.
english.completed: Return the fish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 美味小龙虾
text.objectives: 雷霆崖的卡尔·迷雾行者希望得到10只莫高雷石牛湖中的石牛小龙虾。
text.description: 莫高雷最美味的食物之一就是栖息在我们的湖泊和溪流中的小龙虾。它们在婚礼和生日庆典上尤其受到欢迎。$B$B能不能帮我捉一些这种狡诈的甲壳类生物，以供应雷霆崖的餐桌所需？$B$B你可以在石牛湖钓到它们，也可以跳下水去捉它们。
text.progress: Crayfish are so tasty. Have you caught many?
text.completion: Ah, so many crayfish!$B$BDid you fish these up? Or simply swim after them?$B$BWell, no matter. Excellent work, $n.
text.completed: Return the crayfish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Craving Crayfish
english.objectives: Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff wants 10 Stonebull Crayfish from Stonebull Lake in Mulgore.
english.description: One of the great delicacies of Mulgore is the crayfish that dwell in our lakes and streams. They are particularly popular during weddings or the celebration of a birth.$B$BWould you help me catch some of these crafty crustaceans for the cooking pots of Thunder Bluff?$B$BYou can fish them up from Stonebull Lake, or simply dive in and grab them.
english.progress: Crayfish are so tasty. Have you caught many?
english.completion: Ah, so many crayfish!$B$BDid you fish these up? Or simply swim after them?$B$BWell, no matter. Excellent work, $n.
english.completed: Return the crayfish to Kah Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 侏儒诱鱼器
text.objectives: 获得5个闪光的小珠，1个精密触发器，3个捕鼠陷阱，然后使用诱鱼器设计图。
text.description: 有个侏儒工程训练师来找过我，还给了我一张诱鱼器的设计图。据他说这种新发明不光能帮我快速抓鱼，还能防止鱼儿逃走。要我说，这玩意儿听上去其实挺蠢的，但我总喜欢尝试新鲜玩意儿。$B$B这就是那张设计图。你可以从我在房子里的助手那里买到闪光的小珠，再从工匠镇的工程学供应商那里买到精密触发器，另外你能在矿道地铁里找到捕鼠陷阱。
text.progress: How's that fancy new lure comin' along?
text.completion: It doesn't look like anything I think a fish'd be interested in, but ye never know. Fish're strange creatures. Thanks fer givin' this a try, $n.
text.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

english.title: The Gnomish Bait-o-Matic
english.objectives: Use the Bait-o-Matic Blueprint with 5 Shiny Baubles, a Hair Trigger, and 3 Rat Traps to create the Gnomish Bait-o-Matic.
english.description: One o' the gnomish engineerin' trainers gave me a blueprint fer a fancy lure he says'll help me catch fish faster and keep 'em from gettin' away. The whole thing sounds a mite silly if ye ask me, but I'll try anythin' once.$B$BHere are the blueprints. Ye're going to need shiny baubles, which ye can buy from my assistant inside the buildin', a hair trigger ye can buy from an engineerin' supplier in Tinker Town, and a few rat traps from the Deeprun Tram.
english.progress: How's that fancy new lure comin' along?
english.completion: It doesn't look like anything I think a fish'd be interested in, but ye never know. Fish're strange creatures. Thanks fer givin' this a try, $n.
english.completed: Return to Grimnur Stonebrand in Ironforge's Forlorn Cavern.

text.title: 守卫的军粮
text.objectives: 向6位铁炉堡守卫分发铁炉堡军粮。
text.description: 铁炉堡的守卫们赌上了性命来保卫我们的城市，我们也应当照顾一下他们。$B$B他们今天的军粮由两部分组成：矮人最爱的羊杂馅饼和铁炉堡麦酒。你能帮我分发一下这些军粮吗？这样每个人都能及时拿到自己的伙食，我们也好腾出手来做别的事情。
text.progress: 所有的伙食都發完了嗎？
text.completion: 就像我常說的，吃飽的守衛就是開心的守衛。非常感謝你的幫助，$n。
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: A Round for the Guards
english.objectives: Distribute the Ironforge Rations to 6 Ironforge Guards.
english.description: The guards who defend Ironforge put their lives on the line against our many enemies, and it's up to us to take care of them.$B$BToday, their rations consist of two dwarven favorites, haggis and Ironforge pale ale. Would ye be so kind as to help me distribute them? That way, everyone gets his food in a timely manner and we can move on to other tasks.
english.completion: A full guard is a happy guard, as I always say. Thanks fer yer help, $n.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 禽肉短缺
text.objectives: 在铁炉堡前门附近收集6只丹莫罗小鸡。
text.description: 哦，不，$n，如果我们不快点弄点鸡肉回来，事情就麻烦大了……没有鸡肉的韭菜鸡汤怎么能叫韭菜“鸡汤”呢！$B$B如果我们能马上就弄到一些新鲜鸡肉，那就还来得及做鸡汤。你能帮我吗？铁炉堡前门经常会有些小鸡跑来跑去。如果你能帮我弄回来，我看看，6只小鸡，我们就还能弄出鸡汤来。
text.progress: The chickens, $n, do ye have them or not?
text.completion: Aye, that's exactly what I needed. Ye have me thanks, $n, and me apologies fer bein' so brusque earlier. I just cannae stand the thought of not gettin' a meal finished on time.
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: A Fowl Shortage
english.objectives: Collect 6 Dun Morogh Chickens near the entrance to Ironforge.
english.description: Oh, no, $n, this is going to be a disaster if we don't find some chicken soon... Ye just cannae make cock-a-leekie soup without the chicken! It's not possible!$B$BThere's still time to make the soup and broth if ye can find some fresh chicken. Will ye help me? There are usually a few chickens running around outside the front entrance to the city. If ye can get yer hands on, say, six o' them, that should save me soup.
english.progress: The chickens, $n, do ye have them or not?
english.completion: Aye, that's exactly what I needed. Ye have me thanks, $n, and me apologies fer bein' so brusque earlier. I just cannae stand the thought of not gettin' a meal finished on time.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 羊杂馅饼飘香满溢
text.objectives: 取得一包羊杂碎，5袋甜香料和4袋燕麦片。
text.description: 羊杂馅饼飘香满溢，这是句老话，但他们从没想过馅饼可不是从天上掉下来的！你肯定不想知道要是铁炉堡的人吃不到羊杂馅饼会有多么难受。$B$B我正在做下一锅羊杂馅饼，但还少一些材料。$B$B索戈纳尔·硬须是军事区的肉商，他能卖给你一大袋我需要的羊杂碎。另外，你能从任何一名烹饪供应商那里买到甜香料。我们还需要一些燕麦片，你可以在城里的旅馆或者其他食品商那里买到。
text.progress: 你拿到所有的材料了嗎？
text.completion: 你全都拿到了？太好了！我馬上就開始準備。
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: Keepin' the Haggis Flowin'
english.objectives: Obtain a Bag o' Sheep Innards, 5 packets of Mild Spices, and 4 Sacks of Oatmeal.
english.description: The haggis must flow. Aye, it's a figure o' speech, for haggis'll ne'er flow! Ye dinnae want to know what'll happen if the people o' Ironforge don't get their haggis.$B$BI'm working on the next batch, but I'm still missing a couple of ingredients.$B$BSognar Cliffbeard is the meat vendor in the Military Ward, an' he'll sell you the big bag o' sheep innards I need. Ye can buy mild spices from any cooking supplier and ye can find sacks o' oatmeal in any inn or among the supplies  in the city.
english.progress: Do ye have those ingredients?
english.completion: Ye got them all? Wonderful! I'll get started right away.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 闪光的小珠
text.objectives: 雷霆崖的娜哈莉·追云者希望得到20枚中部高地底层周围的闪光石子。
text.description: 渔夫最简单，也最有效的工具之一就是闪光的小珠。把它们挂在鱼线上，就算是钓鱼新手也有机会钓上大鱼。$B$B但在这种钓鱼活动火爆的情况下，雷霆崖已经极度缺乏这种小东西了！$B$B你能不能去中部高地下面为我收集一些闪光石子？把它们交给娜哈莉·追云者。她就能用它们制做出更多闪光的小珠了。
text.progress: Did you happen to bring me any shiny stones?
text.completion: My, those are some very lovely stones! They'll make perfect shiny baubles, thank you.$B$BHere... Kah told me you'd be by with the stones, and to give this to you upon your arrival.
text.completed: Return the stones to Nahari Cloudchaser in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Shiny Baubles
english.objectives: Nahari Cloudchaser in Thunder Bluff wants 20 Shiny Stones from around the central rise's base.
english.description: One of a fisher's most simple and effective tools is the shiny bauble; affixed to a line, even the most novice angler has a chance at a catch.$B$BWith all the fishing going on of late, though, Thunder Bluff is in woefully short supply!$B$BMight I ask you to collect shiny stones from around the base of the central rise? Bring them to Nahari Cloudchaser so that she might craft more shiny baubles with them.
english.progress: Did you happen to bring me any shiny stones?
english.completion: My, those are some very lovely stones! They'll make perfect shiny baubles, thank you.$B$BHere... Kah told me you'd be by with the stones, and to give this to you upon your arrival.
english.completed: Return the stones to Nahari Cloudchaser in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 再来点香料面包
text.objectives: 烹饪或获得10片香料面包。
text.description: 越简单的菜式越重要，$n，香料面包可是一直在铁炉堡里大受欢迎。有时候甚至供不应求！$B$B你能不能帮我做点香料面包来满足群众的需求，顺便练习下烹饪技术？你能在我的兄弟埃姆鲁尔·里克努斯那里买到所有需要的材料，他就在楼下。
text.progress: 香料麵包的進展如何？
text.completion: 那片麵包看起來真是美味可口。謝啦，$n。
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: Can't Get Enough Spice Bread
english.objectives: Make or obtain 10 slices of Spice Bread.
english.description: It might seem like a basic thing, $n, but spice bread is a longtime favorite in Ironforge. Some days, I have trouble keeping up!$B$BWould ye like to cook some to practice yer skills an' help meet the demand? Ye can buy all the ingredients ye'll need from me brother, Emrul Riknussun, who is downstairs.
english.progress: How's that spice bread?
english.completion: That bread looks delicious. Thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

text.title: 我需要一桶美酒
text.objectives: 在卡拉诺斯酿酒厂外扛起一桶德鲁甘的铁炉堡麦酒，并把它运回铁炉堡。
text.description: 我的铁炉堡麦酒储量正在变低。幸运的是，啤酒厂就在附近，他们应该已经为我们酿好了一桶德鲁甘的铁炉堡麦酒。德鲁甘可是个天才酿酒师。$B$B我今天实在是没空亲自去卡拉诺斯，但也许你能帮我跑一趟，把那桶卖给帮我运回来，如何？
text.completion: Ah, well done! I tell ye, that Drugan's a true polymath -- explorer, historian, brewer -- is there anythin' that man hasn't mastered?
text.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

english.title: I Need to Cask a Favor
english.objectives: Pick up the Cask of Drugan's IPA outside the brewery in Kharanos and run it back to Ironforge.
english.description: My stocks o' IPA, that's Ironforge Pale Ale for ye novices, are gettin' low. Luckily, the brewery isn't too far away an' they should have a new cask o' Drugan's IPA waitin' fer us. That Drugan's a genius of a brewer, I tell ye.$B$BI won't be able to get down to Kharanos meself today, but perhaps ye can dash down there, pick up the new cask an' run it back 'ere? What d'ye say?
english.completion: Ah, well done! I tell ye, that Drugan's a true polymath -- explorer, historian, brewer -- is there anythin' that man hasn't mastered?
english.completed: Return to Daryl Riknussun at the Bronze Kettle in Ironforge.

objectiveDetails.description: 一桶德鲁甘的铁炉堡麦酒
运送德鲁甘的铁炉堡麦酒

text.title: 香料面包无限量
text.objectives: 烹饪或获得10片香料面包。
text.description: 简简单单的香料面包却在达纳苏斯如此受欢迎，是不是很令人惊讶？当我没有繁杂事务缠身的时候，我总是会去烤两片香料面包来锻炼下厨艺。$B$B为什么你不也来试试呢？所有的食材都可以在这里的商店里买到。$B$B香料面包总是不嫌多的，不管你做多少都会有人喜欢吃。当你做好面包之后带来给我，我会邀请我们的吉尔尼斯朋友们也来尝尝。
text.progress: I just love the smell of baking bread, especially spice bread. Don't you?
text.completion: These are well-made, $n. I hope you found baking as relaxing as I do.
text.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

english.title: Spice Bread Aplenty
english.objectives: Make or obtain 10 pieces of Spice Bread.
english.description: Isn't it amazing how something as simple as spice bread is used every day in Darnassus? When I'm not seeing to my other responsibilities, I like to bake spice bread to hone my skills as a cook and practice my technique.$B$BWhy don't you give it a try? You should be able to get your ingredients here in the shop.$B$BNo matter how much we make, it never goes to waste. Bring me your loaves when you're done and I'll have someone share them with our friends, the Gilneans.
english.progress: I just love the smell of baking bread, especially spice bread. Don't you?
english.completion: These are well-made, $n. I hope you found baking as relaxing as I do.
english.completed: Return to Alegorn in Darnassus.

text.title: 需求松仁
text.objectives: 通过火烤莫高雷松果取得30份松仁。将它们交给雷霆崖的阿丝卡·迷雾行者。
text.description: 舒哈鲁的许多菜肴中都要用到松仁，无论是鱼、肉还是蔬菜。松仁甚至会被加在烤面包里和撒到甜馅饼上面。$B$B大地母亲保佑我们，这些台地的松树上生长着最好的松果。只要把松果放在烹饪用火上稍微烤一烤，松仁就会掉出来。$B$B你是否能帮我从那上面收集一些松仁过来？我的松仁总是不够用……
text.progress: Have you found many of those tasty pine nuts?
text.completion: You work so quickly!$B$BI'll see that these are distributed to the various chefs and bakers of Thunder Bluff.$B$BThank you!
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Pining for Nuts
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Pine Nuts by toasting Mulgore Pine Cones from Thunder Bluff.  Deliver the nuts to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: The Shu'halo use pine nuts in so MANY dishes: meat, fish, vegetables, even baked into breads or sprinkled over sweet pastries.$B$BThe Earth Mother has blessed us in that the very BEST pine nuts come from the trees upon these very mesas. Simply gather pine cones and toast them over a cooking fire to release the nuts within.$B$BWould you please be so kind as to gather some? There are hardly ever enough to go around...
english.progress: Have you found many of those tasty pine nuts?
english.completion: You work so quickly!$B$BI'll see that these are distributed to the various chefs and bakers of Thunder Bluff.$B$BThank you!
english.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 昔日最爱
text.objectives: 在鲁瑟兰村钓起8条卡多雷鲱鱼。
text.description: 鲱鱼是达纳苏斯最受追捧的美食之一，但不是所有鲱鱼都能做出好菜式。卡多雷鲱鱼只在泰达希尔周边的水域里出产。$B$B我一直囤积了大量的卡多雷鲱鱼，因为这种鱼能做出的菜式实在是太多了！我刚刚做了一些烟熏鲱鱼，所以我得马上补充存货。你能帮我个忙吗？在鲁瑟兰村，你可以轻松钓起卡多雷鲱鱼。
text.progress: Did you get those herring?
text.completion: Thanks! I wonder what I should do with this batch...
text.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

english.title: An Old Favorite
english.objectives: Catch 8 Kaldorei Herring by fishing in Rut'theran Village.
english.description: Herring is one of the most sought-after fish in Darnassus, but not just any herring. The Kaldorei herring is native only to the waters surrounding Teldrassil.$B$BI try to keep a good supply of it because it's so versatile! I just finished smoking a batch of it, so I need to rebuild my stocks. Would you mind helping me? You can catch Kaldorei herring by fishing in Rut'theran Village.
english.progress: Did you get those herring?
english.completion: Thanks! I wonder what I should do with this batch...
english.completed: Return to Astaia in Darnassus.

text.title: 要来点苍蝇吗
text.objectives: 在攻城绞肉车附近的“肉”上取得25只肿胀苍蝇。然后去找幽暗城的尤奈斯·伯奇。
text.description: 为兽人烹调食物并不是我们唯一的任务，$c。这一次，我们要为一些有望取代兽人的家伙做饭。$b$b我们先要从小东西开始做。所以我们要捉苍蝇。苍蝇爱腐肉，我们也爱腐肉……当然，我们是爱把腐肉做成投掷武器！$b$b去看看攻城绞肉车上有没有残余的肉。有肉的地方就有苍蝇。$b$b给我带25只肿胀苍蝇来，然后我就能进行进一步的烹调了。
text.progress: I bet some of that "meat" is still good.
text.completion: Ah!  Perfect!  Fat, slow and ready to be eaten!  Next up, we will feed them to our spiders.  Fatten them up, and then, we feed the spiders to the frogs...$B$BListen to me go on.  You don't need to know all the details.  This is just a small step in a grand cuisine in a grand scheme.
text.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

english.title: Would You Like Some Flies With That?
english.objectives: Obtain 25 Bloated Flies from the "meat" near the Meat Wagons. Then return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.
english.description: It's not always about making food for the orcs, $c.  This time, it's about making food for what will hopefully be their replacements.$b$bWe need to start small, we need to catch flies.  Flies love rotting meat, and we love rotting meat... as projectile weapons!$b$bCheck out the Meat Wagons for any extra bits of meat.  Where you find the meat, you'll find the flies.$b$bBring me 25 bloated flies, and then I can start on the next stage of our cooking plan.
english.progress: I bet some of that "meat" is still good.
english.completion: Ah!  Perfect!  Fat, slow and ready to be eaten!  Next up, we will feed them to our spiders.  Fatten them up, and then, we feed the spiders to the frogs...$B$BListen to me go on.  You don't need to know all the details.  This is just a small step in a grand cuisine in a grand scheme.
english.completed: Return to Eunice Burch in Undercity.

text.title: 壕沟怪物！
text.objectives: 使用联盟诱捕装置，在洛丹伦废墟中召唤来壕沟怪物。然后使用肿胀青蛙喂这只怪物。
text.description: 有时候，钓鱼也得把合适的东西扔进水里，$c。$b$b这就是我们塞肥这些青蛙的目的。我们用肥苍蝇塞肥了蜘蛛，又用肥蜘蛛塞肥了青蛙，现在，我们要去喂一喂真正的怪物了。$b$b上面洛丹伦废墟的壕沟里就藏着我们的壕沟怪物。$b$b今天是喂食的日子，不过我们也得好好训练它。这只袋子里有一套诱捕工具和一些肿胀青蛙。当怪物出现的时候，就使用诱捕工具把青蛙扔给那个怪物。
text.completion: The dead feed the flies.  The flies feed the spiders.  The spiders feed the frogs.  The frogs feed our moat monster... It's a beautiful circle of life with the goal of ending life.
text.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

english.title: Moat Monster!
english.objectives: Use the Alliance Decoy Kit to summon the Moat Monster in the Ruins of Lordaeron.  Then use the Bloated Frogs to feed the monster.
english.description: Sometimes fishing means throwing something back, $c.$b$bWe've been overfeeding these frogs for just that occasion.  We've fed these frogs bloated spiders, that were fed bloated flies, and now, we are going to feed a real monster.$b$bThe moat above, in the Ruins of Lordaeron, is home to our very own Moat Monster.$b$bToday is feeding day.  But we must train it as well.  In this bag, you will find a decoy kit and some Bloated Frogs.  Use the decoy kit, then toss the frogs to the monster when it appears.
english.completion: The dead feed the flies.  The flies feed the spiders.  The spiders feed the frogs.  The frogs feed our moat monster... It's a beautiful circle of life with the goal of ending life.
english.completed: Return to to Armand Cromwell in Undercity.

objectiveDetails.description: 把肿胀青蛙喂给壕沟怪物

text.title: “魔法”蘑菇
text.objectives: 在雷霆崖的预见之池收集6个“魔法”蘑菇，将这些蘑菇交给雷霆崖的阿丝卡·迷雾行者。
text.description: 你知道预见之池吧？$B$B那里生长着一种蘑菇……不是在那里到处都是的那种坚硬的，散发着臭气的真菌，而是生长在它们下面的一种更小，更精致的伞状蘑菇。$B$B它们很稀少，也很美味，能给肉类菜肴增加一种堪称魔法的风味。$B$B……什么？哦，不是真正的魔法。它们只是非常好吃，仅此而已。
text.progress: Were you able to gather any mushrooms?
text.completion: Thank you, $n! I'm sure these will impart a simply magical taste to whatever dish they're used in.$B$BWhat? Stop looking at me like that!
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: "Magic" Mushrooms
english.objectives: Gather 6 "Magic" Mushrooms from the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff.  Deliver them to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: You know of the Pools of Vision, yes?$B$BThere is a sort of mushroom that grows there... not the tough, rank fungi that dominates the place, but smaller, more delicate caps that grow beneath them.$B$BThey are rare and quite delicious, adding a flavor to meat dishes that one might even call magical.$B$B...what? No, really. They just taste good. That's it.
english.progress: Were you able to gather any mushrooms?
english.completion: Thank you, $n! I'm sure these will impart a simply magical taste to whatever dish they're used in.$B$BWhat? Stop looking at me like that!
english.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 莫高雷香料面包
text.objectives: 对香料面包使用莫高雷香料，制造出5个新鲜出炉的莫高雷香料面包（你可以使用自己的香料面包，或者别人的香料面包）。将这些面包交给雷霆崖的阿丝卡·迷雾行者。
text.description: 经常有人问我：“阿丝卡，是谁制做了所有这些莫高雷香料面包？！”$B$B这是个好问题。我们优质美味的面包会被运往数不清的居民点，即使是在最遥远的地方也能看到它们，即使是我们最凶恶的敌人也会喜欢它们。它就是这样美味！$B$B关于这个问题的答案……？$B$B答案是“你”。请拿上这袋莫高雷香料，用它将淡而无味的香料面包变成莫高雷香料面包吧！
text.progress: Have you baked that Mulgore spice bread, yet?
text.completion: Ooo, that bread smells delicious. You are quite the baker, $n.$B$BWho knows how far these exquisite loaves will go... I hear it's even popular among the draenei of the Azuremyst Isles!
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Mulgore Spice Bread
english.objectives: Use Mulgore Spices with Spice Bread to create 5 Fresh Mulgore Spice Bread (you may make your own Spice Bread or use someone else's). Deliver the bread to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: I am often asked, "Aska, who is making all this Mulgore spice bread?!"$B$BIt is a reasonable question. Our fine and noble bread is traded in countless settlements in the most far-away lands, even by our staunchest foes. IT'S JUST THAT GOOD.$B$BAnd the answer...?$B$BIt is "YOU." Please take this packet of Mulgore spices and use it to turn bland, boring spice bread into MULGORE spice bread!
english.progress: Have you baked that Mulgore spice bread, yet?
english.completion: Ooo, that bread smells delicious. You are quite the baker, $n.$B$BWho knows how far these exquisite loaves will go... I hear it's even popular among the draenei of the Azuremyst Isles!
english.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 碾碎玉米
text.objectives: 帮助雷霆崖居民捶打碗装玉米粒，制做玉米粉。
text.description: 雷霆崖最重要的一种食材就是玉米粉。我们每一家都储藏着不少碗装玉米粒。$B$B但鹰身人，豺狼人，那些矿洞中的怪物，还有天知道什么家伙一直在攻击我们的磨坊。我经常会要求我的学生去把玉米碾成玉米粉。$B$B你愿意去完成这个任务吗？
text.completion: Much work is required to grind enough cornmeal for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, $n.
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Corn Mash
english.objectives: Help the inhabitants of Thunder Bluff make cornmeal by pounding bowls of Corn Kernels.
english.description: One of Thunder Bluff's most important staples is cornmeal; bowls of corn may be found in nearly every home.$B$BWith so many of the local mills under constant attack by harpies, gnolls, reckless mining companies and Earth Mother knows what else, I often ask my students to help with the task of grinding corn into cornmeal.$B$BWould you care to help?
english.completion: Much work is required to grind enough cornmeal for everyone's needs. Thank you for your help, $n.
english.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 精选食材
text.objectives: 从雷霆崖各处的商人那里取得四份“精华部分”，将它们交给雷霆崖的阿丝卡·迷雾行者。
text.description: 就连菜鸟厨师都知道，美味的菜肴来自于优秀的食材。$B$B我已经和雷霆崖的各个商人建立了长期供货关系。不过我很想看看，你是否有能力从他们提供的食材中挑出最好的。$B$B现在，你就到各处转转，从本地的商人们的摊位上收集最好的肉类、鱼类、蔬菜和草药吧。
text.progress: Have you gathered all the necessary ingredients?
text.completion: <Aska examines the ingredients you have chosen.>$B$BMmmhmmm. Yes. Well done!$B$BI could not have chosen better myself.
text.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

english.title: Perfectly Picked Portions
english.objectives: Obtain four "perfect portions" from merchant stalls around Thunder Bluff.  Deliver the ingredients to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.
english.description: Even the novice cook knows that a great dish begins with great ingredients.$B$BI have standing orders with merchants throughout Thunder Bluff, but I'd like to see how well you do at selecting the very best of what they have to offer.$B$BPlease make the rounds and gather perfect portions of meat, fish, vegetables and herbs from local merchant stalls.
english.progress: Have you gathered all the necessary ingredients?
english.completion: <Aska examines the ingredients you have chosen.>$B$BMmmhmmm. Yes. Well done!$B$BI could not have chosen better myself.
english.completed: Return to Aska Mistrunner in Thunder Bluff.

text.title: 败其兴致
text.objectives: 去洛丹伦废墟对稻草人使用灭火剂。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$c。我们虽然尽力享受稻草人庆典，但很明显部落也会尽力破坏我们的庆祝活动。$b$b审慎的做法可能是不去受争端的影响，不去理会那些攻击。$b$b我很尊敬那些行为高尚的人，但我帮他们不上。不过至于那些想以牙还牙的……我倒是能帮点忙。要是你也感兴趣，$c，拿着这灭火剂，去洛丹伦废墟那儿把部落的稻草人给弄灭。
text.progress: Have you extinguished the Horde's Wickerman, $c?
text.completion: Ah, so it is done.  A momentary setback, but if it is as annoying as their attacks have been, then it is worth it.$B$BI spoke to the children about your adventure and they were very excited.  They were impressed with your bravery to venture into enemy territory.  They also seemed to get a kick out of the mischief that you helped bring about... Oh those little rascals...$B$BThey did want you to have some of these treats as a reward.  Enjoy, $n.
text.completed: Return to Keira outside of Stormwind City.

english.title: A Time to Lose
english.objectives: Use the Dousing Agent on the Wickerman in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
english.description: Well met, $c. As we attempt to embrace the Wickerman ceremony, it is no surprise that the Horde would attempt to ruin our celebration.$b$bNow the prudent course of action may be to rise above the conflict and simply ignore the attacks.$b$bI admire those that take that high road, but I cannot help them.  But for those that seek to strike back... I can help them.  If you are interested, $c, take this Dousing Agent and use it on the Horde's Wickerman in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
english.progress: Have you extinguished the Horde's Wickerman, $c?
english.completion: Ah, so it is done.  A momentary setback, but if it is as annoying as their attacks have been, then it is worth it.$B$BI spoke to the children about your adventure and they were very excited.  They were impressed with your bravery to venture into enemy territory.  They also seemed to get a kick out of the mischief that you helped bring about... Oh those little rascals...$B$BThey did want you to have some of these treats as a reward.  Enjoy, $n.
english.completed: Return to Keira outside of Stormwind City.

text.title: 小鎮危機
text.objectives: 解救警長。
text.description: 亡命之徒綁架了警長!
text.completed: You find the sheriff yet?

english.title: Trouble in Podunk
english.objectives: Rescue the sheriff.
english.description: Outlaws have kidnapped the sheriff!
english.completed: You find the sheriff yet?

text.title: 小鎮危機
text.objectives: 解救警長。
text.description: 我們從不把布朗第警長當一回事，他老是為了他那些「法律」啊「小罪」啊動刀動槍的。但麥克林托克家的那些骯髒傢伙，和他們在崔克蕭山脊的那票慣犯、逃犯、通緝犯一類的狗腿，在一週前跑來這裡，把法律綁架成他們家的東西。這可不是譬喻，因為他們真的把我們的好警長給綁架了。
text.completed: You find the sheriff yet?

english.title: Trouble in Podunk
english.objectives: Rescue the sheriff.
english.description: We never paid no heed to Sheriff Blundy, what with his gettin' all up-in-arms at all times 'bout his "laws" and his "mis-de-meanors." But them dirty ol' McClintocks, and their cattle-rustlin' pappy up in Truckshaw ridge done had it up to here with the frequent incarcerations and trials and posse-gatherin' and dead-or-alive-wantin', and come this past week they done took the law into their own hands - in the most literal of senses - by haulin' up and hi-jackin' the good Sheriff. As you can see, our humble
english.completed: You find the sheriff yet?

text.title: 臭气弹轰炸！
text.objectives: 跟克里娜·芬劳谈一谈，骑上扫帚飞往暴风城。用臭弹覆盖城市和市民。
text.description: 愚蠢的联盟雇佣了巫婆们来对我们的城市展开进攻。那么，正如我的姐妹一度告诉过我的，“公平竞争就是以眼还眼”。$b$b我们将很高兴还以颜色。说起我的姐妹，她会给你一把扫帚，让你飞往暴风城。抵达之后，把臭弹丢到城市里，丢到人们的头上。叫他们尝尝苦头！$b$b咱们让暴风城的那些巫婆瞧瞧谁才是最厉害的！
text.completion: That will show the fools in the Alliance who is the strongest.$B$BTake these treats and treat yourself to something nice, $c.
text.completed: Return to Candace Fenlow in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

english.title: Stink Bombs Away!
english.objectives: Speak with Crina Fenlow and take a broomstick flight over Stormwind city.  Use the stink bombs to cover the city and its people.
english.description: The foolish Alliance have employed hags to fuel an attack on our city.  Well, as my sister once told me, "Turnabout is fair play."$b$bWe will gladly return the favor.  Speak with my sister, and she will provide you with a broomstick flight over Stormwind.  While over Stormwind, drop stink bombs on the city and on the people.  Make them suffer!$b$bWe will show those hags in Stormwind who is the most powerful.
english.completion: That will show the fools in the Alliance who is the strongest.$B$BTake these treats and treat yourself to something nice, $c.
english.completed: Return to Candace Fenlow in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.title: 幽暗城大扫除
text.objectives: 使用奥术清洁剂，清除幽暗城里的臭气弹。
text.description: 你好，$c！万圣节过得开心吗？看起来我们在暴风城的臭弹产生了反响，联盟决定也对我们的城市还以颜色。$b$b幸运的是，我们的魔法可以对付联盟的花招。用这份奥术清洁剂去把城里的臭气弹清理掉。
text.completion: I didn't notice a smell before, but I've come to expect weak magic from those Alliance hags.  However, the orc guards complained enough and will surely appreciate your efforts.
text.completed: Return to Candace Fenlow in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

english.title: Clean Up in Undercity
english.objectives: Use the Arcane Cleanser to remove stink bombs within the Undercity.
english.description: Greetings, $c!  Are you enjoying Hallow's End?  It seems that in response to our stink bombing Stormwind, the Alliance has decided to stink bomb our city.$b$bFortunately, we have magics that can handle the stink the Alliance bring us.  Use this Arcane Cleanser to remove the stink bombs from the city.
english.completion: I didn't notice a smell before, but I've come to expect weak magic from those Alliance hags.  However, the orc guards complained enough and will surely appreciate your efforts.
english.completed: Return to Candace Fenlow in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.title: 重振旗鼓
text.objectives: 用稻草人前面的篝火将其点燃。并使用稻草人周围的灰烬。
text.description: 我们烧毁了稻草人，用来警告那些敢于反对我们的人。我们将稻草人焚烧的灰烬涂在身上，向那些奴役我们的人发起永不休止的征战。$b$b用附近的篝火点燃稻草人。把四周的灰烬收集起来，涂在你的脸上。$b$b这些姿态将提醒敌人，我们永不退让。
text.completion: NOW is the time of the Forsaken! Power to the Forsaken - NOW AND FOREVER!!!
text.completed: Return to Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

english.title: A Time to Build Up
english.objectives: Use the bonfire in front of the Wickerman to set it ablaze.  Use the ashes on the ground near the Wickerman.
english.description: We burn the effigy of the Wickerman as a symbol of our struggle against those who would oppose us. We wear the ashes of the burnt Wickerman as a symbol of our neverending fight against those who would enslave us.$b$bUse the bonfire nearby and ignite the Wickerman.  Then take the ashes that lay nearby and spread them across your face.$b$bThese gestures will serve as a reminder to our enemies that we shall never yield.
english.completion: NOW is the time of the Forsaken! Power to the Forsaken - NOW AND FOREVER!!!
english.completed: Return to Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.title: 大肆破坏
text.objectives: 对暴风城前的稻草人使用灭火剂。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$c。在我们欢祝稻草人庆典的时候，联盟显然也会尽力破坏我们的庆祝活动。$b$b现在我们有一个办法可以还以颜色。如果你有兴趣，$c，就拿上这灭火剂，去暴风城前面把联盟的稻草人给弄灭。$b$b去熄灭他们的火苗，让他们吃点苦头吧，$c。
text.completion: Ah, so it is done.  A momentary set back, but if it is as annoying as their attacks have been, then it is worth it.$B$BThe children learned about your adventure and were very excited.  They seemed to revel in the mayhem that you helped bring about... Oh those little rascals...$B$BThey did want you to have some of these treats as a reward.  Enjoy, $n.
text.completed: Return to Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

english.title: A Time to Break Down
english.objectives: Use the Dousing Agent on the Wickerman in front of Stormwind.
english.description: Well met, $c. As we revel in the Wickerman ceremony, it comes as no surprise that the Alliance would attempt to ruin our celebration.$b$bWe have an opportunity to make them pay.  If you are interested, $c, take this Dousing Agent and use it on the Alliance's Wickerman in front of Stormwind.$b$bExtinguish their flame and revel in their misery, $c.
english.completion: Ah, so it is done.  A momentary set back, but if it is as annoying as their attacks have been, then it is worth it.$B$BThe children learned about your adventure and were very excited.  They seemed to revel in the mayhem that you helped bring about... Oh those little rascals...$B$BThey did want you to have some of these treats as a reward.  Enjoy, $n.
english.completed: Return to Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.title: 敬谢不敏
text.objectives: 如果你实在不喜欢你的礼物，可以去跟烟林牧场的商人谈谈，把它换成钱。$b$b一经兑换，概不负责。
text.description: 可能并不是所有人都喜欢节日毛衫。$b$b这张收据上说你可以到任何一名烟林牧场商人那里把它换成钱。$b$b一经兑换，概不负责。
text.end: 你可以在烟林牧场商人那里把你的毛衫换成钱。一经兑换，概不负责。

english.title: Thanks, But No Thanks
english.objectives: If you truly dislike your present, you can exchange it for gold by speaking to a Smokeywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.
english.description: A holiday sweater may not be for everyone.$b$bThe receipt says that you can exchange it for gold at any Smokeywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.
english.end: You may exchange your sweater for gold at a Smokeywood Pastures merchant.  All exchanges are final.

text.title: 敬谢不敏
text.objectives: 如果你实在不喜欢你的礼物，可以去跟烟林牧场的商人谈谈，把它换成钱。$b$b一经兑换，概不负责。
text.description: 可能并不是所有人都喜欢节日毛衫。$b$b这张收据上说你可以到任何一名烟林牧场商人那里把它换成钱。$b$b一经兑换，概不负责。
text.end: 你可以在烟林牧场商人那里把你的毛衫换成钱。一经兑换，概不负责。

english.title: Thanks, But No Thanks
english.objectives: If you truly dislike your present, you can exchange it for gold by speaking to a Smokeywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.
english.description: A holiday sweater may not be for everyone.$b$bThe receipt says that you can exchange it for gold at any Smokeywood Pastures merchant.$b$bAll exchanges are final.
english.end: You may exchange your sweater for gold at a Smokeywood Pastures merchant.  All exchanges are final.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：海加尔山！
text.objectives: 跟塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月谈一谈，进入月光林地。
text.description: 奉瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王陛下的命令，所有身强力壮的联盟公民都要前往月光林地的永夜港，向风歌使者报到。$B$B我们在塞纳里奥议会中的兄弟报告说，死亡之翼的爪牙向世界之树发起了毁灭性的进攻，试图将其夷为平地！$B$B与暴风要塞中的塞纳里奥使者安亚·碧月交谈，前往月光林地。$B$B为了联盟的荣耀与骄傲！英勇战斗吧，我的$G兄弟:姐妹;!
text.end: Transportation to Moonglade Secured
text.completed: Speak with Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

english.title: Hero's Call: Mount Hyjal!
english.objectives: Speak to Cenarion Emissary Jademoon to secure transportation to Moonglade.
english.description: By order of his royal highness, King Varian Wrynn, all able-bodied citizens of the Alliance are to report to Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.$B$BOur brothers in the Cenarion Circle report that Deathwing's minions have launched a destructive offensive against the world tree and threaten to burn it to the ground!$B$BSpeak with Cenarion Emissary Jademoon in Stormwind Keep to gain entry into Moonglade.$B$BFor the glory and honor of the Alliance! Fight on, $g brother:sister;!
english.end: Transportation to Moonglade Secured
english.completed: Speak with Emissary Windsong at Nighthaven in Moonglade.

text.title: 海加尔守护者：进攻火焰之地！
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。
text.description: 由大德鲁伊玛法里奥·怒风领导的海加尔守护者正在寻找勇敢的英雄，协助他们向火焰之地发动全面进攻。$B$B有意愿和能力的联盟英雄应该立即前往海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所报到。
text.completion: Thank you for answering our call for aid, $n.
text.completed: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。

english.title: Guardians of Hyjal: Firelands Invasion!
english.objectives: Report to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: The Guardians of Hyjal, led by Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage, seek brave heroes to assist with a full-scale assault on the Firelands.$B$BWilling and able-bodied heroes of the Alliance should report to the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal immediately.
english.completion: Thank you for answering our call for aid, $n.
english.completed: Report to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.objectives: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。
text.description: 由大德鲁伊玛法里奥·怒风领导的海加尔守护者正在寻找勇敢的英雄，协助他们向火焰之地发动全面进攻。$B$B有意愿和能力的部落勇士应该立即前往海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所报到。
text.completion: Thank you for answering our call for aid, $n.
text.completed: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。

english.description: The Guardians of Hyjal, led by Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage, seek brave heroes to assist with a full-scale assault on the Firelands.$B$BWilling and able-bodied champions of the Horde should report to the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal immediately.
english.completion: Thank you for answering our call for aid, $n.
english.completed: Report to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 海加尔守护者：进攻火焰之地！
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。
text.description: 你的努力为我们争取到了足够的优势来反攻火焰之地。现在，我们的部队就在你的南边集结。$B$B我们又需要你的帮助了，$r。去跟玛洛恩庇护所的麦托克劳谈谈。她正在协调进攻事宜。
text.completion: Thank you for answering our call for aid, $n.
text.completed: 去海加尔山的玛洛恩庇护所找麦托克劳。

english.title: Guardians of Hyjal: Firelands Invasion!
english.objectives: Report to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: <A vision of Hamuul appears in your mind.>$B$B$n, is that you? By the light of Aessina, she has helped me find you again in a time of utmost urgency.$B$BYour work has given the Guardians of Hyjal the advantage they needed to mobilize against the Firelands. We are gathering our invasion force now just south of your position.$B$BWe could use your strength again, $r. Speak with Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne. She is coordinating the invasion effort.
english.completion: Thank you for answering our call for aid, $n.
english.completed: Report to Matoclaw at the Sanctuary of Malorne in Mount Hyjal.

starters.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 海加尔守护者：远古防御者的召唤
text.objectives: 协助海加尔山的洛戈什、托尔托拉、艾维娜和艾森娜。
text.description: 由大德鲁伊玛法里奥·怒风领导的海加尔守护者正在招募勇敢的英雄，以协助抵御元素入侵者，保卫海加尔山。在向火焰之地发动直接攻击的部队动员完毕之前，必须先将入侵者击退。$B$B有意愿和能力的英雄应该立即前往海加尔山报到，协助远古的防御者：洛戈什、托尔托拉、艾维娜和艾森娜。$B$B首次前往海加尔山的旅行者可以在任意部落公告牌上阅读大酋长的海加尔动员令。
text.completed: Assist Lo'gosh, Tortolla, Aviana, and Aessina in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Guardians of Hyjal: Call of the Ancients
english.objectives: Assist Lo'gosh, Tortolla, Aviana, and Aessina in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: The Guardians of Hyjal, led by Archdruid Malfurion Stormrage, seek brave heroes to assist in defending Mount Hyjal from elemental invaders. These invaders must be repelled before forces can mobilize for a direct assault on the Firelands.$B$BWilling and able-bodied heroes should report immediately to Mount Hyjal and assist the Ancient defenders: Lo'gosh, Tortolla, Aviana, and Aessina.$B$BNew travelers to Mount Hyjal may look for a Warchief's Command to Hyjal on any Horde call board.
english.completed: Assist Lo'gosh, Tortolla, Aviana, and Aessina in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 海加尔守护者：远古防御者的召唤
text.objectives: 协助海加尔山的戈德林、托尔托拉、艾维娜和艾森娜。
text.description: 由大德鲁伊玛法里奥·怒风领导的海加尔守护者正在招募勇敢的英雄，以协助抵御元素入侵者，保卫海加尔山。在向火焰之地发动直接攻击的部队动员完毕之前，必须先将入侵者击退。$B$B有意愿和能力的英雄应该立即前往海加尔山报到，协助远古的防御者：戈德林、托尔托拉、艾维娜和艾森娜。$B$B首次前往海加尔山的旅行者可以在任意联盟公告牌上阅读英雄的召唤。

text.title: 失踪的传家宝
text.objectives: 去暴风城港口上船搜寻雇来的送货员的船舱，查看是什么让他耽搁了。
text.description: 我的最后一批货物今天就该从塞拉摩运到了。船是来了，但我还没有收到送货员的消息。他押运着我们家族代代相传的宝物。$B$B你是否愿意前往暴风城港口，看看是什么事情让他耽搁了这么久？
text.completion: This courier won't be meeting with his employer anytime soon and the crate he was hired to transport seems to have disappeared.
text.end: 搜查送货员的船舱。
text.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

english.title: Missing Heirlooms
english.objectives: Search the cabin of the Hired Courier's ship in Stormwind Harbor for evidence of what might be delaying him.
english.description: The last of my belongings were supposed to be arriving from Theramore today. The ship has arrived, but I haven't heard from the courier. The crate he was transporting had items that've been in my family for generations.$B$BWill you go down to Stormwind Harbor and see what's keeping him?
english.completion: This courier won't be meeting with his employer anytime soon and the crate he was hired to transport seems to have disappeared.
english.end: Search the courier's cabin.
english.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

text.title: 美酒节佳酿
text.objectives: 你要在4分钟内骑上羊，并分别维持3种不同的速度各8秒。
text.description: 这么说你想瞧瞧赛羊？矮人们觉得它很难驾驭，但咱们说老实话吧，他们大部分时候都醉醺醺的，所以这能有多难呢？$b$b现在趁你还没露两手，我得知道你能搞定这些上好的、手续齐全的动物。$b$b那么咱们这么办：我借你头羊跑两圈。你得证明自己有这个骑术。$b$b你得分别让羊进行8秒的颠步、跑步、袭步动作。
text.completion: That crash between here and Bladefist Bay really messed up the brew flow!  It doesn't help that Dark Iron dwarves seem to be attacking every hour or so!$B$BSo if you want to help, here's the deal.  I'll let you borrow some reins and one of my rams.$B$BEvery time you bring me a keg, I'll give you some tokens.  I'll even let you use the ram for a bit longer for every keg you bring me!$B$BBUT, once you start this, you won't be able to do it again until tomorrow.$B$BAre you sure you're ready to do this?

english.title: Brew For Brewfest
english.objectives: You have 4 minutes to ride the ram and maintain 3 different levels of speed for 8 seconds.
english.description: So you want to check out the racing rams?  The dwarves think they have got a handle on it, but let's be honest, they are drunk most of the time, so how hard can it really be?$b$bNow before I let you strut your stuff, you'll need to show me that you can handle these fine, legally obtained creatures.$b$bSo here's the deal:  I'll lend you some racing reins and the use of a ram. You need to prove to me that you can handle using these rams.$b$bKeep the ram at a trot, canter and gallop for 8 seconds each.
english.completion: That crash between here and Bladefist Bay really messed up the brew flow!  It doesn't help that Dark Iron dwarves seem to be attacking every hour or so!$B$BSo if you want to help, here's the deal.  I'll let you borrow some reins and one of my rams.$B$BEvery time you bring me a keg, I'll give you some tokens.  I'll even let you use the ram for a bit longer for every keg you bring me!$B$BBUT, once you start this, you won't be able to do it again until tomorrow.$B$BAre you sure you're ready to do this?

text.title: 新的纪念品供应商
text.objectives: 去美酒节营地的布利克斯·菲克维特那里兑换美酒节礼品券。
text.description: <叹气>$b$b去年的酒杯就别提了……$b$b我们那个声名狼藉的供应商和暮光教派有牵连。这事儿直到元素入侵之前，才被人揭发出来。$b$b所以我们换了一家供应商，也换了更好的酒杯！$b$b这儿有张礼品券。$b$b去跟美酒节营地后头附近的布利克斯谈谈。他本来就挺怪，还老是戴着副护目镜。他会负责处理你的礼品券，还有其他一切美酒节的兑换活动。
text.progress: What's happening hot stuff?  Got something for me?
text.completion: What's this?  A stein voucher?  So you like drinking?  Great!  After I give you this stein, go have a few drinks!  Then a few more.  Maybe have a few more after that...  Then, now this is important, come see me.$B$BLook, I know you'll be back eventually.  If you want your Brewfest tokens redeemed you have to see me.$B$BAnyways, here's the stein, and remember to talk to me later.
text.completed: Return to Blix Fixwidget in Durotar.

english.title: A New Supplier of Souvenirs
english.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Blix Fixwidget in the back of the Brewfest camp.
english.description: <sigh>$b$bDon't talk to me about last year's stein...$b$bI think our shady stein suppliers were somehow involved with that Twilight Hammer cult non-sense that errupted just before the elementals invaded.$b$bAnd that's why we have a new supplier and a better stein!$b$b Here's a voucher for one.$b$bTalk to Blix near the back of the Brewfest camp.  He's pretty strange, even more so now that he's always wearing those goggles.  He'll handle the voucher for you, and any other Brewfest transaction.
