english.completion: What's this?  A stein voucher?  So you like drinking?  Great!  After I give you this stein, go have a few drinks!  Then a few more.  Maybe have a few more after that...  Then, now this is important, come see me.$B$BLook, I know you'll be back eventually.  If you want your Brewfest tokens redeemed you have to see me.$B$BAnyways, here's the stein, and remember to talk to me later.
english.completed: Return to Blix Fixwidget in Durotar.

text.title: 新的纪念品供应商
text.objectives: 去美酒节营地的贝尔比那里兑换美酒节礼品券。
text.description: 最好别再提去年的酒杯了，$n。我跟你说哦，我们上一家供应商，他们靠不住。有证据表明他们参与了邪教活动……$b$b我们怎么能和想要毁灭世界的人合作呢！！$b$b于是我们找了一家新的供应商，换了新货。$b$b拿上这张礼品券，去美酒节营地后头附近找贝尔比。她会免费给你一个美酒节酒杯。此外，她还负责节日期间所有的美酒节兑换活动。
text.progress: What's happening hot stuff?  Got something for me?
text.completion: Aww, it's just a stein voucher... Maybe you're just playing hard to get.  So here's this year's stein for you.$B$BBut I suspect I'll be seeing a lot more of you.  After all, if you want any Brewfest tokens redeemed, I'm your girl...$B$BOr maybe I'm his girl...  $B$BOooohhh... or his...
text.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

english.title: A New Supplier of Souvenirs
english.objectives: Redeem the Brewfest Stein Voucher with Belbi Quikswitch in the Brewfest camp.
english.description: The less said about last year's stein, the better, $n.  I'll tell you this, our previous supplier, they were shady.  Turns out they were involved in some cultist activities...$b$bWe can't work with people who are trying to destroy the world!!$b$bSo we have a new supplier and a new stein.$b$bTake this voucher to Belbi Quikswitch  near the back of the Brewfest camp.  She'll give you your free Brewfest stein.  She'll also handle any and all other Brewfest transactions that come up during the holiday.
english.progress: What's happening hot stuff?  Got something for me?
english.completion: Aww, it's just a stein voucher... Maybe you're just playing hard to get.  So here's this year's stein for you.$B$BBut I suspect I'll be seeing a lot more of you.  After all, if you want any Brewfest tokens redeemed, I'm your girl...$B$BOr maybe I'm his girl...  $B$BOooohhh... or his...
english.completed: Return to Belbi Quikswitch in Dun Morogh.

text.title: 保护货物
text.objectives: 跟着蜘蛛走，质询你发现的那个人。
text.description: 你迅速查看了一番，没有在船舱里找到任何证据，能够表明杀手的身份或者是动机。你要找的箱子不翼而飞了。$B$B你正打算离开的时候，发现脚下有什么东西在动。一群蜘蛛接踵从送货员的床下爬了出来。它们这是要去哪儿?
text.completion: Keep your voice down and don't let word of this get out or I'm finished as an auctioneer!
text.completed: See if you can get more information from Auctioneer Fitch.

english.title: Fencing the Goods
english.objectives: Follow the spiders to their destination and question the man you find there.
english.description: A quick search of the cabin reveals no evidence of the killer's identity or motives. The crate you were sent to retrieve has vanished.$B$BAs you turn to leave the cabin, you notice something small moving underfoot. A trail of spiders crawls out from under the slain courier's bed. Where could they be heading?
english.completion: Keep your voice down and don't let word of this get out or I'm finished as an auctioneer!
english.completed: See if you can get more information from Auctioneer Fitch.

text.title: 购物
text.objectives: 前往暴风城矮人区的林荫女士，寻找偷箱贼前来拜访过的证据。
text.description: 我跟那位“绅士”说，矮人区或许有家店更能满足他的需要。店名叫做林荫女士，门口就在矮人区西侧的运河附近。$B$B你要找的人叫做昆西·科特勒。他经手的东西，诚实的中间商从来不碰！
text.progress: You look like you know something about these missing goods.
text.completion: Finally, Cutler's given me something I can work with. Before I give up that information, I'm going to want to know who you're working for.
text.completed: Speak to Hudson Barnes.

english.title: Shopping Around
english.objectives: Make your way to the Shady Lady in Stormwind's Dwarven District and look for evidence of the crate-thief's visit.
english.description: I told the 'gentleman' that there might be a shop more suited to his needs in the Dwarven District. It's called the Shady Lady and you can find the entrance near the Canals on the western side of the district.$B$BQuincy Cutler is your man. He trades in merchandise an honest broker would never touch!
english.progress: You look like you know something about these missing goods.
english.completion: Finally, Cutler's given me something I can work with. Before I give up that information, I'm going to want to know who you're working for.
english.completed: Speak to Hudson Barnes.

text.title: 庆祝的季节
text.objectives: 与幽暗城入口外洛丹伦废墟里的黑暗召唤者雅恩卡交谈。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$c。万圣节是欢庆和反思的时刻。尽管有人在举办许多庆祝活动时，根本不知道它们的起源。除了被遗忘者之外的许多人甚至不知烧“稻草人”到底是干什么的。$b$b到幽暗城上方的洛丹伦废墟去，和黑暗召唤者雅恩卡谈谈。她会向你介绍更多关于稻草人仪式的知识。
text.completion: The Wickerman ceremony is a time honored tradition.  It is good to see the Horde joining us in celebration.

english.title: A Season for Celebration
english.objectives: Speak with Darkcaller Yanka in the Ruins of Lordaeron just outside the entrance to Undercity.
english.description: Well met, $c.$B$BHallow's End is a time for celebration and reflection, though some have no idea why. The burning of the Wickerman in particular is a mystery to many outside the Forsaken.$B$BTravel to the Ruins of Lordaeron above Undercity and speak to Darkcaller Yanka.  She can tell you more about the Wickerman ceremony.
english.completion: The Wickerman ceremony is a time honored tradition.  It is good to see the Horde joining us in celebration.

text.title: 吹跑了
text.objectives: 珈珈想让你在奥格瑞玛城中收集5个飘走的气球。
text.description: 求你了，$g先生:小姐;，你一定要帮帮我！$b$b我爸爸从暗月马戏团给我带回来一些气球。那是最最最好的礼物！那是魔法气球，你知道吗，它们可以一直飘着，不会瘪下去！$b$b只不过……$b$b一阵大风把它们从我手里吹走了，飞得满奥格瑞玛都是！$b$b我可以自己去追它们，但这座城市太大了，我肯定会迷路的。$b$b趁着它们还没飞得无影无踪，你能帮我找回来吗？$b$b求你了！
text.progress: Did you find all of my balloons, $gmister:miss;?
text.completion: This is GREAT! You did it!$B$BThanks, mister!
text.completed: Return to Jaga in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Blown Away
english.objectives: Jaga wants you to collect 5 Windswept Balloons from Orgrimmar.
english.description: Please, $gmister:miss;, you just gotta help me!$b$bMy pa brought me a bunch of balloons from the Darkmoon fair. Best... gift... EVER! They're magical, you know, and never lose their floatiness!$b$bThere's just one thing...$b$bA big ol' gust of wind blew 'em right outta my hands. They're scattered all over Orgrimmar!$b$bI'd chase after 'em myself, but this city's so big I'd get lost for sure.$b$bCan you round 'em up for me before they float away?$b$bPlease?
english.progress: Did you find all of my balloons, $gmister:miss;?
english.completion: This is GREAT! You did it!$B$BThanks, mister!
english.completed: Return to Jaga in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 保护措施
text.objectives: 获得2份奇异之尘，5只水晶瓶，以及5簇血荨麻。
text.description: 换成我，要是谁敢宣称他是箱子及里面货物的合法主人，我就会对他多加小心。他没有告诉过你其中的危险吗？$B$B我有一个更好的主意：咱们联手，把箱子拿回来，以确保里面的东西不会伤害任何人。为了保护咱们自己，我们需要在城市周围找些材料，做一瓶药剂。$B$B去材料商那儿买点奇异之尘，去炼金商人那里弄一些瓶子，然后去城市北边的田里摘些血荨麻来。
text.progress: Did you get all the ingredients?
text.completion: Sometimes, I think I should've followed my father into alchemy.$B$BThis concoction should protect us from the worst effects of carrying or handling the crate. Bottoms up!
text.completed: Return to Hudson Barnes at the Shady Lady in Stormwind.

english.title: Taking Precautions
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Crystal Vials, 5 Arcane Powder, and 5 Blood Nettle.
english.description: I'd be wary of anyone identifying himself as the rightful owner of the crate and its contents. He didn't warn you of the danger?$B$BHere's a better idea: let's work together to recover the crate and ensure that its contents can't hurt anyone. To protect ourselves, we're going to need a draught made from a few ingredients that can be found around the city.$B$BBuy some arcane powder from a reagent merchant, get vials from an alchemy merchant, and pick some blood nettle from the fields north of the city.
english.progress: Did you get all the ingredients?
english.completion: Sometimes, I think I should've followed my father into alchemy.$B$BThis concoction should protect us from the worst effects of carrying or handling the crate. Bottoms up!
english.completed: Return to Hudson Barnes at the Shady Lady in Stormwind.

text.title: 收货人的代表
text.objectives: 去光明大教堂下方的陵寝破坏萨纳斯同窃贼的会面。
text.description: 照昆西的说法，想要箱子的“收货人”不是别人，正是疯狂的艾萨拉大法师克希雷姆。$B$B大法师的忠实信徒打算在光明大教堂底下的陵寝里同拿着箱子的人碰头。$B$B你必须赶到那里，阻止接头，在箱子永远落入克希雷姆手中之前将其夺回来。等你得手之后，就来黄金酒桶找我。
text.completion: Tendrils of dark power dance around the crate, but there's no trace of Sanath Lim-yo. You can now claim the crate and return it to your employer.
text.completed: Inspect the Stolen Crate in the catacombs.

english.title: The Collector's Agent
english.objectives: Disrupt the meeting between Sanath Lim-yo and the thief in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Light.
english.description: According to Quincy, the "collector" who wants the crate is none other than the insane Archmage Xylem of Azshara.$B$BThe archmage's faithful servant is to meet with the man who has the crate in the catacombs beneath the Cathedral of Light.$B$BYou must get there in time to intercept the exchange and retrieve the crate before it is lost to Xylem forever. When you have the crate, meet me at the Golden Keg.
english.completion: Tendrils of dark power dance around the crate, but there's no trace of Sanath Lim-yo. You can now claim the crate and return it to your employer.
english.completed: Inspect the Stolen Crate in the catacombs.

text.title: 學無止境
text.objectives: 跟尚羲大師談話。
text.description: 在訓練初期，你的第一項任務很簡單:去跟尚羲大師談話。
text.completion: Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the strength and cunning to be a <class>? Or are you destined to a life working in the fields?$B$BEach has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.$B$BLet us begin our training, my newest pupil.

english.title: Much to Learn
english.objectives: Speak to Master Shang Xi.
english.description: Fresh to your training, your first task is simple: Speak to Master Shang Xi.
english.completion: Today is the day when your fate will be decided. Do you have the strength and cunning to be a <class>? Or are you destined to a life working in the fields?$B$BEach has its place, but I can sense that you aspire to greatness.$B$BLet us begin our training, my newest pupil.

text.title: The Lesson of the Iron Staff
text.objectives: Loot a training weapon from a weapon rack and then equip it.
text.description: To train, first you must be properly equipped. Retrieve a weapon from one of the weapon racks below, bring it to me, and show me that you know how to hold it properly.
text.completion: A fine weapon. It should suit your needs well.$B$BNow let's put it to use.
text.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

english.title: The Lesson of the Iron Staff
english.objectives: Loot a training weapon from a weapon rack and then equip it.
english.description: To train, first you must be properly equipped. Retrieve a weapon from one of the weapon racks below, bring it to me, and show me that you know how to hold it properly.
english.completion: A fine weapon. It should suit your needs well.$B$BNow let's put it to use.
english.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

objectiveDetails.description: Loot and Equip a Training Weapon

text.title: 沙袋训练
text.objectives: 摧毁5个沙袋。
text.description: 我想看看你的新武器用得怎么样，我年轻的学生。如此，我才能根据你的天赋来制定相应的训练。$B$B下面的习武场上有许多沙袋。你可以用它们来练习攻击，等到适应了新武器后再来找我。
text.progress: 训练沙袋就在山坡下。练习完成后就来找我吧。
text.completion: 干得不错，$n。你的确选择了正确的道路。$B$B很好。我们继续吧。
text.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

english.title: The Lesson of the Sandy Fist
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Training Targets.
english.description: I'd like to observe you putting your new weapon to use, my young student. This will aid me in determining what degree of training will be best suited to your talents.$B$BWe have many training targets in the training grounds below. Practice your attacks upon them, and return to me once you're feeling comfortable with your new weapon.
english.completion: Not bad, $n. You may indeed have chosen the proper path.$B$BGood. Let us continue.
english.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

text.title: The First Sign of Winter
text.objectives: Recover the Shimmering Lotus.
text.description: At the stream below rests a single lotus flower. Within this lotus lies a sign of things to come. Bring it to me that I might show you.
text.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi on the bridge near the Tranquil Grotto.

english.title: The First Sign of Winter
english.objectives: Recover the Shimmering Lotus.
english.description: At the stream below rests a single lotus flower. Within this lotus lies a sign of things to come. Bring it to me that I might show you.
english.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi on the bridge near the Tranquil Grotto.

text.title: 烧毁卷轴
text.objectives: 夺取尚喜师父手中的火焰，然后烧毁戒酒令。
text.description: 大智若水，穿流无形。我们已经在神真子的背上生活了许多个年头。时代变了，智慧之训也不应一成不变。接下来这一课，我要你做两件事情。$B$B第一件，我手中有一团火焰。集中你的精神，做好准备，然后试着从我手中夺取它。$B$B如果你成功了，再做第二件事：爬到寺庙的顶层，在那儿烧毁戒酒令。
text.progress: 有时你必须相信自己的直觉并采取行动。
text.completion: 能如此轻易地从我手中夺过火焰，你可真是不简单。$B$B戒酒令是由我的先祖们代代相传下来的智慧卷轴。它源自一个更加和平的年代。$B$B每一件事物都有其适用的时代和背景，当黑暗即将降临时，它就不合时宜了。$B$B烧毁卷轴说明我们顺应局势并采取行动的决心，而你手中的火焰将照亮我们的未来。
text.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the temple in the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

english.title: The Lesson of the Burning Scroll
english.objectives: Snatch the flame from Master Shang Xi's palm, then burn the Edict of Temperance.
english.description: Every wisdom has a time and place, and times are changing for those of us living here on Shen-zin Su. For this lesson, I would ask two things of you.$B$BFor the first, I hold a flame in my hand. Gather your wits, and when you think you are ready, attempt to snatch the flame.$B$BShould you succeed, I want you to then climb to the top of this temple and burn the Edict of Temperance that you find there.
english.completion: The fact that you were able to snatch the flame so easily is no small feat.$B$BThe Edict of Temperance is a scroll of wisdom passed down from my elders' elders. Wisdom from a more peaceful time.$B$BEvery lesson has its time and place, and with darkness on the horizon, the time for this particular wisdom has passed.$B$BThe burning of the scroll is an acceptance of tidings to come and a promise to action. Your hand carried the flame, and I suspect that it will continue to do so in the future.
english.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the temple in the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

text.title: 门徒的挑战
text.objectives: 击败洛蛟明。
text.description: $n，我在你的身上看到了无穷的勇气、无尽的力量和无比纯洁的灵魂。$B$B虽然时间不长，但我相信你已经准备好迎接更大的挑战了。$B$B走下阶梯，到桥的另一头去吧。在那里，你会见到洛蛟明，他是我们最优秀的学生之一。堂堂正正地挑战并击败他，你第一阶段的训练就结束了。
text.progress:
Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in getting up every time we do.
Jaomin Ro knows this. He finds strength in every defeat.

You may yet learn that lesson.
text.completion: 真是令人惊讶，$n。果然你是注定将要踏上$c之道的人。
text.completed: Speak to Master Shang Xi upon the bridge near the Tranquil Grotto.

english.title: The Disciple's Challenge
english.objectives: Defeat Jaomin Ro.
english.description: $n, I see great strength and great courage in you, and an unsurpassed purity of soul.$B$BThe hour is young, but I think you may be ready to face a greater challenge.$B$BGo to the bottom of the stairs, and cross the bridge. There, you will find Jaomin Ro, one of our eldest students. Challenge and defeat him in honorable combat, and this first phase of your training will be complete.
english.progress:
Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in getting up every time we do.
Jaomin Ro knows this. He finds strength in every defeat.

You may yet learn that lesson.
english.completion: You truly impress, $n. It seems certain that the path of the $c is indeed the path for you.
english.completed: Speak to Master Shang Xi upon the bridge near the Tranquil Grotto.

text.title: 土水派的艾莎
text.objectives: 和福家小池旁的商人罗福谈一谈。
text.description: 在如此短的时间内，你已向我证明了你有潜力成为一个出色的$c。习武场对你来说已经不是问题了，但现在你必须接受一项更大的挑战来证明你自己，之前我的弟子中还从未有人完成过。$B$B我要你去找到上古火灵燧焰，并将他送回五晨寺。$B$B我的另外两名得意弟子会帮你完成这个任务。第一个便是艾莎·云歌，你可以在西边的池塘附近找到她。
text.completion: 你是來找艾莎的嗎？你…最好不要在她完成修行前打擾到她。在完成整套訓練之前她是不會和任何人說話的。$B$B在等待的時候，你能幫幫我嗎？我在森林妖精的問題上遇到了一些麻煩。

english.title: Aysa of the Tushui
english.objectives: Speak to Merchant Lorvo by Fu's Pond.
english.description: In such a short time, you've shown me that you have the potential to be a great $c. The training grounds are behind you, but now you must prove yourself by facing a far greater challenge, one that none of my students have accomplished.$B$BI want you to return Huo, the spirit of fire, to the Temple of Five Dawns.$B$BMy two other most gifted students will help you in this task. The first is Aysa Cloudsinger. Seek her out at the pool to the west.
english.completion: You came for Aysa? You... you really shouldn't interrupt her until she finishes her exercises. She doesn't speak to anyone until her routine is done.$B$BIn the meantime, could you maybe help me? I had some bad luck with forest sprites.

text.title: 现在怎么办？
text.objectives: 去暴风城镶金玫瑰把箱子还给安森·哈斯廷。$B$B或者$B$B去暴风城黄金酒桶把箱子交给赫德森·巴恩斯。
text.description: 你终于找到了安森要你拿回来的箱子。但是，考古学生警告过你，箱子里装的不是什么好东西。$B$B他说的没错，看来你的雇主没有把这份工作的危险性跟你明说。你真的想把箱子交给他吗，还是说你宁可把它交给赫德森·巴恩斯？至少后者愿意把箱子里的东西封存于世。
text.progress: Have you brought the crate as we discussed?
text.completion: Ah, you did manage to get the crate before Archmage Xylem's man could get it out of the city. Excellent!

english.title: What Now?
english.objectives: Return the crate to Anson Hastings at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind.$B$B-OR-$B$BReturn the crate to Hudson Barnes at the Golden Keg in Stormwind.
english.description: You've finally found the crate that Anson sent you to retrieve. However, it appears the archaeology student's warnings about the nature of the crate's contents were correct.$B$BThere's no doubt that your employer lied to you about the dangers involved in the job. Do you really want to hand the crate over to him, or would you rather give it to Hudson Barnes, who believes it better to keep the crate's contents locked away?
english.progress: Have you brought the crate as we discussed?
english.completion: Ah, you did manage to get the crate before Archmage Xylem's man could get it out of the city. Excellent!

text.title: 吹跑了
text.objectives: 蔚蔚想让你在暴风城中收集5个飘走的气球。
text.description: 求你了，$g先生:小姐;，你一定要帮帮我！$b$b我爸爸从暗月马戏团给我带回来一些气球。那是魔法气球，你知道吗，它们可以一直飘着，不会瘪下去！$b$b只不过……$b$b一阵大风把它们从我手里吹走了，飞得满暴风城都是！$b$b我可以自己去追它们，但这座城市太大了，我肯定会迷路的。$b$b趁着它们还没飞得无影无踪，你能帮我找回来吗？$b$b求你了！
text.progress: 氣球都找回來了嗎，$g先生:小姐;？
text.completion: This is GREAT! You did it!$B$BThanks, mister!
text.completed: Return to Vin at Cathedral Square in Stormwind.

english.title: Blown Away
english.objectives: Vin wants you to collect 5 Windswept Balloons from Stormwind.
english.description: Please, $gmister:miss;, you just gotta help me!$b$bFather bought me a bunch of balloons from the Darkmoon fair. They're magical, you know, and never lose their floatiness!$b$bThere's just one thing...$b$bA gust of wind blew them out of my hands. They're scattered all over Stormwind!$b$bI'd chase after them myself, but this city's so big I'd get lost for sure.$b$bCan you find them for me before they float away?$b$bPlease?
english.progress: Did you find all of my balloons, mister?
english.completion: This is GREAT! You did it!$B$BThanks, mister!
english.completed: Return to Vin at Cathedral Square in Stormwind.

text.title: 诡异的箱子
text.description: 箱子几经偷盗、买卖和追寻。凡是打算解开其中封存的魔法之人，都遭到了其力量的反噬。$B$B饶是如此，箱子本身还是毫发未伤，充盈着魔法能量。偶尔，它还会震动一两下子，仿佛其中装着什么活物一般。$B$B貌似它已经同你绑定在了一起，如今是你的东西了。

english.title: The Creepy Crate
english.description: It's been sought after, stolen, and sold. Anyone who tried to tap the magic held within has seen that power turn against him.$B$BYet, the crate itself appears unscathed and suffused with magical energy. From time to time, it shakes or bobs as if its contents were alive.$B$BIt seems bonded to you and now it's yours.

text.title: 土水之道
text.objectives: 在艾莎冥想时保护她。
text.description: 很高兴见到你，$c。我是土水派的艾莎。$B$B自从尚师父告诉我要寻找上古火灵燧焰后，我在这里思考了很久。虽然我知道他在哪里，但不知道怎么过去。我就快找到答案了。和我一起去附近的冥想洞穴。那是一个充满智慧的地方。我将在那里冥想，敞开心扉，找到答案。
text.completion: Your path is set before you. You will be the one to rekindle the spirit of fire and bring it to the safety of the temple.$B$BThis will not be the only time you and Aysa work together. She is strong and wise. You can trust in her.
text.completed: Speak to Master Shang Xi outside of the Cave of Meditation.

english.title: The Way of the Tushui
english.objectives: Protect Aysa while she meditates.
english.description: It's a pleasure to meet you, $c. I am Aysa, of the Tushui.$B$BI've spent much time in thought since Master Shang told me we would be searching for Huo, the spirit of fire. I know where he resides, but not how to reach him. The answers are close, however.$B$BCome with me to the Cave of Meditation nearby. It is a place of great wisdom. I will meditate there, open my mind, and the path shall find us.
english.completion: Your path is set before you. You will be the one to rekindle the spirit of fire and bring it to the safety of the temple.$B$BThis will not be the only time you and Aysa work together. She is strong and wise. You can trust in her.
english.completed: Speak to Master Shang Xi outside of the Cave of Meditation.

text.title: 失踪的传家宝
text.objectives: 去奥格瑞玛东边的码头，上船搜寻雇来的送货员的船舱，查看是什么让他耽搁了。
text.description: 我叫送货员坐飞艇，可他偏不，他要搭地精的船！这下好啦，他迟到了，我家族珍贵的传家宝也没送来。$B$B如果你愿意帮忙的话，能不能去奥格瑞玛东边的码头那儿，登上地精船，看看是什么让他耽搁了？
text.completion: This courier won't be meeting with his employer anytime soon and the crate he was hired to transport seems to have disappeared.
text.end: 搜查送货员的船舱。
text.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

english.title: Missing Heirlooms
english.objectives: Search the cabin of the Hired Courier's ship at the docks east of Orgrimmar  for evidence of what might be delaying him.
english.description: I told that courier to take the zeppelin, but no, he had to use the goblin ship! Well, now he's late and my precious family heirlooms are with him.$B$BIf you're willing to help, would you go down to the docks east of Orgrimmar, board the goblin ship and see what's keeping him?
english.completion: This courier won't be meeting with his employer anytime soon and the crate he was hired to transport seems to have disappeared.
english.end: Search the courier's cabin.
english.completed: Examine the corpse of the Hired Courier.

text.title: 保护货物
text.objectives: 跟着蜘蛛走，质询你发现的那个人。
text.description: 你迅速查看了一番，没有在船舱里找到任何证据，能够表明杀手的身份或者是动机。你要找的箱子不翼而飞了。$B$B你正打算离开的时候，发现脚下有什么东西在动。一群蜘蛛接踵从送货员的床下爬了出来。它们这是要去哪儿？
text.completion: Keep your voice down and don't let word of this get out or I'm finished as an auctioneer!
text.completed: See if you can get more information from Auctioneer Drezmit.

english.title: Fencing the Goods
english.objectives: Follow the spiders to their destination and question the man you find there.
english.description: A quick search of the cabin reveals no evidence of the killer's identity or motives. The crate you were sent to retrieve has vanished.$B$BAs you turn to leave the cabin, you notice something small moving underfoot. A trail of spiders crawls out from under the slain courier's bed. Where could they be heading?
english.completion: Keep your voice down and don't let word of this get out or I'm finished as an auctioneer!
english.completed: See if you can get more information from Auctioneer Drezmit.

text.title: 火金之道
text.objectives: 杀死8个狒狒村攻击者。
text.description: 我们管这些闯进镇里来的邪恶猴子叫猢狲。平时它们与我们井水不犯河水，但现在它们也知道要出大事了，所以就到我们这里来偷物资。$B$B在这种情况下，答案显而易见。我们要把这些猴子赶走！不能保护我们的小镇和我们所爱的人才是真正的犯罪。这就是火金之道。
text.completion: You've got some fight in you! I think I like you!
text.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.

english.title: The Way of the Huojin
english.objectives: Kill 8 Fe-Feng attackers.
english.description: We call those vicious monkeys swinging into town hozen. They keep to themselves normally, but they know something bad is coming, so they're here to steal our supplies.$B$BIn situations like this, the clear answer is the only answer. These monkeys will leave when we force them to leave! To not defend our town and those we love would be the only true crime. Thus is the way of the Huojin.
english.completion: You've got some fight in you! I think I like you!
english.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.

text.title: 点火
text.objectives: 收集5份干燥的山茱萸根。
text.description: 既然你已经完成了任务，那就去找它吧！$B$B上古火灵——燧焰，正急需干燥的山茱萸根作为引燃物。它们生长在村子南面的树林中。你应该可以轻松收集到一些。
text.progress: I hope you're not shy about getting your hands dirty.
text.completion: $n! You've returned, roots in hand! You're a down-to-business kind of guy, aren't you? I like that!
text.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.

english.title: Kindling the Fire
english.objectives: Gather 5 Dry Dogwood Roots.
english.description: Now that that's done with, let's get to it then!$B$BHuo, the spirit of fire, hungers for dry dogwood root kindling. It grows among the trees south of the village. It should be easy enough for you to gather some.
english.progress: I hope you're not shy about getting your hands dirty.
english.completion: $n! You've returned, roots in hand! You're a down-to-business kind of guy, aren't you? I like that!
english.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.

text.title: 失踪的车夫
text.objectives: 营救货车车夫。
text.description: 受到林精的攻击后，我的车夫就去追它们了。我并不认为它们能伤害到他，可我还等着他回来清理遭袭的货车呢。$B$B他追着它们朝北面的峭壁去了。如果往那个方向走，你应该很快就能找到他。
text.progress: 我真该再小心一些的。
text.completion: You are too kind, $c.
text.completed: Return to Merchant Lorvo by Fu's Pond.

english.title: The Missing Driver
english.objectives: Rescue the Cart Driver.
english.description: My driver went running off after the sprites just after they attacked. I don't think they'll really do him any harm, but I need him back to help me clean up the mess by the cart.$B$BHe chased them off towards the cliffs to the north. If you head that direction, you should find him quickly.
english.completion: You are too kind, $c.
english.completed: Return to Merchant Lorvo by Fu's Pond.

text.title: 元素之灵守护者
text.objectives: 与心光神龛中的李飞大师交谈。
text.description: 到目前为止，你做得很不错，我的学生。你已经集齐了唤醒上古火灵燧焰的所有材料。$B$B他就在西南面的洞中，但由李飞大师守护着，就是你在冥想洞穴中见过的那位熊猫人长者。带上祭品去找李飞大师吧。向他证明你的能力，然后去见燧焰。
text.completion: Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself. There is a path before you, but you choose the trials you will face, and the trials you will overcome.

english.title: The Spirit's Guardian
english.objectives: Speak to Master Li Fei in the Shrine of Inner-Light.
english.description: You've done very well this far, my student. You have the materials you need to rekindle Huo, the spirit of fire.$B$BIn the cave to the southwest he awaits, but he is guarded by Master Li Fei, the pandaren elder you met in the Cave of Meditation. Go to Master Li Fei with the offerings. Prove yourself, then meet with Huo.
english.completion: Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself. There is a path before you, but you choose the trials you will face, and the trials you will overcome.

text.title: 胜者方能通行
text.objectives: 在战斗中击败李飞大师。
text.description: 是时候接受我的试炼了。有了这三个激发潜能的火盆，我们来看看你不屈不挠的精神是否能够助你通过试炼。
text.completion: Remember always, the superior warrior is modest in his speech, but exceeds in his actions.
text.completed: Speak to Master Li Fei within the Shrine of Inner-Light.

english.title: Only the Worthy Shall Pass
english.objectives: Defeat Master Li Fei in combat.
english.description: It is time for you to face me. With these three fires illuminating your potential, we will see with certainty whether your resolved soul is truly worthy of passing.
english.completion: Remember always, the superior warrior is modest in his speech, but exceeds in his actions.
english.completed: Speak to Master Li Fei within the Shrine of Inner-Light.

text.title: 上古火灵燧焰
text.objectives: 重新点燃上古火灵燧焰。
text.description: 你通过了试炼，$c。$B$B上古火灵燧焰在大厅里休息。让他尽情享用你收集的木柴，并用风煽起他的烈焰。如此一来，你便能获得他的青睐。一旦他被点燃，只要他愿意，就将他引领至矗立在岛中心的五晨寺。
text.progress: <Huo rests quietly within the pool.>
text.completion: <Through the glare, it looks like Huo is smiling. He seems to have warmed up to you.>
text.completed: Speak to Huo within the Shrine of Inner-Light.

english.title: Huo, the Spirit of Fire
english.objectives: Reignite Huo, the spirit of fire.
english.description: You are worthy of passing, $c.$B$BHuo, the spirit of fire rests in the chamber beyond. Let him feast upon the kindling you've gathered, and use the wind to fan his flames. Doing so should endear you to him. Once he is ignited, if he is willing, lead him to the Temple of Five Dawns, the building standing high in the center of the island.
english.progress: <Huo rests quietly within the pool.>
english.completion: <Through the glare, it looks like Huo is smiling. He seems to have warmed up to you.>
english.completed: Speak to Huo within the Shrine of Inner-Light.

text.title: 神真子的热情
text.objectives: 将上古火灵带到五晨寺。
text.description: <燧焰兴奋地跳来跳去，随时准备跟着你走。>$B$B<尚喜师父让你将燧焰带到岛中心的五晨寺去见他。你的下一个目的地已经很明确了。>
text.completion: $n, you've done very well. Huo, the spirit of fire, is here. The temple flames are reignited. You accomplished the challenge I put before you, and with seeming ease.$B$BThere is a greater purpose in bringing Huo to the temple. It is time that I tell you more of things to come.
text.completed: Speak to Master Shang Xi at the Temple of Five Dawns.

english.title: The Passion of Shen-zin Su
english.objectives: Bring the Spirit of Fire to the Temple of Five Dawns.
english.description: <Huo bounces around excitedly, ready to follow you.>$B$B<Master Shang Xi told you to bring Huo to meet him at the Temple of Five Dawns in the center of the island. Your next destination lies before you.>
english.completion: $n, you've done very well. Huo, the spirit of fire, is here. The temple flames are reignited. You accomplished the challenge I put before you, and with seeming ease.$B$BThere is a greater purpose in bringing Huo to the temple. It is time that I tell you more of things to come.
english.completed: Speak to Master Shang Xi at the Temple of Five Dawns.

objectiveDetails.description: 将上古火灵带回五晨寺

text.title: 至关重要的物品
text.objectives: 从珀叶精怪那里夺回6份训练物资。
text.description: 珀叶精怪围住了我的车，并偷走了大部分训练物资。那些本来都是要运到习武场去的！它们虽然总是惹是生非，但从来没有这么肆无忌惮过。我不知道为什么会这样。$B$B拜托了，请你帮我找回物资。
text.progress: 你不用担心会伤到这些树精。它们不过是成了精的植物，很快就会重新发芽。
text.completion: Thank you! You're an honorable $c. They've taught you well.
text.completed: Return to Merchant Lorvo by Fu's Pond.

english.title: Items of Utmost Importance
english.objectives: Recover 6 Training Supplies from Amberleaf Scamps.
english.description: Amberleaf scamps swarmed my cart and stole most of the training supplies I was bringing up to the training grounds. They've always been troublemakers, but they've never been this aggressive before. I don't know what happened.$B$BPlease, help me recover my supplies.
english.progress: You needn't worry about hurting the sprites. They're really just living plants when it comes down to it - they'll resprout later.
english.completion: Thank you! You're an honorable $c. They've taught you well.
english.completed: Return to Merchant Lorvo by Fu's Pond.

text.title: 购物
text.objectives: 前往奥格瑞玛暗巷区的杜佛斯回收店，寻找偷箱贼前来拜访过的证据。
text.description: 瞧，我跟那见不得人的家伙说，暗巷区或许有家店更适合，呃，处理他的货。那地方叫做杜佛斯回收店。$B$B去找德兰·杜佛斯，他专事“回收”艾泽拉斯各地的各种稀有货色。
text.progress: You look like you know something about these missing goods.
text.completion: Leave it to Droffers to have a buyer lined up already. We should combine our efforts to track down this thief and keep the crate's contents from falling into the wrong hands.
text.completed: Speak to Delian Sunshade.

english.title: Shopping Around
english.objectives: Make your way to Droffers and Son Salvage in Orgrimmar's Drag district and look for evidence of the crate-thief's visit.
english.description: Look, I told that shady character that there might be a shop more open to his, uh, wares in the Drag. Droffer's and Son Salvage is the name of the place.$B$BLook for Dran Droffers. He oversees the 'salvage' of rare and valuable objects from all over Azeroth.
english.progress: You look like you know something about these missing goods.
english.completion: Leave it to Droffers to have a buyer lined up already. We should combine our efforts to track down this thief and keep the crate's contents from falling into the wrong hands.
english.completed: Speak to Delian Sunshade.

text.title: 保护措施
text.objectives: 获得2份奇异之尘，5只水晶瓶，以及5簇血荨麻。
text.description: 那么说有人雇你回收这只箱子？听起来不大妙。$B$B箱子里的东西归神圣遗物学会管。里面装的都是十分危险而强大的物品。$B$B德兰已经安排贼和收货人会面了，我们得过去，不过首先，在处理箱子这件事情之前我们要做些自我保护。$B$B去材料商那儿买点奇异之尘，去炼金商人那里弄一些瓶子，然后从智慧谷摘些血荨麻来。
text.progress: Did you get all the ingredients?
text.completion: Let's see what I can remember from the alchemy lessons of my youth. If it explodes, I've done something wrong.$B$BThis concoction should protect us from the worst effects of carrying or handling the crate.
text.completed: Return to Delian Sunshade in the Drag.

english.title: Taking Precautions
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Crystal Vials, 5 Arcane Powder, and 5 Blood Nettle.
english.description: So someone else hired you to retrieve this crate? I don't like the sound of that.$B$BThat crate's contents belong in the care of the Reliquary. The items it holds are very powerful and very dangerous.$B$BWe have to find the meeting that Dran set up between the thief and the collector, but first, we'll need to protect ourselves from the effects of handling that crate.$B$BBuy some arcane powder from a reagent merchant, get vials from an alchemy merchant, and pick some blood nettle in the Valley of Wisdom.
english.progress: Did you get all the ingredients?
english.completion: Let's see what I can remember from the alchemy lessons of my youth. If it explodes, I've done something wrong.$B$BThis concoction should protect us from the worst effects of carrying or handling the crate.
english.completed: Return to Delian Sunshade in the Drag.

text.title: 收货人的代表
text.objectives: 去洛丹伦废墟破坏萨纳斯同窃贼的会面。
text.description: 照德兰的说法，想要箱子的“收货人”不是别人，正是疯狂的艾萨拉大法师克希雷姆。$B$B大法师的忠实信徒打算在洛丹伦废墟的一处隐秘的天井里同拿着箱子的人碰头。$B$B快，搭飞艇前往提瑞斯法林地！$B$B你必须及时赶到那里，阻止交易，在箱子落入克希雷姆手中之前将其夺回来。你拿到箱子之后，就去荣誉谷的飞龙之尾 找我。
text.completion: Tendrils of dark power dance around the crate, but there's no trace of Sanath Lim-yo. You can now claim the crate and return it to your employer.
text.completed: Inspect the Stolen Crate in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

english.title: The Collector's Agent
english.objectives: Disrupt the meeting between Sanath Lim-yo and the thief in the Ruins of Lordaeron.
english.description: According to Dran, the "collector" who wants the crate is none other than the insane Archmage Xylem of Azshara.$B$BThe archmage's faithful servant is to meet with the man who has the crate in a secluded corner of the courtyard in the Ruins of Lordaeron.$B$BQuickly, take the zeppelin to Tirisfal Glade!$B$BYou must get there in time to intercept the exchange and retrieve the crate before Xylem gets his hands on it. If you can get the crate, meet me at the Wyvern's Tail in the Valley of Honor.
english.completion: Tendrils of dark power dance around the crate, but there's no trace of Sanath Lim-yo. You can now claim the crate and return it to your employer.
english.completed: Inspect the Stolen Crate in the Ruins of Lordaeron.

text.title: 现在怎么办？
text.objectives: 去奥格瑞玛力量谷的“破裂的獠牙”把箱子还给埃德加·古德温。$B$B-或者-$B$B去奥格瑞玛荣誉谷的“飞龙之尾”把箱子交给德利安·日影。
text.description: 你终于找到了埃德加·古德温要你拿回来的箱子。但是，正如神圣遗物学会的代表警告过你的那样，箱子里装的不是什么好东西。$B$B他说的没错，看来你的雇主没有把这份工作的危险性跟你明说。你真的想把箱子交给他吗，还是说你宁可把它交给德利安·日影？至少后者愿意把箱子里的东西封存于世。
text.progress: Have you brought the crate as we discussed?
text.completion: I never thought you'd be able to recover it. Well, let's see it.

english.title: What Now?
english.objectives: You may return the crate to either Edgar Goodwin at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength.$B$B-OR-$B$BReturn the crate to Delian Sunshade at the Wyvern's Tail in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor.
english.description: You've finally found the crate that Edgar Goodwin sent you to retrieve. However, it appears the Reliquary representative's warnings about the nature of the crate's contents were correct.$B$BThere's no doubt that your employer lied to you about the dangers involved in the job. Do you really want to hand the crate over to him, or would you rather give it to Delian Sunshade, who believes it better to keep the crate's contents locked away?
english.progress: Have you brought the crate as we discussed?
english.completion: I never thought you'd be able to recover it. Well, let's see it.

text.title: 诡异的箱子
text.description: 箱子几经偷盗、买卖和追寻。凡是打算解开其中封存的魔法之人，都遭到了其力量的反噬。$B$B饶是如此，箱子本身还是毫发未伤，充盈着魔法能量。偶尔，它还会震动一两下子，仿佛其中装着什么活物一般。$B$B貌似它已经同你绑定在了一起，如今是你的东西了。

english.title: The Creepy Crate
english.description: It's been sought after, stolen, and sold. Anyone who tried to tap the magic held within has seen that power turn against him.$B$BYet, the crate itself appears unscathed and suffused with magical energy. From time to time, it shakes or bobs as if its contents were alive.$B$BIt seems bonded to you and now it's yours.

text.title: 患难真情
text.objectives: 去暴风城贸易区的镶金玫瑰找安森·哈斯廷。
text.description: 你知道，我还没有见到安森。$B$B最近，他老是在镶金玫瑰喝个烂醉。$B$B肯定有什么事情困扰着他！你能否去看看他？
text.completion: What do you want?$B$BI'm never going to finish my research, . It's my life's work, and now the courier with the experimental reagents I need is late!

english.title: A Friend in Need
english.objectives: Visit Anson Hastings at the Gilded Rose in Stormwind's Trade District.
english.description: You know, I haven't seen Anson out here yet.$B$BLately, he's been spending all his time drinking himself into a stupor at the Gilded Rose.$B$BSomething must really be bothering him! Would you mind checking in on him?
english.completion: What do you want?$B$BI'm never going to finish my research, . It's my life's work, and now the courier with the experimental reagents I need is late!

text.title: 患难真情
text.objectives: 去跟奥格瑞玛的“破裂的獠牙”，跟埃德加·古德温谈谈。
text.description: 我的朋友埃德加出事了。往常，他都会积极参与万圣节活动，可最近他总是郁郁寡欢、离群索居。$B$B他一天到晚都在奥格瑞玛的“破裂的獠牙”，跟兽人们喝老酒。你是不是能去看看，想点办法让他振作起来呢？
text.completion: What do you want?$B$BCandace sent you? She knows me too well. I've hit a rut in my research and I've been waiting for a very important delivery, but the courier's late...

english.title: A Friend in Need
english.objectives: Speak with Edgar Goodwin at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar.
english.description: There's something wrong with my friend, Edgar. Normally, he loves the Hallow's End festivities, but he's been sullen and reclusive lately.$B$BHe spends all his time in the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar drinking with the orcs. Would you mind stopping by and seeing if there's anything you can do to cheer him up?
english.completion: What do you want?$B$BCandace sent you? She knows me too well. I've hit a rut in my research and I've been waiting for a very important delivery, but the courier's late...

text.title: 追踪委派
text.objectives: 去火焰之地夺回诺达希尔的分枝。
text.description: 我有责任对你的发现进行调查，$R，这也就意味着我的任务现在只能交给你了。$B$B一股远非天然生成的强大魔力将我引来此地，我这才发现事态大为不妙。$B$B有人将诺达希尔的一根树枝折了下来，带到了火焰之地的深处。在那里，敌人正利用它进行邪恶的仪式，以腐蚀诺达希尔，试图用大火烧毁它。$B$B你必须想办法干扰仪式，将世界之树的树枝夺回来。
text.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

english.title: Delegation Tracker
english.objectives: Recover the Branch of Nordrassil from the Firelands.
english.description: I am duty-bound to look into your claims immediately, $r, which means my mission here now must fall to you.$b$bA surge of ancient magic, far too strong to have occurred naturally, drew me here. I have since discovered a most troubling development.$b$bA bough from Nordrassil has been ripped from the tree and taken deep into the Firelands. There, a powerful ritual threatens to corrupt Nordrassil, consuming it in flame.$b$bYou must find a way to interrupt the ritual and reclaim the world tree's branch.
english.completed: Speak to Kalecgos at Amber Ledge in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 实力检测
text.objectives: 克莉·希克斯要求你收集250个恐怖的战利品。当你带着“暗月冒险者指南”，杀死能够提供你经验值或荣誉值的生物时，你就可以获得恐怖的战利品。
text.description: 对某些人来说，如果这个世界没有伤害，生活将会多么有趣和美妙。我称这些人为——弱者。$b$b要成为强者中的强者，你就必须伤害一些人，一些事物。要想突破身体的极限，你就得伤害自己。有时你也得伤害他人，因为他们威胁到其他人的生存。$b$b要成为强者中的强者，你必须去战斗。你到底有多渴望变强？$b$b我要你去战胜那些值得一战的敌人，而后带着战利品凯旋。
text.progress: No pain, no gain.
text.completion: Did you seek out worthy challenges, or did you simply find some field of boars and slaughter them?$B$BThere is a reason I am the strongest.$B$BPerhaps, one day you will see just how strong I really am, $C.  Until then, keep pushing yourself.  But don't forget to take a break from time to time.$B$BLike now.  Here, enjoy the Darkmoon Faire.
text.completed: Return to Kerri Hicks at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Test Your Strength
english.objectives: Kerri Hicks wants you to collect 250 Grisly Trophies.  Trophies are obtained as long as you kill creatures that offer experience or honor and you have the Darkmoon Field Guide with you.
english.description: For some people, it's all fun and games until someone gets hurt.  I call those people, weak.$b$bTo be the strongest, you have to hurt someone or something.  You hurt yourself as you push your body to its limits.  You hurt those that threaten the well-being of others.$b$bIf you want to be the strongest, you have to fight.  How bad do you want it?$b$bI want you to crush those that would offer a challenge to you, then bring me back proof of your triumphs.
english.progress: No pain, no gain.
english.completion: Did you seek out worthy challenges, or did you simply find some field of boars and slaughter them?$B$BThere is a reason I am the strongest.$B$BPerhaps, one day you will see just how strong I really am, $C.  Until then, keep pushing yourself.  But don't forget to take a break from time to time.$B$BLike now.  Here, enjoy the Darkmoon Faire.
english.completed: Return to Kerri Hicks at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 坦克指挥官
text.objectives: 用你的暗月坦克在规定时间内摧毁30个目标。
text.description: 欢迎光临我们这个小小的模拟坦克战场！$b$b只要1枚代币，你就可以驾驶坦克驰骋沙场，摧毁坦克目标，展现你非凡的战略艺术了。
text.completion: An impressive display!$B$BHere's your reward.
text.completed: Return to Finlay Coolshot at the Darkmoon Faire to claim your prize.
text.giverWindow: 摧毁目标！

english.title: Tonk Commander
english.objectives: Use your Darkmoon Tonk to destroy 30 Tonk Targets in the time allowed.
english.description: Welcome to our humble little steam tank battle simulator!$b$bFor one token, you can demonstrate your tactical mastery by navigating the course and destroying the targets.
english.completion: An impressive display!$B$BHere's your reward.
english.completed: Return to Finlay Coolshot at the Darkmoon Faire to claim your prize.
english.giverWindow: Destroy these targets!

text.title: 炮弹飞人
text.objectives: 落地时尽量靠近火炮目标以获得5点火炮目标积分。
text.description: 只要1个暗月游戏代币，你就能坐着雷管5000型超级大炮飞行啦。而且这游戏的乐趣还不止于此！我们在码头旁的海里设置了目标。$b$b如果你降落时能获得5个积分，那么就可以赢得一些奖券。$b$b正中目标可以获得5分，擦过目标可以获得3分，靠近目标可以获得1分。$b$b祝你好运！
text.progress: Happy landings!
text.completion: Five points?  Good job!  Here are your prize tickets.$B$BEnjoy the rest of the Darkmoon Faire!
text.completed: Claim your prize from Maxima Blastenheimer.

english.title: The Humanoid Cannonball
english.objectives: Accumulate 5 Cannon Target Points by landing near the target.
english.description: For just one Darkmoon Game Token, you can ride the Blastenheimer 5000 Ultra Cannon.  But the fun doesn't end there!  We've placed a target in the water near the boardwalk.$b$bIf you can score five points from your landing, you can win some prize tickets!$b$bA bullseye gets you five points, a close shot three, and landing at least near it gets you one.$b$bHappy landings!

text.title: 堕落的守护者
text.objectives: 去海加尔山的拉多尼尔遗迹，挑战并击败奥利瑟拉。
text.description: 范达尔·鹿盔被关在海加尔。负责关押的是奥利瑟拉，我的同族，一条绿龙！$B$B我们只能认为暮光之锤已经腐蚀了她。你必须前去挑战她，$n。虽然我不忍见到事态发展至此，但如有必要，消灭她。$B$B她最后一次出现，是在世界之树的西边，拉多尼尔遗迹那里。

english.title: The Fallen Guardian
english.objectives: Confront and slay Alysra at the Ruins of Lar'donir in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: Fandral Staghelm was kept prisoner here in Hyjal. It was the green dragon Alysra - one of my very own! - who was in charge of keeping Fandral secure.$B$BWe can only conclude that the Twilight's Hammer has gotten to her. You must confront her, $n. Destroy her if you must - I cannot bear to see it.$B$BShe was last seen in the Ruins of Lar'donir, west of the World Tree.

text.title: 开枪！得分！
text.objectives: 在60秒内得到25分。
text.description: 你自认是个神枪手吗？你的速射技术又如何呢？$b$b只要花一个游戏代币，你就能来试试身手了。$b$b你说呢，伙计？你到底有多少本事？
text.completion: I knew you could do it, $C!  Here's your prize.  Enjoy the faire.
text.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: He Shoots, He Scores!
english.objectives: Score 25 points in 60 seconds.
english.description: Think you're a good shot?  Quick on the trigger?$b$bIt'll cost you just a single game token to test your skills.$b$bWhat do you say?  How good are you?

text.title: 救世萨满的召唤
text.objectives: 去海加尔山世界之树的南边跟萨尔谈一谈。
text.description: 大地之环再次召唤你，$n。$B$B作为联盟的一员，我知道你在和那个名叫“萨尔”的前部落酋长携手这件事上持保留意见。但接下来他要举行一次仪式，来治愈我们的世界。他还特意指名一位联盟的英雄作陪。$B$B抛下你的顾虑，$c，响应救世萨满的号召吧。$B$B你可以在海加尔山诺达希尔的南边找到他。
text.completion: It would appear my message has been heard in Stormwind.$B$BThank you, $n. Let us get to work...

english.title: The Call of the World-Shaman
english.objectives: Speak with Thrall just south of the World Tree in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: The Earthen Ring calls to you once more, $n.$B$BAs a member of the Alliance, I know that you may have reservations working with the one you call Thrall, the former Warchief of the Horde. But he has specifically requested an Alliance hero to accompany him in his next endeavor, a ritual of healing that will profoundly impact our world.$B$BCast aside your doubts, $c, and heed the World Shaman's call.$B$BYou will find him under the boughs of Nordrassil in Mount Hyjal, on the southern side of the tree.

text.title: 敌人的徽记
text.objectives: 将收缴的徽记交给暗月岛上暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
text.description: 这个磨损的徽章上有一个敌军军官的徽记。虽然对你来说，这个徽章的价值仅仅在于它的材质本身。但在那些军事纪念品收藏家眼里，它却是无价之宝。$B$B暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授是艾泽拉斯著名的军用品收藏家。你下次去暗月马戏团时，记得把徽章给他看看。
text.progress: What is it you have there?
text.completion: This is a remarkable example of an Alliance officer's insignia. While many of them visit the Faire, none are willing to part with their badges. Would you be willing to accept some Darkmoon tickets in trade?

english.title: The Enemy's Insignia
english.objectives: Bring the Captured Insignia to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
english.description: This battered badge carries the insignia of an enemy officer. While worth little more to you than the metal it's made from, this piece would have significant value to a collector of military memorabilia.$B$BProfessor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire is famous all over Azeroth for his large collection of military artifacts. Show the badge to him the next time you visit the Darkmoon Faire.
english.progress: What is it you have there?
english.completion: This is a remarkable example of an Alliance officer's insignia. While many of them visit the Faire, none are willing to part with their badges. Would you be willing to accept some Darkmoon tickets in trade?

text.title: 缴获的日记
text.objectives: 将冒险者的日志交给暗月岛上暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
text.description: 这本书的皮质封面已经严重磨损，而且沾满了血迹和泥土。简单翻阅之后，你发现这是某个自视甚高的冒险者的私人日记。$B$B暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授或许会对这类东西感兴趣。
text.progress: What is it you have there?
text.completion: A remarkable find!$B$B<The professor browses the book's contents.>$B$BSome of these are hard to read, but if even a third of the contents of this journal are true, this is a real treasure. Would you trade it for a generous number of Darkmoon tickets?

english.title: The Captured Journal
english.objectives: Bring the Adventurer's Journal to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
english.description: This book is covered in battered leather stained with blood and mud. Leafing through the pages, you discover that it is a personal journal of an adventurer with a high opinion of himself and his adventures.$B$BProfessor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire might want to see something like this.
english.progress: What is it you have there?
english.completion: A remarkable find!$B$B<The professor browses the book's contents.>$B$BSome of these are hard to read, but if even a third of the contents of this journal are true, this is a real treasure. Would you trade it for a generous number of Darkmoon tickets?

text.title: 缴获的旗帜
text.objectives: 将阵亡者的旗帜交给暗月岛上暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
text.description: This tattered banner bears a faded guild crest. This old banner must've seen more than its share of battles.$B$BProfessor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire collects banners and other relics of combat and he might be interested in acquiring this one.

english.title: A Captured Banner
english.objectives: Bring the Banner of the Fallen to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
english.description: This tattered banner bears a faded guild crest. This old banner must've seen more than its share of battles.$B$BProfessor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire collects banners and other relics of combat and he might be interested in acquiring this one.

Leafing through the pages, you discover that it is a personal journal of a Horde adventurer with a high opinion of herself and her adventures.$B$BProfessor Thaddeus Paleo of the Darkmoon Faire might want to see something like this.

text.title: 敲打时刻
text.objectives: 敲打豺狼人，赢得30分。
text.description: 你想来打几个豺狼人吗？那你就来对地方了。$b$b你的目标很简单，在一分钟内得到30分就可以了。$b$b拿出我给你的大锤，准备开打吧。等你准备好之后，就跟我说一声。
text.completion: So you have managed to defeat the gnolls.  It felt good, didn't it?$B$BHere is your prize.  Enjoy the rest of the Darkmoon Faire!
text.completed: Return to Mola at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: It's Hammer Time
english.objectives: Score 30 points by whacking Gnolls.
english.description: So you want to whack some gnolls?  Well you've come to the right place.$b$bYour goal is simple, score 30 points in a minute.$b$bUse the mallet I give you and get ready to whack.  Speak to me when you are ready to start.
english.completion: So you have managed to defeat the gnolls.  It felt good, didn't it?$B$BHere is your prize.  Enjoy the rest of the Darkmoon Faire!
english.completed: Return to Mola at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 占卜道具
text.objectives: 将占卜者符文交给暗月岛上暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
text.description: 这套陈旧的符文石已经使用了很多年，石板都磨损严重，你几乎都辨认不出上面的符文了。$B$B或许某个学者或收藏家能从中看出更多的东西。你下次去暗月马戏团时，记得把符文石带给萨杜斯·帕雷教授看看。
text.progress: What do you have there?
text.completion: Where did you find this collection of runes? I haven't seen anything like this in years. It'll be a splendid mystery to unravel!$B$BWould you trade these for Darkmoon tickets?

english.title: Tools of Divination
english.objectives: Bring the Soothsayer's Runes to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
english.description: This collection of well-worn runestones has seen much use. The pieces seem old; you can't recognize any of the markings on their surfaces.$B$BPerhaps a scholar or a collector would know more about them. Bring them to Professor Thaddeus Paleo next time you're at the Darkmoon Faire.
english.progress: What do you have there?
english.completion: Where did you find this collection of runes? I haven't seen anything like this in years. It'll be a splendid mystery to unravel!$B$BWould you trade these for Darkmoon tickets?

text.objectives: 将占卜者符文交给暗月岛上暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
text.description: 这套陈旧的符文石已经使用了很多年，石板都磨损严重，你几乎都辨认不出上面的符文了。$B$B或许某个学者或收藏家能从中看出更多的东西。把他们带给暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授看看吧。

english.title: Tools of Divination
english.objectives: Bring the Soothsayer's Runes to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire on Darkmoon Island.
english.description: This collection of well-worn runestones has seen much use. The pieces seem old; you can't recognize any of the markings on their surfaces.$B$BPerhaps a scholar or a collector would know more about them. Bring them to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: Plenty of Plump Frogs
text.objectives: Catch 5 Plump Frogs near Stonebull Lake.
text.description: Just about everyone in Azeroth has heard of our world famous crunchy frogs. We can barely keep up with the demand!$B$BYou look like a decent angler and a spry $r. Would you help me restock my frog supply?$B$BThe ones that make the best crunchy frogs are the plump ones that live down near Stonebull Lake. I'll make it worthwhile for you.
text.completed: Bring the Plump Frogs to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.objectives: Catch 5 Plump Frogs near Stonebull Lake.
