Would you help me restock my frog supply?$B$BThe ones that make the best crunchy frogs are the plump ones that live down near Stonebull Lake. I'll make it worthwhile for you.
english.completed: Bring the Plump Frogs to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 修一下又是一辆好坦克
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团场地里修理5辆损坏的蒸汽坦克。
text.description: 蒸汽坦克大战是暗月马戏团最受欢迎的娱乐项目之一。游客们常常为了测试和提高他们的水平一打就是几个小时，而坦克们在带给游客欢乐的同时，却承受着非常严重的打击损耗。$B$B你看上去是个和扳手打过交道的人，介不介意帮我修几辆损坏的蒸汽坦克，让他们正常运作？我不会让你白干的。
text.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Talkin' Tonks
english.objectives: Repair 5 Damaged Steam Tonks around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: The steam tonks are one of the Darkmoon Faire's most popular amusements. Our visitors love to test their skills for hours and hours, but the tonks take a real beating from all that fun.$B$BYou look like you know your way around a wrench. Mind helping me fix some of the damaged tonks and return them to working order? I'll compensate you for your time.
english.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 贝贝需要两双鞋
text.objectives: 使用储备铁块制造4块马蹄铁，然后给暗月马戏团的贝贝安上马蹄铁。
text.description: You may have seen my horse, Baby, over near the wagons. She pulls the cart that hauls all the animals in our Zoo Bizarre.$B$BShe's a hard worker and she tears through shoes like you wouldn't believe. It's about time for a new set. I've already bought the raw materials.$B$BAll you need to do is shape them over an anvil and apply them to Baby's feet. It's a quick job and worth some tickets, wouldn't you say?
text.completed: Return to Yebb Neblegear at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Baby Needs Two Pair of Shoes
english.objectives: Use the Iron Stock to craft 4 Horseshoes, then apply the Horseshoes to Baby at the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: You may have seen my horse, Baby, over near the wagons. She pulls the cart that hauls all the animals in our Zoo Bizarre.$B$BShe's a hard worker and she tears through shoes like you wouldn't believe. It's about time for a new set. I've already bought the raw materials.$B$BAll you need to do is shape them over an anvil and apply them to Baby's feet. It's a quick job and worth some tickets, wouldn't you say?
english.completed: Return to Yebb Neblegear at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 蒸汽坦克，重装上阵
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团场地内收集6块坦克碎片。
text.description: 游客们钟爱蒸汽坦克！每当暗月马戏团落幕的时候，这儿满地都是坦克碎片。$B$B让这些优质的金属就这么埋没在尘泥之中，真是可惜了。$B$B如果你能帮我收集一些大块坦克碎片的话，我就能够用它们来翻新损坏的坦克零件了。这比每次都买新的材料可便宜多了。你愿意帮忙吗？
text.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Rearm, Reuse, Recycle
english.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of Tonk Scrap from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
english.description: Faire-goers just love the steam tonks! And when the Darkmoon Faire closes, these grounds will be littered with tonk scrap.$B$BIt'd be a shame to let all that good metal just sit in the dirt.$B$BIf you help me collect some of the larger scraps, I can use them to reforge broken tonk parts. It's a lot less expensive than buying new metal every time. What do you say?
english.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 皮革打磨
text.objectives: 打磨4张散落在暗月马戏团场地内剥好的兽皮。
text.description: 暗月马戏团需要更多的皮革来制作帐篷、皮靴以及一切你可以想到的东西。我抓了些野兽，把它们的皮晾在外面有待进一步处理。$B$B你看上去是个学过剥皮的人，如果你愿意帮我把这些新剥下的兽皮打磨一下的话，我会给你奖励。
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Tan My Hide
english.objectives: Scrape 4 Staked Skins around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: The Darkmoon Faire always needs more leather for tents, boots, and just about anything you can imagine! I've trapped some creatures and staked the skins out for the next part of their treatment.$B$BYou seem to have some knowledge of skinning. I'll reward you if you help me with the job of scraping some of those new skins.
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 书写未来
text.objectives: 使用一包奇异的草药制作预言墨水，然后使用墨水及轻羊皮纸制作塞格的塔罗牌。
text.description: As the popularity of the Darkmoon Faire grows, more and more people seek me out to peer into their futures.$B$BMost times, they ask for knowledge best left hidden in the mists of time, but it is not my place to give such advice.$B$BMy stock of written fortunes is running low and you look to have a steady hand. Take these herbs, make ink from them, and pen a few fortunes for me. I'll see to it that you're rewarded.
text.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Writing the Future
english.objectives: Use the Bundle of Exotic Herbs to make Prophetic Ink and then combine the ink with Light Parchment to create Sayge's Fortunes.
english.description: As the popularity of the Darkmoon Faire grows, more and more people seek me out to peer into their futures.$B$BMost times, they ask for knowledge best left hidden in the mists of time, but it is not my place to give such advice.$B$BMy stock of written fortunes is running low and you look to have a steady hand. Take these herbs, make ink from them, and pen a few fortunes for me. I'll see to it that you're rewarded.
english.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 关注奖品
text.objectives: 使用暗月工具包，用粗线、闪光的小珠和蓝色染料制作5份暗月奖品。
text.description: The games are more popular than ever, and that means we're giving out prizes faster than we ever have before!$B$BWe're going to need more prizes, and fast. If you've some skill in leatherworking, I can give you a kit. You'll need to buy some of the pieces from a trade goods merchant like Shadi Mistrunner up on the central rise of Thunder Bluff, but they're inexpensive.$B$BAre you willing to help?
text.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Eyes on the Prizes
english.objectives: Use the Darkmoon Craftsman's Kit to make 5 Darkmoon Prizes from Coarse Thread, Shiny Baubles, and Blue Dye.
english.description: The games are more popular than ever, and that means we're giving out prizes faster than we ever have before!$B$BWe're going to need more prizes, and fast. If you've some skill in leatherworking, I can give you a kit. You'll need to buy some of the pieces from a trade goods merchant like Shadi Mistrunner up on the central rise of Thunder Bluff, but they're inexpensive.$B$BAre you willing to help?
english.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 救治伤员
text.objectives: 使用暗月绷带治疗4名受伤的艺人。
text.description: Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job, $n. It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions.$B$BWe send the most gravely wounded to the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff for help, but many still have minor hurts that can be tended to here. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Putting the Carnies Back Together Again
english.objectives: Use the Darkmoon Bandage to heal 4 Injured Carnies.
english.description: Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job, $n. It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions.$B$BWe send the most gravely wounded to the Spirit Rise in Thunder Bluff for help, but many still have minor hurts that can be tended to here. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 变废为宝
text.objectives: 通过分解散落在暗月马戏团地上的废弃的武器收集6份占卜者之尘。
text.description: People don't just come to the fair for fun and fortunes, $n. Most want something to take home with them, so I help to create the magical trinkets visitors purchase with their prize tickets.$B$BFor that, I need a steady supply of soothsayer's dust. Take a look around the grounds and you'll see a lot of discarded weapons. Those are just the kinds of items that can be broken down into dust with enchanting skills like yours. Would you like to help?
text.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Putting Trash to Good Use
english.objectives: Collect 6 Soothsayer's Dusts by disenchanting Discarded Weapons found around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: People don't just come to the fair for fun and fortunes, $n. Most want something to take home with them, so I help to create the magical trinkets visitors purchase with their prize tickets.$B$BFor that, I need a steady supply of soothsayer's dust. Take a look around the grounds and you'll see a lot of discarded weapons. Those are just the kinds of items that can be broken down into dust with enchanting skills like yours. Would you like to help?
english.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 地精工程学
text.objectives: 将20个重磅铁制炸弹，20个实心炸弹和5个自爆绵羊交给任意主城的工程学训练师。
text.description: 每个熟练的工程师都能选择一项专精，而我可以教你地精工程学的秘诀。$b$b你看上去很有搞爆破的天分，不过我还得看看你的作品。给我带20个重磅铁制炸弹，20个实心炸弹和5个自爆绵羊来。$b$b把这些东西交给任意主城的工程学训练师，你就能正式成为地精工程师并学习相关的结构图了！
text.progress: Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, I will grant you the knowledge required to join the exclusive club of goblin engineers!
text.completion: 这是你的第一张哥布林工程师协会会员卡!$B$B这张卡片中包含14天的费用，两周过後，这张卡就会到期。届时你可以到任何哥布林工程学训练师那儿缴付一定的费用，换得另一张卡片。如果没有卡片，你的会员身份就会暂时失效，同时你也无法从我们这里学习新的结构图。$B$B这对你已经学会的东西毫无影响，一旦成为哥布林工程师，你就终身都是哥布林工程师啦。$B$B
text.completed: Return to an engineering trainer in any capital city.

english.title: Goblin Engineering
english.objectives: Bring 20 Big Iron Bombs, 20 Solid Dynamite, and 5 Explosive Sheep to an engineering trainer in any capital city.
english.description: A skilled engineer can choose ONE specialization, and I know the secrets of goblin engineering.$b$bYou look like you're ready to blow things up, but I'll need some samples of your work.  Bring me twenty big iron bombs, twenty sticks of solid dynamite, and five explosive sheep.$b$bSubmit these items to an engineering trainer in any of the capital cities and you'll be an official goblin engineer with access to all the schematics!
english.progress: Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, I will grant you the knowledge required to join the exclusive club of goblin engineers!
english.completion: It appears you are indeed ready for proper training.  I dub you Goblin Engineer $n!$B$BYou'll be able to access any goblin engineer for some diabolical creations.  Have fun and try not to blow your face off.
english.completed: Return to an engineering trainer in any capital city.

text.title: 侏儒工程学
text.objectives: 将6根秘银管、1只精确瞄准镜和2个高级假人交给藏宝海湾的奥格索普·奥布诺提斯。
text.description: 作为你的指导者，我想看看你的工作成果。你是个熟练的技师，这是毫无疑问的，$N。我要对你的工作进行分析，帮助你在侏儒工程学的光明大道上更快地前进。我需要以下物品：6根秘银管、1只精确瞄准镜和2个高级假人——注意安全第一！$B$B把这些东西交给我，我就可以发给你一张属于你自己的侏儒工程师协会会员卡，如果你想要拜访世界各地的侏儒工程学训练师，这张卡是必须的！
text.completed: Return to Oglethorpe Obnoticus at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

english.title: Gnomish Engineering
english.objectives: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and a 2 Advanced Target Dummies to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
english.description: If you're ready to make some truly fantastic devices, then you've come to the right place.  And I can see you're a skilled engineer, but I want some samples of your work.  What I hope to do though is to analyze your craftmanship for ways to emphasize gnome-oriented techniques in your future efforts.  I need the following samples: six mithril tubes, an accurate scope, and two advanced target dummies.$B$BSubmit these items to me and you'll be an official gnomish engineer with access to all the schematics!
english.completed: Return to Oglethorpe Obnoticus at Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

text.title: 侏儒工程学
text.objectives: 将6个秘银管，1个精确瞄准镜和2个高级假人交给任意主城的工程学训练师。
text.description: 每个熟练的工程师都能选择一项专精，而我可以教你侏儒工程学的有关知识。$b$b你看起来很清醒，知道自己在做什么，不过我还得看看你的作品。给我带6个秘银管，1个精确瞄准镜和2个高级假人来。$b$b把这些东西交给任意主城的工程学训练师，你就能正式成为侏儒工程师并学习相关的结构图了！
text.progress: Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, you can become a certified gnomish engineer, granting you unlimited access to gnomish engineer schematics.
text.completion: 这是你的第一张地精工程师协会会员卡!$B$B这张卡片中包含14天的费用，两周过後，这张卡就会到期。届时你可以到任何地精工程学训练师那儿缴付一定的费用，换得另一张卡片。如果没有卡片，你的会员身份就会暂时失效，同时你也无法从我们这里学习新的结构图。$B$B这对你已经学会的东西毫无影响，一旦成为地精工程师，你就终身都是地精工程师啦。$B$B
text.completed: Return to an engineering trainer in any capital city.

english.title: Gnomish Engineering
english.objectives: Bring 6 Mithril Tubes, an Accurate Scope, and 2 Advanced Target Dummies to an engineering trainer in any capital city.
english.description: A skilled engineer can choose ONE specialization, and I can teach you the ways of gnomish engineering.$b$bYou look like you know what you're doing, but I'll need some samples of your work.  Bring me six mithril tubes, an accurate scope, and two advanced target dummies.$b$bSubmit these items to an engineering trainer in any of the capital cities and you'll be an official gnomish engineer with access to all the schematics!
english.progress: Once I receive your crafted engineering items for my review, you can become a certified gnomish engineer, granting you unlimited access to gnomish engineer schematics.
english.completion: Today is the day you become a real engineer, $n.  Don't worry about all those messy bombs and explosives, because it's time to shine!
english.completed: Return to an engineering trainer in any capital city.

text.title: 调制饮料
text.objectives: 使用调酒器混合月莓汁和泡沫饮料，调制出5份月莓泡沫饮料。
text.description: I'm sure you've made a lot of potions in your time as an alchemist. How would you like to help with something a bit more light-hearted?$B$BI've always wanted to try creating a fruit-flavored version of our popular fizzy drinks. If you're willing to give it a try, you can buy some of the base drink from me and mix it with some moonberry juice.$B$BGalissa Sundew should be able to sell you all the moonberry juice you need.
text.completed: Return to Sylannia at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: A Fizzy Fusion
english.objectives: Use the Cocktail Shaker to combine Moonberry Juice and Fizzy Faire Drink to create 5 servings of Moonberry Fizz.
english.description: I'm sure you've made a lot of potions in your time as an alchemist. How would you like to help with something a bit more light-hearted?$B$BI've always wanted to try creating a fruit-flavored version of our popular fizzy drinks. If you're willing to give it a try, you can buy some of the base drink from me and mix it with some moonberry juice.$B$BGalissa Sundew should be able to sell you all the moonberry juice you need.
english.completed: Return to Sylannia at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 救命草
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团场地周围收集6株暗色花。
text.description: The little purple flowers that grow wild around the grounds aren't just pretty.$B$BThey play a role in everything from treating wounds to seasoing food.$B$BYou seem to have some talent for harvesting herbs. Would you like to help me rebuild my stocks of darkblossom?
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Herbs for Healing
english.objectives: Gather 6 Darkblossoms from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
english.description: The little purple flowers that grow wild around the grounds aren't just pretty.$B$BThey play a role in everything from treating wounds to seasoing food.$B$BYou seem to have some talent for harvesting herbs. Would you like to help me rebuild my stocks of darkblossom?
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 遍地旗帜！
text.objectives: Use the Darkmoon Banner Kit to construct a Darkmoon Banner, then set it up in a pile of Loose Stones on Thunder Bluff's central rise.
text.description: Isn't it wonderful to see Darkmoon banners everywhere? It's my favorite part of setting up, but we have so many old and tattered ones that need to be replaced.$B$BIf you've some skill with a needle and thread, would you mind making a banner from this kit and putting it up in some loose stone on the central rise in Thunder Bluff?$B$BYou can get the rest of the supplies you'll need from Shadi Mistrunner on the central rise of Thunder Bluff.
text.completed: Return to Selina Dourman at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Banners, Banners Everywhere!
english.objectives: Use the Darkmoon Banner Kit to construct a Darkmoon Banner, then set it up in a pile of Loose Stones on Thunder Bluff's central rise.
english.description: Isn't it wonderful to see Darkmoon banners everywhere? It's my favorite part of setting up, but we have so many old and tattered ones that need to be replaced.$B$BIf you've some skill with a needle and thread, would you mind making a banner from this kit and putting it up in some loose stone on the central rise in Thunder Bluff?$B$BYou can get the rest of the supplies you'll need from Shadi Mistrunner on the central rise of Thunder Bluff.
english.completed: Return to Selina Dourman at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 药剂大师
text.objectives: 给任意主城的炼金训练师带去各式各样的合剂。
text.description: 药剂能够激发你的潜能！如果你想成为药剂大师，我可以教你。$b$b我可不是随便什么人都教的，你得先向我证明你对药剂学的热忱才行。几瓶合剂就足以证明你的决心了。$b$b记住，$n，你只能学一项专精，如果你完成了药剂大师的训练，那么就不能再学习药水和转化专精了。
text.progress: Have you the flasks?
text.completion: 好极了！
text.completed: Return to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.

english.title: Elixir Master
english.objectives: Bring a variety of flasks to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.
english.description: Elixirs are all about potency!  If you want to become an elixir master, I can teach you.$b$bI can't just train anyone, and I require proof that you are devoted before we continue.  Several flasks should be sufficient to show your dedication.$b$bRemember $n, you can only learn ONE specialization, so if you complete your elixir training, then potion and transmutation specialization will no longer be available.
english.progress: Have you the flasks?
english.completion: Excellent!
english.completed: Return to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.

text.title: 转化大师
text.objectives: 给任意主城的炼金训练师带去所需的材料。
text.description: 点铁成金，化水为火……如果你想成为转化大师，我可以给你指一条明路。$b$b转化大师的训练费用非常高昂，你得帮我带一些世上最好的转化材料来。$b$b记住，$n，你只能学一项专精，所以一旦你完成了转化大师的训练，就学不了药水和药剂专精了。
text.progress: Have you the gold?
text.completion: 好极了！
text.completed: Return to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.

english.title: Transmutation Master
english.objectives: Bring the requested materials to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.
english.description: Iron to gold, water to fire... if you want to become an transmutation master, then I can show you the way.$b$bThe training is very expensive, so bring me some of the finest material in the world, truegold.$b$bRemember $n, you can only learn ONE specialization, so if you complete your transmutation training, then potion and elixir specialization will no longer be available.
english.progress: Have you the gold?
english.completion: Excellent!
english.completed: Return to an alchemy trainer in any capital city.

text.title: 光彩夺目的马戏团
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团的场地内寻找一些碎玻璃并将它们制作成5个闪亮的“宝石”。
text.description: 暗月马戏团的表演者和动物们比我想象得更加需要珠宝的点缀。幸好，那些只是切割过的玻璃而已，但是总得有个手艺人来切割吧。$B$B如果你懂点珠宝加工技能的话，也许你会愿意为我们的表演切割一些闪耀的玻璃宝石。$B$B在这儿周围的地面上，你有时候能找到一些奇特且绚丽的玻璃碎片。经过行家的处理，这些碎片能够被制成非常炫目的宝石。
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Keeping the Faire Sparkling
english.objectives: Find Bits of Glass around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire and craft it into 5 Sparkling 'Gemstones'.
english.description: The Darkmoon Faire's performers and animals go through more jewelry than I'd ever imagined. Thankfully, the gems are just cut glass, but someone has to craft all of it.$B$BIf you've some skill as a jewelcrafter, perhaps you'd be willing to help craft some of the sparkling glass gems for our performers.$B$BSometimes you can find odd and amazing bits of glass around the grounds. Those make stunning gems when cut by someone with an eye for this craft.
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 让青蛙肉更松脆
text.objectives: 在肥美的青蛙肉外包裹面粉，然后将它们在斯塔姆·雷角身后的锅子里制成5份脆青蛙肉。
text.description: The Darkmoon Faire's crunchy frog is famous all over Azeroth!$B$BWe've just had a fresh batch of frogs delivered. How'd you like to help whip up a few and practice your cooking skills in the process?$B$BShadi Mistrunner sells flour, up on the central rise in Thunder Bluff. Get some flour from her and use it to coat these frogs, then cook them in the pot behind me.
text.completed: Return to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Putting the Crunch in the Frog
english.objectives: Prepare 5 Crunchy Frogs by breading your Plump Frogs with Simple Flour and then frying them in the cauldron behind Stamp Thunderhorn.
english.description: The Darkmoon Faire's crunchy frog is famous all over Azeroth!$B$BWe've just had a fresh batch of frogs delivered. How'd you like to help whip up a few and practice your cooking skills in the process?$B$BShadi Mistrunner sells flour, up on the central rise in Thunder Bluff. Get some flour from her and use it to coat these frogs, then cook them in the pot behind me.
english.completed: Return to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 给小家伙们乐一乐
text.objectives: Bring 15 Fossil Fragments to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.
text.description: Children are always full of questions about what an archaeologist does and how it works, so I prepared a demonstration for them.$B$BI take artifacts and fossils and bury them in the sand behind the tent. The children get to dig and make their own discoveries, learn how bones fit together, and see how archaeology can teach them about history.$B$BIf you have any spare fossils, would you consider donating them to my side project?

english.title: Fun for the Little Ones
english.objectives: Bring 15 Fossil Fragments to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: Children are always full of questions about what an archaeologist does and how it works, so I prepared a demonstration for them.$B$BI take artifacts and fossils and bury them in the sand behind the tent. The children get to dig and make their own discoveries, learn how bones fit together, and see how archaeology can teach them about history.$B$BIf you have any spare fossils, would you consider donating them to my side project?

text.title: 调制饮料
text.objectives: 使用调酒器混合月莓汁和泡沫饮料，调制出5份月莓泡沫饮料。
text.description: 我敢说，作为一名炼金师，你肯定调配过不少药水。有没有兴趣帮我个小忙？$B$B我一直想要调制一种水果口味的泡沫饮料。如果你愿意试试，可以从我这里买一些基本饮料，然后再兑入月莓汁。$B$B你可以在艾尔文森林或莫高雷的任何一个旅店老板那里买到足够的月莓汁来调制饮料。
text.progress: How's that moonberry fizz coming?
text.completion: Your creation looks promising. With any luck, we'll soon have a new favorite!$B$BThanks for your help!
text.completed: Return to Sylannia at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: A Fizzy Fusion
english.objectives: Use the Cocktail Shaker to combine Moonberry Juice and Fizzy Faire Drink to create 5 servings of Moonberry Fizz.
english.description: I'm sure you've made a lot of potions in your time as an alchemist. How would you like to help with something a bit more light-hearted?$B$BI've always wanted to try creating a fruit-flavored version of our popular fizzy drinks. If you're willing to give it a try, you can buy some of the base drink from me and mix it with some moonberry juice.$B$BAny innkeeper in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore should be able to sell you enough juice to make your creation.
english.progress: How's that moonberry fizz coming?
english.completion: Your creation looks promising. With any luck, we'll soon have a new favorite!$B$BThanks for your help!
english.completed: Return to Sylannia at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 给小家伙们乐一乐
text.objectives: 用考古学收集15个化石碎片并交给暗月马戏团的萨杜斯·帕雷教授。
text.description: 孩子们总是会问很多诸如“考古学家是干什么的？”或是“考古有什么用？”等等问题，于是我为他们准备了一场演示。$B$B我会把一些古代遗物和化石埋在帐篷后面的沙地里，孩子们可以自行挖掘，了解骨头是如何拼接起来，并通过考古学学习历史。$B$B如果你有多余的化石，是否愿意为我的这个方案捐献一点出来呢？
text.progress: How about it? Want to donate some fossil fragments?
text.completion: These are great! They're just the kinds of pieces the kids will be excited to 'discover'.

english.title: Fun for the Little Ones
english.objectives: Bring 15 Fossil Fragments collected with Archaeology to Professor Thaddeus Paleo at the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: Children are always full of questions about what an archaeologist does and how it works, so I prepared a demonstration for them.$B$BI take artifacts and fossils and bury them in the sandbox beside the tent. The children get to dig and make their own discoveries, learn how bones fit together, and see how archaeology can teach them about history.$B$BIf you have any spare fossils, would you consider donating them to my side project?
english.progress: How about it? Want to donate some fossil fragments?
english.completion: These are great! They're just the kinds of pieces the kids will be excited to 'discover'.

text.title: 贝贝需要两双鞋
text.objectives: 使用储备铁块制造4块马蹄铁，然后给暗月马戏团的贝贝安上马蹄铁。
text.description: 你可能已经在马车这边见过我的马驹贝贝了。她拉的马车把一些动物运送到珍奇馆里。$B$B她干活可卖力了，你可能不会相信她的蹄铁损耗得多么快。现在是时候给她换双新鞋了。我已经把所有的原材料购齐了。$B$B你需要做的就是把它们在铁砧上定型，然后安在贝贝的蹄子上。这事不会用掉你太多时间，还能换取一些奖券，何乐而不为呢？
text.completion: Thank you for your help, $n! Here's the payment I promised.
text.completed: Return to Yebb Neblegear at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Baby Needs Two Pair of Shoes
english.objectives: Use the Iron Stock to craft 4 Horseshoes, then apply the Horseshoes to Baby at the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: You may have seen my horse, Baby, over near the wagons. She pulls the cart that hauls some of the animals in our Zoo Bizarre.$B$BShe's a hard worker and she tears through shoes like you wouldn't believe. It's about time for a new set. I've already bought the raw materials.$B$BAll you need to do is shape them over an anvil and apply them to Baby's feet. It's a quick job and worth some tickets, wouldn't you say?
english.completion: Thank you for your help, $n! Here's the payment I promised.
english.completed: Return to Yebb Neblegear at the Darkmoon Faire.

objectiveDetails.description: 为贝贝安上新的马蹄铁

text.title: 让青蛙肉更松脆
text.objectives: 在肥美的青蛙肉外包裹面粉，然后将它们在斯塔姆·雷角身后的锅子里制成5份脆青蛙肉。
text.description: 暗月马戏团的脆青蛙肉可是风靡全艾泽拉斯的极致美味！$B$B有一批青蛙肉刚刚到货，你想不想帮忙制作一点脆青蛙肉，顺便提高一下你的烹饪水平？$B$B你可以在艾尔文森林或莫高雷的任何商人那里买到裹青蛙所需要的面粉。
text.progress: Do I smell fresh crunchy frog?
text.completion: These are perfectly cooked, $n. You've done an excellent job.
text.completed: Return to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Putting the Crunch in the Frog
english.objectives: Prepare 5 Crunchy Frogs by breading your Plump Frogs with Simple Flour and then frying them in the cauldron behind Stamp Thunderhorn.
english.description: The Darkmoon Faire's crunchy frog is famous all over Azeroth!$B$BWe've just had a fresh batch of frogs delivered. How'd you like to help whip up a few and practice your cooking skills in the process?$B$BYou can get the flour you'll need to bread the frogs from any trade goods vendor in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore.
english.progress: Do I smell fresh crunchy frog?
english.completion: These are perfectly cooked, $n. You've done an excellent job.
english.completed: Return to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 变废为宝
text.objectives: 通过分解散落在暗月马戏团地上的废弃的武器收集6份占卜者之尘。
text.description: 人们来到马戏团不只是为了娱乐和占卜，$n，大部分人希望他们能够带点什么回家。于是我帮忙制造一些魔法饰品，让人们可以用奖券来购买。$B$B为此，我需要一个稳定的占卜者之尘的来源。在这儿周围的地上你可以看到许多被丢弃的武器。你可以运用你的附魔技能将这些武器分解，得到占卜者之尘。你愿意帮忙吗？
text.progress: Did you manage to get any of that soothsayer's dust?
text.completion: This will help maintain my supply. Anytime you want to help, just look up old Sayge while the Darkmoon Faire's in town.
text.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Putting Trash to Good Use
english.objectives: Collect 6 Soothsayer's Dusts by disenchanting Discarded Weapons found around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: People don't just come to the faire for fun and fortunes, $n. Most want something to take home with them, so I help to create the magical trinkets visitors purchase with their prize tickets.$B$BFor that, I need a steady supply of soothsayer's dust. Take a look around the grounds and you'll see a lot of discarded weapons. Those are just the kinds of items that can be broken down into dust with enchanting skills like yours. Would you like to help?
english.progress: Did you manage to get any of that soothsayer's dust?
english.completion: This will help maintain my supply. Anytime you want to help, just look up old Sayge while the Darkmoon Faire's in town.
english.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 修一下又是一辆好坦克
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团场地里修理5辆损坏的蒸汽坦克。
text.description: 蒸汽坦克大战是暗月马戏团最受欢迎的娱乐项目之一。游客们常常为了测试和提高他们的水平一打就是几个小时，而坦克们在带给游客欢乐的同时，却承受着非常严重的打击损耗。$B$B你看上去是个和扳手打过交道的人，介不介意帮我修几辆损坏的蒸汽坦克，让他们正常运作？我不会让你白干的。
text.completion: Good job getting those tonks back online. Here are those tickets I promised.
text.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Talkin' Tonks
english.objectives: Repair 5 Damaged Steam Tonks around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: The steam tonks are one of the Darkmoon Faire's most popular amusements. Our visitors love to test their skills for hours and hours, but the tonks take a real beating from all that fun.$B$BYou look like you know your way around a wrench. Mind helping me fix some of the damaged tonks and return them to working order? I'll compensate you for your time.
english.completion: Good job getting those tonks back online. Here are those tickets I promised.
english.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 救治伤员
text.objectives: 使用暗月绷带治疗4名受伤的艺人。
text.description: 在暗月马戏团工作可是很危险的，$n。所以我们的员工在装配、拆卸和运送各种游乐设施时，经常会有人受伤。$B$B一部分受伤的员工还留在这里的马车附近，其他人已经到医务帐篷去治疗了。你能带上这些绷带，去帮帮这些受伤的员工吗？
text.completion: Thank you for your help, $n. It takes all of us to keep the faire up and running.
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Putting the Carnies Back Together Again
english.objectives: Use the Darkmoon Bandage to heal 4 Injured Carnies.
english.description: Working the Darkmoon Faire is a dangerous job, $n. It's no surprise that many of our workers get injured setting up, taking down, and transporting all of its attractions.$B$BSome of the injured workers can be found around here, near the wagons. Others have gone to the healing tent for treatment. Would you take these bandages and see if you can help any of the injured workers?
english.completion: Thank you for your help, $n. It takes all of us to keep the faire up and running.
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

objectiveDetails.description: 对受伤的艺人使用绷带

text.title: 咸湿老水手的最爱
text.objectives: 在暗月岛周围的海水中捕捉5条大海鲱。
text.description: 我们又开发出了一道新菜式，咸湿老水手套餐！时下这份美味正风靡艾泽拉斯，供不应求。$B$B你这个$r看上去精神奕奕，还是个钓鱼能手吧。愿意帮我补充一下大海鲱的存量吗？$B$B我们都不想让那些想来马戏团常常新滋味的游客失望，不是吗？
text.progress: Do you have those fish?
text.completion: These are wonderful! Here are your tickets, as promised.
text.completed: Bring the Great Sea Herring to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Spoilin' for Salty Sea Dogs
english.objectives: Catch 5 Great Sea Herring in the ocean around Darkmoon Island.
english.description: We've just introduced another exciting new menu item, the salty sea dog. It's so popular, we can barely keep up with the demand!$B$BYou look like a decent angler and a spry $r. Would you help me restock my fish supplies?$B$BWe wouldn't want to disappoint all those faire-goers looking to try a new food, would we?
english.progress: Do you have those fish?
english.completion: These are wonderful! Here are your tickets, as promised.
english.completed: Bring the Great Sea Herring to Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 救命草
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团场地周围收集6株暗色花。
text.description: 那些盛开在野地里的紫色小花不仅仅是漂亮而已。$B$B从处理伤口到食物调味，它们几乎无所不能。$B$B你应该是一个收集草药方面的专家吧，能不能请你帮我收集一些暗色花？
text.progress: How's that herb collection coming along?
text.completion: Thank you, $n. Anytime the Darkmoon Faire is in town, I'd be glad to have your help again.
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Herbs for Healing
english.objectives: Gather 6 Darkblossoms from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
english.description: The little purple flowers that grow wild around the grounds aren't just pretty.$B$BThey play a role in everything from treating wounds to seasoning food.$B$BYou seem to have some talent for harvesting herbs. Would you like to help me rebuild my stocks of darkblossom?
english.progress: How's that herb collection coming along?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. Anytime the Darkmoon Faire is in town, I'd be glad to have your help again.
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 书写未来
text.objectives: 使用一包奇异的草药制作预言墨水，然后使用墨水及轻羊皮纸制作塞格的塔罗牌。
text.description: 随着暗月马戏团日渐火爆，越来越多的人来找我算命了。$B$B大部分时候，他们只想知道隐藏在时间迷雾背后的秘密，可这并非我的所长。$B$B我手里的塔罗牌不多了，而你似乎有一双稳健的手。拿着这些草药，帮我做点墨水出来，然后用墨水帮我写几张塔罗牌。你可以在艾尔文森林或莫高雷的任何一个商人处买到所需的羊皮纸。
text.progress: Have you penned any of those fortunes?
text.completion: These look just like mine. You've quite an eye for detail. Thank you for all your help, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Writing the Future
english.objectives: Use the Bundle of Exotic Herbs to make Prophetic Ink and then combine the ink with Light Parchment to create Sayge's Fortunes.
english.description: As the popularity of the Darkmoon Faire grows, more and more people seek me out to peer into their futures.$B$BMost times, they ask for knowledge best left hidden in the mists of time, but it is not my place to give such advice.$B$BMy stock of written fortunes is running low and you look to have a steady hand. Take these herbs, make ink from them, and pen a few fortunes for me. You can get the parchment you'll need from any trade goods vendor in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore.
english.progress: Have you penned any of those fortunes?
english.completion: These look just like mine. You've quite an eye for detail. Thank you for all your help, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sayge at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 光彩夺目的马戏团
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团的场地内寻找一些碎玻璃并将它们制作成5个闪亮的“宝石”。
text.description: 暗月马戏团的表演者和动物们比我想象得更加需要珠宝的点缀。幸好，那些只是切割过的玻璃而已，但是总得有个手艺人来切割吧。$B$B如果你懂点珠宝加工技能的话，也许你会愿意为我们的表演切割一些闪耀的玻璃宝石。$B$B在这儿周围的地面上，你有时候能找到一些奇特且绚丽的玻璃碎片。经过行家的处理，这些碎片能够被制成非常炫目的宝石。
text.progress: Were you able to craft any replacement gems for the performers' jewelry?
text.completion: Very nice work, $n. You've quite a talent for this.
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Keeping the Faire Sparkling
english.objectives: Find Bits of Glass around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire and craft it into 5 Sparkling 'Gemstones'.
english.description: The Darkmoon Faire's performers and animals go through more jewelry than I'd ever imagined. Thankfully, the gems are just cut glass, but someone has to craft all of it.$B$BIf you've some skill as a jewelcrafter, perhaps you'd be willing to help craft some of the sparkling glass gems for our performers.$B$BSometimes you can find odd and amazing bits of glass around the grounds. Those make stunning gems when cut by someone with an eye for this craft.
english.progress: Were you able to craft any replacement gems for the performers' jewelry?
english.completion: Very nice work, $n. You've quite a talent for this.
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 关注奖品
text.objectives: 使用暗月工具包，用粗线、闪光的小珠和蓝色染料制作5份暗月奖品。
text.description: 我们的游戏项目空前地受欢迎，所以我们发放奖品的速度也是空前地快！$B$B我们需要更多的奖品，而且速度要快。如果你有制皮的手艺，我可以给你一个工具包。你还得向艾尔文森林或莫高雷的商人买些材料，不过这些东西都很便宜的。$B$B你愿意帮忙吗？
text.progress: Have you had a chance to make those prizes?
text.completion: Excellent work! These look just like the others. Thank you for your help.$B$BIf you ever want to help again, look for me next time the Darkmoon Faire is in town.
text.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Eyes on the Prizes
english.objectives: Use the Darkmoon Craftsman's Kit to make 5 Darkmoon Prizes from Coarse Thread, Shiny Baubles, and Blue Dye.
english.description: The games are more popular than ever, and that means we're giving out prizes faster than we ever have before!$B$BWe're going to need more prizes, and fast. If you've some skill in leatherworking, I can give you a kit. You'll need to buy some of the pieces from any trade goods merchant in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore, but they're inexpensive.$B$BAre you willing to help?
english.progress: Have you had a chance to make those prizes?
english.completion: Excellent work! These look just like the others. Thank you for your help.$B$BIf you ever want to help again, look for me next time the Darkmoon Faire is in town.
english.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 蒸汽坦克，重装上阵
text.objectives: 在暗月马戏团场地内收集6块坦克碎片。
text.description: 游客们钟爱蒸汽坦克！每当暗月马戏团落幕的时候，这儿满地都是坦克碎片。$B$B让这些优质的金属就这么埋没在尘泥之中，真是可惜了。$B$B如果你能帮我收集一些大块坦克碎片的话，我就能够用它们来翻新损坏的坦克零件了。这比每次都买新的材料可便宜多了。你愿意帮忙吗？
text.progress: Did you manage to find any scrap? The grounds are full of it.
text.completion: There's a good bit of scrap here. Thanks for your help. It'll be a big help when I refit the steam tonks.$B$BPlease take this as a reward for your help.
text.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Rearm, Reuse, Recycle
english.objectives: Collect 6 pieces of Tonk Scrap from around the Darkmoon Faire grounds.
english.description: Faire-goers just love the steam tonks! And when the Darkmoon Faire closes, these grounds will be littered with tonk scrap.$B$BIt'd be a shame to let all that good metal just sit in the dirt.$B$BIf you help me collect some of the larger scraps, I can use them to reforge broken tonk parts. It's a lot less expensive than buying new metal every time. What do you say?
english.progress: Did you manage to find any scrap? The grounds are full of it.
english.completion: There's a good bit of scrap here. Thanks for your help. It'll be a big help when I refit the steam tonks.$B$BPlease take this as a reward for your help.
english.completed: Return to Rinling at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 皮革打磨
text.objectives: 打磨4张散落在暗月马戏团场地内剥好的兽皮。
text.description: 暗月马戏团需要更多的皮革来制作帐篷、皮靴以及一切你可以想到的东西。我抓了些野兽，把它们的皮晾在外面有待进一步处理。$B$B你看上去是个学过剥皮的人，如果你愿意帮我把这些新剥下的兽皮打磨一下的话，我会给你奖励。
text.completion: Thanks for the help, $n. I'll never forget your contribution to the Darkmoon Faire.$B$BAnd if you feel inclined, come back and help again next time we're in town.
text.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Tan My Hide
english.objectives: Scrape 4 Staked Skins around the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: The Darkmoon Faire always needs more leather for tents, boots, and just about anything you can imagine! I've trapped some creatures and staked the skins out for the next part of their treatment.$B$BYou seem to have some knowledge of skinning. I'll reward you if you help me with the job of scraping some of those new skins.
english.completion: Thanks for the help, $n. I'll never forget your contribution to the Darkmoon Faire.$B$BAnd if you feel inclined, come back and help again next time we're in town.
english.completed: Return to Chronos at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 遍地旗帜！
text.objectives: 使用暗月旗帜包，用粗线、红色染料和蓝色染料制作一面暗月旗帜，然后把它插在暗月马戏团场地内一堆松动的石头里。
text.description: 看到暗月旗帜四处飘扬的感觉棒极了，难道不是吗？这是我在搭建场地的过程中最喜闻乐见的部分，不过我们需要换掉那些老旧褴褛的旗帜了。$B$B如果你懂点针线活的话，是否愿意用这个工具包制作一面旗帜呢？然后再把它插在场地各处的那些松动的石头堆上即可。$B$B你还需要一些其他材料，不过在艾尔文森林或莫高雷的任何一个商人处都能买到。
text.progress: Were you able to find a place for that new banner of yours?
text.completion: Thanks for helping with those banners. You have quite a talent for needlework. Next time the Darkmoon Faire's in town, why not come by and help again?
text.completed: Return to Selina Dourman at the Darkmoon Faire.

english.title: Banners, Banners Everywhere!
english.objectives: Use Coarse Thread, Red Dye, and Blue Dye with a Darkmoon Banner Kit to make a Darkmoon Banner, then set it up in a pile of Loose Stones on the grounds of the Darkmoon Faire.
english.description: Isn't it wonderful to see Darkmoon banners everywhere? It's my favorite part of setting up, but we have so many old and tattered ones that need to be replaced.$B$BIf you've some skill with a needle and thread, would you mind making a banner from this kit and putting it up in some loose stones scattered around the grounds of the faire?$B$BIt's missing a few pieces, but you should be able to get what you need from any trade goods vendor in Elwynn Forest or Mulgore.
english.progress: Were you able to find a place for that new banner of yours?
english.completion: Thanks for helping with those banners. You have quite a talent for needlework. Next time the Darkmoon Faire's in town, why not come by and help again?
english.completed: Return to Selina Dourman at the Darkmoon Faire.

text.title: 咏之池
text.objectives: 与咏之池中的艾莎·云歌交谈。
text.description: 对我们来说，安全找回剩余的三位元素之灵至关重要。我已经老了，对此有心无力。而艾莎和季虽然都很强大，但他们的眼光太过狭窄。$B$B你具备成为一名英雄的所有品质，并达到了他们未曾达到的平衡境界。所以必须由你来完成这项任务。$B$B上古水灵涓流就在东边咏之池的某个地方。去找到艾莎，并与她一起找到涓流。我们就全指望你了。
text.completion: It's good to see you again, $n.$B$BThis is the pool of the skunk, as I'm sure you noticed.$B$BOver the many ages of Shen-zin Su, animals have died in some of these magical pools. Through their deaths, their spirits were infused into the waters, and anyone touching those waters will take their form.$B$BThere are several cursed pools here, some more dangerous than others.
text.completed: It's good to see you again, $n.$B$BThis is the pool of the skunk, as I'm sure you noticed.$B$BOver the many ages of Shen-zin Su, animals have died in some of these magical pools. Through their deaths, their spirits were infused into the waters, and anyone touching those waters will take their form.$B$BThere are several cursed pools here, some more dangerous than others.

english.title: The Singing Pools
english.objectives: Speak to Aysa Cloudsinger in the Singing Pools.
english.description: It is crucial that we bring all of the three remaining spirits back safely. I am too old to do this myself, and for all their strengths, both Aysa and Ji are single-minded in their ideals.$B$BYou possess all the qualities of a hero, and a balance that they do not. It is you that must do this.$B$BShu, the spirit of water is somewhere in the singing pools to the east. Find Aysa there and work with her to locate him. We are all depending on you.
english.completion: It's good to see you again, $n.$B$BThis is the pool of the skunk, as I'm sure you noticed.$B$BOver the many ages of Shen-zin Su, animals have died in some of these magical pools. Through their deaths, their spirits were infused into the waters, and anyone touching those waters will take their form.$B$BThere are several cursed pools here, some more dangerous than others.
english.completed: It's good to see you again, $n.$B$BThis is the pool of the skunk, as I'm sure you noticed.$B$BOver the many ages of Shen-zin Su, animals have died in some of these magical pools. Through their deaths, their spirits were infused into the waters, and anyone touching those waters will take their form.$B$BThere are several cursed pools here, some more dangerous than others.

text.title: 火金派的季
text.objectives: 与武松村中的季·火掌交谈。
text.description: 我另一位最具天赋的学生正在西北面的武松村中等你。他与艾莎完全不同，但正是这种不同才使他们能够互补。$B$B季·火掌会教你收集上古火灵的供品。你要相信他的智慧。
text.completion: Hello! You look poised and confident... I like that!$B$BI've heard some rather impressive whispers about you from the training grounds. If you're half as capable as they say, I think you and I are going to be good friends!

english.title: Ji of the Huojin
english.objectives: Speak to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.
english.description: Another of my most talented students is awaiting you in Wu-Song Village to the northwest. He is of a different mind than Aysa, but in their differences, they bring balance to each other.$B$BJi Firepaw will instruct you on gathering the offerings for the spirit of fire. Trust in his wisdom.
english.completion: Hello! You look poised and confident... I like that!$B$BI've heard some rather impressive whispers about you from the training grounds. If you're half as capable as they say, I think you and I are going to be good friends!

text.title: 煽风
text.objectives: 收集颤动的微风。
text.description: 风是很奇怪的东西，你很难用双手把它包裹住。$B$B我认为最好的办法就是找到有灵性的风。如果它能攻击到你，那你也可以还击，而且它不会从你的手中溜走。$B$B前往南面的夏风神龛，用风之石召唤出这种风。击败它，从它身上收集一缕颤动的微风，然后回来向我复命。到时我们再看接下来该做什么。
text.progress: When opportunity rises, it is our responsibility to reach out and grab it. Second guessing is as good as giving up.
text.completion: You know what it is to seize opportunity. I think you and I are kindred spirits, $n.
text.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.

english.title: Fanning the Flames
english.objectives: Retrieve a Fluttering Breeze.
english.description: Strange thing about wind, it can be hard to wrap your hands around it.$B$BBest practice for me has been finding some sort of living wind. If it can punch you, you can punch it back, and it won't slip through your grasp.$B$BHead over to the Shrine of the Summer Breeze to the south and summon just such a living wind using this wind stone. Best it, gather a Fluttering Breeze from it, and come back over this way so that we can figure out what's next.
english.progress: When opportunity rises, it is our responsibility to reach out and grab it. Second guessing is as good as giving up.
english.completion: You know what it is to seize opportunity. I think you and I are kindred spirits, $n.
english.completed: Return to Ji Firepaw in Wu-Song Village.

text.title: 戒骄
text.objectives: 击败6名火金派弟子或土水派弟子。
text.description: 拿那些不会还手的沙包练拳只是最简单的训练，只有与活生生的对手过招才能算得上是战斗。他们会反击，稍有不慎你就会遭遇失败，甚至是死亡。$B$B你必须鼓足勇气战胜恐惧。$B$B我要你去挑战台阶下或者寺里的徒弟，并击败他们。
text.progress: 有时，我们需要沉思冥想；有时，我们则需要果断行动。两者间的平衡发展就是我们所追求的最高境界。
text.completion: 很不错，我年轻的徒弟。$B$B这里的其他徒弟大多经过了长时间的训练，而你接受训练的时间还不到一小时，却能够击败他们。$B$B这值得赞扬，但我还有其他东西要教给你。
text.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the temple in the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

english.title: The Lesson of Stifled Pride
english.objectives: Defeat 6 Huojin Trainees or Tushui Trainees.
english.description: Facing a living opponent is a very different thing from the stationary targets in the yard. Living opponents strike back. There is the very real fear of failure, and sometimes, even death.$B$BYou must have the courage to overcome those fears.$B$BChallenge the other trainees within the temple or down the steps below, and defeat them.
english.completion: Intriguing, my young pupil.$B$BMost of the other trainees have been here for quite some time, but you are able to match them even within this first hour.$B$BThis speaks well of you, but there are yet other lessons I would see you learn.
english.completed: Return to Master Shang Xi within the temple in the Shang Xi Training Grounds.

text.title: 城头激战
text.objectives: 杀死巡视者加戈玛，传令官瓦兹德和瓦兹德的坐骑纳杉。将加戈玛之手和纳杉徽记交给石头守卫斯托克顿。
text.description: 巡视者加戈玛和传令官瓦兹德负责守卫者这段城墙。$B$B如果你能干掉他们，那他们的部队就会群龙无首。$B$B去杀了他们两个，把证据带回来给我，这样我们才能开始进攻！
text.progress: This operation depends on your success, $n.
text.completion: With their leadership dead their forces should be in disarray.$B$BBut there's far more to this than killing a few guards, $C.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.
text.giverWindow: 靠近时要小心点。

english.title: War on the Ramparts
english.objectives: Slay Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Vazruden the Herald and Vazruden's drake, Nazan.  Return Gargolmar's Hand and Nazan's Head to Stone Guard Stok'ton.
english.description: Watchkeeper Gargolmar and Vazruden the Herald are in charge of defending these ramparts.$B$BIf you take them out, their forces will be in complete disarray.$B$BSlay them both and bring me proof so the invasion can begin!
english.progress: This operation depends on your success, $n.
english.completion: With their leadership dead their forces should be in disarray.$B$BBut there's far more to this than killing a few guards, $C.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.giverWindow: Approach with caution.

text.title: 城头激战
text.objectives: 杀死巡视者加戈玛，传令官瓦兹德和瓦兹德的坐骑纳杉。将加戈玛之手和纳杉徽记交给高级斥候卡德维克。
text.description: 地狱火堡垒的整个防御体系完全依赖于城墙，后者起到了类似于预警系统的作用。$B$B你得去干掉巡视者加戈玛和传令官瓦兹德。没有了这两个家伙，攻占城墙就容易多了。
text.progress: Were you successful? We have a lot riding on this operation, $n.
text.completion: I knew I could count on you!$B$BWith their forces in disarray, we can really get this invasion going.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.
text.giverWindow: 靠近时要小心点。

english.title: War on the Ramparts
english.objectives: Slay Watchkeeper Gargolmar, Vazruden the Herald and Vazruden's drake, Nazan.  Return Gargolmar's Hand and Nazan's Head to Advance Scout Chadwick.
english.description: Hellfire Citadel's entire defensive network relies on the ramparts as a sort of early warning system.$B$BYou need to take out Watchkeeper Gargolmar and Vazruden the Herald. Without them, taking the ramparts will be simple.
english.progress: Were you successful? We have a lot riding on this operation, $n.
english.completion: I knew I could count on you!$B$BWith their forces in disarray, we can really get this invasion going.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.giverWindow: Approach with caution.

text.title: 堡垒里的恶魔
text.objectives: 杀死无疤者奥摩尔然后将他的蹄子带给高级斥候卡德维克。
text.description: 我们的一名斥候报告说，有一名燃烧军团的密探就躲在城墙的某个地方。如果这是真的，那么荣耀堡很可能会遭到邪兽人与燃烧军团的联合进攻！$B$B你必须去找到那个恶魔，然后杀了他。
text.progress: Did you find any demons in there?
text.completion: So it's true. The fel orcs and the Burning Legion are working together in some capacity.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.

english.title: Demons in the Citadel
english.objectives: Slay Omor the Unscarred and bring his hoof to Advance Scout Chadwick.
english.description: One of our scouts spotted what he thought was an agent of the Burning Legion somewhere in the ramparts. If that is true, then Honor Hold may be in grave danger of a combined assault!$B$BIf you find this fiend in there, kill it on sight.
english.progress: Did you find any demons in there?
english.completion: So it's true. The fel orcs and the Burning Legion are working together in some capacity.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.

text.title: 堡垒里的恶魔
text.objectives: 杀死无疤者奥摩尔然后将他的蹄子带给石头守卫斯托克顿。
text.description: 我们的一名斥候带回来一个很糟糕的消息。他在城墙里发现了一个强大的燃烧军团密探！$B$B我要你趁他还没有把我们的行动报告上去之前，先杀了他。
text.progress: Were you able to dispose of the foul creature?
text.completion: Well done. We need the time you've bought us to investigate this link between the fel orcs and the Burning Legion. You very well may have saved hundreds of lives through your actions.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.

english.title: Demons in the Citadel
english.objectives: Kill Omor the Unscarred and bring his hoof to Stone Guard Stok'ton.
english.description: One of our scouts brought back unpleasant news. We've spotted a powerful agent of the Burning Legion in the ramparts!$B$BI need you to kill this demon before he has a chance to relay news of our efforts to his superiors.
english.progress: Were you able to dispose of the foul creature?
english.completion: Well done. We need the time you've bought us to investigate this link between the fel orcs and the Burning Legion. You very well may have saved hundreds of lives through your actions.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.

text.title: 殺東西
text.objectives: 幫任務提供者殺東西。
text.description: 我真的很需要你幫我殺一些東西。這很重要。
text.completed: Return to Questvendor.

english.title: Kill Stuff
english.objectives: Kill stuff for Questvendor.
english.description: I really need you to kill some stuff for me. It's pretty important.
english.completed: Return to Questvendor.

text.title: 黑暗之潮
text.objectives: Take the Ominous Letter to Advance Scout Chadwick.
text.description: Giving the lifeless form of Vazruden the Herald the once-over, you discover a rolled letter, its seal yet unbroken.  An elaborate "I" is pressed within the blood-red ink.  Cracking the note open, the message that you read is most disturbing.$B$Advance Scout Chadwick will definitely want to take a look at this!

english.objectives: Take the Ominous Letter to Advance Scout Chadwick.
english.description: Giving the lifeless form of Vazruden the Herald the once-over, you discover a rolled letter, its seal yet unbroken.  An elaborate "I" is pressed within the blood-red ink.  Cracking the note open, the message that you read is most disturbing.$B$Advance Scout Chadwick will definitely want to take a look at this!

Cracking the note open, the message that you read is most disturbing.$B$BStone Guard Stok'ton will definitely want to take a look at this!

text.title: 收集東西
text.objectives: 幫任務巫師收集5個尾巴東西。
text.description: 任務巫師想要尾巴東西!立刻去取回它們。
text.completed: Return to the Quest Wizard on Designer Island.

english.title: Collect Things
english.objectives: Collect 6 Stuff Tails for the Quest Wizard.
english.description: The Quest Wizard demands Stuff Tails! Go now and fetch them.
english.completed: Return to the Quest Wizard on Designer Island.

text.title: 让他们流血
text.objectives: 帮助卡萨雷兹收集10瓶邪兽人血样和一根邪能注射棒。
text.description: 为了制造更多的邪兽人，制造者一直在给普通兽人注射恶魔的血液。$B$B我的上级相信，我们可以设法扭转这种变异。但在下结论之前，我们还需要一些邪兽人的血液样本以及制造者的邪能注射棒来做研究。
text.progress: You're back! Even better, you're not dead! Well done. Better than anyone else so far.
text.completion: These vials could mean the end of the fel orcs. I hope you understand just how important that is to our campaign here.
text.completed: Return to Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.

english.title: Make Them Bleed
english.objectives: Collect 10 Fel Orc Blood Vials and a Fel Infusion Rod for Caza'rez.
english.description: The Maker serves the purpose of creating more fel orcs by infusing them with demon blood.$B$BMy superiors believe that we may be able to reverse the process, but we need samples of their blood and The Maker's infusion rod before we can know for sure.
english.progress: You're back! Even better, you're not dead! Well done. Better than anyone else so far.
english.completion: These vials could mean the end of the fel orcs. I hope you understand just how important that is to our campaign here.
english.completed: Return to Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.

text.title: 愤怒的心
text.objectives: 彻底调查鲜血熔炉，然后向卡萨雷兹复命。
text.description: 我们都知道，邪兽人是靠给兽人注射恶魔血液来扩张军队的。$B$B我需要你冒险深入这些罪恶的大厅，查出他们究竟在干什么。在不了解确切情况之前，我们不能冒险派部队进入这个地方。
text.completion: <You tell Caza'rez everything you saw in the Blood Furnace.>$B$BI see.$B$BIf they can do this to the Mag'har brown orcs, they can do it to us! We must be careful lest they turn all of Thrallmar into those mindless beasts.
text.end: 彻底调查鲜血熔炉
text.completed: Return to Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.

english.title: Heart of Rage
english.objectives: Fully investigate the Blood Furnace and then report back to Caza'rez.
english.description: We know that the fel orcs are growing their forces by infusing orcs with demon blood.$B$BI need you to venture deep inside these unholy halls and find out how that's happening. We can't risk sending an army into this place until we know exactly what we're dealing with.
english.completion: <You tell Caza'rez everything you saw in the Blood Furnace.>$B$BI see.$B$BIf they can do this to the Mag'har brown orcs, they can do it to us! We must be careful lest they turn all of Thrallmar into those mindless beasts.
english.end: Fully Investigate The Blood Furnace
english.completed: Return to Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.

text.title: 小心裂隙
text.objectives: 杀死击碎者克里丹，然后向卡萨雷兹复命。
text.description: 在整个鲜血熔炉中，有一个地方我们的占星者怎么努力也无法查清。$B$B按照他们的说法，这个“裂隙”相当大，那里肯定就是关押玛瑟里顿的地方。$B$B你必须找出干扰的源头，然后解决掉它。
text.completion: The interference has gone down, but we still cannot access that area. We will continue to investigate the matter. Thank you for your help.
text.completed: Return to Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.
text.giverWindow: 这个地方的深处有着非常强大的力量。

english.title: Mind the Gap
english.objectives: Kill Keli'dan the Breaker and return to Caza'rez.
english.description: In all of the Blood Furnace, there is one area where our scryers cannot reach despite their efforts.$B$BThis 'gap', as they've been calling it, is fairly large, and must be where Magtheridon is being held captive..$B$BYou must find the source of the interference and dispose of it.
english.completion: The interference has gone down, but we still cannot access that area. We will continue to investigate the matter. Thank you for your help.
english.completed: Return to Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.
english.giverWindow: Something very powerful lies deep within this place.

text.title: 让他们流血
text.objectives: 帮助冈尼收集10瓶邪兽人血样和一根邪能注射棒。
text.description: 制造者能使用恶魔的鲜血和一根特殊的注射棒将棕色和绿色的兽人变成红色的。我们得想办法弄到那种鲜血，然后在里面动点手脚，让它把各种颜色的兽人全都变成无害又温顺的大块头。$B$B你得帮我们弄点儿鲜血样本来，我们才好进行研究。还有，别忘了把那根注射棒也弄过来！
text.progress: You have that blood, darlin'?  Might be kind of important if we asked you to get it, you know?
text.completion: Out-frikkin-standing! As of right now, you are my eighth favorite person on the smoldering remains of this sorry planet!
text.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.

english.title: Make Them Bleed
english.objectives: Collect 10 Fel Orc Blood Vials and a Fel Infusion Rod for Gunny.
english.description: The Maker uses demon blood and a special rod to turn brown and green orcs into red ones. We'd like to see if we can take that blood, mess around with it a bit, and make it turn orcs of all colors into harmless docile lumps. $B$BYou're going to bring me some samples of their blood so we can see. Don't forget to grab that rod!
english.progress: You have that blood, darlin'?  Might be kind of important if we asked you to get it, you know?
english.completion: Out-frikkin-standing! As of right now, you are my eighth favorite person on the smoldering remains of this sorry planet!
english.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.

text.title: 愤怒的心
text.objectives: 彻底调查鲜血熔炉，然后向冈尼复命。
text.description: 结果证明，荣耀堡的那群书呆子根本就没本事了解这个地方。他们不过是一群谎话连篇的懒骨头法师而已。$B$B不管怎样，我们不知道这里到底出了什么事。所以，你必须去找出真相！
text.completion: <You tell Gunny everything you saw in the Blood Furnace.>$B$BYou brought back some loot for ol' Gunny, right?$B$BNo, no, you're right, clearly I owe you a reward for all your hard work. Not like Gunny didn't arrange all this and send you in there in the first place.
text.end: 彻底调查鲜血熔炉
text.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.

english.title: Heart of Rage
english.objectives: Fully investigate the Blood Furnace and then report back to Gunny.
english.description: As it turns out, the eggheads back at Honor Hold can't see much into this place. Bunch of lying lazy mages, is what they are.$B$BEither way, we don't really know exactly what's going on in here. So, you're going in to find out!
english.completion: <You tell Gunny everything you saw in the Blood Furnace.>$B$BYou brought back some loot for ol' Gunny, right?$B$BNo, no, you're right, clearly I owe you a reward for all your hard work. Not like Gunny didn't arrange all this and send you in there in the first place.
english.end: Fully Investigate The Blood Furnace
english.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.

text.title: 击碎者
text.objectives: 杀死击碎者克里丹，然后向冈尼复命。
text.description: 嗯，按照他们的说法，他们就把那个大恶魔藏在这里。有一个兽人正负责藏匿他。$B$B杀兽人就是杀兽人，对吧？不管他干了什么或者正在干什么，兽人就是该杀！
text.completion: Really? You want a reward for killing an orc? As in fame and riches and noble steeds?$B$BBack in my day killing orcs WAS the reward!
text.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
text.giverWindow: 给他点苦头尝尝。

english.title: The Breaker
english.objectives: Kill Keli'dan the Breaker and return to Gunny.
english.description: So they've got this big ol' demon stashed away in this place, is what they're telling me. And there's an orc that's in charge of keeping him under wraps.$B$BKilling an orc is killing an orc, am I right? Doesn't matter what he did or what he's doin', orcs are always ripe for the slaughter!
english.completion: Really? You want a reward for killing an orc? As in fame and riches and noble steeds?$B$BBack in my day killing orcs WAS the reward!
english.completed: Return to Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
english.giverWindow: Make him suffer.

text.title: Take Care of It
text.objectives: Resolve the dispute any way you see fit.
text.description: This looks bad... you'd better do something.
text.end: Resolve the dispute.

english.title: Take Care of It
english.objectives: Resolve the dispute any way you see fit.
english.description: This looks bad... you'd better do something.
english.end: Resolve the dispute.

text.title: 入侵堡垒
text.objectives: 与地狱火城墙的石头守卫斯托克顿谈谈。
text.description: 在燃烧军团和邪兽人的前后夹击之下，如果我们不能采取措施，萨尔玛就会被敌人占领。$B$B我要你前往西面的地狱火城墙，和石头守卫斯托克顿谈一谈。他正秘密负责部落对整个城堡的攻击。
text.completion: Shatterskull's not personable by anyone's standards, but he certainly gets the job done. Let's put you to work.

english.title: Invading the Citadel
english.objectives: Speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.description: With the Legion to one side and the fel orcs to the other, Thrallmar is going to be overrun if we don't do something about it.$B$Head west to the Hellfire Ramparts and speak with Stone Guard Stok'ton. He's in charge of a covert operation to start a Horde invasion on the entire citadel.
english.completion: Shatterskull's not personable by anyone's standards, but he certainly gets the job done. Let's put you to work.

text.title: 入侵堡垒
text.objectives: 与地狱火城墙的高级斥候卡德维克谈谈。
text.description: 面对燃烧军团和邪兽人的两面夹击，如果我们再不采取行动，荣耀堡的陷落只是时间问题。$B$B到西边的地狱火城墙去，与高级斥候卡德维克谈谈。他正负责策划联盟对整个堡垒的奇袭。
text.completion: That Altumus is certainly a gem, isn't she? But there won't be any of us left alive out here if we aren't successful in our efforts in the ramparts.

english.title: Invading the Citadel
english.objectives: Speak with Advance Scout Chadwick in Hellfire Ramparts.
english.description: With the Legion to one side and the fel orcs to the other, Honor Hold is going to be overrun in a matter of time if we don't do something about it.$B$BHead west to the Hellfire Ramparts and speak with Advance Scout Chadwick. He's in charge of a covert operation to start an Alliance invasion on the entire citadel.
english.completion: That Altumus is certainly a gem, isn't she? But there won't be any of us left alive out here if we aren't successful in our efforts in the ramparts.

text.title: 鲜血熔炉
text.objectives: Speak with Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.
text.description: Caza'rez awaits you within the Blood Furnace. He's already cleared out a small area and has our scryers hard at work figuring out what's going on down there.$B$BBut I don't trust that scrying will be enough. I'm sure Caza'rez has plans in mind for a solid blade or two. I want you to go there and lend him your expertise in dealing with the fel orcs.

english.title: The Blood Furnace
english.objectives: Speak with Caza'rez in the Blood Furnace.
english.description: Caza'rez awaits you within the Blood Furnace. He's already cleared out a small area and has our scryers hard at work figuring out what's going on down there.$B$BBut I don't trust that scrying will be enough. I'm sure Caza'rez has plans in mind for a solid blade or two. I want you to go there and lend him your expertise in dealing with the fel orcs.

text.title: 鲜血熔炉
text.objectives: Speak with Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
text.description: This war is far from over. We need to stop the flow of new recruits to the fel orc front if we are to have any hope of victory.$B$BTravel to the Blood Furnace and speak with Gunny, he's secured a small area within and I'm sure he could use your assistance. Be forewarned, Gunny is...unusual.

english.title: The Blood Furnace
english.objectives: Speak with Gunny in the Blood Furnace.
english.description: This war is far from over. We need to stop the flow of new recruits to the fel orc front if we are to have any hope of victory.$B$BTravel to the Blood Furnace and speak with Gunny, he's secured a small area within and I'm sure he could use your assistance. Be forewarned, Gunny is...unusual.

text.title: Tipping the Scales
text.objectives: Kill 12 Hozen Ravagers.
text.description: These blasted native monkey savages have been assaulting us since the day we put to shore!$B$BWe were holding our own until they kidnapped half our men, including the Admiral.$B$BJust look at their numbers! They're endless, and we're standing on our last legs.$B$BIf you're here to get us out of this mess, go help take down some monkeys.$B$BIt's them or us, $r!
text.completed: Return to Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Tipping the Scales
english.objectives: Kill 12 Hozen Ravagers.
english.description: These blasted native monkey savages have been assaulting us since the day we put to shore!$B$BWe were holding our own until they kidnapped half our men, including the Admiral.$B$BJust look at their numbers! They're endless, and we're standing on our last legs.$B$BIf you're here to get us out of this mess, go help take down some monkeys.$B$BIt's them or us, $r!
english.completed: Return to Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 国王的密令
text.objectives: 前往暴风城的暴风要塞指挥室找杰塔瑞斯将军。
text.description: 你好，$c。$B$B我奉命组建团队去执行一个非常重要的任务。$B$B请立即前往暴风要塞，瓦里安·乌瑞恩国王将会给你指示。我会在国王的指挥室里等你。
text.completion: Our role is of utmost importance. Admiral Taylor and his flagship have gone missing. More importantly, the young Prince was with him, and it is our primary objective to bring him back home safely.
text.giverWindow: 这项任务非常紧急……而且要求严格保密。

english.title: The King's Command
english.objectives: Find Grand Admiral Jes-Tereth in the war room at Stormwind Keep in Stormwind City.
english.description: Greetings, $c.$B$BI have been asked to assemble a team for a high priority mission.$B$BPlease come to Stormwind Keep immediately for a briefing with King Varian Wrynn. I will be waiting in the King's war room.
english.completion: Our role is of utmost importance. Admiral Taylor and his flagship have gone missing. More importantly, the young Prince was with him, and it is our primary objective to bring him back home safely.
english.giverWindow: This is a matter of utmost urgency...and secrecy.

text.title: 皇家使命
text.objectives: 去天火号向罗杰斯上将报到。
text.description: 好吧，你也听到国王的命令了。海军上将泰勒最后一次出现在南海的某个位置。$B$B我们将从天空展开搜索！找到王子殿下——也就是白卒——是我们的首要目标。$B$B天火号的燃料和补给已经补充完毕，随时准备出发了。罗杰斯上将和她的船员正在海港北部的上空停留。$B$B做好最后的准备工作，然后去甲板向罗杰斯上将报到。我们会准时出发。
text.progress: 啊，經歷過大浩劫的老兵！很好，我隨時用得上有經驗的人。
text.completion: That's a whole Horde base down there! Where was our intel?$B$BWell $c, it's time to see what this upgraded gunship is capable of.

english.title: The Mission
english.objectives: Report to Admiral Rogers on The Skyfire.
english.description: Well, you heard the King. Admiral Taylor's last transmission came from somewhere in the southern seas.$B$BWe will begin our search from the air! Locating the Prince - the White Pawn - is of critical priority.$B$BThe Skyfire is fueled, supplied, and ready to depart. She and her crew idle in the sky just north of the harbor.$B$BMake your last preparations, then meet Admiral Rogers on the deck. We will depart without delay.
english.completion: That's a whole Horde base down there! Where was our intel?$B$BWell $c, it's time to see what this upgraded gunship is capable of.

objectiveDetails.description: 与天火号炮舰上的罗杰斯上将交谈

text.title: Flightmaster Down
text.objectives: Speak to Donovar Murall in Veridian Grove.
text.description: I've taken stock of the missing, and among them is Donovar Murall, our Flightmaster.$B$BHe is not only a vital part of our crew, he is a dear friend as well.$B$BPlease find him and bring him back alive.
text.completed: Return to First Mate Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Flightmaster Down
english.objectives: Speak to Donovar Murall in Veridian Grove.
english.description: I've taken stock of the missing, and among them is Donovar Murall, our Flightmaster.$B$BHe is not only a vital part of our crew, he is a dear friend as well.$B$BPlease find him and bring him back alive.
english.completed: Return to First Mate Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

text.title: Saving Snowpuff
text.objectives: Collect 4 Gingerleaf for Snowpuff.
text.description: <Donovar bursts into tears upon seeing you.>$B$BTh-th-those blasted monkey hooligans d-d-dragged me inta these woods. I thot I were dunnert, but mah faithful Snowpuff came flyin' to mah rescue!$B$BShe fought 'em off and then they all jumped 'er! Wot with them apes prowlin' around, she's...$B$B<Donovar blows his nose loudly.>$B$B...she's done for! Wahaahaaaaaa! Unless...$B$BListen $c, I saw Gingerleaf growing all over these woods. I beg ya, bring me some o' that healing herb and Snowpuff just might make et!
text.completed: Return to Flight Master Donovar Murall in the Veridian Grove in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Saving Snowpuff
english.objectives: Collect 4 Gingerleaf for Snowpuff.
english.description: <Donovar bursts into tears upon seeing you.>$B$BTh-th-those blasted monkey hooligans d-d-dragged me inta these woods. I thot I were dunnert, but mah faithful Snowpuff came flyin' to mah rescue!$B$BShe fought 'em off and then they all jumped 'er! Wot with them apes prowlin' around, she's...$B$B<Donovar blows his nose loudly.>$B$B...she's done for! Wahaahaaaaaa! Unless...$B$BListen $c, I saw Gingerleaf growing all over these woods. I beg ya, bring me some o' that healing herb and Snowpuff just might make et!
english.completed: Return to Flight Master Donovar Murall in the Veridian Grove in the Jade Forest.

text.title: Grove Stalkers
text.objectives: Kill 8 Grove Stalkers.
text.description: We're still trying to take stock of our crew after the fighting.$B$BI'm afraid many of them are stranded out in the woods, probably wounded and fighting to survive.$B$BWe know that the forest to the north is full of vicious tigers.$B$BGo clear them out of the woods. You'll give more of our men and women a chance to make it back alive.
text.completed: Return to Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Grove Stalkers
english.objectives: Kill 8 Grove Stalkers.
english.description: We're still trying to take stock of our crew after the fighting.$B$BI'm afraid many of them are stranded out in the woods, probably wounded and fighting to survive.$B$BWe know that the forest to the north is full of vicious tigers.$B$BGo clear them out of the woods. You'll give more of our men and women a chance to make it back alive.
english.completed: Return to Grayson Early at Wayward Landing in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 情况危急
text.objectives: 在坡东林救助6名受伤的飞行员。你也可以使用治疗法术或绷带来救助他们。
text.description: 我们或许赢得了首战开门红，但还有个紧急情况需要处理。$B$B许多天火号飞行员在空中搏斗时被击落了。$B$B不及时抢救的话，他们的伤势会持续恶化，直至身亡。我们是他们获救的唯一希望。$B$B进入果园，尽可能多地找到并救助飞行员。$B$B一个也不能落下。
text.completion: Good work, $n. Those soldiers will live and fight another day because of your efforts.
text.completed: Return to Mishka at Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Critical Condition
english.objectives: Revive 6 Wounded Pilots in Paw'don Glade. You can also use healing spells or bandages to revive them.
english.description: We may have won the first battle, but a critical task still remains.$B$BDozens of Skyfire pilots were shot down during the initial aerial battle.$B$BWithout medical aid, their condition will deteriorate over time, until they finally perish. We are their only hope for survival.$B$BGo into the orchard and revive as many pilots as you can find.$B$BWe will leave no one behind.
english.completion: Good work, $n. Those soldiers will live and fight another day because of your efforts.
english.completed: Return to Mishka at Paw'don Village in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 失踪的海军上将
text.objectives: 找到海军上将泰勒。
text.description:
好吧。你所提供的线索表明那是安度因的船，而船长则是海军上将泰勒。

泰勒在上次的汇报中提到在船只遇难后，他正试图击退猢狲并保护船只。

当地人说这些猢狲偶尔会抓俘虏，而且我在遇难船只的残骸周围没有发现泰勒的尸体。或许你能在东北边的猢狲营地里找到泰勒。

立即行动，我们不能再浪费时间了！
text.completion: <You found him, but the Admiral is unconscious. He looks on the verge of death.>

english.title: The Missing Admiral
english.objectives: Find Admiral Taylor.
english.description:
Alright. According to the clues you found, that was Anduin's ship, and Admiral Taylor was the captain. 

And Admiral Taylor's last entry says he was going to fight off the hozen and protect the vessel after the shipwreck.

The locals say these hozen sometimes take prisoners, and I didn't see Taylor's corpse anywhere among the wreckage. So you'll probably find Taylor at the hozen encampment to the northeast.

Get going, we have no time to lose!
english.completion: <You found him, but the Admiral is unconscious. He looks on the verge of death.>

text.title: Sunken Junk
text.objectives: Collect 8 Waterlogged Scraps.
text.description: Hey $n!$B$BThe coast here is littered with scraps of tools and metal from the shipwreck.$B$BThe ordinary person might think that this is junk, but I'm sure I can salvage most of it. I once repaired a submarine using only a bronze tube and a luffa!$B$BGet me some of the waterlogged scraps along the shore by the ship. I need them for my next project.
text.completed: Return to Nodd at Sapphire's End in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Sunken Junk
english.objectives: Collect 8 Waterlogged Scraps.
english.description: Hey $n!$B$BThe coast here is littered with scraps of tools and metal from the shipwreck.$B$BThe ordinary person might think that this is junk, but I'm sure I can salvage most of it. I once repaired a submarine using only a bronze tube and a luffa!$B$BGet me some of the waterlogged scraps along the shore by the ship. I need them for my next project.
english.completed: Return to Nodd at Sapphire's End in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 白卒
text.objectives: 在翡翠林搜索先锋号船骸的货物，找寻线索，并找到加密的船长日志。
text.description:
好吧，士兵，我有一项重要的任务要交给你。

去南边的海岸线一带——就在海湾那里，你会发现一艘遇难的联盟船只。我要你去调查这艘船，看它是不是搭载安度因的那一艘。

然后带回船长的日志，看看能否给我们提供有效信息，找到安度因在哪。

鉴于该日志出自于军舰上，所以它肯定会以某种加密语言来记录——回头带给诺德·杰码，他能搞定。他正在海湾的另一头，看守着遇难船只。
text.progress: Well?
text.completion:
Alright... let me see... using the cipher from when the ship went missing...

<Nodd is clearly doing some calculations in his head.>

Aha!
text.completed: Report to Nodd Codejack at the Wreck of the Vanguard in the Jade Forest.

english.title: The White Pawn
english.objectives: Search the Wreck of the Vanguard in Jade Forest for clues about its cargo, and recover the Encoded Captain's Log.
english.description:
Alright, soldier. I've got a critical mission for you.

Get down to the coastline south of here - in the cove there you'll find a wrecked Alliance vessel. I need you to search it and find out if it was the ship that was carrying Anduin. 

Then, recover the Captain's Log and see if it has any information on where we can find him.

Since the log is from a military ship, it'll be written using a cipher - take it to Nodd Codejack afterwards. He's keeping watch on the wreck from the other end of the cove.
english.progress: Well?
english.completion:
Alright... let me see... using the cipher from when the ship went missing...

<Nodd is clearly doing some calculations in his head.>

Aha!
english.completed: Report to Nodd Codejack at the Wreck of the Vanguard in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 是敌非友
text.objectives: 在先锋号船骸击败14只猢狲。
text.description:
我们已经找到了联盟船只的残骸。可不幸的是，当地人告诉我们说那边已经被一群不怀好意的“猢狲”给占领了。

洗劫我们遇难船只的这件事足以证明，他们并不友好。不能让他们继续洗劫我们的船只，掠夺我们的补给，甚至抓捕或杀死任何幸存者这样更糟糕的事情了。

给我去那儿干掉他们！当你完成后，跟诺德·杰码碰个头，他是我们在该地区的军情七处特工。
text.completion:
Good work. Dirty creatures trying to kick us when we're down... 

That'll teach 'em to try and salvage an Alliance vessel!
text.completed: Talk with Nodd Codejack at the Wreck of the Vanguard in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Hozen Aren't Your Friends, Hozen Are Your Enemies
english.objectives: Kill 14 Hozen at the Wreck of the Vanguard.
english.description:
We've located an Alliance wreck to the south. Unfortunately, the locals have informed us that it's currently being scavenged by a group of creatures called "hozen."

By pillaging our wrecked ships, these creatures have already shown that they aren't friendly. We can't have them taking spoils from our ships, stealing our supplies, and worse, potentially capturing or killing any survivors.

Get down there and take them out! When you're done, meet up with Nodd Codejack, our SI:7 agent in the area.
english.completion:
Good work. Dirty creatures trying to kick us when we're down... 

That'll teach 'em to try and salvage an Alliance vessel!
english.completed: Talk with Nodd Codejack at the Wreck of the Vanguard in the Jade Forest.

text.title: The Mission Continues
text.objectives: Speak to Nodd at Sapphire's End in the Jade Forest.
text.description: The King's flagship went aground not far from here.$B$BApparently, the ship signaled Anduin's safe arrival shortly after landing, but when they sent men to retrieve the Prince, he was gone.$B$BI want to investigate the wreckage for clues.$B$BNodd and Sully are already at the crash site. Go east along the beach and see if they need help.

english.title: The Mission Continues
english.objectives: Speak to Nodd at Sapphire's End in the Jade Forest.
english.description: The King's flagship went aground not far from here.$B$BApparently, the ship signaled Anduin's safe arrival shortly after landing, but when they sent men to retrieve the Prince, he was gone.$B$BI want to investigate the wreckage for clues.$B$BNodd and Sully are already at the crash site. Go east along the beach and see if they need help.

text.title: 战争之路
text.objectives: 击败12只吊尾树猴或吊尾泥潭先知。
text.description: 我知道你想救你的朋友。如果你愿意帮我的话，我也会帮你。$B$B首先，显而易见的是——四周游荡的吊尾族越少，我们就越容易逃脱。$B$B只要杀死我们周围的猢狲守卫，我们就离自由更近了一步。
text.completion: Ahahaha! You are brave.$B$BAn admirable trait.
text.completed: Return to Bold Karasshi at the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest.

english.title: The Path of War
english.objectives: Kill 12 Slingtail Treeleapers or Slingtail Mudseers.
english.description: I see you want to save your friend. I can help you, if you will help me.$B$BFirst of all, it should be obvious that the fewer the Slingtail roaming around, the easier it will be to escape.$B$BKill the hozen guards around us, and we will be one step closer to freedom.
english.completion: Ahahaha! You are brave.$B$BAn admirable trait.
english.completed: Return to Bold Karasshi at the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 拯救同胞
text.objectives: 释放6名锦鱼人囚徒或联盟囚徒。
text.description: 你或许是个局外人，但猢狲是你我共同的敌人。$B$B我的许多部族同伴都被关在附近的牢笼中。我还看到了你们……联盟……的士兵。$B$B就跟你一样，我也不能对我的同胞见死不救。$B$B吊尾族掌管着牢笼的钥匙。找到钥匙，然后释放我们的朋友。
text.completion: You have freed my brothers? Good.$B$BWe are in your debt.
text.completed: Return to Bold Karasshi at the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Freeing Our Brothers
english.objectives: Free 6 Jinyu Prisoners or Alliance Prisoners.
english.description: You may be an outsider, but you and I have a common enemy in the hozen.$B$BMany members of my tribe are trapped in cages nearby. I have also seen your... Alliance... soldiers as well.$B$BI cannot leave without freeing my brethren, just as you cannot leave yours.$B$BThe Slingtail hold the keys to those cages. Find the keys and free our friends.
english.completion: You have freed my brothers? Good.$B$BWe are in your debt.
english.completed: Return to Bold Karasshi at the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 上古力量
text.objectives: 收集8个古代猢狲遗物。
text.description: 在我们村里，猢狲遗物是珍贵的施法材料。$B$B我们用猢狲的遗物举行祭典仪式，而且遗物越古老，其中蕴藏的魔力就越强大。$B$B幸运的是，猢狲都是些粗心、肮脏的野兽。它们把遗物随意丢弃在棚屋里和篝火旁。$B$B为我收集一些来，我会好好报答你的。
text.progress: The skulls are precious to my tribe. How many have you collected?
text.completion: It is good to see that you are so resourceful, $n. It is a trait admired by my people.$B$BThe fine specimens you have brought me will produce powerful magic.
text.completed: Return to Bold Karasshi at the Slingtail Pits in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Ancient Power
english.objectives: Collect 8 Ancient Hozen Skulls.
