english.description: temp

text.title: 园丁老吴
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的天禅院找园丁老吴报告。
text.description: 我们这里的规矩并不多，但有一个你必须得记住。如果你想吃饭……$b$b<晓的肚子响了。>$b$b……你就得干活。园丁老吴可以给你分配今天的杂务。他在西边的集市那儿。
text.completion: <Wu addresses you sharply.>$b$b$n, is it? The High Elder's favored $g son:daughter;? Yes, I remember you from the banquet.$b$bDon't expect any special treatment from me, $g boy:young lady;. You'll be working just as hard as the greenest pandaren trainee here.$b$bPerhaps harder.

english.title: Groundskeeper Wu
english.objectives: Report to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
english.description: We don't have many rules here, but we do have one particular rule that is worth remembering. If you want to eat...$b$b<Xiao's stomach grumbles audibly.>$b$b...you have to work. Groundskeeper Wu can give you your chores for the day. He's in the market, to the west.
english.completion: <Wu addresses you sharply.>$b$b$n, is it? The High Elder's favored $g son:daughter;? Yes, I remember you from the banquet.$b$bDon't expect any special treatment from me, $g boy:young lady;. You'll be working just as hard as the greenest pandaren trainee here.$b$bPerhaps harder.

text.title: 称手的武器
text.objectives: 去天禅院的市场附近收集6条藤鞭。$b$b在琼·白花那里买一瓶黑胡桃木萃取物。$b$b从酒仙雷康磊那里买三瓶特苦啤酒。
text.description: 当然首先，$b$b一个好的徒弟需要一把称手的武器。而优秀的徒弟自己制作武器……或者起码要收集一些材料。$b$b附近生长的藤鞭应该可以做成像样的武器。同时你可能也需要买一些黑胡桃木萃取物来处理你的木头。你去的时候顺便弄些啤酒来……$b$b<老吴顿了顿。>$b$b呃……你知道啤酒是干嘛用的对吧。
text.progress: <Wu looks at you expectantly.>
text.completion: <Groundskeeper Wu gratefully scoops up the gathered materials.>$b$bI will have a weapon prepared for you by the end of your training. Now, onto the real work.
text.completed: Return to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

english.title: A Proper Weapon
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Rattan Switches from the area around the market in the Tian Monastery.$b$bPurchase a vial of Black Walnut Extract from June Whiteblossom.$b$bPurchase 3 Triple-Bittered Ales from Brewmaster Lei Kanglei.
english.description: First things first, though.$b$bA proper trainee needs a proper weapon. And a scrupulous trainee builds his own... or at least gathers the materials.$b$bThe switches which grow nearby should suffice for any respectable weapon. You'll also need to shop for black walnut extract to treat the wood. While you're there, get some ale, for...$b$b<Wu pauses.>$b$b...well, you know what ale is for.
english.progress: <Wu looks at you expectantly.>
english.completion: <Groundskeeper Wu gratefully scoops up the gathered materials.>$b$bI will have a weapon prepared for you by the end of your training. Now, onto the real work.
english.completed: Return to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 强壮的后背
text.objectives: 从红烛林吴大妈处拿到沸腾的大锅，再去天禅院找园丁老吴。
text.description: 我们这儿的某些弟子食量过人。有时候我们无法为他们提供足够的食物。碰到这种情况时，我们就不得不寻求帮助。$b$b在西北面的一间小屋里，住着一位好心的大妈，她答应做炖肉给徒弟吃。你的任务就是去找她，并把炖肉带回来。
text.completion: I will see to it that this stew is distributed evenly and appropriately among the trainees.$b$bAfter I set some aside for myself, of course.
text.completed: Speak with Groundskeeper Wu in Tian Monastery.

english.title: A Strong Back
english.objectives: Obtain a Boiling Cauldron from Mother Wu in the Waxwood Forest, then return to Groundskeeper Wu in the Tian Monastery.
english.description: Some of our trainees have... larger-than normal appetites. We have occasionally had difficulty supplying enough food for all of them. In times like these, we have to ask for help.$b$bA kindly older woman, who lives in a small house to the northwest, has agreed to make some stew for our trainees. All you need to do is go and get it.
english.completion: I will see to it that this stew is distributed evenly and appropriately among the trainees.$b$bAfter I set some aside for myself, of course.
english.completed: Speak with Groundskeeper Wu in Tian Monastery.

text.title: 稳健的双手
text.objectives: 从红烛林中的猩红叶树丛提取出80瓶猩红叶萃取物。
text.description: 你从白花小姐那儿买来的黑胡桃木萃取物只是我们储藏的诸多萃取物中的一种，这些萃取物的用途各不相同。$b$b猩红叶萃取物可以从西面红烛林中的花中提取。能从一朵花中提取的萃取物可不止一份，但是只有那些心无杂念，并有稳健的双手的人，才能从一朵花中提取到所有的萃取物。
text.progress: It is said that the ancient herbalism masters were able to remove 20 vials of extract from each blossom.
text.completion: Do not forget to wash your hands. Blushleaf stains forever.
text.completed: Return to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

english.title: A Steady Hand
english.objectives: Obtain 80 vials of Blushleaf Extract from Blushleaf Clusters in the Waxwood Forest.
english.description: The black walnut extract you purchased from Miss Whiteblossom is but one of many extracts we keep in stock for various applications.$b$bBlushleaf extract can be gathered from the flowers in the Waxwood Forest to the west. Several units can be extracted from one flower, but only those with calm nerves and steady hands can remove all of the extract from one flower.
english.progress: It is said that the ancient herbalism masters were able to remove 20 vials of extract from each blossom.
english.completion: Do not forget to wash your hands. Blushleaf stains forever.
english.completed: Return to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 沉重的拳头
text.objectives: 杀死10只红烛林中的绿木欺诈者。
text.description: 红烛林西面的绿木林精原本无法对我们构成直接威胁。但最近，随着它们数量的增多，它们的诡计也多了起来。$b$b作为园林的守卫，我们有责任维护这里的平衡。而你的责任就是要将这些恶魔杀死。
text.completion: Thank you, $n. The sprites' numbers will return in several days' time, but for now, the balance is maintained.
text.completed: Return to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

english.title: And a Heavy Fist
english.objectives: Slay 10 Greenwood Tricksters in the Waxwood Forest.
english.description: The greenwood sprites in the Waxwood Forest to the west pose no direct threat to us, this is true. However, their numbers have increased as of late, as have their wily antics.$b$bPart of our duty as wardens of this forest is to maintain the balance. Your duty is to do so by returning these sprites to the earth.
english.completion: Thank you, $n. The sprites' numbers will return in several days' time, but for now, the balance is maintained.
english.completed: Return to Groundskeeper Wu at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 明亮地燃烧
text.objectives: 杀死6只红烛林老虎。
text.description: 能不能帮我个忙，徒弟$n？$b$b在我到禅院以前，我曾对战斗一无所知。在我为徒的时光里，我表现出众，但从来没有遇到过真正的危险。现在，作为一名毕业生和一个带薪护卫，我必须要不惜一切代价保护这里。$b$b我能对付那些绿木林精，但西边红烛林里的老虎可就不一样了。你能帮我收拾一下它们吗？
text.completion: Thank you, $n. A thousand times, thank you.
text.completed: Return to Guard Shan Long outside the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Burning Bright
english.objectives: Slay 6 Waxwood tigers.
english.description: Might I ask a favor of you, trainee $n?$b$bBefore I came to the monastery, I was a stranger to battle. During my time as a trainee, I performed adequately, but I was never placed in any real danger. Now, as a graduate and a wage-earning guard, I am expected to protect this perimeter at all costs.$b$bI can handle greenwood sprites, but the tigers in the western Waxwood are something different altogether. Would you mind taking care of them for me?
english.completion: Thank you, $n. A thousand times, thank you.
english.completed: Return to Guard Shan Long outside the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 战备状态
text.objectives: 在天禅院的比武中击败8名天禅院新徒。
text.description: 好了，$r。我要看看你的资质如何。$b$b你可以在禅院各处找到我的弟子，去和他们过过招，不要留情面。因为他们也会这样对你。$b$b不论输赢，比武之后你们都会变得更强大。
text.completion: <Master Stone Fist eyes you warily.>$b$bAlright, I've seen enough. No more beating up on the younger pupils. We will proceed to the next phase.
text.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

english.title: Becoming Battle-Ready
english.objectives: Defeat 8 Tian Pupils in sparring matches at the Tian Monastery.
english.description: Alright, $r. I'd like to see what you're really made of.$b$bYou'll find my pupils all over the monastery. Challenge them to fights. Push them to their limits. They have been instructed to do the same to you.$b$bWin or lose, you both will come out of the fight stronger.
english.completion: <Master Stone Fist eyes you warily.>$b$bAlright, I've seen enough. No more beating up on the younger pupils. We will proceed to the next phase.
english.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

text.title: 灵巧的齐齐
text.objectives: 在天禅院击败齐齐。
text.description: 在我右手边的山坡上，有一只名叫齐齐的猢狲。他也赢了好几场比武的胜利，够得上晋级了。我想他会给你带来不小的麻烦。$b$b向他发出挑战，然后尽全力击败他。
text.completion: It appears that I must move you up the ranks yet again, $c.
text.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 快拳如风，脑袋空空。

english.title: Zhi-Zhi, the Dextrous
english.objectives: Defeat Zhi-Zhi at the Tian Monastery.
english.description: Upon the hills to my right, you will find a hozen named Zhi-Zhi. He, too, won enough sparring matches to move up the ranks. I think he will provide you with more of a challenge.$b$bChallenge him, and try to defeat him.
english.completion: It appears that I must move you up the ranks yet again, $c.
english.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: Fights with blinding speed and a less-than-blinding intellect.

text.title: 枯瘦的胡苏安
text.objectives: 在天禅院向胡苏安发起挑战并击败他。
text.description: 锦鱼人是熊猫人的长期盟友，我们欢迎他们当中的任何一员来到我们的禅院。胡苏安是锦鱼人的萨满长者，也是我们最新加入的徒弟。$b$b他的功夫平平，但仍不失为一名凶猛的格斗家。和他切磋再合适不过。
text.completion: I must warn you, $C:$b$bIf you continue defeating my best trainees, I will no longer be able to train you. And then you will have no excuse to enjoy the presence of my company.$b$bThink wisely before you quickly dispatch any more of my students.$b$b<It is difficult to tell if Master Stone Fist is joking.>
text.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 毫无悬念，你肯定会在有水的地方找到他。

english.title: Husshun, the Wizened
english.objectives: Challenge and defeat Husshun at the Tian Monastery.
english.description: The jinyu are long-standing allies of the pandaren, and we welcome any of their kind into our monastery. Husshun, one of their elder shaman, is one of our newest trainees.$b$bHis skills as a monk are mediocre at best, but he is still a fierce combatant. He should provide you with the challenge that you deserve.
english.completion: I must warn you, $C:$b$bIf you continue defeating my best trainees, I will no longer be able to train you. And then you will have no excuse to enjoy the presence of my company.$b$bThink wisely before you quickly dispatch any more of my students.$b$b<It is difficult to tell if Master Stone Fist is joking.>
english.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: Not surprisingly, you can find him by the water.

text.title: 贪吃的晓
text.objectives: 在天禅院向晓发起挑战并击败他。
text.description: 你可能已经在宴会酒桌上见过晓了吧，他是我最棒的学生。我好几次想擢升他，但夏教头坚持认为他需要继续学习如何自律。$b$b但在我看来，如果能赢得每场战斗，那自律简直毫无意义。我很想看看晓能不能在你身上延续他的不败纪录。
text.completion: I must admit, I was never surprised, $r. You are a born fighter, and an excellent $c.
text.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
text.giverWindow: 小心：这家伙有乱扔食物的前科。

english.title: Xiao, the Eater
english.objectives: Challenge and defeat Xiao at the Tian Monastery.
english.description: You may have already met my best student, Xiao, at the banquet tables. I personally would have graduated him several times over, but Instructor Xann insists that he needs more discipline.$b$bIf you ask me, discipline means very little if you win every fight you enter. I'm curious to see if Xiao can keep his streak alive against you.
english.completion: I must admit, I was never surprised, $r. You are a born fighter, and an excellent $c.
english.completed: Return to Master Stone Fist at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
english.giverWindow: Caution: has been known to throw his food.

text.title: 耐力的试炼
text.objectives: 去天禅院的西边找孟教头。
text.description: 我已将毕生所学尽授与你，$n。现在你可以去和孟教头谈一谈。$b$b与我习惯的过招比试相比，她安排的战斗可就没这么传统了。不过，对于你这种旅行冒险者，未来的路难以预测，并且全面掌握各种格斗方式也是一项了不起的成就。$b$b再见$n，祝你剩下的训练一切顺利。
text.completion: Greetings, $n. You are becoming quite famous among the trainees here. I have already heard your name whispered several times, usually between the puffy and discolored lips one of your sparring partners.$b$bI'm looking forward to working with you.

english.title: A Test of Endurance
english.objectives: Report to Instructor Myang on the western side of the Tian Monastery.
english.description: I have taught you everything that I can, $n. It is time you spoke with Instructor Myang.$b$bThe fights that she stages are less traditional than the sparring matches I am used to. Nevertheless, the path of a traveling adventurer like yourself is unpredictable, and a broad knowledge of fighting styles is an admirable trait.$b$bFarewell, $n, and best of luck on the remainder of your training.
english.completion: Greetings, $n. You are becoming quite famous among the trainees here. I have already heard your name whispered several times, usually between the puffy and discolored lips one of your sparring partners.$b$bI'm looking forward to working with you.

text.title: 大乱斗
text.objectives: 在制衡之环中点燃禅院烟火，然后在大乱斗中坚持两分钟。
text.description: 石拳大师已经把一对一的格斗技巧传授给你。现在你要学的是以一敌多的本领。$b$b五十个对手怎么样？$b$b去下面的制衡之环，等你准备好了就点燃这只烟火。我的助手会三五成群地去找你。$b$b而你需要做的很简单，撑过去。
text.completion: Your $c fighting style is strong, $n. Our trainees could learn much from watching you.
text.completed: Return to Instructor Myang at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

english.title: The Rumpus
english.objectives: Set off the Monastery Fireworks in the Ring of Inner Focus, then survive the Rumpus for two minutes.
english.description: Master Stone Fist has trained you in the art of one-on-one combat. Now you learn the art of one-on-many.$b$bHow does fifty sound?$b$bLower yourself into the Ring of Inner Focus below, then, when you're ready, set off this firework. My assistants will come at you, several at a time.$b$bAll you need to do is survive.
english.completion: Your $c fighting style is strong, $n. Our trainees could learn much from watching you.
english.completed: Return to Instructor Myang at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.

text.title: UNUSED
text.objectives: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
text.description: Your training is over, young one. The cycle is complete. Thankfully, this particular cycle ends exactly where it started... with a banquet.$b$bI will meet you over at the banquet grounds. I will likely be dancing on a table.

english.title: UNUSED
english.objectives: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Your training is over, young one. The cycle is complete. Thankfully, this particular cycle ends exactly where it started... with a banquet.$b$bI will meet you over at the banquet grounds. I will likely be dancing on a table.

text.title: 流光溢彩
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的天禅院向云瀑长老报告。
text.description: $n，你通过了我们为你准备的所有试炼。是时候去见见大场面了。$b$b……但你得先参加另一场宴会。长老将在宴会地等着你，庆祝你通过禅院的试炼。
text.completion: Congratulations, $n. While your traineeship was strictly honorary, your results were undeniably impressive. The young ones look up to you.$b$bGroundskeeper Wu had this prepared for you. Please, use it as you see fit.

english.title: Flying Colors
english.objectives: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Tian Monastery in the Jade Forest.
english.description: You have passed every test we prepared for you, $n. It is now time for you to move on to bigger and better things.$b$b...but not before another banquet. The High Elder will be waiting for you at the banquet grounds to celebrate your graduation from our monastery.
english.completion: Congratulations, $n. While your traineeship was strictly honorary, your results were undeniably impressive. The young ones look up to you.$b$bGroundskeeper Wu had this prepared for you. Please, use it as you see fit.

text.title: 寻找间谍托古恩
text.objectives: 在奥金顿的暗影迷宫中找到间谍托古恩。
text.description: 暗影议会已经杀死了我们绝大多数的间谍。托古恩虽然得以逃脱，却居然又返回这里并深入了暗影迷宫。他这么做太愚蠢了！$B$B你必须找到他。他或许是个鲁莽的家伙，但我们必须得到他收集到的情报。
text.completion: Do you think you could help me get out of this cage?  It's a bit cramped.

english.title: Find Spy To'gun
english.objectives: Locate Spy To'gun in the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: The Shadow Council has already killed most of our spies, but To'gun was foolish enough to escape only to go back in!$B$BYou must find him. He may be reckless, but we need to find out what he knows.
english.completion: Do you think you could help me get out of this cage?  It's a bit cramped.

text.title: 灵魂装置
text.objectives: 偷走5台灵魂装置，把它们交给在奥金顿暗影迷宫内的间谍格利克萨。
text.description: 他们对我百般磨难，逼迫我说出所知晓的一切。$B$B他们把其他人都送去给了赫尔默，现在该轮到我了。但我什么都没有说！$B$B他们利用一种特殊装置使自己的召唤能力变得更加强大。你必须偷走他们的装置！
text.progress: Were you able to find To'gun?
text.completion: So, these are the soul devices that the Shadow Council were using to enhance their summoning power?  Intriguing.
text.completed: Return to Spy Grik'tha inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

english.title: The Soul Devices
english.objectives: Steal 5 Soul Devices and deliver them to Spy Grik'tha inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: They've been torturing me, trying to get me to tell them everything that I know.$B$BThey fed the others to Hellmaw, and I was to be next. But I told them nothing!$B$BThey're using special devices to make their summoning more powerful. You must steal these devices!
english.progress: Were you able to find To'gun?
english.completion: So, these are the soul devices that the Shadow Council were using to enhance their summoning power?  Intriguing.
english.completed: Return to Spy Grik'tha inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

text.title: 奥金顿的麻烦
text.objectives: 返回泰罗卡森林向奥金顿暗影迷宫里的战地指挥官玛弗恩报道。
text.description: 我在奥金顿的探子给我发来了令人困扰的信息。自从多年以前的一场爆炸以后，那里就成了满是麻烦的是非之地。$B$B那里一定是又出了什么大事，因为暗影议会目前正处于紧张的备战状态。尽管细节内容尚未明确，但他们的军事准备显然在针对暗影迷宫内部。$B$B你必须前往暗影迷宫，战地指挥官玛弗恩会告诉你该做什么。
text.completion: It's about time that you arrived.$B$BMehlisah said that she would be sending help days ago.  And we've been fighting in here longer than that!

english.title: Trouble at Auchindoun
english.objectives: Report to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth at Auchindoun in Terokkar Forest.
english.description: I have spies within Auchindoun and they have been sending me disturbing reports.  That place has been nothing but trouble ever since it exploded a couple of years ago.$B$BSomething in there has gone horribly wrong - again - and the Shadow Council is now on a war footing.  Though the reports were lacking on details, their preparations appear to be directed inward.$B$BYou must make your way to the Shadow Labyrinth.  My field commander, Mahfuun, will fill you in on what needs to be done.
english.completion: It's about time that you arrived.$B$BMehlisah said that she would be sending help days ago.  And we've been fighting in here longer than that!

starters.name: 间谍女王梅丽萨·海克隆

text.title: 鲜血法典
text.objectives: 在奥金顿暗影迷宫内阅读鲜血法典的内容。
text.description: 两年以前，暗影议会进行了一场召唤仪式。正是他们所召唤生物的觉醒把奥金顿化为废墟。$B$B必须要阅读鲜血法典才能确切知道发生了什么。小心行事，沃匹尔大师毕生保护着法典。
text.completion: Opening the magically-suspended tome, a sense of dread overwhelms you.$B$BSomething is most definitely wrong here!

english.title: The Codex of Blood
english.objectives: Read from the Codex of Blood in the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: Two years ago the Shadow Council summoned forth a being that shattered Auchindoun in its wake.$B$BRead the Codex of Blood to find out what happened. Be warned, Grandmaster Vorpil guards it with his life.
english.completion: Opening the magically-suspended tome, a sense of dread overwhelms you.$B$BSomething is most definitely wrong here!

text.title: 深入暗影迷宫
text.objectives: 消灭摩摩尔并通知奥金顿暗影迷宫内的战地指挥官玛弗恩。
text.description: 暗影议会在两年前召唤了一个虚空生物，现在他们失去了对它的控制。$B$B这只名叫摩摩尔的怪物已经威胁到了暗影议会，并可能闯入外部世界！
text.completion: I cringe to think what would have happened had Murmur escaped to the outside world.$B$BThank you, brave hero.
text.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

english.title: Into the Heart of the Labyrinth
english.objectives: Destroy Murmur and inform Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: The Shadow Council has lost control of the cosmic being that they summoned here almost two years ago.$B$BKnown only as Murmur, it threatens to overrun the Shadow Council and break free into the outside world!
english.completion: I cringe to think what would have happened had Murmur escaped to the outside world.$B$BThank you, brave hero.
english.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

text.title: 赫尔默大使
text.objectives: 杀死12名秘教仪祭师和赫尔默大使，然后去奥金顿的暗影迷宫找战地指挥官玛弗恩。
text.description: 秘教徒每次发现我们的间谍，就会把他们送到赫尔默大使那里去。$B$B我们的人需要公正。把那些听命于大使的教徒杀了，然后击败赫尔默本人。$B$B他是罪有应得。
text.completion: It won't bring anyone back, but at least justice has been done.
text.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

english.title: Ambassador Hellmaw
english.objectives: Kill 18 Cabal Ritualists and Ambassador Hellmaw, then return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.
english.description: When the Cabal found our spies, they fed them to Ambassador Hellmaw one by one.$B$BOur men deserve justice. Slay the ritualists binding him, then dispose of Hellmaw.$B$BIt is a most deserving fate.
english.completion: It won't bring anyone back, but at least justice has been done.
english.completed: Return to Field Commander Mahfuun inside the Shadow Labyrinth of Auchindoun.

text.title: 流光溢彩
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的宴会地向云瀑长老报到。
text.description: 我已将毕生所学尽授与你。看起来其他人也是。$b$b云瀑长老将在宴会地点等着你，准备为你践行。并不是我们希望你离去……他只是喜欢庆祝。
text.completion: Congratulations, $n. While your traineeship was strictly honorary, your results were undeniably impressive. The young ones look up to you.$B$BGroundskeeper Wu had this prepared for you. Please, use it as you see fit.

english.title: Flying Colors
english.objectives: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
english.description: Well, I've done all that I can with you. Sounds like the others have, too.$b$bHigh Elder Cloudfall will be waiting at the banquet grounds, ready to celebrate your departure. Not that we're happy you're leaving... he just enjoys celebrations.
english.completion: Congratulations, $n. While your traineeship was strictly honorary, your results were undeniably impressive. The young ones look up to you.$B$BGroundskeeper Wu had this prepared for you. Please, use it as you see fit.

text.title: 流光溢彩
text.objectives: 去翡翠林的宴会地向云瀑长老报到。
text.description: 你的最后一项试炼是：尽情狂欢吧。你已经掌握了禅院教导的训诫。$b$b训练既然从宴会开始，也该以宴会结束。云瀑长老在宴会地等着你。我随后就来。
text.completion: Congratulations, $n. While your traineeship was strictly honorary, your results were undeniably impressive. The young ones look up to you.$B$BGroundskeeper Wu had this prepared for you. Please, use it as you see fit.

english.title: Flying Colors
english.objectives: Report to High Elder Cloudfall at the Banquet Grounds in the Jade Forest.
english.description: The Rumpus was your final test. You have mastered the disciplines taught at this monastery.$b$bJust as your training began with a banquet, so shall it end. High Elder Cloudfall should be waiting at the banquet grounds. I'll be right behind you.
english.completion: Congratulations, $n. While your traineeship was strictly honorary, your results were undeniably impressive. The young ones look up to you.$B$BGroundskeeper Wu had this prepared for you. Please, use it as you see fit.

text.title: 如何拯救一条生命
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的高级斥候卡德维克希望你能帮他带回一份邪能灰烬。
text.description: 冈尼快被一种强大的诅咒折磨死了，$n。$B$B一对神秘的火盆强化了高阶术士奈瑟库斯的能力。如果你能帮我从那个火盆中带回一份灰烬，也许还能对抗这种黑暗魔法。
text.progress: Did you bring the ember? We don't have much time!
text.completion: He was a good soldier.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: How to Save a Life
english.objectives: Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to bring him a Fel Ember.
english.description: Gunny is dying from a powerful curse, $n.$B$BGrand Warlock Nethekurse augments his power with a pair of mystical braziers. If you bring me an ember from that brazier, perhaps it can counteract the dark magic?
english.progress: Did you bring the ember? We don't have much time!
english.completion: He was a good soldier.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 邪能灰烬
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的石头守卫斯托克顿希望你能帮他带回一份邪能灰烬。
text.description: 卡萨雷兹不该受到这样的折磨。$B$B高阶术士奈瑟库斯对他下了恶咒。如果你能从他的火盆中拿来一份灰烬，也许我们还来得及对抗这种魔法。
text.progress: Did you bring the ember? Caza'rez deserves a warrior's death.
text.completion: I will sing many songs of his glories.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: Fel Ember
english.objectives: Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to bring him a Fel Ember.
english.description: Caza'rez is dying a coward's death.$B$BGrand Warlock Netherkurse placed a terrible curse upon him. Perhaps if you were to bring me one of the embers from his braziers, we could use it to counteract the magic before it's too late?
english.progress: Did you bring the ember? Caza'rez deserves a warrior's death.
english.completion: I will sing many songs of his glories.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 安息
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的卡萨雷兹要你杀死4个碎手军团士兵、2个碎手百夫长和2个碎手勇士。
text.description: 他们的精英战士冷酷无情……又……如此强大。$B$B<卡萨雷兹开始吐血。>$B$B你必须杀死他们……否则我们永远无法击败卡加斯……
text.completion: Caza'rez...is no more.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: Honor the Dying
english.objectives: Caza'rez inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to kill 4 Shattered Hand Legionnaires, 2 Shattered Hand Centurions, and 2 Shattered Hand Champions.
english.description: Their elite warriors are ruthless...so... powerful.$B$B<Caza'rez spits up blood.>$B$BYou have to kill them...or we will never defeat Kargath...
english.completion: Caza'rez...is no more.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 帮最后一个忙
text.objectives: 在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的冈尼要你杀死4个碎手军团士兵，2个碎手百夫长和2个碎手勇士。
text.description: 老冈尼的日子不多了……$B$B帮我最后一个忙，杀掉那些最强壮、最凶残的邪兽人。$B$B就当为了我们往日的情谊，怎么样？
text.completion: If only we could have saved him.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Peninsula.

english.title: One Last Favor
english.objectives: Gunny inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel wants you to kill 4 Shattered Hand Legionnaires, 2 Shattered Hand Centurions, and 2 Shattered Hand Champions.
english.description: Ol' Gunny doesn't have much longer...$B$BDo me one last favor, and kill the biggest, meanest fel orcs ye can find.$B$BFor old times' sake, aye?
english.completion: If only we could have saved him.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Peninsula.

text.title: 酋长的意志
text.objectives: 把卡加斯酋长之拳带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的石头守卫斯托克顿。
text.description: 卡加斯曾是部落最伟大的英雄之一。$B$B可他现在成了邪恶的酋长。把那把以他的名字命名的武器给我拿来，这样他在我们的心目中就永远是那个勇士，而不是后来的那个怪物。
text.progress: Have you proof of Kargath Bladefist's defeat?
text.completion: We should not forget the orc Kargath once was, nor the lessons to be learned from his downfall.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
text.giverWindow: 他已经不再是过去的那个他了。

english.title: The Will of the Warchief
english.objectives: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: Kargath was once one of the Horde's greatest heroes.$B$BHe now wears the false mantle of Warchief. Bring me his namesake weapon so that we can remember the champion he once was, rather than the monster he's become.
english.progress: Have you proof of Kargath Bladefist's defeat?
english.completion: We should not forget the orc Kargath once was, nor the lessons to be learned from his downfall.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.giverWindow: His will is no longer his own.

text.title: 扭转局势
text.objectives: 把卡加斯酋长之拳带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的高级斥候卡德维克。
text.description: 只有一种方法能彻底终结邪兽人对联盟和荣耀堡的威胁。$B$B必须杀死他们的酋长。$B$B给我带来以他的名字命名的武器，这样我们就会永远记住他的死。
text.progress: Have you returned with proof of 'Warchief' Kargath Bladefist's demise?
text.completion: We have struck a major blow against the enemy with your help.$B$BHonor Hold is far safer than it's been in years.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
text.giverWindow: 消灭他是这场战争的主要目的。

english.title: Turning the Tide
english.objectives: Bring Warchief Kargath's Fist to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: There is only one true way to end the fel orc threat to Honor Hold and the Alliance.$B$BTheir Warchief must be slain.$B$BBring me his namesake weapon, so that we can always remember his death.
english.progress: Have you returned with proof of 'Warchief' Kargath Bladefist's demise?
english.completion: We have struck a major blow against the enemy with your help.$B$BHonor Hold is far safer than it's been in years.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.giverWindow: Eliminating him is a key goal in this war.

text.title: 特殊的布
text.objectives: 杀死战争使者沃姆罗格，把他的战袍带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的石头守卫斯托克顿。
text.description: 战争使者沃姆罗格杀死了无数勇敢的战士，我从没见过这样的对手。他冷血狡诈，极为强大。$B$B干掉他，把他的战袍给我带来，我们可以把它做成旗帜，让敌人看看部落的怒火！
text.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
text.completion: Well done. This will show those blood crazed monsters what they're up against.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: A Very Special Cloth
english.objectives: Kill Warbringer O'mrogg and bring his warcloth to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: Warbringer O'mrogg has killed more brave soldiers than any enemy I've ever encountered. He is ruthless, cunning, and extremely powerful.$B$BTake him down and bring me his warcloth so that we may fashion it into a banner and show them the fury of the Horde!
english.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
english.completion: Well done. This will show those blood crazed monsters what they're up against.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Stok'ton inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 沃姆罗格的战袍
text.objectives: 杀死战争使者沃姆罗格，把他的战袍带给在地狱火堡垒破碎大厅里的高级斥候卡德维克。
text.description: 暴风城想要看看我们在战场上的成果。$B$B与其把一个一个装尸袋拿出来，还不如把最强大的战士——战争使者沃姆罗格的战袍给他们看看。你能对付他吗？
text.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
text.completion: My superiors will be very pleased to see this. Thank you.
text.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

english.title: O'mrogg's Warcloth
english.objectives: Kill Warbringer O'mrogg and bring his warcloth to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.
english.description: Stormwind wants to see proof of our successes in the war effort.$B$BRather than showing him body bags, I thought we'd present him the warcloth of O'mrogg, Kargath's fiercest warrior. Think you can handle him?
english.progress: Did you bring me the cloth?
english.completion: My superiors will be very pleased to see this. Thank you.
english.completed: Return to Advance Scout Chadwick inside the Shattered Halls of Hellfire Citadel.

text.title: 能力越强，责任越大
text.objectives: 阿达尔要你前往风暴要塞的能源舰，杀死机械领主卡帕西图斯。
text.description: <你的脑海中响起一个银铃般的声音。>$B$B能源舰使用我们一族的科技制造了魔法晶格，这种东西能提供强大的能量。$B$B我要你去消灭机械领主卡帕西图斯，这样凯尔萨斯就没法获得这种能量了。
text.completion: You have done well, $n. But more work remains to be done.
text.giverWindow: 不要害怕。
text.turninWindow: 我们的任务还未完成。

english.title: With Great Power, Comes Great Responsibility
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Mechano-Lord Capacitus in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
english.description: <A voice like the sound of light bells rings in your head.>$B$BThe Mechanar employs my race's technology to create manacells, objects which provide great amounts of power.$B$BI need you to eliminate Mechano-Lord Capacitus so that Kael'thas' forces cannot harvest that power.
english.completion: You have done well, $n. But more work remains to be done.
english.giverWindow: Do not be alarmed.
english.turninWindow: Our work here is not yet complete.

text.title: 计算者
text.objectives: 阿达尔要你前往风暴要塞的能源舰，杀死计算者帕萨雷恩。
text.description: <清风拂过你的脸庞。>$B$B还有一个任务没完成。$B$B计算者帕萨雷恩替他的主子监督着许多行动。最近的大部分灾难都是他一手造成的。$B$B我要你去消灭他。
text.completion: You have my gratitude, $n.
text.giverWindow: 你必须践行我的意志。
text.turninWindow: 希望仍在。

english.title: The Calculator
english.objectives: A'dal has asked you to slay Pathaleon the Calculator in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
english.description: <A gentle wind caresses your face.>$B$BOne more task yet remains.$B$BPathaleon the Calculator oversees many of his master's operations. He is personally responsible for much of the recent torment that has plagued this world.$B$BI ask that you eliminate him.
english.completion: You have my gratitude, $n.
english.giverWindow: You must enact my will.
english.turninWindow: Hope yet remains.

text.title: 丢失的宝物
text.objectives: 前往风暴要塞的能源舰，为阿达尔拿回军团宝箱中的光耀之怒。
text.description: 我能感觉到，我们族人的一件神器被人偷走并藏到了军团宝箱中。$B$B我们不能给他们足够的时间来发现它的力量。如果你能杀死看守者，并帮我拿回它，我将十分感激。
text.progress: You've obtained it, I assume?
text.completion: You have done well. Any advantage we can take away from Kael'thas' forces is to our benefit.
text.giverWindow: 我们不能让它落入歹徒的手中！
text.turninWindow: 谢谢你的努力。

english.title: Lost Treasure
english.objectives: Retrieve the Blinding Fury for A'dal from the Cache of the Legion in the Mechanar of Tempest Keep.
english.description: I sense that one of my kind's artifacts has been taken and stashed away in the Cache of the Legion.$B$BWe cannot give them time to discover its power. If you would kill the Gatewatchers and retrieve it for me, I would be most grateful.
english.progress: You've obtained it, I assume?
english.completion: You have done well. Any advantage we can take away from Kael'thas' forces is to our benefit.
english.giverWindow: We cannot let it fall into the wrong hands.
english.turninWindow: Your efforts are appreciated.

text.title: 拯救生态船
text.objectives: 阿达尔希望你能前往风暴要塞的生态船，杀死指挥官萨拉妮丝、高级植物学家弗雷温以及看管者索恩格林。
text.description: 凯尔萨斯在生态船的部队没能控制住里面的无数怪物。我们必须纠正他们的错误。$B$B第一步就是消灭他们的力量，使他们无法进一步造成麻烦。
text.completion: They were going to die to the creatures contained here soon even without our interference. It is for the greater good.
text.giverWindow: 你能帮助我吗？
text.turninWindow: 现在，我们得收拾这场试验了。

english.title: Saving the Botanica
english.objectives: A'dal wants you to kill Commander Sarannis, High Botanist Freywinn, and Thorngrin the Tender inside the Botanica of Tempest Keep.
english.description: Kael'thas' forces in the Botanica were unsuccessful in handling the numerous creatures contained within. We must take action to right their wrongs.$B$BThe first step is to eliminate their forces so that they cannot cause further problems.
english.completion: They were going to die to the creatures contained here soon even without our interference. It is for the greater good.
english.giverWindow: Will you help me?
english.turninWindow: Now, we must deal with the experiments.

text.title: 戒躁
text.objectives: 踩着梅花桩并敲响那口钟。
text.description: 我打算通过冥想来寻找涓流的踪迹。在这段时间里，你可以通过锻炼和修行增强自己的能力。$B$B你的第一个任务和所有进入咏之池的徒弟的一样：踩着西边的梅花桩，并在不掉入池中的情况下敲响那口钟。$B$B一旦掉下去，在池水的诅咒效果的影响下，你将无法再次站上梅花桩，你需要回到池边重新开始。$B$B噢，还有，小心那些鹤。
text.progress: Have you done as I asked of you?
text.completion: Good. You're a quick study.
text.completed: Return to Aysa Cloudsinger in the Singing Pools.

english.title: The Lesson of Dry Fur
english.objectives: Cross the balance poles and ring the training bell.
english.description: Through meditation, I intend to find a route to locating Shu. In the meantime, you would benefit from practice and discipline.$B$BYour first task is the task of all trainees entering the pools: cross the balance poles to the west and ring the bell without falling into the pool.$B$BShould you fall, the pool's curse will make it difficult to get on a pole again, so you will need to return to the edge of the pool to start over.$B$BOh, and beware the cranes.
english.progress: Have you done as I asked of you?
english.completion: Good. You're a quick study.
english.completed: Return to Aysa Cloudsinger in the Singing Pools.
